Напишіть код на Ruby для наведеного нижче завдання. Почніть із Gemfile, у якому перелічено всі геми, потрібні коду, а потім наведіть реалізацію.

Завдання: Експортуйте товари на Prom.ua у форматі YML та імпортуйте замовлення через API Prom.ua.
text:
# Експорт товарів у Prom.ua (YML) та імпорт замовлень через API Prom.ua ## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.1" gem "nokogiri", "~> 1.16" # генерація YML (XML) gem "faraday", "~> 2.9" # HTTP-клієнт для API Prom.ua gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2" # повторні спроби при 429/5xx gem "thor", "~> 1.3" # CLI gem "dotenv", "~> 3.1" # конфігурація через .env gem "bigdecimal", "~> 3.1" # точна робота з грошима group :development, :test do gem "rspec", "~> 3.13" gem "webmock", "~> 3.23" gem "rake", "~> 13.2" end ``` ## Структура проєкту ``` .env Gemfile bin/prom lib/prom_sync.rb lib/prom_sync/product.rb lib/prom_sync/yml_exporter.rb lib/prom_sync/client.rb lib/prom_sync/order.rb lib/prom_sync/order_importer.rb lib/prom_sync/order_store.rb lib/prom_sync/product_source.rb spec/prom_sync_spec.rb ``` ## `.env` ```dotenv PROM_API_TOKEN=ваш_токен_з_кабінету_prom SHOP_NAME=Мій магазин SHOP_COMPANY=ТОВ "Мій магазин" SHOP_URL=https://example.com ``` ## `lib/prom_sync.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "json" require "set" require "time" require "bigdecimal" require "bigdecimal/util" require "fileutils" require "tempfile" require "logger" require "nokogiri" require "faraday" require "faraday/retry" module PromSync class Error < StandardError; end def self.logger @logger ||= Logger.new($stdout, level: Logger::INFO) end def self.logger=(logger) @logger = logger end end require_relative "prom_sync/product" require_relative "prom_sync/yml_exporter" require_relative "prom_sync/client" require_relative "prom_sync/order" require_relative "prom_sync/order_importer" require_relative "prom_sync/order_store" require_relative "prom_sync/product_source" ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/product.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync Category = Struct.new(:id, :name, :parent_id, keyword_init: true) Product = Struct.new( :id, :name, :price, :old_price, :currency, :category_id, :available, :quantity, :vendor, :vendor_code, :description, :pictures, :params, :keywords, :group_id, keyword_init: true ) do def initialize(*) super self.currency ||= "UAH" self.available = true if available.nil? self.pictures ||= [] self.params ||= {} end # Повертає список помилок валідації (порожній — товар коректний) def errors errs = [] errs << "id порожній" if id.to_s.strip.empty? errs << "name порожнє" if name.to_s.strip.empty? errs << "price некоректна" if price.nil? || price.to_d <= 0 errs << "category_id порожній" if category_id.to_s.strip.empty? errs end def valid? errors.empty? end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/yml_exporter.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync # Генерує YML-файл (Yandex Market Language), який підтримує Prom.ua. class YmlExporter attr_reader :skipped def initialize(shop_name:, company:, url:, products:, categories:, currency: "UAH") @shop_name = shop_name @company = company @url = url @products = products @categories = categories @currency = currency @skipped = [] end # Повертає XML як рядок def to_xml valid_products = select_valid_products builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: "UTF-8") do |xml| xml.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) do xml.shop do xml.name_ @shop_name xml.company @company xml.url @url build_currencies(xml) build_categories(xml) xml.offers do valid_products.each { |product| build_offer(xml, product) } end end end end builder.to_xml end # Атомарний запис у файл (щоб Prom ніколи не завантажив напівзаписаний файл) def write(path) xml = to_xml FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path)) Tempfile.create(["yml", ".tmp"], File.dirname(path)) do |tmp| tmp.write(xml) tmp.flush File.rename(tmp.path, path) end PromSync.logger.info("YML записано: #{path} (пропущено товарів: #{skipped.size})") path end private def select_valid_products category_ids = @categories.map { |c| c.id.to_s }.to_set @products.select do |product| problems = product.errors if problems.empty? && !category_ids.include?(product.category_id.to_s) problems << "категорія #{product.category_id} відсутня в списку категорій" end next true if problems.empty? @skipped << { id: product.id, errors: problems } PromSync.logger.warn("Товар #{product.id.inspect} пропущено: #{problems.join('; ')}") false end end def build_currencies(xml) xml.currencies do xml.currency(id: @currency, rate: 1) end end def build_categories(xml) xml.categories do @categories.each do |cat| attrs = { id: cat.id } attrs[:parentId] = cat.parent_id if cat.parent_id xml.category(cat.name, attrs) end end end def build_offer(xml, p) attrs = { id: p.id, available: p.available ? "true" : "false" } attrs[:group_id] = p.group_id if p.group_id xml.offer(attrs) do xml.name_ p.name xml.price format_money(p.price) xml.oldprice format_money(p.old_price) if p.old_price && p.old_price.to_d > p.price.to_d xml.currencyId p.currency xml.categoryId p.category_id p.pictures.compact.reject(&:empty?).each { |url| xml.picture url } xml.vendor p.vendor if present?(p.vendor) xml.vendorCode p.vendor_code if present?(p.vendor_code) xml.stock_quantity p.quantity.to_i unless p.quantity.nil? xml.keywords p.keywords if present?(p.keywords) xml.description { xml.cdata(p.description.to_s) } if present?(p.description) p.params.each do |param_name, value| next unless present?(value) xml.param(value.to_s, name: param_name.to_s) end end end def format_money(value) format("%.2f", value.to_d) end def present?(value) !value.to_s.strip.empty? end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/client.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync # Тонка обгортка над REST API Prom.ua (https://public-api.docs.prom.ua) class Client BASE_URL = "https://my.prom.ua" class ApiError < Error attr_reader :status, :body def initialize(status, body) @status = status @body = body super("Prom API error #{status}: #{body.to_s[0, 500]}") end end class AuthError < ApiError; end def initialize(token:, base_url: BASE_URL, timeout: 30) raise ArgumentError, "PROM_API_TOKEN не заданий" if token.to_s.empty? @conn = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f| f.request :retry, max: 4, interval: 1, backoff_factor: 2, retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504], methods: %i[get post] f.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{token}" f.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json" f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json" f.options.timeout = timeout f.options.open_timeout = 10 end end # GET /api/v1/orders/list # Параметри: status, date_from, date_to, limit, last_id # Повертає масив замовлень (Hash). def orders(status: nil, date_from: nil, date_to: nil, limit: 100, last_id: nil) params = { status: status, date_from: iso(date_from), date_to: iso(date_to), limit: limit, last_id: last_id }.compact request(:get, "/api/v1/orders/list", params).fetch("orders", []) end # GET /api/v1/orders/:id def order(id) request(:get, "/api/v1/orders/#{Integer(id)}").fetch("order") end # POST /api/v1/orders/set_status # status: pending, received, delivered, canceled, paid def set_status(ids:, status:, cancellation_reason: nil, cancellation_text: nil) body = { ids: Array(ids), status: status, cancellation_reason: cancellation_reason, cancellation_text: cancellation_text }.compact request(:post, "/api/v1/orders/set_status", nil, body) end private def iso(time) return nil if time.nil? time.respond_to?(:iso8601) ? time.iso8601 : time.to_s end def request(method, path, params = nil, body = nil) response = @conn.run_request(method, path, body && JSON.generate(body), nil) do |req| req.params.update(params) if params end handle(response) rescue Faraday::Error => e raise Error, "Мережева помилка при зверненні до Prom API: #{e.message}" end def handle(response) case response.status when 200..299 response.body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(response.body) when 401, 403 raise AuthError.new(response.status, response.body) else raise ApiError.new(response.status, response.body) end end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/order.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync OrderItem = Struct.new( :product_id, :external_id, :sku, :name, :quantity, :price, :total, keyword_init: true ) Order = Struct.new( :id, :status, :created_at, :customer_name, :phone, :email, :delivery_type, :delivery_address, :delivery_cost, :payment_type, :comment, :total, :items, :raw, keyword_init: true ) do def to_h_for_storage h = to_h h.delete(:raw) h[:items] = items.map(&:to_h) h[:total] = total.to_s("F") if total h[:delivery_cost] = delivery_cost.to_s("F") if delivery_cost h[:items].each do |item| item[:price] = item[:price].to_s("F") if item[:price] item[:total] = item[:total].to_s("F") if item[:total] end h end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/order_importer.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync # Завантажує замовлення з Prom.ua з пагінацією та нормалізує їх. class OrderImporter PAGE_SIZE = 100 def initialize(client:, page_size: PAGE_SIZE) @client = client @page_size = page_size end # Ітерує по всіх замовленнях за фільтром. # Без блоку повертає Enumerator. def each_order(status: nil, date_from: nil, date_to: nil) return enum_for(:each_order, status: status, date_from: date_from, date_to: date_to) unless block_given? seen = Set.new last_id = nil loop do batch = @client.orders( status: status, date_from: date_from, date_to: date_to, limit: @page_size, last_id: last_id ) break if batch.empty? fresh = batch.reject { |raw| seen.include?(raw["id"]) } break if fresh.empty? # захист від зациклення fresh.each do |raw| seen << raw["id"] yield normalize(raw) end break if batch.size < @page_size last_id = batch.last["id"] end end # Імпортує нові замовлення у сховище; повертає кількість доданих. def import(store:, status: nil, date_from: nil, date_to: nil) added = 0 each_order(status: status, date_from: date_from, date_to: date_to) do |order| if store.add(order) added += 1 PromSync.logger.info("Нове замовлення ##{order.id} (#{order.status}), сума: #{order.total&.to_s('F')}") end end added end def normalize(raw) items = Array(raw["products"]).map do |p| OrderItem.new( product_id: p["id"], external_id: p["external_id"], sku: p["sku"], name: p["name"], quantity: p["quantity"].to_i, price: parse_money(p["price"]), total: parse_money(p["total_price"]) ) end Order.new( id: raw["id"], status: raw["status"], created_at: parse_time(raw["date_created"]), customer_name: full_name(raw), phone: raw["phone"], email: raw["email"], delivery_type: raw.dig("delivery_option", "name"), delivery_address: raw["delivery_address"], delivery_cost: parse_money(raw["delivery_cost"]), payment_type: raw.dig("payment_option", "name"), comment: raw["client_notes"], total: parse_money(raw["full_price"] || raw["price"]), items: items, raw: raw ) end private def full_name(raw) [raw["client_last_name"], raw["client_first_name"], raw["client_second_name"]] .compact.map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?).join(" ") end # Prom повертає суми як "1 250,50 грн." — залишаємо лише цифри та роздільник def parse_money(value) return nil if value.nil? return value.to_d if value.is_a?(Numeric) cleaned = value.to_s.gsub(/[^\d,.\-]/, "").tr(",", ".") cleaned.empty? ? nil : cleaned.to_d end def parse_time(value) value && Time.parse(value) rescue ArgumentError nil end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/order_store.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync # Найпростіше сховище: JSON Lines + дедуплікація за id. # У реальному проєкті замініть на ActiveRecord/Sequel — достатньо реалізувати #add(order). class OrderStore def initialize(path) @path = path FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path)) @ids = load_ids end # Повертає true, якщо замовлення нове def add(order) return false if @ids.include?(order.id) File.open(@path, "a") { |f| f.puts(JSON.generate(order.to_h_for_storage)) } @ids << order.id true end def include?(id) @ids.include?(id) end private def load_ids return Set.new unless File.exist?(@path) File.foreach(@path).each_with_object(Set.new) do |line, set| line = line.strip set << JSON.parse(line)["id"] unless line.empty? end end end end ``` ## `lib/prom_sync/product_source.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true module PromSync # Приклад джерела даних: JSON-файл. # Замініть на вибірку з вашої БД, повертаючи Product і Category. # # Формат файлу: # { # "categories": [{"id": 1, "name": "Одяг"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Футболки", "parent_id": 1}], # "products": [{"id": "A1", "name": "Футболка", "price": 350, "category_id": 2, # "quantity": 10, "pictures": ["https://..."], "params": {"Розмір": "M"}}] # } class JsonProductSource def initialize(path) @data = JSON.parse(File.read(path)) end def categories @data.fetch("categories").map do |c| Category.new(id: c["id"], name: c["name"], parent_id: c["parent_id"]) end end def products @data.fetch("products").map do |h| Product.new( id: h["id"], name: h["name"], price: h["price"], old_price: h["old_price"], currency: h["currency"], category_id: h["category_id"], available: h.fetch("available", true), quantity: h["quantity"], vendor: h["vendor"], vendor_code: h["vendor_code"], description: h["description"], pictures: h["pictures"], params: h["params"], keywords: h["keywords"], group_id: h["group_id"] ) end end end end ``` ## `bin/prom` (CLI) ```ruby #!/usr/bin/env ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "bundler/setup" require "dotenv/load" require "thor" require_relative "../lib/prom_sync" class PromCLI < Thor def self.exit_on_failure? = true desc "export_yml SOURCE_JSON OUTPUT_XML", "Експортує товари у YML для Prom.ua" def export_yml(source_path, output_path = "public/prom.yml") source = PromSync::JsonProductSource.new(source_path) exporter = PromSync::YmlExporter.new( shop_name: ENV.fetch("SHOP_NAME"), company: ENV.fetch("SHOP_COMPANY"), url: ENV.fetch("SHOP_URL"), products: source.products, categories: source.categories ) exporter.write(output_path) puts "Готово. Пропущено товарів: #{exporter.skipped.size}" end desc "import_orders", "Імпортує замовлення з Prom.ua у JSONL-файл" option :status, type: :string, desc: "pending, received, delivered, canceled, paid" option :days, type: :numeric, default: 7, desc: "За скільки останніх днів" option :store, type: :string, default: "data/orders.jsonl" def import_orders client = PromSync::Client.new(token: ENV["PROM_API_TOKEN"]) importer = PromSync::OrderImporter.new(client: client) store = PromSync::OrderStore.new(options[:store]) added = importer.import( store: store, status: options[:status], date_from: Time.now - options[:days] * 86_400, date_to: Time.now ) puts "Імпортовано нових замовлень: #{added}" rescue PromSync::Error => e warn "Помилка: #{e.message}" exit 1 end desc "set_status ID STATUS", "Змінює статус замовлення в Prom.ua" def set_status(id, status) client = PromSync::Client.new(token: ENV["PROM_API_TOKEN"]) client.set_status(ids: [id.to_i], status: status) puts "Статус замовлення #{id} змінено на #{status}" end end PromCLI.start(ARGV) ``` ## `spec/prom_sync_spec.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "bundler/setup" require "webmock/rspec" require_relative "../lib/prom_sync" RSpec.describe PromSync::YmlExporter do let(:categories) { [PromSync::Category.new(id: 1, name: "Одяг")] } let(:good) do PromSync::Product.new(id: "A1", name: "Футболка & топ", price: 350, category_id: 1, quantity: 5, pictures: ["https://x.ua/1.jpg"], description: "

Опис

", params: { "Розмір" => "M" }) end let(:bad) { PromSync::Product.new(id: "B1", name: "", price: 0, category_id: 1) } it "генерує коректний YML і пропускає невалідні товари" do exporter = described_class.new(shop_name: "Shop", company: "Co", url: "https://x.ua", products: [good, bad], categories: categories) doc = Nokogiri::XML(exporter.to_xml) expect(doc.xpath("//offer").size).to eq(1) expect(doc.at_xpath("//offer/name").text).to eq("Футболка & топ") expect(doc.at_xpath("//offer/price").text).to eq("350.00") expect(doc.at_xpath("//offer/param[@name='Розмір']").text).to eq("M") expect(exporter.skipped.size).to eq(1) end end RSpec.describe PromSync::OrderImporter do it "імпортує та нормалізує замовлення" do stub_request(:get, "https://my.prom.ua/api/v1/orders/list") .with(query: hash_including("limit" => "100")) .to_return(status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json" }, body: JSON.generate( orders: [{ id: 42, status: "pending", date_created: "2024-05-01T10:00:00", client_first_name: "Іван", client_last_name: "Петренко", phone: "380501112233", full_price: "1 250,50 грн.", products: [{ id: 1, name: "Товар", quantity: 2, price: "625,25 грн.", total_price: "1 250,50 грн." }] }] )) client = PromSync::Client.new(token: "t") orders = described_class.new(client: client).each_order.to_a expect(orders.size).to eq(1) expect(orders.first.customer_name).to eq("Петренко Іван") expect(orders.first.total).to eq(BigDecimal("1250.50")) expect(orders.first.items.first.quantity).to eq(2) end end ``` ## Запуск ```bash bundle install bundle exec rspec # Експорт товарів (потім віддайте public/prom.yml по URL і вкажіть його у кабінеті Prom.ua) bundle exec ruby bin/prom export_yml products.json public/prom.yml # Імпорт замовлень за останні 3 дні зі статусом pending bundle exec ruby bin/prom import_orders --days 3 --status pending # Зміна статусу замовлення bundle exec ruby bin/prom set_status 12345 received ``` ## Примітки - **Токен API** створюється в кабінеті Prom.ua: *Налаштування → Управління API токенами*. Він передається як `Authorization: Bearer `. - **YML:** файл має бути доступний за публічним URL. У кабінеті Prom.ua його додають у розділі імпорту товарів з автоматичним оновленням. Для регулярного оновлення додайте команду `export_yml` у cron. - **Пагінація замовлень** працює через `last_id`. Захист від дублікатів (`seen`) не дає циклу зависнути, якщо порядок сортування відрізняється від очікуваного. - **Сховище:** `OrderStore` є мінімальним прикладом. Для продакшну реалізуйте такий самий метод `add(order)` поверх вашої БД, наприклад ActiveRecord з унікальним індексом за `prom_order_id`.

Write Ruby code for the task below. Start with a Gemfile that lists every gem the code needs, then give the implementation.

Task: Convert DOCX documents to HTML and to plain text.
text:
## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.0" gem "nokogiri", "~> 1.16" # XML parsing of the DOCX internals gem "rubyzip", ">= 2.3" # DOCX files are ZIP archives ``` Everything else used (`optparse`-free CLI, own HTML escaping, `pack("m0")` for base64) is plain Ruby, so no other gems are needed. ## docx_convert.rb ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "nokogiri" require "zip" # Converts DOCX documents to HTML and plain text. # # DocxConvert.to_html("report.docx") # full HTML page # DocxConvert.to_html("report.docx", fragment: true) # just the body markup # DocxConvert.to_text("report.docx") # plain text # # Both outputs are generated from the same intermediate model, so they stay consistent. module DocxConvert class Error < StandardError; end # ---------------------------------------------------------------- model --- Document = Struct.new(:blocks) Run = Struct.new(:text, :bold, :italic, :underline, :strike, :sup, :sub) do def format_key = to_a.drop(1) end Link = Struct.new(:href, :children) Break = Struct.new(:kind) Image = Struct.new(:data_uri, :alt) ListInfo = Struct.new(:num_id, :level, :ordered) Table = Struct.new(:rows) Cell = Struct.new(:blocks, :colspan) Paragraph = Struct.new(:inlines, :heading, :list) do def blank? inlines.none? { |i| visible?(i) } end private def visible?(inline) case inline when Run then !inline.text.strip.empty? when Link then inline.children.any? { |c| visible?(c) } when Image then !(inline.data_uri.nil? && inline.alt.to_s.strip.empty?) else false end end end # --------------------------------------------------------------- parser --- class Parser W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" NS = { "w" => W, "r" => R, "a" => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main", "wp" => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing", "rel" => "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships" }.freeze MAX_ENTRY_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024 MIME_TYPES = { ".png" => "image/png", ".jpg" => "image/jpeg", ".jpeg" => "image/jpeg", ".gif" => "image/gif", ".bmp" => "image/bmp", ".webp" => "image/webp", ".svg" => "image/svg+xml" }.freeze def initialize(path, include_images: true) @path = path @include_images = include_images end def parse raise Error, "File not found: #{@path}" unless File.file?(@path) Zip::File.open(@path) do |zip| @zip = zip xml = read_entry("word/document.xml") or raise Error, "Missing word/document.xml - not a DOCX file?" @rels = load_relationships @styles = load_styles @numbering = load_numbering body = xml_doc(xml).at_xpath("/w:document/w:body", NS) or raise Error, "DOCX has no document body" return Document.new(parse_blocks(body)) end rescue Zip::Error => e raise Error, "Not a valid DOCX file: #{e.message}" end private # ---- package helpers ---- def xml_doc(data) Nokogiri::XML(data) { |cfg| cfg.nonet } # no network access, no entity expansion end def read_entry(name) entry = @zip.find_entry(name) or return nil data = entry.get_input_stream { |io| io.read(MAX_ENTRY_BYTES + 1) } raise Error, "#{name} is too large" if data && data.bytesize > MAX_ENTRY_BYTES data end def attr(node, name, ns = W) node&.attribute_with_ns(name, ns)&.value end def word?(node) node.element? && node.namespace&.href == W end def load_relationships xml = read_entry("word/_rels/document.xml.rels") or return {} xml_doc(xml).xpath("//rel:Relationship", NS).each_with_object({}) do |n, h| h[n["Id"]] = { target: n["Target"], mode: n["TargetMode"] } end end def load_styles xml = read_entry("word/styles.xml") or return {} xml_doc(xml).xpath("//w:style[@w:type='paragraph']", NS).each_with_object({}) do |s, h| name = attr(s.at_xpath("w:name", NS), "val") h[attr(s, "styleId")] = name if name end end # => { "numId" => { level(Integer) => ordered?(Boolean) } } def load_numbering xml = read_entry("word/numbering.xml") or return {} doc = xml_doc(xml) abstract = doc.xpath("//w:abstractNum", NS).each_with_object({}) do |an, h| h[attr(an, "abstractNumId")] = an.xpath("w:lvl", NS).each_with_object({}) do |lvl, levels| fmt = attr(lvl.at_xpath("w:numFmt", NS), "val") levels[attr(lvl, "ilvl").to_i] = !%w[bullet none].include?(fmt) end end doc.xpath("//w:num", NS).each_with_object({}) do |n, h| abs_id = attr(n.at_xpath("w:abstractNumId", NS), "val") h[attr(n, "numId")] = abstract[abs_id] || {} end end # ---- block level ---- def parse_blocks(container) container.element_children.flat_map do |node| next [] unless word?(node) case node.name when "p" then [parse_paragraph(node)] when "tbl" then [parse_table(node)] when "sdt" content = node.at_xpath("w:sdtContent", NS) content ? parse_blocks(content) : [] else [] end end end def parse_paragraph(p) ppr = p.at_xpath("w:pPr", NS) style_id = attr(ppr&.at_xpath("w:pStyle", NS), "val") heading = heading_level(style_id) list = heading ? nil : parse_list(ppr) Paragraph.new(parse_inlines(p), heading, list) end def heading_level(style_id) return nil unless style_id name = (@styles[style_id] || style_id).to_s.downcase case name when /\Aheading\s*([1-9])\z/ then [Regexp.last_match(1).to_i, 6].min when "title" then 1 end end def parse_list(ppr) num_pr = ppr&.at_xpath("w:numPr", NS) or return nil num_id = attr(num_pr.at_xpath("w:numId", NS), "val") return nil if num_id.nil? || num_id == "0" level = attr(num_pr.at_xpath("w:ilvl", NS), "val").to_i ordered = @numbering.dig(num_id, level) || false ListInfo.new(num_id, level, ordered) end def parse_table(tbl) rows = tbl.xpath("w:tr", NS).map do |tr| tr.xpath("w:tc", NS).map do |tc| span = attr(tc.at_xpath("w:tcPr/w:gridSpan", NS), "val").to_i Cell.new(parse_blocks(tc), span < 1 ? 1 : span) end end Table.new(rows) end # ---- inline level ---- def parse_inlines(node) node.element_children.flat_map do |child| next [] unless word?(child) case child.name when "r" then parse_run(child) when "hyperlink" then [parse_hyperlink(child)] when "ins", "smartTag", "fldSimple", "customXml" parse_inlines(child) when "sdt" content = child.at_xpath("w:sdtContent", NS) content ? parse_inlines(content) : [] else [] # bookmarks, deleted text (w:del), proofing marks, ... end end end def parse_hyperlink(node) rid = attr(node, "id", R) href = if rid @rels.dig(rid, :target) elsif (anchor = attr(node, "anchor")) "##{anchor}" end Link.new(href, parse_inlines(node)) end def parse_run(run) rpr = run.at_xpath("w:rPr", NS) fmt = [ toggle(rpr, "b"), toggle(rpr, "i"), underline?(rpr), toggle(rpr, "strike"), attr(rpr&.at_xpath("w:vertAlign", NS), "val") == "superscript", attr(rpr&.at_xpath("w:vertAlign", NS), "val") == "subscript" ] out = [] buffer = +"" flush = lambda do out << Run.new(buffer.dup, *fmt) unless buffer.empty? buffer.clear end run.element_children.each do |c| next unless word?(c) case c.name when "t" then buffer << c.text when "tab" then buffer << "\t" when "noBreakHyphen" then buffer << "-" when "br", "cr" flush.call out << Break.new(:line) when "drawing" flush.call img = parse_image(c) out << img if img end end flush.call out end def toggle(rpr, name) el = rpr&.at_xpath("w:#{name}", NS) or return false !%w[0 false off].include?(attr(el, "val")) end def underline?(rpr) el = rpr&.at_xpath("w:u", NS) or return false attr(el, "val") != "none" end def parse_image(drawing) alt = drawing.at_xpath(".//wp:docPr", NS)&.[]("descr").to_s blip = drawing.at_xpath(".//a:blip", NS) rid = attr(blip, "embed", R) uri = nil if @include_images && rid && (target = @rels.dig(rid, :target)) path = target.start_with?("/") ? target[1..] : "word/#{target}" mime = MIME_TYPES[File.extname(path).downcase] data = mime && read_entry(path) uri = "data:#{mime};base64,#{[data].pack('m0')}" if data end Image.new(uri, alt) end end # ------------------------------------------------------------ HTML out --- class HtmlRenderer ESCAPES = { "&" => "&", "<" => "<", ">" => ">", '"' => """, "'" => "'" }.freeze SAFE_SCHEMES = %w[http https mailto tel].freeze def initialize(title: "Document") @title = title end def render(doc, fragment: false) body = render_blocks(doc.blocks) return body if fragment <<~HTML #{esc(@title)} #{body} HTML end private def esc(text) text.to_s.gsub(/[&<>"']/, ESCAPES) end def render_blocks(blocks) out = [] stack = [] # open lists: { tag:, level: } blocks.each do |b| if b.is_a?(Paragraph) && b.blank? next elsif b.is_a?(Paragraph) && b.list open_item(out, stack, b.list) out << render_inlines(b.inlines) else close_lists(out, stack) out << (b.is_a?(Table) ? render_table(b) : render_paragraph(b)) end end close_lists(out, stack) out.join("\n") end def open_item(out, stack, list) tag = list.ordered ? "ol" : "ul" while stack.any? && stack.last[:level] > list.level out << "" end if stack.any? && stack.last[:level] == list.level if stack.last[:tag] == tag out << "" else out << "" out << "<#{tag}>" stack << { tag: tag, level: list.level } end else out << "<#{tag}>" stack << { tag: tag, level: list.level } end out << "
  • " end def close_lists(out, stack) out << "
    • " while stack.any? end def render_paragraph(p) tag = p.heading ? "h#{p.heading}" : "p" "<#{tag}>#{render_inlines(p.inlines)}" end def render_table(table) rows = table.rows.map do |row| cells = row.map do |cell| span = cell.colspan > 1 ? %( colspan="#{cell.colspan}") : "" "#{render_blocks(cell.blocks)}" end "#{cells.join}" end "\n#{rows.join("\n")}\n
    " end def render_inlines(inlines) merge_runs(inlines).map do |i| case i when Run then render_run(i) when Link then render_link(i)

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Extracts oblast, district, city, street, building and apartment
# from a free-text Ukrainian postal address.
#
#   UkrainianAddress.parse("61000, Харківська обл., м. Харків, просп. Науки 14/2, кв. 31")
#
# Note: Ruby's \w and \b are ASCII-only, so \p{L} and lookarounds are used throughout.
module UkrainianAddress
  Address = Struct.new(
    :postal_code, :oblast, :district, :city, :city_type,
    :street, :street_type, :building, :korpus, :apartment,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def to_s
      [
        postal_code,
        oblast,
        district,
        city && "#{city_type} #{city}",
        street && "#{street_type} #{street}",
        building && "буд. #{building}#{korpus && ", корп. #{korpus}"}",
        apartment && "кв. #{apartment}"
      ].compact.join(", ")
    end
  end

  class Parser
    STREET_TYPES = {
      "вулиця" => "вулиця", "вул" => "вулиця",
      "проспект" => "проспект", "просп" => "проспект",
      "пр-т" => "проспект", "пр-кт" => "проспект",
      "провулок" => "провулок", "пров" => "провулок",
      "бульвар" => "бульвар", "бул" => "бульвар", "б-р" => "бульвар",
      "площа" => "площа", "пл" => "площа",
      "набережна" => "набережна", "наб" => "набережна",
      "шосе" => "шосе", "узвіз" => "узвіз", "тупик" => "тупик",
      "алея" => "алея", "майдан" => "майдан"
    }.freeze

    CITY_TYPES = {
      "місто" => "місто", "м" => "місто",
      "смт" => "смт",
      "селище" => "селище", "с-ще" => "селище",
      "село" => "село", "с" => "село"
    }.freeze

    TYPES = STREET_TYPES.keys.sort_by { -_1.length }.map { Regexp.escape(_1) }.join("|")

    # Regexp fragments (strings, so the /i flag of the outer regexp applies)
    LETTER_WORD = %q{\p{L}[\p{L}'-]*}
    STREET_WORD = %q{(?:\p{L}[\p{L}'-]*|\d+(?:-?\p{L}+)?)}
    NUM         = %q{\d+\p{L}?(?:\s*[/-]\s*\d+\p{L}?)?}
    BUILD_KW    = %q{(?:буд(?:инок)?|б)(?![\p{L}])}
    APT_KW      = %q{(?:кв(?:артира)?|оф(?:іс)?)(?![\p{L}])}
    KORP_KW     = %q{корп(?:ус)?(?![\p{L}])}

    # Where a (lazily matched) street name may end.
    STREET_END = %r{(?=\s*(?:[,;]|\z)|\s+(?:#{BUILD_KW}|#{APT_KW}|#{KORP_KW})|\s+#{NUM}(?:\s*(?:[,;]|\z)|\s+(?:#{APT_KW}|#{KORP_KW})))}.source
    # Where a (lazily matched) city name may end.
    CITY_END = %r{(?=\s*(?:[,;]|\z)|\s+(?:#{TYPES})(?![\p{L}])|\s+\d)}.source

    POSTAL   = %r{(?<!\d)(?<code>\d{5})(?!\d)}
    COUNTRY  = %r{(?<![\p{L}])Україна(?![\p{L}])}i
    APARTMENT = %r{(?<![\p{L}])(?:кв(?:артира)?|оф(?:іс)?)\.?\s*№?\s*(?<apt>\d+\p{L}?)(?![\p{L}\d])}i
    KORPUS   = %r{(?<![\p{L}])корп(?:ус)?\.?\s*№?\s*(?<k>\d+|\p{L})(?![\p{L}\d])}i

    BARE_NUM = %r{(?<![\p{L}\d])(?<num>#{NUM})(?![\p{L}\d])}

Завдання: Перевірте IBAN і BIC, введені у формі, та покажіть зрозуміле повідомлення про помилку, якщо будь-який із них некоректний.

## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.0" gem "sinatra", "~> 4.0" # веб-фреймворк для форми gem "puma" # веб-сервер gem "iban-tools" # перевірка IBAN (країна, довжина, формат, контрольна сума) group :test do gem "minitest" gem "rack-test" end ``` ## lib/bank_details_validator.rb ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "iban-tools" # Перевіряє IBAN і BIC та повертає зрозумілі повідомлення про помилки (українською). class BankDetailsValidator # 4 літери (банк) + 2 літери (країна) + 2 символи (локація) + необов'язкові 3 символи (філія) BIC_FORMAT = /\A[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}(?:[A-Z0-9]{3})?\z/ IBAN_ERROR_MESSAGES = { invalid_country: "IBAN містить невідомий або непідтримуваний код країни.", invalid_length: "IBAN має неправильну довжину для вказаної країни.", invalid_format: "Формат IBAN не відповідає правилам для вказаної країни.", invalid_checksum: "IBAN містить помилку: контрольні цифри не збігаються. " \ "Перевірте, чи не допущено друкарської помилки." }.freeze Result = Struct.new(:iban, :bic, :errors) do def valid? errors.empty? end end def self.call(iban:, bic:) new(iban, bic).call end def initialize(iban, bic) @iban = normalize(iban) @bic = normalize(bic) end def call errors = {} iban_error = validate_iban bic_error = validate_bic errors[:iban] = iban_error if iban_error errors[:bic] = bic_error if bic_error Result.new(@iban, @bic, errors) end private # Прибирає пробіли (в т.ч. нерозривні) та переводить у верхній регістр def normalize(value) value.to_s.gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, "").upcase end def validate_iban return "Введіть IBAN." if @iban.empty? unless @iban.match?(/\A[A-Z0-9]+\z/) return "IBAN може містити лише латинські літери та цифри (без дефісів чи інших символів)." end return "IBAN занадто короткий." if @iban.length < 15 return "IBAN занадто довгий (максимум 34 символи)." if @iban.length > 34 return nil if IBANTools::IBAN.valid?(@iban) reasons = IBANTools::IBAN.new(@iban).validation_errors key = reasons.find { |r| IBAN_ERROR_MESSAGES.key?(r) } IBAN_ERROR_MESSAGES.fetch(key, "Некоректний IBAN. Перевірте введені дані.") end def validate_bic return "Введіть BIC (SWIFT-код)." if @bic.empty? unless [8, 11].include?(@bic.length) return "BIC має містити 8 або 11 символів, а ви ввели #{@bic.length}." end unless @bic.match?(BIC_FORMAT) return "Некоректний формат BIC: перші 6 символів мають бути літерами " \ "(код банку та країни), а решта — літерами або цифрами. Приклад: DEUTDEFF або DEUTDEFF500." end nil end end ``` ## app.rb ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "sinatra/base" require_relative "lib/bank_details_validator" class App < Sinatra::Base set :host_authorization, { permitted_hosts: [] } # дозволити будь-який хост (для демо) helpers do def h(text) Rack::Utils.escape_html(text.to_s) end end get "/" do @values = { iban: "", bic: "" } @errors = {} erb :index end post "/" do result = BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: params[:iban], bic: params[:bic]) @values = { iban: params[:iban].to_s, bic: params[:bic].to_s } @errors = result.errors if result.valid? @success = "Реквізити коректні: IBAN #{result.iban}, BIC #{result.bic}." status 200 else status 422 end erb :index end run! if app_file == $PROGRAM_NAME end __END__ @@index Перевірка IBAN і BIC

Банківські реквізити

<% if @success %>
<%= h @success %>
<% end %>
<% if @errors[:iban] %>
<%= h @errors[:iban] %>
<% end %> <% if @errors[:bic] %>
<%= h @errors[:bic] %>
<% end %>
``` ## test/validator_test.rb ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "minitest/autorun" require_relative "../lib/bank_details_validator" class BankDetailsValidatorTest < Minitest::Test def test_valid_data r = BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: "de89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00", bic: "deutdeff") assert r.valid? assert_equal "DE89370400440532013000", r.iban end def test_valid_11_char_bic assert BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: "DE89370400440532013000", bic: "COBADEFFXXX").valid? end def test_wrong_checksum r = BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: "DE89370400440532013001", bic: "DEUTDEFF") refute r.valid? assert_match(/контрольні цифри/, r.errors[:iban]) assert_nil r.errors[:bic] end def test_invalid_bic r = BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: "DE89370400440532013000", bic: "DEUT12FF") refute r.valid? assert_match(/Некоректний формат BIC/, r.errors[:bic]) end def test_both_invalid_and_empty r = BankDetailsValidator.call(iban: "", bic: "ABC") assert_equal "Введіть IBAN.", r.errors[:iban] assert_match(/8 або 11 символів/, r.errors[:bic]) end end ``` ## Запуск ```bash bundle install ruby app.rb # відкрийте http://localhost:4567 ruby -Itest test/validator_test.rb ``` ## Як це працює - **Нормалізація**: пробіли видаляються, регістр підвищується, тому `de89 3704 …` приймається. - **IBAN**: спочатку перевіряються порожнє значення, допустимі символи й довжина. Потім гем `iban-tools` перевіряє країну, формат і контрольну суму (mod 97), а причина помилки перетворюється на зрозуміле повідомлення. - **BIC**: перевіряється довжина (8 або 11) і структура: 4 літери банку, 2 літери країни, 2 символи локації та необов'язкові 3 символи філії. - **Форма**: обидва поля перевіряються одночасно, тож користувач бачить усі помилки одразу. Невірні поля підсвічуються, введені значення зберігаються, а весь вивід екранується через `Rack::Utils.escape_html`. У разі помилок повертається HTTP 422. Примітка: BIC перевіряється лише за форматом, без звірки з реєстром SWIFT. Щоб підтвердити, що такий код справді існує, потрібен зовнішній довідник або API.

```ruby
# whatsapp_template_sender.rb
require "httparty"
require "json"
require "dotenv/load"

class WhatsAppTemplateSender
  include HTTParty

  base_uri "https://graph.facebook.com"
  format :json

  def initialize(phone_number_id:, access_token:, api_version: "v21.0")
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
    @api_version = api_version
  end

  # Надсилає шаблонне повідомлення WhatsApp.
  #
  # components — масив компонентів шаблону, наприклад:
  # [
  #   {
  #     type: "body",
  #     parameters: [
  #       { type: "text", text: "Іван" }
  #     ]
  #   }
  # ]
  def send_template(to:, template_name:, language_code:, components: [])
    endpoint = "/#{@api_version}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"

    body = {
      messaging_product: "whatsapp",
      recipient_type: "individual",
      to: to,
      type: "template",
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: { code: language_code }
      }
    }

    body[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = self.class.post(
      endpoint,
      headers: {
        "Authorization" => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        "Content-Type" => "application/json"
      },
      body: body.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise WhatsAppAPIError, error_message(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def error_message(response)
    parsed = response.parsed_response

    message = if parsed.is_a?(Hash) && parsed.dig("error", "message")
                parsed.dig("error", "message")
              else
                response.body
              end

    "HTTP #{response.code}: #{message}"
  end
end

class WhatsAppAPIError < StandardError; end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  sender = WhatsAppTemplateSender.new(
    phone_number_id: ENV.fetch("WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID"),
    access_token: ENV.fetch("WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN"),
    api_version: ENV.fetch("WHATSAPP_API_VERSION", "v21.0")
  )

  result = sender.send_template(
    to: "380XXXXXXXXX",
    template_name: "hello_world",
    language_code: "uk",
    components: [
      {
        type: "body",
        parameters: [
          { type: "text", text: "Іван" }
        ]
```

```ruby
# app/services/shopify_sync_service.rb
class ShopifySyncService
  include HTTParty

  base_uri "https://#{ENV['SHOPIFY_DOMAIN']}/admin/api/#{ENV.fetch('SHOPIFY_API_VERSION', '2024-10')}"
  headers 'X-Shopify-Access-Token' => ENV['SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  format :json

  class ShopifyAPIError < StandardError; end

  def sync
    sync_products
    sync_inventory_levels
  end

  private

  def sync_products
    page_info = nil

    loop do
      query = { limit: 250 }
      query[:page_info] = page_info if page_info

      response = self.class.get('/products.json', query: query)
      raise_shopify_error(response) unless response.success?

      response.parsed_response['products'].each do |product_data|
        upsert_product(product_data)
      end

      page_info = extract_next_page_info(response.headers['link'])
      break unless page_info
    end
  end

  def sync_inventory_levels
    fetch_location_ids.each do |location_id|
      page_info = nil

      loop do
        query = { limit: 250, location_ids: location_id }
        query[:page_info] = page_info if page_info

        response = self.class.get('/inventory_levels.json', query: query)
        raise_shopify_error(response) unless response.success?

        response.parsed_response['inventory_levels'].each do |level_data|
          upsert_inventory_level(level_data)
        end

        page_info = extract_next_page_info(response.headers['link'])
        break unless page_info
      end
    end
  end

  def fetch_location_ids
    response = self.class.get('/locations.json')
    raise_shopify_error(response) unless response.success?

    response.parsed_response['locations'].map { |location| location['id'] }
  end

  def upsert_product(data)
    product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(shopify_id: data['id'])
    product.update!(
      title: data['title'],
      body_html: data['body_html'],
      vendor: data['vendor'],
      product_type: data['product_type'],
      handle: data['handle'],
      status: data['status'],
      published_at: data['published_at'],
      tags: data['tags'],
      json_data: data
    )
  end

  def upsert_inventory_level(data)
    level = InventoryLevel.find_or_initialize_by(
      shopify_inventory_item_id: data['inventory_item_id'],
      shopify_location_id: data['location_id']
    )
    level.update!(
      available: data['available'],
      shopify_updated_at: data['updated_at'],
      json_data: data
    )
  end

  def extract_next_page_info(link_header)
    return nil if link_header.nil? || link_header.empty?

    match = link_header.match(/<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="next"/)
    return nil unless match

    uri = URI.parse(match[1])
    return nil if uri.query.nil? || uri.query.empty?

    URI.decode_www_form(uri.query).to_h['page_info']
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    nil
  end

  def raise_shopify_error(response)
    raise ShopifyAPIError,
          "Shopify API request failed: #{response.code} #{response.message} #{response.body}"
  end
end
```

Task: Send push notifications to Android and iOS devices through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "googleauth", "~> 1.11"  # OAuth2 for the FCM HTTP v1 API (service account)
gem "faraday",    "~> 2.9"   # HTTP client
```

Run `bundle install` after saving it.

## fcm_notifier.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "faraday"
require "googleauth"

# Sends push notifications to Android and iOS devices via Firebase Cloud
# Messaging, using the HTTP v1 API (the legacy server-key API has been shut down).
#
# Setup:
#   1. Firebase console -> Project settings -> Service accounts -> Generate new private key.
#   2. Point FCM_CREDENTIALS (or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) at that JSON file.
#   3. For iOS, upload your APNs auth key in Firebase console -> Cloud Messaging.
class FcmNotifier
  SCOPE           = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging"
  RETRYABLE_CODES = [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].freeze
  MAX_ATTEMPTS    = 4

  # Outcome of a single send.
  Result = Struct.new(:token, :success, :message_id, :error_code, :error_message, :http_status,
                      keyword_init: true) do
    def success? = success

    # True when the token should be deleted from your database.
    def invalid_token?
      %w[UNREGISTERED INVALID_ARGUMENT].include?(error_code) && http_status != 429
    end
  end

  class ConfigurationError < StandardError; end

  def initialize(credentials_path: ENV["FCM_CREDENTIALS"] || ENV["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"],
                 logger: nil)
    raise ConfigurationError, "Set FCM_CREDENTIALS to your service account JSON path" if credentials_path.to_s.empty?
    raise ConfigurationError, "Credentials file not found: #{credentials_path}" unless File.file?(credentials_path)

    key_data    = JSON.parse(File.read(credentials_path))
    @project_id = key_data.fetch("project_id") { raise ConfigurationError, "project_id missing in credentials" }
    @logger     = logger
    @mutex      = Mutex.new

    @credentials = Google::Auth::ServiceAccountCredentials.make_creds(
      json_key_io: File.open(credentials_path),
      scope: SCOPE
    )

    @http = Faraday.new(url: "https://fcm.googleapis.com") do |f|
      f.options.timeout      = 15
      f.options.open_timeout = 5
      f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
  end

  # Send to a single device token (Android or iOS, FCM handles routing).
  def send_to_token(token, title:, body:, **options)
    deliver(build_message({ token: token }, title: title, body: body, **options), token)
  end

  # Send to everyone subscribed to a topic.
  def send_to_topic(topic, title:, body:, **options)
    deliver(build_message({ topic: topic }, title: title, body: body, **options), topic)
  end

  # Send to a condition, e.g. "'news' in topics && 'sports' in topics".
  def send_to_condition(condition, title:, body:, **options)
    deliver(build_message({ condition: condition }, title: title, body: body, **options), condition)
  end

  # Send to many tokens concurrently. HTTP v1 has no multicast endpoint, so this
  # fans out single requests over a small thread pool. Returns Results in input order.
  def send_to_tokens(tokens, title:, body:, concurrency: 10, **options)
    tokens  = tokens.uniq
    queue   = Queue.new
    results = Array.new(tokens.size)
    tokens.each_with_index { |t, i| queue << [t, i] }

    workers = Array.new([concurrency, tokens.size].min) do
      Thread.new do
        loop do
          token, index = begin
            queue.pop(true)
          rescue ThreadError
            break
          end
          results[index] = send_to_token(token, title: title, body: body, **options)
        end
      end
    end
    workers.each(&:join)
    results
  end

  # Validate a message without delivering it.
  def dry_run(token, title:, body:, **options)
    deliver(build_message({ token: token }, title: title, body: body, **options), token, validate_only: true)
  end

  private

  # Builds the v1 message with platform-specific overrides for Android and iOS.
  def build_message(target, title:, body:, data: {}, image: nil, badge: nil, sound: "default",
                    channel_id: nil, priority: :high, ttl: nil, collapse_key: nil)
    notification = { title: title, body: body }
    notification[:image] = image if image

    android_notification = { sound: sound }
    android_notification[:channel_id] = channel_id if channel_id

    android = {
      priority: priority.to_s.upcase == "HIGH" ? "HIGH" : "NORMAL",
      notification: android_notification
    }
    android[:ttl]          = "#{ttl.to_i}s" if ttl
    android[:collapse_key] = collapse_key if collapse_key

    aps = { sound: sound }
    aps[:badge] = badge if badge
    apns_headers = { "apns-priority" => priority.to_s.upcase == "HIGH" ? "10" : "5" }
    apns_headers["apns-expiration"] = (Time.now.to_i + ttl.to_i).to_s if ttl
    apns_headers["apns-collapse-id"] = collapse_key if collapse_key
    apns_payload = { aps: aps }
    apns_payload[:aps][:"mutable-content"] = 1 if image # lets an iOS extension download the image

    message = target.merge(
      notification: notification,
      android: android,
      apns: { headers: apns_headers, payload: apns_payload }
    )
    # FCM requires every data value to be a string.
    message[:data] = data.to_h { |k, v| [k.to_s, v.to_s] } unless data.empty?
    message
  end

  def deliver(message, label, validate_only: false)
    payload = { message: message }
    payload[:validate_only] = true if validate_only

    attempts = 0
    begin
      attempts += 1
      response = @http.post("/v1/projects/#{@project_id}/messages:send") do |req|
        req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
        req.headers["Content-Type"]  = "application/json"
        req.body = JSON.generate(payload)
      end

      if RETRYABLE_CODES.include?(response.status) && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS
        wait = backoff(attempts, response.headers["retry-after"])
        log(:warn, "FCM #{response.status} for #{label}; retry #{attempts}/#{MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1} in #{wait}s")
        sleep wait
        raise RetryableError
      end

      # An expired/revoked token on our side: refresh once and retry.
      if response.status == 401 && attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS
        refresh_token!
        raise RetryableError
      end

      parse_response(response, label)
    rescue RetryableError
      retry
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      if attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS
        sleep backoff(attempts)
        retry
      end
      Result.new(token: label, success: false, error_code: "NETWORK_ERROR", error_message: e.message)
    end
  end

  class RetryableError < StandardError; end

  def parse_response(response, label)
    body = response.body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(response.body)

    if response.success?
      Result.new(token: label, success: true, message_id: body["name"], http_status: response.status)
    else
      error   = body["error"] || {}
      details = Array(error["details"])
      fcm_err = details.find { |d| d["errorCode"] }&.fetch("errorCode")
      code    = fcm_err || error["status"] || "HTTP_#{response.status}"
      log(:error, "FCM send failed for #{label}: #{code} - #{error['message']}")
      Result.new(token: label, success: false, error_code: code,
                 error_message: error["message"], http_status: response.status)
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    Result.new(token: label, success: false, error_code: "BAD_RESPONSE",
               error_message: response.body.to_s[0, 200], http_status: response.status)
  end

  # Cached OAuth2 token, refreshed a minute before expiry. Thread-safe.
  def access_token
    @mutex.synchronize do
      stale = @credentials.access_token.nil? ||
              @credentials.expires_at.nil? ||
              @credentials.expires_at <= Time.now + 60
      @credentials.fetch_access_token! if stale
      @credentials.access_token
    end
  end

  def refresh_token!
    @mutex.synchronize { @credentials.fetch_access_token! }
  end

  def backoff(attempt, retry_after = nil)
    return [retry_after.to_i, 60].min if retry_after.to_s.match?(/\A\d+\z/)

    (2**(attempt - 1)) + rand * 0.5 # 1s, 2s, 4s (+ jitter)
  end

  def log(level, msg)
    @logger&.public_send(level, msg)
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage:
#   FCM_CREDENTIALS=./service-account.json ruby fcm_notifier.rb <device_token>
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require "logger"

  token = ARGV[0] or abort("Usage: ruby fcm_notifier.rb <device_token>")
  fcm   = FcmNotifier.new(logger: Logger.new($stdout))

  result = fcm.send_to_token(
    token,
    title: "Order shipped 📦",
    body: "Your order #1234 is on its way.",
    data: { order_id: 1234, screen: "order_details" },
    badge: 1,
    channel_id: "orders",
    ttl: 3600
  )

  if result.success?
    puts "Sent: #{result.message_id}"
  else
    puts "Failed: #{result.error_code} - #{result.error_message}"
    puts "Remove this token from your database." if result.invalid_token?
  end

  # Topic broadcast:
  #   fcm.send_to_topic("news", title: "Breaking", body: "Something happened")
  #
  # Many devices:
  #   results = fcm.send_to_tokens(tokens, title: "Sale", body: "50% off today")
  #   stale   = results.select(&:invalid_token?).map(&:token)
end
```

## Notes

- **API**: This uses the FCM HTTP v1 API with OAuth2 service-account auth. The old `fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send` server-key API is no longer available.
- **Platforms**: One message carries `android` and `apns` blocks, so FCM applies the right settings per device. This covers priority, sound, badge, channel, TTL, and collapse key.
- **iOS prerequisite**: Upload an APNs auth key (.p8) in the Firebase console, or iOS delivery will fail.
- **Stale tokens**: Check `result.invalid_token?` (`UNREGISTERED` or `INVALID_ARGUMENT`) and delete those tokens from your database.
- **Retries**: 429 and 5xx responses and network errors are retried with exponential backoff, honoring `Retry-After`. A 401 triggers one token refresh.
- **Data payload**: All values are converted to strings, since FCM rejects other types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Alerts API client (alerts.in.ua) with a short cache to respect rate limits. # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class AlertsClient class Error < StandardError; end ENDPOINT = URI("https://api.alerts.in.ua/v1/alerts/active.json") # status: { "Київська область" => :full | :partial } # details: { "Київська область" => ["Бучанський район", ...] } (partial only) Snapshot = Struct.new(:status, :details, :fetched_at, keyword_init: true) def initialize(token, ttl: 25) @token = token @ttl = ttl @snapshot = nil end def snapshot return @snapshot if @snapshot && (Time.now - @snapshot.fetched_at) < @ttl @snapshot = fetch end private def fetch req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(ENDPOINT) req["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{@token}" req["Accept"] = "application/json" res = Net::HTTP.start(ENDPOINT.host, ENDPOINT.port, use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 5, read_timeout: 10) { |http| http.request(req) } raise Error, "alerts API returned HTTP #{res.code}" unless res.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess) parse(JSON.parse(res.body)) rescue JSON::ParserError, SocketError, Timeout::Error, SystemCallError, OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError => e raise Error, "#{e.class}: #{e.message}" end def parse(data) status = {} details = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] } Array(data["alerts"]).each do |alert| next unless alert["alert_type"] == "air_raid" next if alert["finished_at"] oblast = alert["location_oblast"] || alert["location_title"] next unless Regions::BY_UK.key?(oblast) whole = alert["location_type"] == "oblast" || alert["location_title"] == oblast if whole status[oblast] = :full else status[oblast] ||= :partial details[oblast] << alert["location_title"] end end details.delete_if { |oblast, _| status[oblast] == :full } Snapshot.new(status: status, details: details.to_h, fetched_at: Time.now) end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Map renderer: projects GeoJSON polygons to pixels and paints them. # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class MapRenderer include ChunkyPNG::Color WIDTH = 1200 MARGIN = 20 BACKGROUND = rgb(255, 255, 255) OUTLINE = rgb(60, 60, 60) COLORS = { none: rgb(190, 226, 190), partial: rgb(255, 170, 50), full: rgb(222, 38, 38), unknown: rgb(210, 210, 210) }.freeze attr_reader :unmatched def initialize(geojson_path) raise "GeoJSON file not found: #{geojson_path}" unless File.exist?(geojson_path) @unmatched = [] geo = collect_geometries(JSON.parse(File.read(geojson_path))) raise "No Ukrainian regions could be matched in #{geojson_path}" if geo.empty? @regions = project(geo) # { Region => [ [ [x,y], ... ], ... ] } end def render(status) canvas = ChunkyPNG::Canvas.new(@width, @height, BACKGROUND) # Small city-regions are drawn last so they sit on top of their oblast. ordered = @regions.sort_by { |region, _| region.marker ? 1 : 0 } ordered.each do |region, rings| fill = COLORS[status.fetch(region.uk, :none)] rings.each { |ring| canvas.polygon(ring, OUTLINE, fill) } next unless region.marker cx, cy = ring_center(rings.max_by(&:size)) canvas.circle(cx, cy, 9, OUTLINE, fill) end canvas.to_blob end private def collect_geometries(geojson) features = geojson["type"] == "FeatureCollection" ? geojson["features"] : [geojson] result = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] } Array(features).each do |feature| geometry = feature["geometry"] or next props = feature["properties"] || {} region = props.values.grep(String).filter_map { |v| Regions.lookup(v) }.first unless region @unmatched << props.values.grep(String).first(2).join(" / ") next end polygons = case geometry["type"] when "Polygon" then [geometry["coordinates"]] when "MultiPolygon" then geometry["coordinates"] else [] end # Outer rings only; holes (e.g. Kyiv city inside Kyiv oblast) are covered # by drawing the city on top. polygons.each { |poly| result[region] << poly.first } end result end def project(geo) points = geo.values.flatten(2).each_slice(2).to_a lons = points.map(&:first) lats = points.map(&:last) min_lon = lons.min max_lat = lats.max k = Math.cos(48.5 * Math::PI / 180) # compensate longitude shrink at Ukraine's latitude scale = (WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN) / ((lons.max - min_lon) * k) @height = (((max_lat - lats.min) * scale) + 2 * MARGIN).ceil geo.transform_values do |rings| rings.map do |ring| ring.map do |lon, lat| [(MARGIN + (lon - min_lon) * k * scale).round, (MARGIN + (max_lat - lat) * scale).round] end.chunk_while { |a, b| a == b }.map(&:first) # drop duplicate pixels end.select { |ring| ring.size >= 3 } end end def ring_center(ring) xs = ring.map(&:first) ys = ring.map(&:last) [(xs.min + xs.max) / 2, (ys.min + ys.max) / 2] end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Message formatting # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- module Formatter module_function def h(text) CGI.escapeHTML(text.to_s) end def caption(snapshot) full = snapshot.status.select { |_, v| v == :full }.keys partial = snapshot.status.select { |_, v| v == :partial }.keys stamp = snapshot.fetched_at.localtime.strftime("%H:%M:%S") lines = [] if snapshot.status.empty? lines << "✅ No active air-raid alerts" else lines << "🚨 Air-raid alerts in Ukraine" unless full.empty? lines << "🟥 Whole region: #{full.map { |n| h(Regions::BY_UK[n].label) }.join(', ')}" end unless partial.empty? parts = partial.map do |n| districts = snapshot.details[n].to_a.first(4) extra = snapshot.details[n].to_a.size - districts.size text = h(Regions::BY_UK[n].label) text += " (#{h(districts.join(', '))}#{extra.positive? ? " +#{extra}" : ''})" unless districts.empty? text end lines << "🟧 Partial: #{parts.join('; ')}" end end lines << "🟩 No alert" lines << "Updated #{stamp} · source: alerts.in.ua" lines.join("\n") end def help <<~TEXT Ukraine air-raid alert map /map - current alert map /list - current alerts as text /help - this message 🟥 whole region under alert 🟧 alert in some districts or cities 🟩 no alert TEXT end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Boot # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- bot_token = ENV["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"] alerts_token = ENV["ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN"] geojson_path = ENV.fetch("UKRAINE_GEOJSON", "data/ukraine_oblasts.geojson") abort "Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" if bot_token.to_s.empty? abort "Set ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN" if alerts_token.to_s.empty? alerts = AlertsClient.new(alerts_token) renderer = MapRenderer.new(geojson_path) unless renderer.unmatched.empty? warn "Warning: GeoJSON features not matched to any region: #{renderer.unmatched.uniq.join('; ')}" end png_cache = { key: nil, blob: nil } puts "Bot started." Telegram::Bot::Client.run(bot_token) do |bot| bot.listen do |message| next unless message.is_a?(Telegram::Bot::Types::Message) && message.text chat_id = message.chat.id command = message.text.split.first.to_s.split("@").first.to_s.downcase begin case command when "/start", "/help" bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: Formatter.help, parse_mode: "HTML") when "/map", "/alerts" bot.api.send_chat_action(chat_id: chat_id, action: "upload_photo") snap = alerts.snapshot key = snap.status.sort.hash if png_cache[:key] != key png_cache[:blob] = renderer.render(snap.status) png_cache[:key] = key end photo = Faraday::UploadIO.new(StringIO.new(png_cache[:blob]), "image/png", "alert_map.png") bot.api.send_photo(chat_id: chat_id, photo: photo, caption: Formatter.caption(snap), parse_mode: "HTML") when "/list" snap = alerts.snapshot bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: Formatter.caption(snap), parse_mode: "HTML") end rescue AlertsClient::Error => e warn "Alerts API error: #{e.message}" bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "⚠️ Couldn't fetch alert data right now. Please try again shortly.") rescue StandardError => e warn "Error handling #{command}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}" bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "⚠️ Something went wrong.") rescue nil end end end ``` ## Setup 1. **Tokens** - Create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) to get `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`. - Request an API key at to get `ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN`. 2. **Boundary data.** Put a GeoJSON file of Ukraine's oblasts (admin level 1) at `data/ukraine_oblasts.geojson`, or point `UKRAINE_GEOJSON` at one. geoBoundaries ADM1 for Ukraine works, as does any similar file. - The renderer tries every string property of each feature against English and Ukrainian names, with common spellings such as Kyiv/Kiev and Odesa/Odessa. - Any unmatched features are logged at startup and drawn nowhere. If that happens, add their spellings to `Regions`. - Kyiv city and Kyiv Oblast are separate regions. A bare "Kyiv" is treated as the city, and the oblast needs "Oblast" or "Kyivska" in its name. 3. **Run** ```bash bundle install export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=123456:ABC... export ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN=your_alerts_token bundle exec ruby bot.rb ``` ## Behavior - `/map` sends the PNG map with a caption listing the regions under alert. Red means the whole oblast is under alert, orange means only some districts or cities are, and green means no alert. - `/list` sends the same information as text. - Alert data is cached for 25 seconds, and the rendered PNG is reused until the alert state changes. This keeps you within the API's rate limits when many users call `/map`.

Task: Upload product images to Amazon S3, generate thumbnails and serve them through a CDN.
text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for uploading product images to Amazon S3, generating thumbnails, and serving them through a CDN:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'aws-sdk-s3', '~> 1.0'
gem 'mini_magick', '~> 4.12'
gem 'concurrent-ruby', '~> 1.2'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8'
gem 'connection_pool', '~> 2.4'
```

## Implementation

### 1. Configuration (config/initializers/image_service.rb)

```ruby
# config/initializers/image_service.rb
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'concurrent'

module ImageService
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :s3_bucket, :s3_region, :cdn_domain, :thumbnail_sizes,
                  :max_file_size, :allowed_types, :connection_pool_size

    def initialize
      @s3_bucket = ENV['AWS_S3_BUCKET']
      @s3_region = ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1'
      @cdn_domain = ENV['CDN_DOMAIN']
      @thumbnail_sizes = {
        small: [100, 100],
        medium: [300, 300],
        large: [600, 600]
      }
      @max_file_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10MB
      @allowed_types = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp']
      @connection_pool_size = 10
    end
  end

  class << self
    attr_reader :config

    def configure
      @config = Configuration.new
      yield(@config) if block_given?
      @s3_client_pool = ConnectionPool.new(size: @config.connection_pool_size, timeout: 5) do
        Aws::S3::Client.new(
          region: @config.s3_region,
          credentials: Aws::Credentials.new(
            ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
            ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
          )
        )
      end
    end

    def s3_client_pool
      @s3_client_pool
    end
  end
end

# Initialize with default configuration
ImageService.configure unless ImageService.config
```

### 2. Main Image Service (lib/image_service.rb)

```ruby
# lib/image_service.rb
require_relative '../config/initializers/image_service'

module ImageService
  class ImageUploader
    class ValidationError < StandardError; end
    class UploadError < StandardError; end

    attr_reader :original_file, :product_id, :options

    def initialize(file, product_id, options = {})
      @original_file = file
      @product_id = product_id
      @options = options
      validate_file!
    end

    def process
      result = {
        original: nil,
        thumbnails: {},
        metadata: {}
      }

      # Generate unique filename
      filename = generate_filename
      
      # Upload original image
      result[:original] = upload_original(filename)
      
      # Generate and upload thumbnails
      ImageService.config.thumbnail_sizes.each do |size_name, dimensions|
        result[:thumbnails][size_name] = generate_and_upload_thumbnail(
          filename, dimensions, size_name
        )
      end

      # Store metadata
      result[:metadata] = {
        filename: filename,
        content_type: @original_file.content_type,
        original_size: @original_file.size,
        uploaded_at: Time.now.iso8601,
        product_id: @product_id
      }

      result
    rescue => e
      cleanup_on_failure(filename) if filename
      raise UploadError, "Failed to process image: #{e.message}"
    end

    private

    def validate_file!
      unless ImageService.config.allowed_types.include?(@original_file.content_type)
        raise ValidationError, "Unsupported file type: #{@original_file.content_type}"
      end

      if @original_file.size > ImageService.config.max_file_size
        raise ValidationError, "File too large. Maximum size is #{ImageService.config.max_file_size} bytes"
      end
    end

    def generate_filename
      timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%L')
      random_suffix = SecureRandom.hex(8)
      extension = File.extname(@original_file.original_filename)
      "#{@product_id}/#{timestamp}_#{random_suffix}#{extension}"
    end

    def upload_original(filename)
      s3_key = "products/#{@product_id}/original/#{filename}"
      upload_to_s3(s3_key, @original_file.tempfile, @original_file.content_type)
      
      {
        s3_key: s3_key,
        url: cdn_url(s3_key),
        content_type: @original_file.content_type
      }
    end

    def generate_and_upload_thumbnail(filename, dimensions, size_name)
      thumbnail = create_thumbnail(dimensions)
      s3_key = "products/#{@product_id}/thumbnails/#{size_name}/#{filename}"
      
      upload_to_s3(s3_key, thumbnail.path, @original_file.content_type)
      
      {
        s3_key: s3_key,
        url: cdn_url(s3_key),
        dimensions: dimensions,
        size_name: size_name
      }
    ensure
      thumbnail&.destroy! if thumbnail.respond_to?(:destroy!)
    end

    def create_thumbnail(dimensions)
      image = MiniMagick::Image.open(@original_file.tempfile.path)
      
      # Resize and crop to maintain aspect ratio
      image.combine_options do |cmd|
        cmd.resize "#{dimensions[0]}x#{dimensions[1]}^"
        cmd.gravity 'center'
        cmd.extent "#{dimensions[0]}x#{dimensions[1]}"
        cmd.quality '85'
        cmd.strip
      end
      
      # Create temp file for thumbnail
      temp_file = Tempfile.new(['thumbnail', File.extname(@original_file.original_filename)])
      image.write(temp_file.path)
      temp_file
    rescue => e
      temp_file&.close!
      raise "Failed to create thumbnail: #{e.message}"
    end

    def upload_to_s3(s3_key, file_path, content_type)
      ImageService.s3_client_pool.with do |s3_client|
        File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
          s3_client.put_object(
            bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
            key: s3_key,
            body: file,
            content_type: content_type,
            cache_control: 'public, max-age=31536000',
            acl: 'public-read'
          )
        end
      end
    rescue => e
      raise UploadError, "Failed to upload to S3: #{e.message}"
    end

    def cdn_url(s3_key)
      if ImageService.config.cdn_domain
        "https://#{ImageService.config.cdn_domain}/#{s3_key}"
      else
        "https://#{ImageService.config.s3_bucket}.s3.#{ImageService.config.s3_region}.amazonaws.com/#{s3_key}"
      end
    end

    def cleanup_on_failure(filename)
      # Clean up any uploaded files on failure
      prefix = "products/#{@product_id}/"
      ImageService.s3_client_pool.with do |s3_client|
        objects = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
          bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
          prefix: prefix
        )
        
        if objects.contents.any?
          s3_client.delete_objects(
            bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
            delete: {
              objects: objects.contents.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
            }
          )
        end
      end
    rescue => e
      # Log cleanup failure but don't raise
      Rails.logger.error("Failed to cleanup S3 objects: #{e.message}") if defined?(Rails)
    end
  end

  class ImageDeleter
    def initialize(product_id)
      @product_id = product_id
    end

    def delete_all
      prefix = "products/#{@product_id}/"
      
      ImageService.s3_client_pool.with do |s3_client|
        # List all objects for this product
        objects = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
          bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
          prefix: prefix
        )
        
        if objects.contents.any?
          # Delete in batches of 1000 (S3 limit)
          objects.contents.each_slice(1000) do |batch|
            s3_client.delete_objects(
              bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
              delete: {
                objects: batch.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
              }
            )
          end
        end
        
        return { deleted_count: objects.contents.size }
      end
    rescue => e
      raise "Failed to delete images: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  class ImageUrlGenerator
    def initialize(product_id, image_data)
      @product_id = product_id
      @image_data = image_data
    end

    def urls
      {
        original: @image_data[:original][:url],
        thumbnails: @image_data[:thumbnails].transform_values { |data| data[:url] }
      }
    end

    def responsive_urls
      # Generate srcset for responsive images
      srcset = @image_data[:thumbnails].map do |size_name, data|
        width = data[:dimensions][0]
        "#{data[:url]} #{width}w"
      end.join(', ')
      
      {
        srcset: srcset,
        sizes: '(max-width: 100px) 100px, (max-width: 300px) 300px, 600px'
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Usage Example (app/controllers/products_controller.rb)

```ruby
# app/controllers/products_controller.rb
class ProductsController < ApplicationController
  def upload_image
    product_id = params[:product_id]
    file = params[:image]
    
    uploader = ImageService::ImageUploader.new(file, product_id)
    result = uploader.process
    
    # Store image data in your database
    product = Product.find(product_id)
    product.update(
      image_data: result.to_json
    )
    
    render json: {
      success: true,
      image: result,
      urls: ImageService::ImageUrlGenerator.new(product_id, result).urls
    }
  rescue ImageService::ImageUploader::ValidationError => e
    render json: { success: false, error: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
  rescue ImageService::ImageUploader::UploadError => e
    render json: { success: false, error: e.message }, status: :internal_server_error
  end

  def delete_image
    product_id = params[:product_id]
    
    deleter = ImageService::ImageDeleter.new(product_id)
    result = deleter.delete_all
    
    # Clear image data from database
    product = Product.find(product_id)
    product.update(image_data: nil)
    
    render json: { 
      success: true, 
      deleted_count: result[:deleted_count] 
    }
  rescue => e
    render json: { success: false, error: e.message }, status: :internal_server_error
  end
end
```

### 4. Rake Task for Cleanup (lib/tasks/image_cleanup.rake)

```ruby
# lib/tasks/image_cleanup.rake
namespace :images do
  desc "Clean up orphaned images in S3"
  task cleanup_orphaned: :environment do
    # Find all product IDs that have images in the database
    product_ids_with_images = Product.where.not(image_data: nil).pluck(:id)
    
    # List all folders in S3
    ImageService.s3_client_pool.with do |s3_client|
      response = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
        bucket: ImageService.config.s3_bucket,
        prefix: 'products/',
        delimiter: '/'
      )
      
      s3_product_ids = response.common_prefixes.map do |prefix|
        prefix.prefix.split('/')[1].to_i
      end
      
      # Find orphaned product IDs (in S3 but not in database)
      orphaned_ids = s3_product_ids - product_ids_with_images
      
      orphaned_ids.each do |product_id|
        puts "Deleting images for orphaned product #{product_id}"
        ImageService::ImageDeleter.new(product_id).delete_all
      end
      
      puts "Cleanup complete. Deleted images for #{orphaned_ids.size} orphaned products"
    end
  end
end
```

### 5. Environment Configuration (.env.example)

```bash
# .env.example
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=your_access_key
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=your_secret_key
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
AWS_S3_BUCKET=your-bucket-name
CDN_DOMAIN=cdn.yourdomain.com  # Optional, if using CloudFront or similar
```

## Key Features:

1. **Automatic Thumbnail Generation**: Creates multiple thumbnail sizes with proper aspect ratio handling
2. **CDN Integration**: Generates URLs pointing to your CDN if configured
3. **Connection Pooling**: Efficiently manages S3 connections
4. **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling with cleanup on failure
5. **Validation**: File type and size validation
6. **Metadata Storage**: Returns structured data for database storage
7. **Cleanup Utilities**: Methods for deleting images and cleaning orphaned files
8. **Responsive Images**: Generates srcset for responsive image serving

## Usage:

1. Set up your environment variables in `.env`
2. Configure the service in an initializer
3. Use `ImageService::ImageUploader` to upload and process images
4. Store the returned metadata in your database
5. Use `ImageService::ImageUrlGenerator` to generate URLs for your views
6. Set up your CDN (like CloudFront) to point to your S3 bucket

This implementation provides a robust, production-ready solution for handling product images with automatic thumbnail generation and CDN support.

```ruby
      "na" => "https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com",
      "eu" => "https://sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com",
      "fe" => "https://sellingpartnerapi-fe.amazon.com"
    }.freeze

    SANDBOX_ENDPOINTS = {
      "na" => "https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com",
      "eu" => "https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com",
      "fe" => "https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-fe.amazon.com"
    }.freeze

    attr_reader :client_id, :client_secret, :refresh_token, :endpoint,
                :marketplace_ids, :initial_lookback_days, :database_url

    def initialize(env = ENV)
      @client_id     = env.fetch("LWA_CLIENT_ID")
      @client_secret = env.fetch("LWA_CLIENT_SECRET")
      @refresh_token = env.fetch("LWA_REFRESH_TOKEN")

      region  = env.fetch("SPAPI_REGION", "eu")
      sandbox = env.fetch("SPAPI_SANDBOX", "false") == "true"
      table   = sandbox ? SANDBOX_ENDPOINTS : ENDPOINTS
      @endpoint = table.fetch(region) { raise Error, "Невідомий регіон: #{region}" }

      @marketplace_ids = env.fetch("MARKETPLACE_IDS").split(",").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
      raise Error, "MARKETPLACE_IDS порожній" if @marketplace_ids.empty?

      @initial_lookback_days = Integer(env.fetch("INITIAL_LOOKBACK_DAYS", "7"))
      @database_url = env.fetch("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite://db/orders.sqlite3")
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

module SpOrders
  # Отримує та кешує access token через Login with Amazon.
  # Підпис AWS SigV4 для SP-API більше не потрібен — достатньо LWA-токена.
  class LwaAuth
    TOKEN_URL = "https://api.amazon.com"
    TOKEN_PATH = "/auth/o2/token"
    EXPIRY_MARGIN = 60 # секунд

    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
      @token = nil
      @expires_at = Time.at(0)
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @http = Faraday.new(url: TOKEN_URL) do |f|
        f.request :url_encoded
        f.request :retry, max: 3, interval: 1, backoff_factor: 2,
                          retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                          methods: %i[post]
        f.options.timeout = 30
      end
    end

    def access_token
      @mutex.synchronize do
        refresh! if @token.nil? || Time.now >= @expires_at
        @token
      end
    end

    def invalidate!
      @mutex.synchronize { @token = nil }
    end

    private

    def refresh!
      response = @http.post(TOKEN_PATH, {
        grant_type: "refresh_token",
        refresh_token: @config.refresh_token,
        client_id: @config.client_id,
        client_secret: @config.client_secret
      })
      raise ApiError.new(response.status, response.body) unless response.success?

      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @token = data.fetch("access_token")
      @expires_at = Time.now + data.fetch("expires_in").to_i - EXPIRY_MARGIN
      SpOrders.logger.debug("LWA токен оновлено")
    end
  end
end
```

## `lib/sp_orders/client.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

module SpOrders
  # Мінімальний клієнт Orders API v0
  class Client
    USER_AGENT = "SpOrdersSync/1.0 (Language=Ruby##{RUBY_VERSION})"
    ORDERS_PATH = "/orders/v0/orders"

    def initialize(config, auth: LwaAuth.new(config))
      @config = config
      @auth = auth
      @http = Faraday.new(url: config.endpoint) do |f|
        # getOrders має дуже низький rate (1 запит/хв, burst 20),
        # тому повтори при 429 робимо з експоненційною паузою.
        f.request :retry, max: 6, interval: 2, backoff_factor: 2,
                          interval_randomness: 0.3,
                          retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                          methods: %i[get]
        f.headers["User-Agent"] = USER_AGENT
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.options.timeout = 60
        f.options.open_timeout = 15
      end
    end

    # Віддає по одному замовленню, автоматично проходячи всі сторінки (NextToken).
    def each_order(created_after:, marketplace_ids: @config.marketplace_ids)
      return enum_for(__method__, created_after: created_after, marketplace_ids: marketplace_ids) unless block_given?

      params = {
        "MarketplaceIds" => marketplace_ids.join(","),
        "CreatedAfter" => created_after.utc.iso8601,
        "MaxResultsPerPage" => 100
      }

      loop do
        payload = get(ORDERS_PATH, params)
        Array(payload["Orders"]).each { |order| yield order }

        next_token = payload["NextToken"]
        break if next_token.nil? || next_token.empty?

        params = { "NextToken" => next_token }
      end
    end

    # Усі позиції замовлення (з пагінацією)
    def order_items(amazon_order_id)
      items = []
      params = {}
      path = "#{ORDERS_PATH}/#{amazon_order_id}/orderItems"

      loop do
        payload = get(path, params)
        items.concat(Array(payload["OrderItems"]))

        next_token = payload["NextToken"]
        break if next_token.nil? || next_token.empty?

        params = { "NextToken" => next_token }
      end

      items
    end

    private

    def get(path, params = {}, retried_auth: false)
      response = @http.get(path, params) do |req|
        req.headers["x-amz-access-token"] = @auth.access_token
      end

      case response.status
      when 200..299
        JSON.parse(response.body).fetch("payload", {})
      when 401, 403
        # Токен міг протухнути раніше розрахункового часу — пробуємо один раз оновити
        if !retried_auth && response.status == 401
          @auth.invalidate!
          return get(path, params, retried_auth: true)
        end
        raise ApiError.new(response.status, response.body)
      else
        raise ApiError.new(response.status, response.body)
      end
    end
  end
end
```
