```

Everything else (`json`, `set`, `time`, `fileutils`) is in the Ruby standard library.

## alert_notifier.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Notifies Telegram users about air-raid alerts in the oblast they subscribed to,
# using the alerts.in.ua API (https://devs.alerts.in.ua).
#
# Environment variables:
#   ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN  (required) API token from https://alerts.in.ua/api-request
#   TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN  (required) token from @BotFather
#   POLL_INTERVAL       (optional) seconds between API polls, default 45
#   SUBSCRIBERS_FILE    (optional) default ./subscribers.json
#
# Bot commands:
#   /subscribe <oblast>   e.g. /subscribe Київська область
#   /unsubscribe
#   /oblasts
#   /status

require "bundler/setup"
require "faraday"
require "json"
require "logger"
require "set"
require "time"
require "fileutils"

module AirRaid
  # Names exactly as the alerts.in.ua API returns them in `location_oblast`.
  OBLASTS = [
    "Автономна Республіка Крим", "Волинська область", "Вінницька область",
    "Дніпропетровська область", "Донецька область", "Житомирська область",
    "Закарпатська область", "Запорізька область", "Івано-Франківська область",
    "м. Київ", "Київська область", "Кіровоградська область", "Луганська область",
    "Львівська область", "Миколаївська область", "Одеська область",
    "Полтавська область", "Рівненська область", "м. Севастополь", "Сумська область",
    "Тернопільська область", "Харківська область", "Херсонська область",
    "Хмельницька область", "Черкаська область", "Чернівецька область",
    "Чернігівська область"
  ].freeze

  # Alert types we notify about (API `alert_type` values).
  ALERT_LABELS = {
    "air_raid"           => "Повітряна тривога",
    "chemical"           => "Хімічна небезпека",
    "radiation"          => "Радіаційна небезпека",
    "artillery_shelling" => "Загроза артобстрілу",
    "urban_fights"       => "Загроза вуличних боїв"
  }.freeze

  # Only air-raid alerts by default; add more keys from ALERT_LABELS if desired.
  NOTIFY_TYPES = Set["air_raid"].freeze

  Alert = Struct.new(:id, :location_title, :location_type, :oblast, :alert_type,
                     :started_at, keyword_init: true) do
    def self.from_api(hash)
      new(
        id: hash["id"],
        location_title: hash["location_title"],
        location_type: hash["location_type"],
        oblast: hash["location_oblast"],
        alert_type: hash["alert_type"],
        started_at: hash["started_at"]
      )
    end

    def label
      ALERT_LABELS.fetch(alert_type, alert_type.to_s)
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # alerts.in.ua client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class AlertsClient
    class Error < StandardError; end
    class AuthError < Error; end
    class RateLimited < Error; end

    BASE_URL = "https://api.alerts.in.ua"

    def initialize(token:)
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL, request: { timeout: 15, open_timeout: 5 }) do |f|
        f.request :authorization, "Bearer", token
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.headers["User-Agent"] = "air-raid-notifier/1.0"
      end
    end

    # Returns an Array<Alert> of currently active alerts.
    def active_alerts
      resp = @conn.get("/v1/alerts/active.json")

      case resp.status
      when 200
        data = JSON.parse(resp.body)
        Array(data["alerts"]).map { |h| Alert.from_api(h) }
      when 401, 403 then raise AuthError, "alerts.in.ua rejected the token (HTTP #{resp.status})"
      when 429      then raise RateLimited, "alerts.in.ua rate limit hit"
      else               raise Error, "alerts.in.ua returned HTTP #{resp.status}"
      end
    rescue Faraday::Error, JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error, "#{e.class}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Persistent subscriber store: chat_id => oblast
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class SubscriberStore
    def initialize(path)
      @path = path
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @data = load_file
    end

    def subscribe(chat_id, oblast)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @data[chat_id.to_s] = oblast
        persist
      end
    end

    def unsubscribe(chat_id)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        removed = @data.delete(chat_id.to_s)
        persist if removed
        !removed.nil?
      end
    end

    def oblast_for(chat_id)
      @mutex.synchronize { @data[chat_id.to_s] }
    end

    def subscribers_for(oblast)
      @mutex.synchronize { @data.select { |_, o| o == oblast }.keys }
    end

    private

    def load_file
      return {} unless File.exist?(@path)

      JSON.parse(File.read(@path))
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {}
    end

    def persist
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(File.expand_path(@path)))
      tmp = "#{@path}.tmp"
      File.write(tmp, JSON.pretty_generate(@data))
      File.rename(tmp, @path) # atomic replace
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Telegram Bot API (just what we need)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class TelegramBot
    def initialize(token:, logger:)
      @logger = logger
      url = "https://api.telegram.org/bot#{token}/"
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: url, request: { timeout: 15, open_timeout: 5 })
      # Separate connection for long polling (timeout must exceed the poll timeout).
      @poll_conn = Faraday.new(url: url, request: { timeout: 45, open_timeout: 5 })
    end

    # Returns :ok, :blocked (user blocked bot / chat gone) or :error.
    def send_message(chat_id, text)
      resp = @conn.post("sendMessage", chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
      case resp.status
      when 200 then :ok
      when 403 then :blocked
      when 400
        body = safe_json(resp.body)
        body["description"].to_s.include?("chat not found") ? :blocked : :error
      else
        @logger.warn("Telegram sendMessage HTTP #{resp.status}: #{resp.body}")
        :error
      end
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      @logger.warn("Telegram sendMessage failed: #{e.message}")
      :error
    end

    # Long-poll for updates; returns an Array of update hashes.
    def get_updates(offset)
      resp = @poll_conn.get("getUpdates", offset: offset, timeout: 30,
                                          allowed_updates: '["message"]')
      return [] unless resp.status == 200

      safe_json(resp.body).fetch("result", [])
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      @logger.warn("Telegram getUpdates failed: #{e.message}")
      sleep 5
      []
    end

    private

    def safe_json(body)
      JSON.parse(body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {}
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Handles /subscribe, /unsubscribe, ... commands from users
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class CommandHandler
    def initialize(bot:, store:, monitor:, logger:)
      @bot = bot
      @store = store
      @monitor = monitor
      @logger = logger
    end

    def run(stop_flag)
      offset = 0
      until stop_flag.call
        @bot.get_updates(offset).each do |update|
          offset = update["update_id"].to_i + 1
          handle(update["message"]) if update["message"]
        end
      end
    end

    def handle(message)
      text = message["text"].to_s.strip
      chat_id = message.dig("chat", "id")
      return if chat_id.nil? || !text.start_with?("/")

      command, arg = text.split(/\s+/, 2)
      command = command.sub(/@\w+\z/, "").downcase # strip @BotName suffix

      reply =
        case command
        when "/start", "/help" then help_text
        when "/oblasts"        then OBLASTS.join("\n")
        when "/subscribe"      then subscribe(chat_id, arg.to_s.strip)
        when "/unsubscribe"
          @store.unsubscribe(chat_id) ? "Ви відписалися від сповіщень." : "Ви ні на що не підписані."
        when "/status" then status(chat_id)
        else "Невідома команда. /help"
        end

      @bot.send_message(chat_id, reply)
    end

    private

    def help_text
      <<~TXT
        Я сповіщаю про тривоги у вашій області.

        /subscribe <область> — підписатися (напр. /subscribe Львівська область)
        /unsubscribe — відписатися
        /oblasts — список областей
        /status — поточний стан у вашій області
      TXT
    end

    def subscribe(chat_id, query)
      return "Вкажіть область: /subscribe Київська область\nСписок: /oblasts" if query.empty?

      matches = find_oblasts(query)
      case matches.size
      when 0 then "Область не знайдено. Список: /oblasts"
      when 1
        @store.subscribe(chat_id, matches.first)
        "Підписано: #{matches.first}"
      else "Уточніть, будь ласка: #{matches.join(' / ')}"
      end
    end

    def find_oblasts(query)
      q = query.downcase
      exact = OBLASTS.select { |o| o.downcase == q }
      return exact if exact.size == 1

      OBLASTS.select { |o| o.downcase.include?(q) }
    end

    def status(chat_id)
      oblast = @store.oblast_for(chat_id)
      return "Ви ні на що не підписані. /subscribe <область>" unless oblast

      active = @monitor.active_in(oblast)
      if active.empty?
        "✅ #{oblast}: тривоги немає."
      else
        "🚨 #{oblast}:\n" + active.map { |a| "• #{a.label}: #{a.location_title}" }.join("\n")
      end
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Polls alerts, diffs against the previous state, notifies subscribers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class Monitor
    MAX_BACKOFF = 600

    def initialize(client:, store:, bot:, interval:, logger:)
      @client = client
      @store = store
      @bot = bot
      @interval = interval
      @logger = logger
      @known = nil # Hash alert_id => Alert; nil until the first successful poll
      @lock = Mutex.new
    end

    def active_in(oblast)
      @lock.synchronize { (@known || {}).values.select { |a| a.oblast == oblast } }
    end

    def run(stop_flag)
      failures = 0
      until stop_flag.call
        begin
          tick
          failures = 0
          wait = @interval
        rescue AlertsClient::AuthError => e
          @logger.fatal(e.message)
          raise
        rescue AlertsClient::Error => e
          failures += 1
          wait = [@interval * (2**failures), MAX_BACKOFF].min
          @logger.warn("Poll failed (#{e.message}); retrying in #{wait}s")
        end
        interruptible_sleep(wait, stop_flag)
      end
    end

    def tick
      alerts = @client.active_alerts.select do |a|
        a.oblast && NOTIFY_TYPES.include?(a.alert_type)
      end
      current = alerts.to_h { |a| [a.id, a] }

      previous = @lock.synchronize { @known }
      if previous.nil?
        # First poll: establish baseline silently so a restart doesn't re-announce everything.
        @lock.synchronize { @known = current }
        @logger.info("Baseline loaded: #{current.size} active alert(s)")
        return
      end

      started = current.reject { |id, _| previous.key?(id) }.values
      ended   = previous.reject { |id, _| current.key?(id) }.values
      @lock.synchronize { @known = current }

      notify_started(started)
      notify_ended(ended)
    end

    private

    def notify_started(alerts)
      alerts.group_by(&:oblast).each do |oblast, list|
        lines = list.map { |a| "• #{a.label}: #{a.location_title}" }
        broadcast(oblast, "🚨 Увага! #{oblast}\n#{lines.join("\n")}\n\nПрямуйте в укриття!")
      end
    end

    def notify_ended(alerts)
      alerts.group_by(&:oblast).each do |oblast, list|
        lines = list.map { |a| "• #{a.location_title}" }
        broadcast(oblast, "✅ Відбій тривоги. #{oblast}\n#{lines.join("\n")}")
      end
    end

    def broadcast(oblast, text)
      recipients = @store.subscribers_for(oblast)
      @logger.info("Notifying #{recipients.size} subscriber(s) in #{oblast}")

      recipients.each do |chat_id|
        if @bot.send_message(chat_id, text) == :blocked
          @logger.info("Chat #{chat_id} unreachable; unsubscribing")
          @store.unsubscribe(chat_id)
        end
        sleep 0.05 # stay well below Telegram's ~30 msg/sec limit
      end
    end

    def interruptible_sleep(seconds, stop_flag)
      deadline = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) + seconds
      while Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) < deadline
        return if stop_flag.call

        sleep 0.5
      end
    end
  end
end

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  logger = Logger.new($stdout, progname: "air-raid")

  alerts_token = ENV["ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN"]
  telegram_token = ENV["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]
  if alerts_token.to_s.empty? || telegram_token.to_s.empty?
    warn "Set ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
    exit 1
  end

  # The API is rate limited, so don't poll too aggressively.
  interval = [ENV.fetch("POLL_INTERVAL", "45").to_i, 15].max
  store = AirRaid::SubscriberStore.new(ENV.fetch("SUBSCRIBERS_FILE", "subscribers.json"))
  client = AirRaid::AlertsClient.new(token: alerts_token)
  bot = AirRaid::TelegramBot.new(token: telegram_token, logger: logger)
  monitor = AirRaid::Monitor.new(client: client, store: store, bot: bot,
                                 interval: interval, logger: logger)
  commands = AirRaid::CommandHandler.new(bot: bot, store: store, monitor: monitor, logger: logger)

  stopping = false
  stop_flag = -> { stopping }
  # Only set a flag inside trap handlers (no logging / mutexes allowed there).
  %w[INT TERM].each { |sig| Signal.trap(sig) { stopping = true } }

  command_thread = Thread.new do
    commands.run(stop_flag)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Command handler crashed: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
  end

  logger.info("Started; polling every #{interval}s")
  begin
    monitor.run(stop_flag)
  rescue AirRaid::AlertsClient::AuthError
    exit 1
  ensure
    stopping = true
    command_thread.join(5)
    logger.info("Stopped")
  end
end
```

## Running

```bash
bundle install
export ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN=...   # request one at https://alerts.in.ua/api-request
export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=...   # from @BotFather
bundle exec ruby alert_notifier.rb
```

Users then message the bot with `/subscribe Київська область` and receive a message when an alert starts in their oblast, and another when it ends.

## Design notes

- **Change detection:** each poll of `/v1/alerts/active.json` is diffed by alert `id` against the previous poll. New ids trigger an alert message and vanished ids trigger an all-clear. The first poll only sets a baseline, so restarts don't re-announce ongoing alerts.
- **Oblast matching:** the API reports `location_oblast` for raion, hromada and city alerts too. A user subscribed to an oblast therefore hears about alerts anywhere inside it, with the specific `location_title` in the message.
- **Alert types:** only `air_raid` is notified by default. Edit `NOTIFY_TYPES` to include others such as `artillery_shelling`.
- **Resilience:**
  - API errors back off exponentially.
  - A bad token stops the program.
  - Users who block the bot are unsubscribed automatically.
  - Subscriber file writes are atomic.
- **Rate limits:** the poll interval has a 15-second floor and defaults to 45 seconds to stay within alerts.in.ua's limits.

text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday",       "~> 2.9"

```

Run `bundle install` after saving it. The code also uses `json` from the standard library, so it needs no entry.

## whatsapp_client.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "json"

module WhatsApp
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ConfigurationError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end
  class ConnectionError < Error; end

  # Raised when the Cloud API responds with a non-2xx status.
  class APIError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :code, :subcode, :error_type, :fbtrace_id, :body

    def initialize(status:, body:)
      @status = status
      @body = body
      err = body.is_a?(Hash) ? (body["error"] || {}) : {}
      @code = err["code"]
      @subcode = err["error_subcode"]
      @error_type = err["type"]
      @fbtrace_id = err["fbtrace_id"]
      detail = err["error_data"].is_a?(Hash) ? err["error_data"]["details"] : nil
      message = err["message"] || "HTTP #{status}"
      message = "#{message} (#{detail})" if detail
      super("WhatsApp API error [HTTP #{status}, code #{@code.inspect}]: #{message}")
    end
  end

  Result = Struct.new(:message_id, :wa_id, :message_status, :raw, keyword_init: true)

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://graph.facebook.com"
    DEFAULT_API_VERSION = "v21.0"
    MEDIA_TYPES = %w[image video document].freeze

    def initialize(access_token: ENV["WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN"],
                   phone_number_id: ENV["WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID"],
                   api_version: ENV.fetch("WHATSAPP_API_VERSION", DEFAULT_API_VERSION),
                   timeout: 15,
                   connection: nil)
      raise ConfigurationError, "access_token is required" if blank?(access_token)
      raise ConfigurationError, "phone_number_id is required" if blank?(phone_number_id)

      @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
      @api_version = api_version
      @conn = connection || build_connection(access_token, timeout)
    end

    # Send a pre-approved template message.
    #
    # to:       recipient phone number in international format ("+1 555 123 4567" is fine)
    # name:     template name as approved in WhatsApp Manager
    # language: template language/locale code, e.g. "en_US"
    # header:   nil, or a Hash:
    #             { type: :text, text: "Hello" }
    #             { type: :image | :video | :document, link: "https://..." }  (or id: "media-id")
    #             document headers may also include filename: "invoice.pdf"
    # body:     Array of values for positional placeholders ({{1}}, {{2}}),
    #           or Hash for named placeholders ({{first_name}}) -> { first_name: "Ana" }
    # buttons:  Array of Hashes:
    #             { sub_type: :url, index: 0, text: "dynamic-url-suffix" }
    #             { sub_type: :quick_reply, index: 1, payload: "OPT_OUT" }
    def send_template(to:, name:, language: "en_US", header: nil, body: [], buttons: [])
      raise ValidationError, "template name is required" if blank?(name)

      template = { name: name, language: { code: language } }
      components = build_components(header, body, buttons)
      template[:components] = components unless components.empty?

      payload = {
        messaging_product: "whatsapp",
        recipient_type: "individual",
        to: normalize_phone(to),
        type: "template",
        template: template
      }

      parse_result(post("#{@api_version}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages", payload))
    end

    private

    def build_connection(token, timeout)
      Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
        f.request :json
        # Retrying POSTs can duplicate messages, so only retry cases where
        # the message was certainly not accepted: rate limiting (429) and
        # failures to connect at all.
        f.request :retry,
                  max: 3,
                  interval: 1,
                  backoff_factor: 2,
                  methods: %i[post],
                  retry_statuses: [429],
                  exceptions: [Faraday::ConnectionFailed]
        f.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{token}"
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.options.timeout = timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    def post(path, payload)
      @conn.post(path, payload)
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise ConnectionError, "Could not reach WhatsApp API: #{e.message}"
    end

    def parse_result(response)
      body = parse_body(response.body)
      raise APIError.new(status: response.status, body: body) unless response.success?

      Result.new(
        message_id: body.dig("messages", 0, "id"),
        wa_id: body.dig("contacts", 0, "wa_id"),
        message_status: body.dig("messages", 0, "message_status"),
        raw: body
      )
    end

    def parse_body(raw)
      return raw if raw.is_a?(Hash)

      JSON.parse(raw.to_s)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      { "error" => { "message" => raw.to_s[0, 200] } }
    end

    # ---- component building -------------------------------------------------

    def build_components(header, body, buttons)
      components = []
      components << build_header(header) if header
      body_component = build_body(body)
      components << body_component if body_component
      Array(buttons).each { |b| components << build_button(b) }
      components
    end

    def build_header(header)
      type = header.fetch(:type) { raise ValidationError, "header requires :type" }.to_s

      parameter =
        if type == "text"
          { type: "text", text: header.fetch(:text).to_s }
        elsif MEDIA_TYPES.include?(type)
          media = if header[:id] then { id: header[:id] }
                  elsif header[:link] then { link: header[:link] }
                  else raise ValidationError, "media header requires :link or :id"
                  end
          media[:filename] = header[:filename] if type == "document" && header[:filename]
          { type: type, type.to_sym => media }
        else
          raise ValidationError, "unsupported header type: #{type}"
        end

      { type: "header", parameters: [parameter] }
    end

    def build_body(body)
      return nil if body.nil? || (body.respond_to?(:empty?) && body.empty?)

      parameters =
        if body.is_a?(Hash)
          body.map { |k, v| { type: "text", parameter_name: k.to_s, text: v.to_s } }
        else
          Array(body).map { |v| { type: "text", text: v.to_s } }
        end

      { type: "body", parameters: parameters }
    end

    def build_button(button)
      sub_type = button.fetch(:sub_type) { raise ValidationError, "button requires :sub_type" }.to_s
      index = button.fetch(:index) { raise ValidationError, "button requires :index" }.to_s

      parameter =
        case sub_type
        when "url"
          { type: "text", text: button.fetch(:text).to_s }
        when "quick_reply"
          { type: "payload", payload: button.fetch(:payload).to_s }
        else
          raise ValidationError, "unsupported button sub_type: #{sub_type}"
        end

      { type: "button", sub_type: sub_type, index: index, parameters: [parameter] }
    rescue KeyError => e
      raise ValidationError, "button is missing #{e.key.inspect}"
    end

    # ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

    def normalize_phone(number)
      digits = number.to_s.gsub(/[\s\-().+]/, "")
      unless digits.match?(/\A\d{7,15}\z/)
        raise ValidationError, "invalid phone number: #{number.inspect} (use international format)"
      end

      digits
    end

    def blank?(value)
      value.nil? || value.to_s.strip.empty?
    end
  end
end

# ---- Example usage -----------------------------------------------------------
#   export WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN=...
#   export WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=...
#   bundle exec ruby whatsapp_client.rb +15551234567
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  client = WhatsApp::Client.new
  recipient = ARGV.fetch(0) { abort "Usage: ruby #{$PROGRAM_NAME} <phone number>" }

  begin
    # 1. Simplest case: Meta's built-in sample template
    result = client.send_template(to: recipient, name: "hello_world", language: "en_US")
    puts "Sent hello_world: #{result.message_id}"

    # 2. Template with an image header, body variables, and a dynamic URL button
    # result = client.send_template(
    #   to: recipient,
    #   name: "order_confirmation",
    #   language: "en_US",
    #   header: { type: :image, link: "https://example.com/order.png" },
    #   body: ["Ana", "ORD-1234", "$49.90"],
    #   buttons: [{ sub_type: :url, index: 0, text: "ORD-1234" }]
    # )

    # 3. Named placeholders
    # client.send_template(to: recipient, name: "welcome_named",
    #                      body: { first_name: "Ana", plan: "Pro" })
  rescue WhatsApp::ValidationError => e
    warn "Invalid input: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue WhatsApp::APIError => e
    warn "API error: #{e.message} (fbtrace_id=#{e.fbtrace_id})"
    exit 1
  rescue WhatsApp::ConnectionError => e
    warn "Network error: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Notes

- **Credentials:** you need a permanent (system user) access token and the **Phone Number ID**, which is not the phone number itself. Both are in Meta's developer dashboard under WhatsApp > API Setup.
- **Templates:** they must be approved in WhatsApp Manager first. The `name`, `language`, and the number and type of parameters must match the approved template, or the API returns an error such as code `132000` for a parameter count mismatch.
- **Retries:** I deliberately retry only on HTTP 429 and connection failures. Retrying a POST after a timeout or 5xx could send the message twice.
- **Errors:** `APIError` exposes `status`, `code`, `subcode`, and `fbtrace_id`, so you can branch on Meta's error codes or quote the trace ID to Meta support.
- **Sandbox:** while using a test number, the recipient must be on your allowed-recipients list.

## Implementation

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# id_ocr.rb: extract text from scanned identity documents with Tesseract.
#
# Usage:
#   bundle exec ruby id_ocr.rb scan.jpg
#   bundle exec ruby id_ocr.rb scan.png --lang eng --psm 6 --json

require "bundler/setup"
require "date"
require "json"
require "open3"
require "optparse"
require "tmpdir"
require "mini_magick"
require "rtesseract"

module IdOcr
  class Error < StandardError; end

  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.png .jpg .jpeg .tif .tiff .bmp .webp].freeze
  MAX_BYTES          = 25 * 1024 * 1024

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image cleanup to improve OCR accuracy on scans and phone photos.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class Preprocessor
    def initialize(min_width: 2000)
      @min_width = min_width
    end

    # Writes a cleaned copy of +input+ to +output+.
    # +crop_bottom+ keeps only the bottom N percent (where the MRZ lives).
    def call(input, output, crop_bottom: nil)
      MiniMagick.convert do |c|
        c << "#{input}[0]"                # first page/frame only
        c.auto_orient                     # honor EXIF rotation
        c.colorspace "Gray"
        c.resize "#{@min_width}x<"        # upscale only if narrower than min_width
        c.normalize                       # stretch contrast
        c.deskew "40%"                    # straighten slightly rotated scans
        c.sharpen "0x1"
        if crop_bottom
          c.gravity "South"
          c.crop "100%x#{crop_bottom}%+0+0"
          c << "+repage"
        end
        c << output
      end
    rescue MiniMagick::Error => e
      raise Error, "Image preprocessing failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Parser for ICAO 9303 machine readable zones (passports: TD3, ID cards: TD1),
  # including check-digit validation.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  module MrzParser
    module_function

    WEIGHTS = [7, 3, 1].freeze
    DIGIT_FIXES = {
      "O" => "0", "Q" => "0", "D" => "0", "I" => "1", "L" => "1",
      "Z" => "2", "S" => "5", "G" => "6", "B" => "8"
    }.freeze

    def parse(text)
      lines = candidate_lines(text)

      lines.each_index do |i|
        l1 = fit(lines[i], 44)
        l2 = lines[i + 1] && fit(lines[i + 1], 44)
        return parse_td3(l1, l2) if l1 && l2

        t1 = fit(lines[i], 30)
        t2 = lines[i + 1] && fit(lines[i + 1], 30)
        t3 = lines[i + 2] && fit(lines[i + 2], 30)
        return parse_td1(t1, t2, t3) if t1 && t2 && t3
      end
      nil
    end

    def candidate_lines(text)
      text.each_line
          .map { |l| l.upcase.gsub(/\s+/, "").tr("«", "<") }
          .select { |l| l.match?(/\A[A-Z0-9<]{28,46}\z/) && l.include?("<") }
    end

    # Exact length, or padded with filler if OCR dropped trailing '<' characters.
    def fit(line, len)
      return line if line.length == len
      return line.ljust(len, "<") if line.length.between?(len - 2, len - 1)

      nil
    end

    def char_value(ch)
      case ch
      when /\d/    then ch.to_i
      when /[A-Z]/ then ch.ord - 55
      else 0
      end
    end

    def check_digit(data)
      data.each_char.with_index.sum { |ch, i| char_value(ch) * WEIGHTS[i % 3] } % 10
    end

    def valid?(data, check)
      return true if check == "<" && data.delete("<").empty?

      check.match?(/\A\d\z/) && check_digit(data) == check.to_i
    end

    # Replace letters commonly confused with digits at purely numeric positions.
    def fix_numeric(line, *ranges)
      fixed = line.dup
      ranges.each do |r|
        r.each { |i| fixed[i] = DIGIT_FIXES.fetch(fixed[i], fixed[i]) }
      end
      fixed
    end

    def parse_td3(l1, l2)
      l2 = fix_numeric(l2, 9..9, 13..19, 21..27, 42..43)
      surname, given = parse_names(l1[5, 39])

      checks = {
        document_number: valid?(l2[0, 9],  l2[9]),
        birth_date:      valid?(l2[13, 6], l2[19]),
        expiry_date:     valid?(l2[21, 6], l2[27]),
        personal_number: valid?(l2[28, 14], l2[42]),
        composite:       valid?(l2[0, 10] + l2[13, 7] + l2[21, 22], l2[43])
      }

      {
        format: "TD3",
        document_type: l1[0, 2].delete("<"),
        issuing_country: l1[2, 3].delete("<"),
        surname: surname,
        given_names: given,
        document_number: l2[0, 9].delete("<"),
        nationality: l2[10, 3].delete("<"),
        birth_date: parse_date(l2[13, 6], :birth),
        sex: parse_sex(l2[20]),
        expiry_date: parse_date(l2[21, 6], :expiry),
        personal_number: l2[28, 14].delete("<"),
        check_digits: checks,
        valid: checks.values.all?,
        raw: [l1, l2]
      }
    end

    def parse_td1(l1, l2, l3)
      l1 = fix_numeric(l1, 14..14)
      l2 = fix_numeric(l2, 0..6, 8..14, 29..29)
      surname, given = parse_names(l3)

      checks = {
        document_number: valid?(l1[5, 9], l1[14]),
        birth_date:      valid?(l2[0, 6], l2[6]),
        expiry_date:     valid?(l2[8, 6], l2[14]),
        composite:       valid?(l1[5, 25] + l2[0, 7] + l2[8, 7] + l2[18, 11], l2[29])
      }

      {
        format: "TD1",
        document_type: l1[0, 2].delete("<"),
        issuing_country: l1[2, 3].delete("<"),
        surname: surname,
        given_names: given,
        document_number: l1[5, 9].delete("<"),
        nationality: l2[15, 3].delete("<"),
        birth_date: parse_date(l2[0, 6], :birth),
        sex: parse_sex(l2[7]),
        expiry_date: parse_date(l2[8, 6], :expiry),
        check_digits: checks,
        valid: checks.values.all?,
        raw: [l1, l2, l3]
      }
    end

    def parse_names(field)
      primary, secondary = field.split("<<", 2)
      [clean_name(primary), clean_name(secondary)]
    end

    def clean_name(str)
      str.to_s.tr("<", " ").squeeze(" ").strip
    end

    def parse_sex(ch)
      { "M" => "M", "F" => "F" }.fetch(ch, "X")
    end

    def parse_date(yymmdd, kind)
      return nil unless yymmdd.match?(/\A\d{6}\z/)

      yy = yymmdd[0, 2].to_i
      mm = yymmdd[2, 2].to_i
      dd = yymmdd[4, 2].to_i
      century = if kind == :birth && yy > Date.today.year % 100 then 1900 else 2000 end
      year = century + yy
      Date.valid_date?(year, mm, dd) ? Date.new(year, mm, dd).iso8601 : nil
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Orchestrates validation, preprocessing, OCR and MRZ parsing.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class Extractor
    Result = Struct.new(:text, :mrz, keyword_init: true) do
      def to_h = { text: text, mrz: mrz }
    end

    def initialize(lang: "eng", psm: 3, preprocessor: Preprocessor.new)
      # The language is passed to the tesseract command line, so restrict it.
      raise Error, "Invalid language code: #{lang.inspect}" unless lang.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z_]+(\+[a-zA-Z_]+)*\z/)

      @lang = lang
      @psm = Integer(psm)
      @preprocessor = preprocessor
      ensure_tesseract!
    end

    def call(path)
      validate_file!(path)

      Dir.mktmpdir("id_ocr") do |dir|          # temp files (PII) removed on exit
        cleaned = File.join(dir, "full.png")
        @preprocessor.call(path, cleaned)

        text = ocr(cleaned, psm: @psm)
        mrz  = MrzParser.parse(text)

        if mrz.nil?                              # retry on the bottom strip only
          strip = File.join(dir, "mrz.png")
          @preprocessor.call(path, strip, crop_bottom: 35)
          strip_text = ocr(strip, psm: 6)
          mrz = MrzParser.parse(strip_text)
        end

        Result.new(text: text, mrz: mrz)
      end
    end

    private

    def ocr(image_path, psm:)
      RTesseract.new(image_path, lang: @lang, psm: psm).to_s.strip
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise Error, "OCR failed: #{e.message}"
    end

    def validate_file!(path)
      raise Error, "File not found: #{path}" unless File.file?(path)
      raise Error, "Unsupported file type: #{File.extname(path)}" unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(File.extname(path).downcase)
      raise Error, "File too large (max #{MAX_BYTES / 1024 / 1024} MB)" if File.size(path) > MAX_BYTES
    end

    def ensure_tesseract!
      _out, status = Open3.capture2e("tesseract", "--version")
      raise Error, "tesseract returned an error" unless status.success?
    rescue Errno::ENOENT
      raise Error, "tesseract is not installed or not on PATH"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Command line interface
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class CLI
    def self.run(argv)
      options = { lang: "eng", psm: 3, json: false }
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "Usage: id_ocr.rb IMAGE [options]"
        o.on("-l", "--lang LANG", "Tesseract language(s), e.g. eng or eng+deu") { |v| options[:lang] = v }
        o.on("--psm N", Integer, "Page segmentation mode (default 3)") { |v| options[:psm] = v }
        o.on("--json", "Output JSON") { options[:json] = true }
        o.on("-h", "--help") { puts o; exit }
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)

      path = argv.shift or abort(parser.to_s)
      result = Extractor.new(lang: options[:lang], psm: options[:psm]).call(path)

      if options[:json]
        puts JSON.pretty_generate(result.to_h)
      else
        puts "=== Extracted text ==="
        puts result.text
        puts "\n=== MRZ ==="
        puts result.mrz ? JSON.pretty_generate(result.mrz) : "(no machine readable zone found)"
      end
    rescue IdOcr::Error, OptionParser::ParseError => e
      warn "Error: #{e.message}"
      exit 1
    end
  end
end

IdOcr::CLI.run(ARGV) if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
```

## Notes

- **Pipeline**: the image is auto-rotated, converted to grayscale, upscaled, contrast-normalized, deskewed and sharpened. Tesseract then reads the full page. If no MRZ is found, the bottom 35% is OCR'd again in single-block mode (`--psm 6`), which is more reliable for the MRZ.
- **MRZ parsing**: passports (TD3, 2×44) and ID cards (TD1, 3×30) are supported. Check digits are verified, and common letter/digit confusions (`O`→`0`, `B`→`8`, and so on) are corrected at numeric positions. `valid: false` means the OCR result should be reviewed by a person. Don't trust the extracted fields in that case.
- **Limits**: TD2 (2×36) and PDFs are not handled. Convert PDFs to images first, for example with `pdftoppm -r 300 -png`. Accuracy on the MRZ improves if you install the `ocrb` traineddata and run with `--lang ocrb`.
- **Privacy**: temp files live in a temp directory that is deleted after processing, nothing is logged, and the language code is validated because it reaches a command line. In production, also consider encrypting stored output and limiting who can read it, since identity documents are sensitive personal data.

```ruby
# translator.rb
require 'deepl'
require 'digest'

# Simple in-memory TTL cache.
# Can be replaced with any object that responds to: get, store, fetch, clear.
class TranslationCache
  Entry = Struct.new(:value, :expires_at)

  def initialize
    @store = {}
  end

  # Returns cached value if present and not expired, otherwise nil.
  def get(key)
    entry = @store[key]
    return nil unless entry

    if entry.expires_at > Time.now
      entry.value
    else
      @store.delete(key)
      nil
    end
  end

  # Stores a value with the given TTL (in seconds).
  def store(key, value, ttl:)
    @store[key] = Entry.new(value, Time.now + ttl)
  end

  # Fetches a key from the cache. If not present or expired,
  # executes the block, stores the result, and returns it.
  def fetch(key, ttl:)
    cached = get(key)
    return cached if cached

    value = yield
    store(key, value, ttl: ttl)
    value
  end

  def clear
    @store.clear
  end
end

# Service for translating product descriptions using DeepL API with caching.
class ProductDescriptionTranslator
  # @param api_key [String] DeepL API key (defaults to ENV['DEEPL_AUTH_KEY'])
  # @param host [String, nil] optional DeepL host (e.g. 'https://api-free.deepl.com')
  # @param source_lang [String, nil] default source language code (e.g. 'EN')
  # @param target_lang [String, nil] default target language code (e.g. 'DE')
  # @param cache [TranslationCache] cache object (defaults to in-memory cache)
  # @param cache_ttl [Integer] cache time-to-live in seconds
  def initialize(
    api_key: ENV.fetch('DEEPL_AUTH_KEY'),
    host: nil,
    source_lang: nil,
    target_lang: nil,
    cache: TranslationCache.new,
    cache_ttl: 3600
  )
    client_options = { auth_key: api_key }
    client_options[:host] = host if host
    @client = DeepL::Client.new(client_options)
    @default_source_lang = source_lang
    @default_target_lang = target_lang
    @cache = cache
    @cache_ttl = cache_ttl
  end

  # Translates a single description.
  # Uses defaults for source/target languages if not provided.
  def translate(text, source_lang: @default_source_lang, target_lang: @default_target_lang)
    raise ArgumentError, 'source_lang is required' if source_lang.nil?
    raise ArgumentError, 'target_lang is required' if target_lang.nil?

    cache_key = cache_key_for(text, source_lang, target_lang)
    @cache.fetch(cache_key, ttl: @cache_ttl) do
      result = @client.translate(text, source_lang, target_lang)
      result.text
    end
  end

  # Translates an array of descriptions.
  # Efficiently batches uncached texts into a single API call,
  # then caches each translated result.
  def translate_all(texts, source_lang: @default_source_lang, target_lang: @default_target_lang)
    raise ArgumentError, 'source_lang is required' if source_lang.nil?
    raise ArgumentError, 'target_lang is required' if target_lang.nil?

    results = Array.new(texts.length)
    missing_indices = []
    missing_texts = []

    # Phase 1: check cache for each text
    texts.each_with_index do |text, idx|
      key = cache_key_for(text, source_lang, target_lang)
      cached = @cache.get(key)
      if cached
        results[idx] = cached
      else
        missing_indices << idx
        missing_texts << text
      end
    end

    # Phase 2: translate all missing texts in one batch
    unless missing_texts.empty?
      api_results = @client.translate(missing_texts, source_lang, target_lang)
      api_results.each_with_index do |res, i|
        idx = missing_indices[i]
        translated_text = res.text
        key = cache_key_for(missing_texts[i], source_lang, target_lang)
        @cache.store(key, translated_text, ttl: @cache_ttl)
        results[idx] = translated_text
      end
    end

    results
  end

  private

  # Generates a unique cache key for a text and language pair.
  def cache_key_for(text, source_lang, target_lang)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{text}|#{source_lang}|#{target_lang}")
  end
end

# Usage example (run with `ruby translator.rb`)
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  # Set your DeepL API key in the environment or replace directly.
  translator = ProductDescriptionTranslator.new(
    api_key: ENV['DEEPL_AUTH_KEY'],
    source_lang: 'EN',
    target_lang: 'DE'
  )

  description = 'High-quality wireless headphones with noise cancelling.'
  puts translator.translate(description)

  descriptions = [
    'Ergonomic office chair',
    'Stainless steel water bottle',
    'Portable Bluetooth speaker'
  ]
  translated = translator.translate_all(descriptions)
  translated.each { |t| puts t }
end
```

Ось повна реалізація Rails додатку для керування товарами WooCommerce через REST API. ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' ruby '3.2.2' # Rails gem 'rails', '~> 7.0.8' gem 'pg', '~> 1.5' gem 'puma', '~> 6.0' # Authentication gem 'devise', '~> 4.9' gem 'pundit', '~> 2.3' # WooCommerce API gem 'woocommerce_api', '~> 1.0' # Frontend gem 'importmap-rails' gem 'turbo-rails' gem 'stimulus-rails' gem 'bootstrap', '~> 5.3' gem 'sassc-rails' # Utilities gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21' gem 'dotenv-rails', groups: [:development, :test] gem 'kaminari', '~> 1.2' gem 'ransack', '~> 4.0' group :development, :test do gem 'debug', platforms: %i[ mri mingw x64_mingw ] gem 'rspec-rails', '~> 6.0' gem 'factory_bot_rails', '~> 6.2' gem 'faker', '~> 3.2' gem 'webmock', '~> 3.19' end group :development do gem 'web-console' gem 'letter_opener', '~> 1.8' end group :test do gem 'capybara', '~> 3.39' gem 'selenium-webdriver', '~> 4.14' gem 'shoulda-matchers', '~> 5.3' gem 'vcr', '~> 6.2' end ``` ## Конфігурація ### config/initializers/woocommerce.rb ```ruby # config/initializers/woocommerce.rb require 'woocommerce_api' WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG = { url: ENV['WOOCOMMERCE_URL'] || 'https://your-store.com', consumer_key: ENV['WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY'], consumer_secret: ENV['WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET'], wp_api: true, version: 'wc/v3', verify_ssl: Rails.env.production? }.freeze ``` ### config/routes.rb ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do devise_for :admin_users authenticate :admin_user do namespace :admin do root to: 'dashboard#index' resources :products, except: [:show] do collection do post :import get :sync end member do post :sync post :publish post :unpublish end end resources :product_categories resources :settings, only: [:index, :update] end end root to: redirect('/admin') end ``` ## Моделі ### app/models/admin_user.rb ```ruby # app/models/admin_user.rb class AdminUser < ApplicationRecord devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable, :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable has_many :product_sync_logs validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true end ``` ### app/models/product.rb ```ruby # app/models/product.rb class Product < ApplicationRecord include WooCommerceSyncable # Database fields (cache from WooCommerce) # id, woo_id, name, sku, price, regular_price, sale_price, # description, short_description, status, featured, # stock_quantity, stock_status, categories, images, # created_at, updated_at, synced_at STATUSES = %w[draft pending private publish].freeze STOCK_STATUSES = %w[instock outofstock onbackorder].freeze # Validations validates :name, presence: true validates :price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true validates :regular_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true validates :sale_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_nil: true validates :status, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }, allow_nil: true validates :stock_status, inclusion: { in: STOCK_STATUSES }, allow_nil: true # Scopes scope :published, -> { where(status: 'publish') } scope :drafts, -> { where(status: 'draft') } scope :in_stock, -> { where(stock_status: 'instock') } scope :out_of_stock, -> { where(stock_status: 'outofstock') } scope :needs_sync, -> { where('synced_at IS NULL OR synced_at < ?', 1.hour.ago) } # Instance methods def published? status == 'publish' end def in_stock? stock_status == 'instock' end def display_price sale_price || price || regular_price end def formatted_price return 'N/A' unless display_price ActionController::Base.helpers.number_to_currency(display_price) end def categories_list return [] if categories.blank? JSON.parse(categories) rescue [] end def images_list return [] if images.blank? JSON.parse(images) rescue [] end def primary_image images_list.first end end ``` ### app/models/product_sync_log.rb ```ruby # app/models/product_sync_log.rb class ProductSyncLog < ApplicationRecord belongs_to :admin_user, optional: true enum operation: { create: 0, update: 1, delete: 2, import: 3, sync: 4 } enum status: { pending: 0, in_progress: 1, completed: 2, failed: 3 } validates :operation, presence: true scope :recent, -> { order(created_at: :desc).limit(100) } def mark_completed!(details = {}) update!( status: :completed, completed_at: Time.current, details: details.to_json ) end def mark_failed!(error_message) update!( status: :failed, error_message: error_message, completed_at: Time.current ) end end ``` ## Сервіси ### app/services/woocommerce/base_service.rb ```ruby # app/services/woocommerce/base_service.rb module WooCommerce class BaseService attr_reader :client, :errors def initialize @client = setup_client @errors = [] end private def setup_client WooCommerce::API.new( WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:url], WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:consumer_key], WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:consumer_secret], wp_api: WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:wp_api], version: WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:version], verify_ssl: WOOCOMMERCE_CONFIG[:verify_ssl] ) end def handle_response(response) if response.success? yield(response) if block_given? response else @errors << response.message Rails.logger.error("WooCommerce API Error: #{response.message}") false end rescue => e @errors << e.message Rails.logger.error("WooCommerce API Exception: #{e.message}") false end end end ``` ### app/services/woocommerce/product_service.rb ```ruby # app/services/woocommerce/product_service.rb module WooCommerce class ProductService < BaseService # Get all products def list(page: 1, per_page: 100, filters: {}) params = { page: page, per_page: per_page }.merge(filters) response = client.get('products', params) handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end # Get single product def get(product_id) response = client.get("products/#{product_id}") handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end # Create product def create(product_attributes) response = client.post('products', product_attributes) handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end # Update product def update(product_id, product_attributes) response = client.put("products/#{product_id}", product_attributes) handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end # Delete product def delete(product_id, force: false) params = force ? { force: true } : {} response = client.delete("products/#{product_id}", params) handle_response(response) do return true end end # Batch operations def batch_create(products) response = client.post('products/batch', { create: products }) handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end def batch_update(products) response = client.post('products/batch', { update: products }) handle_response(response) do return response.parsed_response end end # Sync specific product def sync_product(woo_id) woo_product = get(woo_id) return false unless woo_product local_product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(woo_id: woo_id) local_product.update!(map_product_attributes(woo_product)) local_product.touch(:synced_at) local_product end # Sync all products def sync_all(batch_size: 100) page = 1 total_synced = 0 loop do products = list(page: page, per_page: batch_size) break if products.blank? products.each do |woo_product| local_product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(woo_id: woo_product['id']) local_product.update!(map_product_attributes(woo_product)) local_product.touch(:synced_at) total_synced += 1 end page += 1 break if products.length < batch_size end total_synced end # Map WooCommerce product to local attributes def map_product_attributes(woo_product) { woo_id: woo_product['id'], name: woo_product['name'], sku: woo_product['sku'], price: woo_product['price'], regular_price: woo_product['regular_price'], sale_price: woo_product['sale_price'], description: woo_product['description'], short_description: woo_product['short_description'], status: woo_product['status'], featured: woo_product['featured'], stock_quantity: woo_product['stock_quantity'], stock_status: woo_product['stock_status'], categories: woo_product['categories']&.to_json, images: woo_product['images']&.to_json, attributes: woo_product['attributes']&.to_json, variations: woo_product['variations']&.to_json, meta_data: woo_product['meta_data']&.to_json, date_created: woo_product['date_created'], date_modified: woo_product['date_modified'] } end # Build WooCommerce product attributes from local product def build_product_attributes(product) { name: product.name, sku: product.sku, type: 'simple', status: product.status || 'draft', featured: product.featured || false, description: product.description, short_description: product.short_description, price: product.price.to_s, regular_price: product.regular_price.to_s, sale_price: product.sale_price.to_s, manage_stock: product.stock_quantity.present?, stock_quantity: product.stock_quantity, stock_status: product.stock_status || 'instock', categories: product.categories_list.map { |c| { id: c['id'] } }, images: product.images_list }.compact end end end ``` ## Контролери ### app/controllers/admin/base_controller.rb ```ruby # app/controllers/admin/base_controller.rb module Admin class BaseController < ApplicationController before_action :authenticate_admin_user! layout 'admin' private def authorize_admin unless current_admin_user redirect_to new_admin_user_session_path, alert: 'Please sign in.' end end end end ``` ### app/controllers/admin/products_controller.rb ```ruby # app/controllers/admin/products_controller.rb module Admin class ProductsController < BaseController before_action :set_product, only: [:edit, :update, :destroy, :sync, :publish, :unpublish] # GET /admin/products def index @q = Product.ransack(params[:q]) @products = @q.result(distinct: true) .order(created_at: :desc) .page(params[:page]) .per(25) end # GET /admin/products/new def new @product = Product.new(status: 'draft', stock_status: 'instock') end # POST /admin/products def create @product = Product.new(product_params) if @product.valid? service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new woo_product = service.create(service.build_product_attributes(@product)) if woo_product @product.woo_id = woo_product['id'] @product.synced_at = Time.current if @product.save log_sync(@product, :create, :completed) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: 'Product was successfully created in WooCommerce.' else log_sync(@product, :create, :failed) render :new end else log_sync(@product, :create, :failed, service.errors.join(', ')) flash.now[:alert] = "Failed to create product: #{service.errors.join(', ')}" render :new end else render :new end end # GET /admin/products/:id/edit def edit end # PATCH/PUT /admin/products/:id def update if @product.update(product_params) service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new woo_product = service.update(@product.woo_id, service.build_product_attributes(@product)) if woo_product @product.touch(:synced_at) log_sync(@product, :update, :completed) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: 'Product was successfully updated.' else log_sync(@product, :update, :failed, service.errors.join(', ')) flash.now[:alert] = "Failed to update product: #{service.errors.join(', ')}" render :edit end else render :edit end end # DELETE /admin/products/:id def destroy service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new if service.delete(@product.woo_id) @product.destroy log_sync(@product, :delete, :completed) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: 'Product was successfully deleted.' else log_sync(@product, :delete, :failed, service.errors.join(', ')) redirect_to admin_products_path, alert: "Failed to delete product: #{service.errors.join(', ')}" end end # POST /admin/products/:id/sync def sync service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new if service.sync_product(@product.woo_id) log_sync(@product, :sync, :completed) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: 'Product was successfully synced.' else log_sync(@product, :sync, :failed, service.errors.join(', ')) redirect_to admin_products_path, alert: "Failed to sync product: #{service.errors.join(', ')}" end end # POST /admin/products/sync def sync_all service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new log = ProductSyncLog.create!( admin_user: current_admin_user, operation: :sync, status: :in_progress ) # Run sync in background (or synchronously for simplicity) total = service.sync_all log.mark_completed!(total_synced: total) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: "#{total} products were successfully synced from WooCommerce." rescue => e log&.mark_failed!(e.message) redirect_to admin_products_path, alert: "Sync failed: #{e.message}" end # POST /admin/products/:id/publish def publish update_status('publish', 'published') end # POST /admin/products/:id/unpublish def unpublish update_status('draft', 'unpublished') end private def set_product @product = Product.find(params[:id]) end def product_params params.require(:product).permit( :name, :sku, :price, :regular_price, :sale_price, :description, :short_description, :status, :featured, :stock_quantity, :stock_status, categories: [], images: [] ) end def update_status(new_status, action_name) service = WooCommerce::ProductService.new if service.update(@product.woo_id, { status: new_status }) @product.update(status: new_status) @product.touch(:synced_at) log_sync(@product, :update, :completed) redirect_to admin_products_path, notice: "Product was successfully #{action_name}." else log_sync(@product, :update, :failed, service.errors.join(', ')) redirect_to admin_products_path, alert: "Failed to #{action_name} product: #{service.errors.join(', ')}" end end def log_sync(product, operation, status, error = nil) ProductSyncLog.create!( admin_user: current_admin_user, product_woo_id: product.woo_id, operation: operation, status: status, error_message: error, completed_at: Time.current ) end end end ``` ### app/controllers/admin/dashboard_controller.rb ```ruby # app/controllers/admin/dashboard_controller.rb module Admin class DashboardController < BaseController def index @total_products = Product.count @published_products = Product.published.count @draft_products = Product.drafts.count @in_stock_products = Product.in_stock.count @out_of_stock_products = Product.out_of_stock.count @needs_sync = Product.needs_sync.count @recent_sync_logs = ProductSyncLog.recent.limit(10) end end end ``` ## Views ### app/views/admin/products/index.html.erb ```erb

## Gemfile

```

## tracking.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "dotenv/load"

# Клієнт для отримання статусу відправлень через API служби «Делівері»
# (delivery-auto.com).
#
# ВАЖЛИВО: точний шлях методу та назви полів відповіді перевірте в актуальній
# документації API Делівері. Тут вони винесені в налаштування (.env), а розбір
# відповіді зроблено толерантним до регістру й варіантів назв полів.
module DeliveryApi
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class ConfigurationError < Error; end

  class NotFoundError < Error; end

  class RequestError < Error
    attr_reader :http_status

    def initialize(message, http_status = nil)
      super(message)
      @http_status = http_status
    end
  end

  # Результат запиту статусу одного відправлення
  ShipmentStatus = Struct.new(
    :number, :status, :city_from, :city_to, :updated_at, :raw,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def to_s
      parts = ["ТТН #{number}: #{status || 'статус невідомий'}"]
      parts << "маршрут: #{city_from} → #{city_to}" if city_from || city_to
      parts << "оновлено: #{updated_at}" if updated_at
      parts.join(" | ")
    end
  end

  class Client
    DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://www.delivery-auto.com"
    DEFAULT_TRACK_PATH = "/api/v4/Public/GetReceiptDetails"

    def initialize(base_url: ENV.fetch("DELIVERY_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL),
                   track_path: ENV.fetch("DELIVERY_TRACK_PATH", DEFAULT_TRACK_PATH),
                   api_key: ENV["DELIVERY_API_KEY"],
                   culture: ENV.fetch("DELIVERY_CULTURE", "uk-UA"),
                   timeout: 10)
      @track_path = track_path
      @culture = culture
      @connection = build_connection(base_url, api_key, timeout)
    end

    # Повертає ShipmentStatus для однієї накладної
    def track(number)
      number = number.to_s.strip
      raise ArgumentError, "Номер відправлення не може бути порожнім" if number.empty?

      response = perform_request(number)
      body = parse_body(response)
      build_status(number, body)
    end

    # Повертає хеш { номер => ShipmentStatus | Error } для списку накладних.
    # Помилка по одній накладній не зупиняє обробку решти.
    def track_many(numbers)
      numbers.uniq.each_with_object({}) do |number, result|
        result[number] = track(number)
      rescue Error, ArgumentError => e
        result[number] = e
      end
    end

    private

    def build_connection(base_url, api_key, timeout)
      Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f|
        f.request :retry,
                  max: 3,
                  interval: 0.5,
                  backoff_factor: 2,
                  retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                  exceptions: [Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed]
        f.options.timeout = timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.headers["User-Agent"] = "delivery-tracker-ruby/1.0"
        f.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{api_key}" if api_key && !api_key.empty?
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    def perform_request(number)
      @connection.get(@track_path, { number: number, culture: @culture })
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError
      raise RequestError, "Тайм-аут під час запиту до API Делівері"
    rescue Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise RequestError, "Не вдалося з'єднатися з API Делівері: #{e.message}"
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise RequestError, "Помилка HTTP-клієнта: #{e.message}"
    end

    def parse_body(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299
        # ок
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "Відправлення не знайдено"
      when 401, 403
        raise RequestError.new("Доступ заборонено (перевірте DELIVERY_API_KEY)", response.status)
      else
        raise RequestError.new("API повернуло HTTP #{response.status}", response.status)
      end

      JSON.parse(response.body.to_s)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise RequestError.new("API повернуло некоректний JSON", response.status)
    end

    def build_status(number, body)
      unless body.is_a?(Hash)
        raise RequestError, "Неочікуваний формат відповіді API"
      end

      # Типова обгортка: { "status": true/false, "data": {...}, "message": "..." }
      if pick(body, "status") == false
        message = pick(body, "message") || "Відправлення не знайдено"
        raise NotFoundError, message.to_s
      end

      data = pick(body, "data") || body
      data = data.first if data.is_a?(Array)
      raise NotFoundError, "Порожня відповідь для ТТН #{number}" if data.nil? || data.empty?

      ShipmentStatus.new(
        number: number,
        status: pick(data, "StatusName", "StateName", "Status", "State"),
        city_from: pick(data, "CityFromName", "CitySenderName", "CityFrom"),
        city_to: pick(data, "CityToName", "CityReceiverName", "CityTo"),
        updated_at: pick(data, "StatusDate", "DateStatus", "UpdatedAt"),
        raw: data
      )
    end

    # Пошук значення за першим наявним ключем без урахування регістру
    def pick(hash, *keys)
      return nil unless hash.is_a?(Hash)

      keys.each do |key|
        found = hash.find { |k, _| k.to_s.casecmp?(key) }
        return found[1] unless found.nil? || found[1].to_s.strip.empty? && found[1] != false
      end
      nil
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------- Запуск з командного рядка ----------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  numbers = ARGV.flat_map { |arg| arg.split(/[\s,;]+/) }.reject(&:empty?)

  if numbers.empty?
    warn "Використання: ruby tracking.rb <номер_ТТН> [<номер_ТТН> ...]"
    exit 1
  end

  client = DeliveryApi::Client.new
  results = client.track_many(numbers)

  results.each do |number, result|
    case result
    when DeliveryApi::ShipmentStatus
      puts result
    when DeliveryApi::NotFoundError
      puts "ТТН #{number}: не знайдено (#{result.message})"
    else
      puts "ТТН #{number}: помилка — #{result.message}"
    end
  end

  exit(results.values.all?(DeliveryApi::ShipmentStatus) ? 0 : 2)
end
```

DELIVERY_TRACK_PATH=/api/v4/Public/GetReceiptDetails

DELIVERY_CULTURE=uk-UA
```

## Використання

```

Або з коду:

```

## Примітки

- Я не можу перевірити актуальність ендпоінта й структури відповіді Делівері. Шлях `GetReceiptDetails`, параметри `number` та `culture` і назви полів у `build_status` потрібно звірити з офіційною документацією. Шлях і ключ API задаються через `.env`, а мапінг полів змінюється в одному місці.
- Клієнт має тайм-аути та до 3 повторів із наростаючою паузою при помилках мережі й відповідях 429/5xx.
- `track_many` не зупиняється на помилці однієї накладної: для неї в результаті буде об'єкт помилки.

```ruby
# support_ticket_summarizer.rb
require 'anthropic'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class SupportTicketSummarizer
  attr_reader :client, :max_tokens, :temperature

  def initialize(max_tokens: 1000, temperature: 0.3)
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(api_key: ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])
    @max_tokens = max_tokens
    @temperature = temperature
  end

  def summarize_ticket(ticket_text, options = {})
    validate_input(ticket_text)
    
    prompt = build_prompt(ticket_text, options)
    
    begin
      response = client.complete(
        prompt: prompt,
        model: options[:model] || 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229',
        max_tokens_to_sample: options[:max_tokens] || max_tokens,
        temperature: options[:temperature] || temperature,
        stop_sequences: options[:stop_sequences] || ["\n\nHuman:", "\n\nAssistant:"]
      )
      
      parse_response(response)
    rescue Anthropic::APIError => e
      handle_api_error(e)
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_standard_error(e)
    end
  end

  def summarize_multiple_tickets(tickets, options = {})
    results = []
    
    tickets.each_with_index do |ticket, index|
      puts "Summarizing ticket #{index + 1} of #{tickets.length}..."
      
      result = summarize_ticket(ticket[:content], options)
      results << {
        ticket_id: ticket[:id],
        summary: result[:summary],
        key_points: result[:key_points],
        sentiment: result[:sentiment],
        priority: result[:priority]
      }
      
      # Rate limiting pause to avoid API throttling
      sleep(0.5) if index < tickets.length - 1
    end
    
    results
  end

  private

  def validate_input(ticket_text)
    raise ArgumentError, "Ticket text cannot be empty" if ticket_text.nil? || ticket_text.strip.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Ticket text is too long (max 100,000 characters)" if ticket_text.length > 100_000
  end

  def build_prompt(ticket_text, options)
    format = options[:format] || default_format
    language = options[:language] || 'English'
    
    <<~PROMPT
      Human: You are a customer support assistant. Please analyze and summarize the following support ticket.
      
      Requirements:
      - Provide a concise summary (2-3 sentences)
      - Extract key points and action items
      - Determine sentiment (positive, negative, or neutral)
      - Assess priority level (low, medium, high, or urgent)
      - Respond in #{language}
      
      Response format:
      #{format}
      
      Support Ticket:
      #{ticket_text}
      
      Assistant: Here is my analysis of the support ticket:
    PROMPT
  end

  def default_format
    <<~FORMAT
      Summary: [Your summary here]
      Key Points:
      - [Point 1]
      - [Point 2]
      - [Point 3]
      Sentiment: [Positive/Negative/Neutral]
      Priority: [Low/Medium/High/Urgent]
    FORMAT
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    response_text = response.dig('completion') || response.dig('content', 0, 'text') || ''
    
    # Parse the structured response
    summary = extract_section(response_text, 'Summary')
    key_points = extract_key_points(response_text)
    sentiment = extract_section(response_text, 'Sentiment')
    priority = extract_section(response_text, 'Priority')
    
    {
      summary: summary,
      key_points: key_points,
      sentiment: sentiment,
      priority: priority,
      full_response: response_text,
      model: response.dig('model'),
      usage: response.dig('usage')
    }
  end

  def extract_section(text, section_name)
    pattern = /#{section_name}:\s*(.+?)(?=\n\s*(?:Key Points|Sentiment|Priority|$))/im
    match = text.match(pattern)
    match ? match[1].strip : ''
  end

  def extract_key_points(text)
    points = []
    in_key_points = false
    
    text.each_line do |line|
      if line.match?(/Key Points:/i)
        in_key_points = true
        next
      elsif line.match?(/Sentiment:|Priority:/i)
        in_key_points = false
        next
      end
      
      if in_key_points && line.match?(/^\s*[-•*]\s*(.+)/)
        points << $1.strip
      end
    end
    
    points
  end

  def handle_api_error(error)
    {
      error: true,
      message: "API Error: #{error.message}",
      status: error.status_code
    }
  end

  def handle_standard_error(error)
    {
      error: true,
      message: "Unexpected error: #{error.message}"
    }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables
  require 'dotenv'
  Dotenv.load
  
  # Example ticket
  ticket = <<~TICKET
    Subject: Unable to access account after password reset
    
    Hello Support Team,
    
    I've been trying to reset my password for the past 3 hours without success. 
    When I click the "Forgot Password" link, I receive the reset email, but when

    Ticket reference: #TKT-2024-001234

  # Initialize summarizer

    puts "Error: #{result[:message]}"
  else
    puts "Summary: #{result[:summary]}"
    puts "\nKey Points:"

    puts "\nSentiment: #{result[:sentiment]}"

  # Example with multiple tickets
  tickets = [
    { id: "TKT-001", content: ticket },
    { id: "TKT-002", content: "Another support ticket text here..." }
  ]

  puts "\nMultiple tickets summarized: #{results.length}"
end

```markdown
# Support Ticket Summarizer

Ruby application for summarizing long customer support tickets using Anthropic Claude API.

## Setup

1. Install dependencies:
```bash
bundle install
```

2. Set up environment variables:
```bash
cp .env.example .env
# Add your Anthropic API key to .env file
```

3. Run the application:
```bash
ruby support_ticket_summarizer.rb
```

## Features

- Summarizes support tickets into concise summaries
- Extracts key points and action items
- Determines sentiment analysis
- Assesses priority level
- Handles multiple tickets with rate limiting
- Error handling for API failures
- Configurable parameters (temperature, max tokens, model)

## Usage

```ruby
summarizer = SupportTicketSummarizer.new
result = summarizer.summarize_ticket("Your ticket text here")
```

## Configuration

- `max_tokens`: Maximum tokens for response (default: 1000)
- `temperature`: Response creativity (default: 0.3)
- `model`: Claude model to use (default: claude-3-sonnet-20240229)
```

- Повний Gemfile з усіма необхідними залежностями

- Підтримку кількох звернень
- Налаштовувані параметри
- Приклади використання
- Документацію

### 1. Database Configuration

# config/database.rb
require 'active_record'

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(

      t.decimal :price, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false

### 2. Product Model

```ruby
# models/product.rb
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :sku, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :title, presence: true
  validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :quantity, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  
  scope :needs_listing, -> { where(ebay_item_id: nil) }
  scope :listed, -> { where.not(ebay_item_id: nil) }
  scope :needs_quantity_update, -> { 
    where.not(ebay_item_id: nil)
    .where('last_synced_at IS NULL OR last_synced_at < updated_at')
  }
  
  def needs_listing?
    ebay_item_id.nil?
  end
  
  def needs_quantity_update?
    ebay_item_id.present? && (last_synced_at.nil? || last_synced_at < updated_at)
  end
end

### 3. eBay Service

```ruby
# services/ebay_service.rb
require 'ebayapi'
require 'logger'

class EbayService
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    configure_ebay_api
  end
  
  def list_item(product)
    @logger.info("Listing product #{product.sku} on eBay")
    
    begin
      response = @ebay.add_item(
        title: product.title,
        description: product.description || product.title,
        price: product.price,
        quantity: product.quantity,
        sku: product.sku,
        currency: 'USD',
        country: 'US',
        category_id: ENV['EBAY_CATEGORY_ID'] || '9355',
        condition: 'New',
        listing_duration: 'GTC', # Good Till Cancelled
        payment_methods: ['PayPal'],
        paypal_email: ENV['PAYPAL_EMAIL'],
        shipping_details: {
          shipping_service: 'USPSPriority',
          shipping_cost: 0,
          shipping_type: 'Flat'
        },
        return_policy: {
          returns_accepted: 'ReturnsAccepted',
          returns_within: 'Days_30',
          refund_option: 'MoneyBack',
          shipping_cost_paid_by: 'Buyer'
        }
      )
      
      if response.success?
        item_id = response.item_id
        product.update(
          ebay_item_id: item_id,
          ebay_listing_status: 'Active',
          last_synced_at: Time.current
        )
        @logger.info("Successfully listed product #{product.sku} with eBay ID #{item_id}")
        return true
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to list product #{product.sku}: #{response.errors}")
        return false
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error listing product #{product.sku}: #{e.message}")
      return false
    end
  end
  
  def update_quantity(product)
    @logger.info("Updating quantity for product #{product.sku} (eBay ID: #{product.ebay_item_id})")
    
    begin
      response = @ebay.revise_inventory_status(
        item_id: product.ebay_item_id,
        quantity: product.quantity
      )
      
      if response.success?
        product.update(last_synced_at: Time.current)
        @logger.info("Successfully updated quantity for product #{product.sku} to #{product.quantity}")
        return true
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to update quantity for product #{product.sku}: #{response.errors}")
        return false
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error updating quantity for product #{product.sku}: #{e.message}")
      return false
    end
  end
  
  def end_listing(product)
    @logger.info("Ending eBay listing for product #{product.sku}")
    
    begin
      response = @ebay.end_item(
        item_id: product.ebay_item_id,
        ending_reason: 'NotAvailable'
      )
      
      if response.success?
        product.update(
          ebay_listing_status: 'Ended',
          last_synced_at: Time.current
        )
        @logger.info("Successfully ended eBay listing for product #{product.sku}")
        return true
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to end listing for product #{product.sku}: #{response.errors}")
        return false
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error ending listing for product #{product.sku}: #{e.message}")
      return false
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def configure_ebay_api
    @ebay = EbayAPI.new(
      auth_token: ENV['EBAY_AUTH_TOKEN'],
      dev_id: ENV['EBAY_DEV_ID'],
      app_id: ENV['EBAY_APP_ID'],
      cert_id: ENV['EBAY_CERT_ID'],
      sandbox: ENV['EBAY_SANDBOX'] == 'true'
    )
  end
end
```

### 4. eBay Synchronization Service

```ruby
# services/ebay_sync_service.rb
require 'concurrent'

class EbaySyncService
  def initialize
    @ebay_service = EbayService.new
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def sync_all
    @logger.info("Starting eBay synchronization")
    
    # List new items
    list_new_items
    
    # Update quantities for existing items
    update_quantities
    
    @logger.info("eBay synchronization completed")
  end
  
  def list_new_items
    products = Product.needs_listing
    @logger.info("Found #{products.count} products needing eBay listing")
    
    products.each do |product|
      @ebay_service.list_item(product)
      sleep(1) # Rate limiting
    end
  end
  
  def update_quantities
    products = Product.needs_quantity_update
    @logger.info("Found #{products.count} products needing quantity updates")
    
    # Process in parallel for better performance
    pool = Concurrent::FixedThreadPool.new(5)
    
    products.each do |product|
      pool.post do
        @ebay_service.update_quantity(product)
        sleep(0.5) # Rate limiting within threads
      end
    end
    
    pool.shutdown
    pool.wait_for_termination
  end
  
  def sync_single_product(product_id)
    product = Product.find(product_id)
    
    if product.needs_listing?
      @ebay_service.list_item(product)
    elsif product.needs_quantity_update?
      @ebay_service.update_quantity(product)
    else
      @logger.info("Product #{product.sku} is already up to date")
    end
  end
end
```
