Task: Send invoices to Xero and keep their payment status in sync with the Rails app.
text:
Below is a complete Rails integration for sending invoices to Xero and keeping their payment status synchronised via webhooks and polling.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '3.3.0'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.1'
gem 'pg'
gem 'puma'
gem 'sidekiq'
gem 'redis'
gem 'xero-ruby'
gem 'dotenv-rails', groups: [:development, :test]
```

---

## Database Migrations

Add Xero fields to your existing `invoices` table and create a token store for Xero OAuth tokens.

```ruby
# db/migrate/xxxx_add_xero_fields_to_invoices.rb
class AddXeroFieldsToInvoices < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1]
  def change
    add_column :invoices, :xero_invoice_id, :string
    add_column :invoices, :xero_status, :string
    add_column :invoices, :xero_synced_at, :datetime
    add_index :invoices, :xero_invoice_id, unique: true
  end
end
```

```ruby
# db/migrate/xxxx_create_xero_tokens.rb
class CreateXeroTokens < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1]
  def change
    create_table :xero_tokens do |t|
      t.text :access_token
      t.text :refresh_token
      t.integer :expires_in
      t.datetime :expires_at
      t.timestamps
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Models

### XeroToken

```ruby
# app/models/xero_token.rb
class XeroToken < ApplicationRecord
  def self.current
    first
  end

  def self.store_token_set(token_set)
    record = first || new
    expires_in = token_set[:expires_in] || token_set['expires_in']
    expires_at = token_set[:expires_at] || token_set['expires_at']

    record.update!(
      access_token: token_set[:access_token] || token_set['access_token'],
      refresh_token: token_set[:refresh_token] || token_set['refresh_token'],
      expires_in: expires_in,
      expires_at: expires_at ? Time.parse(expires_at.to_s) : (expires_in ? Time.current + expires_in.to_i.seconds : nil)
    )
  end

  def token_set
    {
      access_token: access_token,
      refresh_token: refresh_token,
      expires_in: expires_in,
      expires_at: expires_at
    }
  end
end
```

### Invoice (relevant parts)

```ruby
# app/models/invoice.rb
class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :line_items, dependent: :destroy

  enum :status, { draft: 'draft', sent: 'sent', paid: 'paid', void: 'void' }

  # Add to your existing Invoice model
  def xero_contact
    # Option 1: if you store Xero Contact ID
    { contact_id: xero_contact_id }

    # Option 2: if you want Xero to create the contact from name/email
    # { name: contact_name, email_address: contact_email }
  end

  def xero_line_items
    line_items.map do |li|
      XeroRuby::LineItem.new(
        description: li.description,
        quantity: li.quantity,
        unit_amount: li.unit_price,
        account_code: li.account_code,
        tax_type: li.tax_type
      )
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Xero Client Wrapper

```ruby
# app/services/xero/client.rb
module Xero
  class Client
    class << self
      def api_client
        @api_client ||= begin
          credentials = {
            client_id: ENV.fetch('XERO_CLIENT_ID'),
            client_secret: ENV.fetch('XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'),
            redirect_uri: ENV.fetch('XERO_REDIRECT_URI'),
            scopes: ENV.fetch('XERO_SCOPES', 'openid profile email accounting.transactions accounting.contacts accounting.settings offline_access')
          }

          client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(credentials)
          token = XeroToken.current
          raise 'No Xero token found' unless token

          if token.expires_at && token.expires_at < Time.current
            new_token_set = client.refresh_token_set(token.token_set)
            XeroToken.store_token_set(new_token_set)
            token = XeroToken.current
          end

          client.set_token_set(token.token_set)
          client
        end
      end

      def accounting_api
        XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(api_client)
      end

      def tenant_id
        ENV.fetch('XERO_TENANT_ID')
      end
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Services

### Send Invoice to Xero

```ruby
# app/services/xero/send_invoice.rb
module Xero
  class SendInvoice
    def initialize(invoice)
      @invoice = invoice
    end

    def call
      xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice
      response = Xero::Client.accounting_api.create_invoices(
        Xero::Client.tenant_id,
        { invoices: [xero_invoice] }
      )

      created = response.invoices.first
      @invoice.update!(
        xero_invoice_id: created.invoice_id,
        xero_status: created.status,
        xero_synced_at: Time.current,
        status: map_status(created.status)
      )
      @invoice
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error("Xero invoice creation failed for invoice #{@invoice.id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end

    private

    def build_xero_invoice
      XeroRuby::Invoice.new(
        type: XeroRuby::Invoice::ACCREC,
        contact: @invoice.xero_contact,
        line_items: @invoice.xero_line_items,
        date: @invoice.issue_date.iso8601,
        due_date: @invoice.due_date.iso8601,
        reference: @invoice.number,
        currency_code: @invoice.currency,
        status: XeroRuby::Invoice::AUTHORISED
      )
    end

    def map_status(xero_status)
      case xero_status
      when 'PAID' then :paid
      when 'VOIDED' then :void
      when 'AUTHORISED', 'SUBMITTED' then :sent
      else :draft
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Sync Invoice Status from Xero

```ruby
# app/services/xero/sync_invoice_status.rb
module Xero
  class SyncInvoiceStatus
    def initialize(invoice)
      @invoice = invoice
    end

    def call
      return unless @invoice.xero_invoice_id.present?

      xero_invoice = Xero::Client.accounting_api.get_invoice(
        Xero::Client.tenant_id,
        @invoice.xero_invoice_id
      )

      @invoice.update!(
        xero_status: xero_invoice.status,
        xero_synced_at: Time.current,
        status: map_status(xero_invoice.status)
      )
      @invoice
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error("Xero invoice status sync failed for invoice #{@invoice.id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end

    private

    def map_status(xero_status)
      case xero_status
      when 'PAID' then :paid
      when 'VOIDED' then :void
      when 'AUTHORISED', 'SUBMITTED' then :sent
      else :draft
      end
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Webhook Receiver

### Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/xero/webhooks_controller.rb
module Xero
  class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
    skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: :receive

    def receive
      payload = request.raw_post
      signature = request.headers['x-xero-signature']

      unless valid_signature?(payload, signature)
        render plain: 'Signature verification failed', status: :unauthorized
        return
      end

      Xero::WebhookProcessor.new(payload).call
      render plain: 'OK', status: :ok
    end

    private

    def valid_signature?(payload, signature)
      return false if signature.blank?

      key = ENV.fetch('XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY')
      computed = Base64.strict_encode64(
        OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', key, payload)
      )
      ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(computed, signature)
    end
  end
end
```

### Webhook Processor

```ruby
# app/services/xero/webhook_processor.rb
module Xero
  class WebhookProcessor
    def initialize(payload)
      @payload = payload
    end

    def call
      data = JSON.parse(@payload)
      events = data['events'] || []
      events.each do |event|
        process_event(event)
      end
    end

    private

    def process_event(event)
      return unless event['eventCategory'] == 'INVOICE'
      return unless %w[Create Update].include?(event['eventType'])

      invoice_id = event['resourceId']
      invoice = Invoice.find_by(xero_invoice_id: invoice_id)
      return unless invoice

      Xero::SyncInvoiceStatus.new(invoice).call
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Sidekiq Jobs

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero/send_invoice_job.rb
module Xero
  class SendInvoiceJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    def perform(invoice_id)
      invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
      Xero::SendInvoice.new(invoice).call
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero/sync_invoice_status_job.rb
module Xero
  class SyncInvoiceStatusJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    def perform(invoice_id)
      invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
      Xero::SyncInvoiceStatus.new(invoice).call
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero/sync_all_invoices_status_job.rb
module Xero
  class SyncAllInvoicesStatusJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    def perform
      Invoice.where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil).find_each do |invoice|
        Xero::SyncInvoiceStatusJob.perform_async(invoice.id)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

---

## Routes

```ruby
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  post 'xero/webhooks', to: 'xero/webhooks#receive'
end
```

---

## Configuration

Create an initializer to load Xero constants and require the gem.

```ruby
# config/initializers/xero.rb
require 'xero-ruby'

# Set environment variables:
# XERO_CLIENT_ID
# XERO_CLIENT_SECRET
# XERO_REDIRECT_URI
# XERO_TENANT_ID
# XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY
```

---

## Usage

1. **Send an invoice to Xero**
   ```ruby
   invoice = Invoice.find(123)
   Xero::SendInvoiceJob.perform_async(invoice.id)
   ```

2. **Manual status sync**
   ```ruby
   invoice = Invoice.find(123)
   Xero::SyncInvoiceStatus.new(invoice).call
   ```

3. **Webhook endpoint**
   Configure your Xero app webhook URL to `https://yourdomain.com/xero/webhooks`.  
   The controller verifies the signature and processes invoice events automatically.

4. **Scheduled full sync** (optional)
   Use Sidekiq Scheduler or cron to run `Xero::SyncAllInvoicesStatusJob` periodically.

---

This implementation covers the full lifecycle: sending invoices to Xero, storing the Xero invoice ID, receiving real‑time webhooks for status updates, and providing a polling fallback to keep payment statuses synchronised with your Rails app.

Task: Import bank transactions from a CAMT.053 XML statement and match them to unpaid invoices by reference.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.1"

gem "nokogiri", "~> 1.16"   # XML parsing
gem "bigdecimal", "~> 3.1"  # exact money arithmetic (a bundled gem since Ruby 3.4)
gem "csv", "~> 3.3"         # reading the unpaid-invoice list (a bundled gem since Ruby 3.4)
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# camt_reconciler.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true
#
# Usage:  bundle exec ruby camt_reconciler.rb statement.xml invoices.csv
#
# invoices.csv headers: number,reference,amount,currency
#   INV-2024-001,RF18539007547034,1210.00,EUR

require "nokogiri"
require "bigdecimal"
require "date"
require "digest"
require "csv"
require "set"

module Camt
  # A single bank movement extracted from a CAMT.053 statement.
  Transaction = Struct.new(
    :id, :account_iban, :booking_date, :value_date, :amount, :currency,
    :credit, :reversal, :end_to_end_id, :structured_reference,
    :remittance_text, :counterparty,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def credit? = credit && !reversal
  end

  class ParseError < StandardError; end

  # Parses CAMT.053 (any camt.053.001.xx version) into Transaction objects.
  class Parser
    def self.parse_file(path)
      parse(File.read(path))
    end

    def self.parse(xml)
      doc = begin
        # strict: raise on malformed XML. nonet: never fetch network resources.
        # DTD loading and entity substitution are off by default (XXE-safe).
        Nokogiri::XML(xml) { |cfg| cfg.strict.nonet.noblob }
      rescue Nokogiri::XML::SyntaxError => e
        raise ParseError, "Malformed XML: #{e.message}"
      end

      # The namespace carries the schema version, and the element names are
      # the same across versions, so drop it.
      doc.remove_namespaces!
      unless doc.at_xpath("/Document/BkToCstmrStmt")
        raise ParseError, "Not a CAMT.053 document (missing Document/BkToCstmrStmt)"
      end

      doc.xpath("/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt").flat_map do |stmt|
        iban = first_text(stmt, "Acct/Id/IBAN") || first_text(stmt, "Acct/Id/Othr/Id")
        stmt.xpath("Ntry").flat_map { |entry| parse_entry(entry, iban) }
      end
    end

    def self.parse_entry(entry, iban)
      status = first_text(entry, "Sts") # "BOOK" or <Sts><Cd>BOOK</Cd></Sts>
      return [] if status && status != "BOOK" # skip pending/info entries

      details = entry.xpath("NtryDtls/TxDtls").to_a
      amount_nodes = details.map { |d| d.at_xpath("AmtDtls/TxAmt/Amt") || d.at_xpath("Amt") }

      if details.size > 1 && amount_nodes.all?
        # Batch entry with per-transaction amounts: one Transaction per TxDtls.
        details.each_with_index.map do |d, i|
          build(entry, iban, [d], amount_nodes[i], i)
        end
      else
        # Single (or no) detail, or a batch without per-item amounts:
        # treat the whole entry as one transaction at the entry amount.
        [build(entry, iban, details.empty? ? [entry] : details, entry.at_xpath("Amt"), 0)]
      end
    end

    def self.build(entry, iban, scopes, amount_node, index)
      raise ParseError, "Entry without amount" unless amount_node

      credit  = first_text(entry, "CdtDbtInd") == "CRDT"
      reverse = first_text(entry, "RvslInd") == "true"
      amount  = BigDecimal(amount_node.text.strip)
      ccy     = amount_node["Ccy"]
      booking = parse_date(entry, "BookgDt")
      value   = parse_date(entry, "ValDt")

      e2e  = texts(scopes, "Refs/EndToEndId").reject { |t| t.upcase == "NOTPROVIDED" }.first
      sref = texts(scopes, "RmtInf/Strd/CdtrRefInf/Ref").first
      party_path = credit ? "Dbtr" : "Cdtr"
      party = texts(scopes, "RltdPties/#{party_path}/Nm").first ||
              texts(scopes, "RltdPties/#{party_path}/Pty/Nm").first

      free_text = texts(scopes, "RmtInf/Ustrd") +
                  texts(scopes, "RmtInf/Strd/AddtlRmtInf") +
                  [first_text(entry, "AddtlNtryInf")].compact
      svcr_ref = first_text(entry, "AcctSvcrRef") || texts(scopes, "Refs/AcctSvcrRef").first

      id = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(
        [iban, svcr_ref, booking, value, credit, amount.to_s("F"), ccy,
         e2e, sref, free_text.join("|"), index].join("\u001F")
      )

      Transaction.new(
        id: id, account_iban: iban, booking_date: booking, value_date: value,
        amount: amount, currency: ccy, credit: credit, reversal: reverse,
        end_to_end_id: e2e, structured_reference: sref,
        remittance_text: free_text.join(" "), counterparty: party
      )
    end

    def self.parse_date(node, path)
      raw = first_text(node, "#{path}/Dt") || first_text(node, "#{path}/DtTm")
      raw && Date.iso8601(raw[0, 10])
    rescue ArgumentError
      nil
    end

    def self.first_text(node, path)
      t = node.at_xpath(path)&.text&.strip
      t.nil? || t.empty? ? nil : t
    end

    def self.texts(nodes, path)
      nodes.flat_map { |n| n.xpath(path).map { |x| x.text.strip } }.reject(&:empty?)
    end

    private_class_method :parse_entry, :build, :parse_date, :first_text, :texts
  end
end

module Billing
  class Invoice
    attr_reader :number, :reference, :amount, :currency, :status, :paid_on, :paid_by

    def initialize(number:, amount:, currency:, reference: nil)
      @number    = number
      @reference = reference
      @amount    = BigDecimal(amount.to_s)
      @currency  = currency
      @status    = :unpaid
    end

    def unpaid? = @status == :unpaid

    def mark_paid!(date, transaction_id)
      @status  = :paid
      @paid_on = date
      @paid_by = transaction_id
    end

    # Identifiers a payer may quote.
    def keys = [number, reference].compact
  end

  Result = Struct.new(:transaction, :invoice, :status, :note, keyword_init: true)

  # Matches incoming credits to unpaid invoices.
  #
  # Statuses:
  #   :matched           reference + amount + currency agree -> invoice marked paid
  #   :partial           reference found, amount lower than invoice
  #   :overpaid          reference found, amount higher than invoice
  #   :currency_mismatch reference found, different currency
  #   :ambiguous         several invoices fit, cannot pick one safely
  #   :unmatched         no invoice reference found
  #   :duplicate         transaction already imported earlier
  #   :ignored           debit or reversal (not a customer payment)
  #
  # Only :matched changes invoice state; everything else needs human review.
  class Reconciler
    MIN_COMPACT_KEY_LENGTH = 10

    attr_reader :imported_ids

    def initialize(invoices, imported_ids: Set.new)
      @invoices     = invoices.select(&:unpaid?)
      @imported_ids = imported_ids
      @index        = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }
      @invoices.each { |inv| inv.keys.each { |k| @index[compact(k)] << inv } }
    end

    def reconcile(transactions)
      transactions.map { |tx| reconcile_one(tx) }
    end

    private

    def reconcile_one(tx)
      return result(tx, nil, :ignored, "debit or reversal") unless tx.credit?
      return result(tx, nil, :duplicate, "already imported") if @imported_ids.include?(tx.id)

      @imported_ids << tx.id
      candidates = find_candidates(tx).select(&:unpaid?) # may have been paid earlier in this run

      if candidates.size > 1
        narrowed = candidates.select { |i| i.amount == tx.amount && i.currency == tx.currency }
        candidates = narrowed if narrowed.size == 1
      end

      case candidates.size
      when 0 then result(tx, nil, :unmatched, "no invoice reference found")
      when 1 then settle(tx, candidates.first)
      else
        result(tx, nil, :ambiguous, "matches #{candidates.map(&:number).join(', ')}")
      end
    end

    def settle(tx, invoice)
      if tx.currency != invoice.currency
        result(tx, invoice, :currency_mismatch, "#{tx.currency} received, #{invoice.currency} expected")
      elsif tx.amount == invoice.amount
        invoice.mark_paid!(tx.booking_date || tx.value_date, tx.id)
        refresh_index
        result(tx, invoice, :matched, nil)
      elsif tx.amount < invoice.amount
        result(tx, invoice, :partial, "short by #{(invoice.amount - tx.amount).to_s('F')}")
      else
        result(tx, invoice, :overpaid, "over by #{(tx.amount - invoice.amount).to_s('F')}")
      end
    end

    def refresh_index
      @index.each_value { |list| list.select!(&:unpaid?) }
    end

    def find_candidates(tx)
      # 1. A structured creditor reference is the most reliable signal: exact lookup.
      if tx.structured_reference
        hits = @index[compact(tx.structured_reference)]
        return hits.uniq unless hits.empty?
      end

      # 2. Look for invoice numbers/references inside the other reference fields.
      texts = [tx.structured_reference, tx.end_to_end_id, tx.remittance_text].compact.map(&:upcase)
      found = @index.keys.select { |key| texts.any? { |t| contains_token?(t, key) } }
      return found.flat_map { |k| @index[k] }.uniq unless found.empty?

      # 3. Fallback for references split by spaces ("RF18 5390 0754 7034").
      #    Only for long keys, to avoid false positives.
      squeezed = texts.map { |t| t.gsub(/\s+/, "") }
      found = @index.keys.select do |key|
        key.length >= MIN_COMPACT_KEY_LENGTH && squeezed.any? { |t| contains_token?(t, key) }
      end
      found.flat_map { |k| @index[k] }.uniq
    end

    # Whole-token match, so INV-1 does not match inside INV-12.
    def contains_token?(text, key)
      text.match?(/(?<![A-Z0-9])#{Regexp.escape(key)}(?![A-Z0-9])/)
    end

    def compact(value) = value.to_s.upcase.gsub(/\s+/, "")

    def result(tx, invoice, status, note)
      Result.new(transaction: tx, invoice: invoice, status: status, note: note)
    end
  end
end

# ---- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  xml_path, csv_path = ARGV
  abort "Usage: ruby #{$PROGRAM_NAME} statement.xml invoices.csv" unless xml_path && csv_path

  invoices = CSV.foreach(csv_path, headers: true).map do |row|
    Billing::Invoice.new(
      number: row["number"], reference: row["reference"],
      amount: row["amount"], currency: row["currency"]
    )
  end

  begin
    transactions = Camt::Parser.parse_file(xml_path)
  rescue Camt::ParseError, Errno::ENOENT => e
    abort "Import failed: #{e.message}"
  end

  results = Billing::Reconciler.new(invoices).reconcile(transactions)

  results.each do |r|
    tx = r.transaction
    printf("%-18s %-10s %12s %s  %-14s %s\n",
           r.status, tx.booking_date, tx.amount.to_s("F"), tx.currency,
           r.invoice&.number || "-", r.note)
  end

  summary = results.group_by(&:status).transform_values(&:size)
  puts "\nSummary: #{summary.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join(', ')}"
end
```

## Notes

- **Parsing:** namespaces are stripped, so any `camt.053.001.xx` version works. Only `BOOK`ed entries are imported. Batch entries with several `TxDtls` and their own amounts become one transaction each. Parsing is strict, uses `nonet`, and does not load DTDs or expand entities.
- **Matching order:** an exact lookup on the structured creditor reference (`CdtrRefInf/Ref`) comes first. If that finds nothing, the code searches `EndToEndId` and the free text for invoice numbers or references as whole tokens, so `INV-1` does not match inside `INV-12`. Last, it tries a whitespace-squeezed search for long references.
- **Safety:** only an exact reference, amount, and currency match marks an invoice paid. Partial payments, overpayments, currency mismatches, and ambiguous matches are reported for manual review instead of being auto-applied.
- **Idempotency:** each transaction gets a stable content hash. Persist `reconciler.imported_ids` between runs (database or file) and pass it back via `imported_ids:` so re-importing an overlapping statement yields `:duplicate` rather than double-processing.

```ruby
require 'plaid'
require 'dotenv/load'

class PlaidService
  attr_reader :client
  
  def initialize
    configuration = Plaid::Configuration.new
    configuration.server_index = Plaid::Configuration::Environment[ENV['PLAID_ENV'] || 'sandbox']
    configuration.api_key['PLAID-CLIENT-ID'] = ENV['PLAID_CLIENT_ID']
    configuration.api_key['PLAID-SECRET'] = ENV['PLAID_SECRET']
    
    api_client = Plaid::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @client = Plaid::PlaidApi.new(api_client)
  end
  
  def fetch_accounts_and_transactions(access_token, start_date: nil, end_date: nil)
    start_date ||= Date.today - 30
    end_date ||= Date.today
    
    request = Plaid::TransactionsGetRequest.new(
      access_token: access_token,
      start_date: start_date.to_s,
      end_date: end_date.to_s,
      options: {
        include_personal_finance_category: true
      }
    )
    
    response = client.transactions_get(request)
    
    {
      accounts: response.accounts,
      transactions: response.transactions,
      total_transactions: response.total_transactions
    }
  rescue Plaid::ApiError => e
    puts "Plaid API Error: #{e.response_body}"
    raise
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'logger'

class DataSyncService
  def initialize(plaid_service: PlaidService.new, database: Database.connection)
    @plaid_service = plaid_service
    @database = database
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  end
  
  def sync_account_data(access_token, start_date: nil, end_date: nil)
    @logger.info("Starting data sync at #{Time.now}")
    
    @database.transaction do
      data = @plaid_service.fetch_accounts_and_transactions(
        access_token,
        start_date: start_date,
        end_date: end_date
      )
      
      # Sync accounts
      accounts_map = {}
      data[:accounts].each do |plaid_account|
        account = Account.find_or_create_from_plaid(plaid_account)
        accounts_map[plaid_account.account_id] = account.id
        @logger.info("Synced account: #{account.name} (ID: #{account.id})")
      end
      
      # Sync transactions
      transaction_count = 0
      data[:transactions].each do |plaid_transaction|
        account_id = accounts_map[plaid_transaction.account_id]
        if account_id
          transaction = Transaction.find_or_create_from_plaid(plaid_transaction, account_id)
          transaction_count += 1 if transaction
        else
          @logger.warn("No account found for transaction #{plaid_transaction.transaction_id}")
        end
      end
      
      @logger.info("Synced #{transaction_count} transactions")
    end
    
    @logger.info("Data sync completed at #{Time.now}")
    true
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Data sync failed: #{e.message}")
    @logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
    raise
  end
end
```

## Gemfile

Встановлення: `bundle install`

## Реалізація

```ruby
# company_matcher.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "jaro_winkler"
require "text"

module CompanyMatcher
  # Організаційно-правові форми, які не несуть інформації для порівняння
  LEGAL_FORMS = %w[
    тов тзов пп фоп пат ат прат зат кп дп тд
    ооо зао ао оао
    llc ltd inc corp co gmbh sa ag plc
  ].freeze

  Match = Struct.new(
    :left, :right,
    :levenshtein_distance, :levenshtein_similarity,
    :jaro_winkler, :score,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def to_s
      format(
        "%-32s ~ %-32s | Lev: %2d (%.3f) | JW: %.3f | score: %.3f",
        left, right, levenshtein_distance, levenshtein_similarity, jaro_winkler, score
      )
    end
  end

  # Приводить назву до канонічного вигляду
  module Normalizer
    APOSTROPHES = /[’ʼ'`‘]/.freeze

    module_function

    def call(name, sort_tokens: true, strip_legal_forms: true)
      str = name.to_s.unicode_normalize(:nfkc).downcase
      str = str.gsub(APOSTROPHES, "")          # м'ясо == мясо
      str = str.gsub(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/, " ")   # пунктуація, лапки тощо
      tokens = str.split

      if strip_legal_forms
        without_forms = tokens - LEGAL_FORMS
        tokens = without_forms unless without_forms.empty?
      end

      tokens.sort! if sort_tokens # «Нова Пошта» == «Пошта Нова»
      tokens.join(" ")
    end
  end

  class Matcher
    # lev_threshold — мінімальна нормалізована подібність Levenshtein (0..1)
    # jw_threshold  — мінімальна подібність Jaro-Winkler (0..1)
    # mode          — :all (обидві метрики мають пройти поріг) або :any (досить однієї)
    def initialize(lev_threshold: 0.75, jw_threshold: 0.90, mode: :all, sort_tokens: true)
      raise ArgumentError, "mode має бути :all або :any" unless %i[all any].include?(mode)

      @lev_threshold = lev_threshold
      @jw_threshold = jw_threshold
      @mode = mode
      @sort_tokens = sort_tokens
    end

    # Порівняння двох назв. Повертає Match (незалежно від порогів).
    def compare(a, b)
      na = Normalizer.call(a, sort_tokens: @sort_tokens)
      nb = Normalizer.call(b, sort_tokens: @sort_tokens)

      distance = Text::Levenshtein.distance(na, nb)
      max_len  = [na.length, nb.length].max
      lev_sim  = max_len.zero? ? 0.0 : 1.0 - distance.to_f / max_len
      jw       = na.empty? || nb.empty? ? 0.0 : JaroWinkler.distance(na, nb)

      Match.new(
        left: a, right: b,
        levenshtein_distance: distance,
        levenshtein_similarity: lev_sim.round(4),
        jaro_winkler: jw.round(4),
        score: ((lev_sim + jw) / 2).round(4)
      )
    end

    def match?(match)
      lev_ok = match.levenshtein_similarity >= @lev_threshold
      jw_ok  = match.jaro_winkler >= @jw_threshold
      @mode == :all ? (lev_ok && jw_ok) : (lev_ok || jw_ok)
    end

    # Пошук потенційних дублікатів усередині одного списку (O(n²))
    def find_duplicates(names)
      names.uniq.combination(2)
           .map { |a, b| compare(a, b) }
           .select { |m| match?(m) }
           .sort_by { |m| -m.score }
    end

    # Пошук відповідників для кожної назви із `queries` у довіднику `references`
    def find_matches(queries, references)
      queries.to_h do |query|
        matches = references
                  .map { |ref| compare(query, ref) }
                  .select { |m| match?(m) }
                  .sort_by { |m| -m.score }
        [query, matches]
      end
    end
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  companies = [
    'ТОВ "Нова Пошта"',
    "Нова пошта, ТзОВ",
    "Нова Почта",
    'ПАТ "Укрнафта"',
    "Укрнафта",
    "Укрнафтa Ltd",
    "Київстар",
    "Kyivstar",
    "Київстар Інк.",
    "Apple Inc.",
    "Apple Incorporated",
    "Aple, Inc",
    "Microsoft Corporation",
    "Microsft Corp.",
    "Monobank"
  ]

  matcher = CompanyMatcher::Matcher.new(lev_threshold: 0.75, jw_threshold: 0.90)

  puts "=== Потенційні дублікати у списку ==="
  matcher.find_duplicates(companies).each { |m| puts m }

  queries   = ["Нова Почта ТОВ", "Укр нафта", "Kyivstar", "Microsft Corp."]

    puts "#{query}:"
    if matches.empty?
      puts "  (збігів не знайдено)"
    else
      matches.each { |m| puts "  #{m}" }
    end
  end
end
```

## Тести (необов'язково)

```ruby
# test/company_matcher_test.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../company_matcher"

class CompanyMatcherTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @matcher = CompanyMatcher::Matcher.new
  end

  def test_normalizer_removes_legal_forms_and_punctuation
    assert_equal "пошта нова", CompanyMatcher::Normalizer.call('ТОВ "Нова Пошта"')
  end

  def test_identical_after_normalization
    m = @matcher.compare('ТОВ "Нова Пошта"', "Нова пошта, ТзОВ")
    assert_equal 0, m.levenshtein_distance
    assert @matcher.match?(m)
  end

  def test_typo_is_matched
    assert @matcher.match?(@matcher.compare("Microsoft Corporation", "Microsft Corp."))
  end

  def test_different_companies_not_matched
    refute @matcher.match?(@matcher.compare("Apple Inc.", "Київстар"))
  end
end
```

Запуск: `ruby company_matcher.rb` та `ruby test/company_matcher_test.rb`.

## Як це працює

1. **Нормалізація**: нижній регістр, Unicode NFKC, видалення пунктуації та апострофів, відкидання правових форм (ТОВ, LLC, Inc тощо). Токени сортуються, тож порядок слів не впливає на результат.
2. **Levenshtein** — кількість вставок, видалень і замін. Для порівнянності з порогом вона нормалізується: `1 − відстань / довжина_довшої_назви`.
3. **Jaro-Winkler** — подібність від 0 до 1 з бонусом за спільний префікс. Добре підходить для коротких рядків і назв з однаковим початком.
4. **Рішення про збіг**: режим `:all` вимагає, щоб обидві метрики пройшли пороги (менше хибних спрацювань), `:any` — достатньо однієї (вища повнота). `score` — середнє двох подібностей, за ним сортується результат.

Для великих списків (десятки тисяч назв) парне порівняння O(n²) буде повільним. Спершу згрупуйте назви за блоками, наприклад за першими літерами чи першим токеном, і порівнюйте лише всередині блоків.

Write Ruby code for the task below. Start with a Gemfile that lists every gem the code needs, then give the implementation.

Task: Convert DOCX documents to HTML and to plain text.
text:
Here's a complete Ruby solution for converting DOCX documents to HTML and plain text: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'nokogiri', '~> 1.15' gem 'rubyzip', '~> 2.3' gem 'htmlentities', '~> 4.3' ``` ## Implementation ```ruby # docx_converter.rb require 'nokogiri' require 'zip' require 'htmlentities' require 'stringio' class DocxConverter attr_reader :docx_path def initialize(docx_path) @docx_path = docx_path validate_file! end def to_html document_xml = extract_document_xml convert_to_html(document_xml) end def to_text html = to_html strip_html_tags(html) end private def validate_file! unless File.exist?(@docx_path) raise ArgumentError, "File not found: #{@docx_path}" end unless File.extname(@docx_path).downcase == '.docx' raise ArgumentError, "File must be a .docx file" end end def extract_document_xml Zip::File.open(@docx_path) do |zip_file| document_entry = zip_file.find_entry('word/document.xml') unless document_entry raise "Invalid DOCX file: word/document.xml not found" end return document_entry.get_input_stream.read end end def convert_to_html(document_xml) doc = Nokogiri::XML(document_xml) html_output = StringIO.new # Add HTML header html_output.puts '' html_output.puts '' html_output.puts '' html_output.puts ' ' html_output.puts ' ' html_output.puts '' html_output.puts '' # Process document body body = doc.at_xpath('//w:body', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') if body process_paragraphs(body, html_output) end html_output.puts '' html_output.puts '' html_output.string end def process_paragraphs(parent, html_output) parent.children.each do |node| case node.name when 'p' process_paragraph(node, html_output) when 'tbl' process_table(node, html_output) end end end def process_paragraph(paragraph, html_output) style = get_paragraph_style(paragraph) text_content = extract_paragraph_text(paragraph) return if text_content.strip.empty? && !paragraph_has_image?(paragraph) html_output.print "\n" case style when /Heading1/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Heading2/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Heading3/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Heading4/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Heading5/i html_output.puts "
#{text_content}
" when /Heading6/i html_output.puts "
#{text_content}
" when /Title/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Subtitle/i html_output.puts "

#{text_content}

" when /Quote|BlockText/i html_output.puts "
#{text_content}
" when /ListParagraph|ListBullet|ListNumber/i process_list_item(paragraph, text_content, html_output) else # Check for inline formatting if paragraph_has_image?(paragraph) html_output.puts "

#{process_inline_content(paragraph)}

" elsif text_content.strip.empty? html_output.puts "

 

" else html_output.puts "

#{process_inline_content(paragraph)}

" end end end def process_list_item(paragraph, text_content, html_output) # Determine list type (ordered or unordered) numbering_props = paragraph.at_xpath('.//w:numPr', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') if numbering_props && numbering_props.at_xpath('.//w:numId', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') html_output.puts "
  • #{text_content}
    • " else html_output.puts "

    #{text_content}

    " end end def extract_paragraph_text(paragraph) text_parts = [] paragraph.xpath('.//w:t', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |text_node| text_parts << text_node.text end # Handle tabs and breaks paragraph.xpath('.//w:tab', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |tab| text_parts << "\t" end paragraph.xpath('.//w:br', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |br| text_parts << "\n" end HTMLEntities.new.decode(text_parts.join) end def process_inline_content(paragraph) html_parts = [] paragraph.children.each do |node| case node.name when 'r' # Run (text fragment) text = extract_run_text(node) formatting = get_run_formatting(node) html_parts << apply_formatting(text, formatting) when 'hyperlink' # Hyperlink link_text = extract_paragraph_text(node) relationship_id = node['r:id'] html_parts << "#{link_text}" when 'drawing', 'pict' # Image html_parts << extract_image(node) when 'tab' html_parts << '    ' when 'br' html_parts << '
    ' end end html_parts.join end def extract_run_text(run) text_nodes = run.xpath('.//w:t', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') text = text_nodes.map(&:text).join # Handle breaks within runs if run.at_xpath('.//w:br', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') text += '
    ' end HTMLEntities.new.decode(text) end def get_run_formatting(run) formatting = {} # Get run properties run_props = run.at_xpath('./w:rPr', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') if run_props formatting[:bold] = true if run_props.at_xpath('./w:b', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:italic] = true if run_props.at_xpath('./w:i', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:underline] = true if run_props.at_xpath('./w:u', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') # Check for strikethrough if run_props.at_xpath('./w:strike', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:strikethrough] = true end # Check for superscript/subscript if vert_align = run_props.at_xpath('./w:vertAlign', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:superscript] = true if vert_align['w:val'] == 'superscript' formatting[:subscript] = true if vert_align['w:val'] == 'subscript' end # Check for color if color = run_props.at_xpath('./w:color', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:color] = color['w:val'] end # Check for font size if size = run_props.at_xpath('./w:sz', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') formatting[:size] = size['w:val'].to_i / 2 # Convert half-points to points end end formatting end def apply_formatting(text, formatting) return text if formatting.empty? || text.empty? result = text if formatting[:bold] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:italic] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:underline] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:strikethrough] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:superscript] result = "#{result}" elsif formatting[:subscript] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:color] result = "#{result}" end if formatting[:size] result = "#{result}" end result end def get_paragraph_style(paragraph) style = '' # Get paragraph properties para_props = paragraph.at_xpath('./w:pPr', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') if para_props # Get style if style_node = para_props.at_xpath('./w:pStyle', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') style = style_node['w:val'] || '' end # Check for alignment if alignment = para_props.at_xpath('./w:jc', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main') style += " Align#{alignment['w:val'].capitalize}" if alignment['w:val'] end end style end def paragraph_has_image?(paragraph) !paragraph.at_xpath('.//w:drawing | .//w:pict', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').nil? end def extract_image(paragraph) # Extract image relationship ID blip = paragraph.at_xpath('.//a:blip', 'a' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main') if blip && blip['r:embed'] relationship_id = blip['r:embed'] # Get actual image file from relationships image_data = extract_image_data(relationship_id) if image_data # Create data URI for the image base64_image = Base64.strict_encode64(image_data[:data]) mime_type = image_data[:content_type] || 'image/png' return "" end end '' end def extract_image_data(relationship_id) Zip::File.open(@docx_path) do |zip_file| # Read relationships rels_entry = zip_file.find_entry('word/_rels/document.xml.rels') return nil unless rels_entry rels_xml = Nokogiri::XML(rels_entry.get_input_stream.read) # Find relationship relationship = rels_xml.at_xpath("//*[local-name()='Relationship' and @Id='#{relationship_id}']") return nil unless relationship target = relationship['Target'] # Handle relative paths image_path = if target.start_with?('word/') target else "word/#{target}" end # Extract image image_entry = zip_file.find_entry(image_path) return nil unless image_entry { data: image_entry.get_input_stream.read, content_type: get_content_type(File.extname(image_path)) } end end def get_content_type(extension) case extension.downcase when '.png' then 'image/png' when '.jpg', '.jpeg' then 'image/jpeg' when '.gif' then 'image/gif' when '.bmp' then 'image/bmp' when '.svg' then 'image/svg+xml' else 'application/octet-stream' end end def process_table(table, html_output) html_output.puts '' table.xpath('./w:tr', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |row| html_output.puts ' ' row.xpath('./w:tc', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |cell| html_output.puts ' ' end html_output.puts ' ' end html_output.puts '
    ' # Process content within cell cell.xpath('./w:p', 'w' => 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main').each do |paragraph| text = extract_paragraph_text(paragraph) html_output.puts " #{text}" end html_output.puts '
    ' end def strip_html_tags(html) # Parse HTML and extract text content doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html) # Remove script and style elements doc.css('script, style').remove # Get text content text = doc.text # Clean up whitespace text.gsub(/\n{3,}/, "\n\n").strip end end # Example usage if __FILE__ == $0 if ARGV.empty? puts "Usage: ruby docx_converter.rb [output.html] [output.txt]" exit 1 end input_file = ARGV[0] html_output = ARGV[1] || input_file.sub(/\.docx$/i, '.html') text_output = ARGV[2] || input_file.sub(/\.docx$/i, '.txt') begin converter = DocxConverter.new(input_file) # Convert to HTML html_content = converter.to_html File.write(html_output, html_content) puts "HTML output written to: #{html_output}" # Convert to plain text text_content = converter.to_text File.write(text_output, text_content) puts "Text output written to: #{text_output}" rescue StandardError => e puts "Error: #{e.message}" exit 1 end end ``` ## Usage Example ```ruby # In your Ruby code require_relative 'docx_converter' converter = DocxConverter.new('document.docx') # Convert to HTML html = converter.to_html File.write('output.html', html) # Convert to plain text text = converter.to_text File.write('output.txt', text) ``` Or from the command line: ```bash ruby docx_converter.rb input.docx # This will create input.html and input.txt ``` ## Features This DOCX converter supports: - **Paragraph formatting**: Headings (H1-H6), titles, subtitles, quotes, alignment - **Inline formatting**: Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript/subscript, colors, font sizes - **Lists**: Ordered and unordered lists - **Tables**: Basic table conversion - **Images**: Embedded images converted to base64 data URIs - **Hyperlinks**: Basic hyperlink support - **Special characters**: Proper HTML entity encoding - **Line breaks and tabs**: Preserved in output The converter handles complex DOCX structures and produces clean, well-formatted HTML and plain text output.

text:
Ось рішення на Ruby для розбору дат, записаних природною мовою англійською:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '3.2.0'

gem 'chronic', '~> 0.10.2'
gem 'activesupport', '~> 7.0'
gem 'timecop', '~> 0.9.6', group: :test
gem 'rspec', '~> 3.12', group: :test
```

## Реалізація

### Основна бібліотека для розбору дат

```ruby
# date_parser.rb
require 'chronic'
require 'active_support/time'

class DateParser
  # Основні патерни для розбору дат
  PATTERNS = {
    'next' => 'next',
    'this' => 'this',
    'last' => 'last',
    'today' => 'today',
    'tomorrow' => 'tomorrow',
    'yesterday' => 'yesterday'
  }.freeze

  def self.parse(text)
    return nil if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
    
    text = text.strip.downcase
    
    # Спроба розібрати за допомогою Chronic
    chronic_result = Chronic.parse(text)
    return chronic_result if chronic_result
    
    # Якщо Chronic не впорався, спробуємо власний розбір
    parse_custom(text)
  end
  
  def self.parse_with_timezone(text, timezone = 'UTC')
    result = parse(text)
    return nil unless result
    
    # Конвертуємо в потрібну часову зону
    Time.zone = timezone
    result.in_time_zone(timezone)
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.parse_custom(text)
    # Розбір "next Friday at 5pm"
    match = text.match(/(next|this|last)?\s*(\w+)(?:\s+at\s+(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm)?)?/)
    
    return nil unless match
    
    day_name = match[2]
    time_hour = match[3]&.to_i
    time_minute = match[4]&.to_i || 0
    meridiem = match[5]
    
    # Визначаємо день тижня
    days = {
      'monday' => 1, 'tuesday' => 2, 'wednesday' => 3, 
      'thursday' => 4, 'friday' => 5, 'saturday' => 6, 'sunday' => 0
    }
    
    return nil unless days.key?(day_name)
    
    target_day = days[day_name]
    today = Date.today
    current_day = today.wday
    
    # Обчислюємо різницю в днях
    day_diff = target_day - current_day
    
    case match[1]
    when 'next'
      day_diff += 7 if day_diff <= 0
    when 'last'
      day_diff -= 7 if day_diff >= 0
    when 'this'
      # Якщо день вже пройшов цього тижня, беремо наступний
      day_diff += 7 if day_diff < 0
    else
      # За замовчуванням - наступний найближчий день
      day_diff += 7 if day_diff <= 0
    end
    
    target_date = today + day_diff
    
    # Формуємо час
    hour = time_hour
    if hour && meridiem
      hour += 12 if meridiem == 'pm' && hour < 12
      hour = 0 if meridiem == 'am' && hour == 12
    end
    
    if hour
      Time.local(target_date.year, target_date.month, target_date.day, hour, time_minute)
    else
      Time.local(target_date.year, target_date.month, target_date.day, 0, 0)
    end
  end
end
```

### Розширена версія з додатковими функціями

```ruby
# advanced_date_parser.rb
require 'chronic'
require 'active_support/time'
require 'date'

class AdvancedDateParser
  class << self
    def parse(text, options = {})
      return nil if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
      
      text = text.strip.downcase
      
      # Нормалізація тексту
      text = normalize_text(text)
      
      # Спроба розібрати за допомогою Chronic
      if (chronic_result = parse_with_chronic(text, options))
        return chronic_result
      end
      
      # Власний розбір для специфічних випадків
      parse_special_cases(text, options)
    end
    
    def parse_range(text, options = {})
      # Розбір діапазонів дат: "from Monday to Friday"
      if text.include?(' to ') || text.include?(' from ')
        parts = text.split(/\s+(?:to|from)\s+/)
        start_date = parse(parts[0], options)
        end_date = parse(parts[1], options)
        
        return [start_date, end_date] if start_date && end_date
      end
      
      nil
    end
    
    private
    
    def normalize_text(text)
      # Заміна скорочень
      text.gsub!(/\bmon\b/, 'monday')
      text.gsub!(/\btue\b/, 'tuesday')
      text.gsub!(/\bwed\b/, 'wednesday')
      text.gsub!(/\bthu\b/, 'thursday')
      text.gsub!(/\bfri\b/, 'friday')
      text.gsub!(/\bsat\b/, 'saturday')
      text.gsub!(/\bsun\b/, 'sunday')
      
      # Нормалізація часу
      text.gsub!(/(\d+)\s*pm/, '\1 pm')
      text.gsub!(/(\d+)\s*am/, '\1 am')
      text.gsub!(/(\d+):(\d+)\s*pm/, '\1:\2 pm')
      text.gsub!(/(\d+):(\d+)\s*am/, '\1:\2 am')
      
      text
    end
    
    def parse_with_chronic(text, options)
      chronic_options = {}
      chronic_options[:now] = options[:now] if options[:now]
      chronic_options[:guess] = options[:guess] != false
      
      Chronic.parse(text, chronic_options)
    rescue StandardError
      nil
    end
    
    def parse_special_cases(text, options)
      # Розбір "in X days/weeks/months/years"
      if (match = text.match(/^in (\d+) (day|week|month|year)s?$/))
        amount = match[1].to_i
        unit = match[2]
        
        base_date = options[:now] || Time.current
        return base_date + amount.send(unit)
      end
      
      # Розбір "X days/weeks/months/years from now"
      if (match = text.match(/^(\d+) (day|week|month|year)s? from now$/))
        amount = match[1].to_i
        unit = match[2]
        
        base_date = options[:now] || Time.current
        return base_date + amount.send(unit)
      end
      
      # Розбір "X days/weeks/months/years ago"
      if (match = text.match(/^(\d+) (day|week|month|year)s? ago$/))
        amount = match[1].to_i
        unit = match[2]
        
        base_date = options[:now] || Time.current
        return base_date - amount.send(unit)
      end
      
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

### Приклад використання

```ruby
# example.rb
require_relative 'date_parser'
require_relative 'advanced_date_parser'

# Приклади використання
examples = [
  "next Friday at 5pm",
  "tomorrow at 3:30 pm",
  "yesterday",
  "in 2 weeks",
  "3 days from now",
  "last Monday at 10am",
  "today at noon",
  "next week Tuesday",
  "this weekend",
  "2 months ago"
]

puts "=== DateParser Results ==="
examples.each do |example|
  result = DateParser.parse(example)
  puts "#{example.ljust(30)} => #{result ? result.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p') : 'nil'}"
end

puts "\n=== AdvancedDateParser Results ==="
examples.each do |example|
  result = AdvancedDateParser.parse(example)
  puts "#{example.ljust(30)} => #{result ? result.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p') : 'nil'}"
end

# Приклад з часовою зоною
puts "\n=== With Timezone ==="
result = DateParser.parse_with_timezone("next Friday at 5pm", "America/New_York")
puts "Next Friday at 5pm (NY): #{result}" if result
```

### Тести

```ruby
# spec/date_parser_spec.rb
require 'rspec'
require_relative '../date_parser'
require_relative '../advanced_date_parser'

RSpec.describe DateParser do
  describe '.parse' do
    it 'parses simple day names' do
      result = DateParser.parse('tomorrow')
      expect(result).to be_a(Time)
      expect(result.to_date).to eq(Date.today + 1)
    end
    
    it 'parses next Friday at 5pm' do
      result = DateParser.parse('next Friday at 5pm')
      expect(result).to be_a(Time)
      expect(result.friday?).to be true
      expect(result.hour).to eq(17)
    end
    
    it 'returns nil for invalid input' do
      expect(DateParser.parse('')).to be_nil
      expect(DateParser.parse(nil)).to be_nil
      expect(DateParser.parse('invalid date format')).to be_nil
    end
  end
end

RSpec.describe AdvancedDateParser do
  describe '.parse' do
    it 'parses relative dates' do
      result = AdvancedDateParser.parse('in 2 weeks')
      expect(result.to_date).to eq(Date.today + 14)
    end
    
    it 'parses dates with time' do
      result = AdvancedDateParser.parse('tomorrow at 3:30 pm')
      expect(result.hour).to eq(15)
      expect(result.min).to eq(30)
    end
    
    it 'supports custom base time' do
      base_time = Time.local(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)
      result = AdvancedDateParser.parse('in 1 week', now: base_time)
      expect(result).to eq(base_time + 1.week)
    end
  end
end
```

Це рішення використовує гем `chronic` для потужного розбору дат природною мовою, а також включає власну реалізацію для специфічних випадків. Код підтримує різні формати дат, часові зони та відносні дати.

# Офіційні курси гривні з API НБУ на задану дату

## `Gemfile`

## `nbu_rates.rb`

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "date"
require "json"
require "bigdecimal"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"

# Клієнт для отримання офіційних курсів гривні з API Національного банку України.
# Документація: https://bank.gov.ua/ua/open-data/api-dev
module NBU
  class Error < StandardError; end

  Rate = Struct.new(:numeric_code, :name, :rate, :currency, :date, keyword_init: true)

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://bank.gov.ua"
    ENDPOINT = "/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange"

    def initialize(connection: nil)
      @connection = connection || build_connection
    end

    # Повертає масив NBU::Rate на вказану дату.
    #
    # date     - Date, або рядок "YYYY-MM-DD" / "DD.MM.YYYY" / "YYYYMMDD"
    # currency - (необов'язково) буквений код валюти, напр. "USD"
    def rates(date = Date.today, currency: nil)
      date = parse_date(date)
      validate_date!(date)

      params = { date: date.strftime("%Y%m%d"), json: "" }
      params[:valcode] = currency.to_s.downcase if currency

      response = @connection.get(ENDPOINT, params)
      data = parse_body(response.body)

      if data.empty?
        raise Error, "НБУ не повернув курсів на #{date}" \
                     "#{currency ? " для валюти #{currency.to_s.upcase}" : ''}"
      end

      data.map { |item| build_rate(item) }
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Помилка запиту до API НБУ: #{e.message}"
    end

    private

    def build_connection
      Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
        f.request :retry, max: 3, interval: 0.5, backoff_factor: 2,
                          retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
        f.options.timeout = 10
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.response :raise_error # 4xx/5xx -> Faraday::Error
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    def parse_date(value)
      case value
      when Date then value
      when Time then value.to_date
      when String
        str = value.strip
        format = case str
                 when /\A\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\z/ then "%Y-%m-%d"
                 when /\A\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}\z/ then "%d.%m.%Y"
                 when /\A\d{8}\z/ then "%Y%m%d"
                 else
                   raise Error, "Невідомий формат дати: #{value.inspect} " \
                                "(очікується YYYY-MM-DD або DD.MM.YYYY)"
                 end
        Date.strptime(str, format)
      else
        raise Error, "Непідтримуваний тип дати: #{value.class}"
      end
    rescue Date::Error
      raise Error, "Некоректна дата: #{value.inspect}"
    end

    def validate_date!(date)
      raise Error, "Дата #{date} знаходиться в майбутньому" if date > Date.today
    end

    def parse_body(body)
      data = JSON.parse(body)
      raise Error, "Неочікувана відповідь API: #{body[0, 200]}" unless data.is_a?(Array)

      data
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise Error, "API повернуло некоректний JSON: #{body.to_s[0, 200]}"
    end

    def build_rate(item)
      Rate.new(
        numeric_code: item["r030"],
        name: item["txt"],
        rate: BigDecimal(item["rate"].to_s),
        currency: item["cc"],
        date: Date.strptime(item["exchangedate"], "%d.%m.%Y")
      )
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------- CLI ----------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  if ARGV.include?("-h") || ARGV.include?("--help")
    puts <<~USAGE
      Використання: ruby nbu_rates.rb [ДАТА] [ВАЛЮТА]

        ДАТА    YYYY-MM-DD або DD.MM.YYYY (за замовчуванням — сьогодні)
        ВАЛЮТА  буквений код ISO, напр. USD (за замовчуванням — усі валюти)

      Приклади:
        ruby nbu_rates.rb 2024-03-15
        ruby nbu_rates.rb 15.03.2024 USD
    USAGE
    exit
  end

  date     = ARGV[0] || Date.today
  currency = ARGV[1]

  begin
    rates = NBU::Client.new.rates(date, currency: currency)

    puts "Офіційні курси гривні (UAH) НБУ на #{rates.first.date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')}"
    puts "-" * 70
    puts format("%-5s %-4s %-42s %12s", "Код", "Вал.", "Назва", "Курс, грн")
    puts "-" * 70
    rates.each do |r|
      puts format("%-5s %-4s %-42s %12s",
                  r.numeric_code, r.currency, r.name[0, 42], r.rate.to_s("F"))
    end
  rescue NBU::Error => e
    warn "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Використання

```bash
bundle install
ruby nbu_rates.rb 2024-03-15          # усі валюти на дату
ruby nbu_rates.rb 15.03.2024 USD      # лише долар США
```

Як бібліотеку:

```ruby
require_relative "nbu_rates"

client = NBU::Client.new
usd = client.rates("2024-03-15", currency: "USD").first
puts "#{usd.currency}: #{usd.rate.to_s('F')} грн"
```

## Нотатки

- Використовується ендпоінт `https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange?date=YYYYMMDD&json` (з необов'язковим `valcode=usd`).
- Курси зберігаються як `BigDecimal`, щоб уникнути похибок чисел з плаваючою комою.
- Реалізовано таймаути, повторні спроби при 429/5xx, перевірку формату дати, відхилення майбутніх дат і обробку порожньої або некоректної відповіді.

```ruby
require 'firebase_cloud_messaging'
require 'dotenv/load'

module FirebaseConfig
  class << self
    def client
      @client ||= FirebaseCloudMessaging::Client.new(
        credentials: credentials,
        project_id: ENV['FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID']
      )
    end

    private

    def credentials
      if ENV['FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH']
        # Використання файлу з обліковими даними
        JSON.parse(File.read(ENV['FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH']))
      elsif ENV['FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY'] && ENV['FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL']
        # Використання змінних середовища
        {
          'type' => 'service_account',
          'project_id' => ENV['FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID'],
          'private_key' => ENV['FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY'].gsub('\\n', "\n"),
          'client_email' => ENV['FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL'],
          'token_uri' => 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token'
        }
      else
        raise 'Firebase credentials not configured'
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### `app/services/push_notification_service.rb`

```ruby
require 'firebase_cloud_messaging'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class PushNotificationService
  attr_reader :logger

  def initialize(logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @logger = logger
    @client = FirebaseConfig.client
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token:, title:, body:, data: {}, platform: nil)
    message = build_message(
      token: device_token,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      platform: platform
    )

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_devices(device_tokens:, title:, body:, data: {}, platform: nil)
    results = { successful: [], failed: [] }

    device_tokens.each do |token|
      begin
        response = send_to_device(
          device_token: token,
          title: title,
          body: body,
          data: data,
          platform: platform
        )
        
        if response[:success]
          results[:successful] << { token: token, response: response }
        else
          results[:failed] << { token: token, error: response[:error] }
        end
      rescue => e
        results[:failed] << { token: token, error: e.message }
        logger.error("Failed to send notification to #{token}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end

    results
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на тему
  def send_to_topic(topic:, title:, body:, data: {}, platform: nil)
    message = build_message(
      topic: topic,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      platform: platform
    )

    send_message(message)
  end

  private

  def build_message(token: nil, topic: nil, title:, body:, data:, platform:)
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: body
    }

    # Додавання специфічних для платформи налаштувань
    case platform&.downcase
    when 'android'
      notification[:android] = build_android_config
    when 'ios'
      notification[:apns] = build_ios_config
    end

    message = {
      notification: notification,
      data: data
    }

    message[:token] = token if token
    message[:topic] = topic if topic

    message
  end

  def build_android_config
    {
      priority: 'high',
      notification: {
        sound: 'default',
        channel_id: 'default'
      }
    }
  end

  def build_ios_config
    {
      headers: {
        'apns-priority' => '10'
      },
      payload: {
        aps: {
          sound: 'default',
          badge: 1
        }
      }
    }
  end

  def send_message(message)
    begin
      response = @client.send(message)
      
      if response.success?
        logger.info("Notification sent successfully: #{response.body}")
        { success: true, response: JSON.parse(response.body) }
      else
        logger.error("Failed to send notification: #{response.body}")
        { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    rescue => e
      logger.error("Error sending notification: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end
```

### `app/services/push_notification_batch_service.rb`

```ruby
require 'concurrent'

class PushNotificationBatchService
  def initialize(push_service: PushNotificationService.new)
    @push_service = push_service
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщень великій кількості пристроїв паралельно
  def send_batch(device_tokens:, title:, body:, data: {}, batch_size: 100)
    results = { successful: [], failed: [] }
    
    # Розбиття на батчі
    device_tokens.each_slice(batch_size) do |batch|
      batch_results = send_batch_parallel(
        device_tokens: batch,
        title: title,
        body: body,
        data: data
      )
      
      results[:successful].concat(batch_results[:successful])
      results[:failed].concat(batch_results[:failed])
    end

    results
  end

  private

  def send_batch_parallel(device_tokens:, title:, body:, data:)
    results = { successful: [], failed: [] }
    mutex = Mutex.new
    
    # Створення пулу потоків
    pool = Concurrent::FixedThreadPool.new(10)
    
    futures = device_tokens.map do |token|
      Concurrent::Future.execute(executor: pool) do
        @push_service.send_to_device(
          device_token: token,
          title: title,
          body: body,
          data: data
        )
      end
    end

    # Збір результатів
    futures.each_with_index do |future, index|
      result = future.value
      token = device_tokens[index]
      
      mutex.synchronize do
        if result[:success]
          results[:successful] << { token: token, response: result[:response] }
        else
          results[:failed] << { token: token, error: result[:error] }
        end
      end
    end

    pool.shutdown
    pool.wait_for_termination

    results
  end
end
```

### `app/controllers/push_notifications_controller.rb`

```ruby
class PushNotificationsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :validate_notification_params

  def send_single
    service = PushNotificationService.new
    
    result = service.send_to_device(
      device_token: params[:device_token],
      title: params[:title],
      body: params[:body],
      data: params[:data] || {},
      platform: params[:platform]
    )

    render json: result, status: result[:success] ? :ok : :unprocessable_entity
  end

  def send_multiple
    service = PushNotificationBatchService.new
    
    result = service.send_batch(
      device_tokens: params[:device_tokens],
      title: params[:title],
      body: params[:body],
      data: params[:data] || {}
    )

    render json: {
      total: params[:device_tokens].length,
      successful_count: result[:successful].length,
      failed_count: result[:failed].length,
      results: result
    }
  end

  def send_to_topic
    service = PushNotificationService.new
    
    result = service.send_to_topic(
      topic: params[:topic],
      title: params[:title],
      body: params[:body],
      data: params[:data] || {},
      platform: params[:platform]
    )

    render json: result, status: result[:success] ? :ok : :unprocessable_entity
  end

  private

  def validate_notification_params
    unless params[:title].present? && params[:body].present?
      render json: { error: 'Title and body are required' }, status: :bad_request
      return false
    end

    if action_name == 'send_single' && params[:device_token].blank?
      render json: { error: 'Device token is required' }, status: :bad_request
      return false
    end

    if action_name == 'send_multiple' && params[:device_tokens].blank?
      render json: { error: 'Device tokens are required' }, status: :bad_request
      return false
    end

    if action_name == 'send_to_topic' && params[:topic].blank?
      render json: { error: 'Topic is required' }, status: :bad_request
      return false
    end

    true
  end
end
```

prompt:
Write Ruby code for the task below. Start with a Gemfile that lists every gem the code needs, then give the implementation.

Task: Build a Discord bot that posts deployment notifications and responds to slash commands.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "discordrb", "~> 3.5"   # Discord gateway client + slash command support
gem "sinatra",   "~> 4.0"   # HTTP endpoint that CI/CD calls to announce deployments
gem "puma",      "~> 6.4"   # Web server used by Sinatra
gem "rackup",    "~> 2.1"   # Rack handler loader (needed by Sinatra 4 / Rack 3)
gem "dotenv",    "~> 3.1"   # Loads configuration from .env
gem "logger"                # Explicit dependency (no longer a default gem in newer Rubies)
```

## `bot.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "dotenv/load"
require "discordrb"
require "sinatra/base"
require "json"
require "openssl"
require "time"
require "logger"

LOG = Logger.new($stdout)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Config
  def self.fetch!(key)
    ENV.fetch(key) { abort "Missing required environment variable: #{key}" }
  end

  TOKEN      = fetch!("DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN")
  CHANNEL_ID = Integer(fetch!("DISCORD_NOTIFY_CHANNEL_ID"))
  SECRET     = fetch!("WEBHOOK_SECRET")
  # Optional: registering commands for a single server makes them appear instantly.
  # Without it, commands are registered globally (can take a while to propagate).
  SERVER_ID  = ENV["DISCORD_SERVER_ID"]&.then { |v| Integer(v) }
  PORT       = Integer(ENV.fetch("PORT", "4567"))
  DATA_FILE  = ENV.fetch("DEPLOY_DATA_FILE", "deployments.json")
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deployment storage (thread-safe, persisted to a JSON file)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class DeploymentStore
  MAX_RECORDS = 200

  def initialize(path)
    @path  = path
    @mutex = Mutex.new
    @items = load_file
  end

  def add(record)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @items.unshift(record)
      @items = @items.first(MAX_RECORDS)
      save_file
    end
    record
  end

  def latest(environment = nil)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      environment ? @items.find { |d| d["environment"].casecmp?(environment) } : @items.first
    end
  end

  def recent(limit = 5, environment = nil)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      list = environment ? @items.select { |d| d["environment"].casecmp?(environment) } : @items
      list.first(limit)
    end
  end

  private

  def load_file
    return [] unless File.exist?(@path)

    JSON.parse(File.read(@path))
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    LOG.warn("Could not parse #{@path}: #{e.message}; starting empty")
    []
  end

  def save_file
    tmp = "#{@path}.tmp"
    File.write(tmp, JSON.pretty_generate(@items))
    File.rename(tmp, @path) # atomic replace
  end
end

STORE = DeploymentStore.new(Config::DATA_FILE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Presentation helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Format
  STATUS_STYLE = {
    "started"  => { color: 0x3498DB, emoji: "🚀", label: "Deployment started" },
    "success"  => { color: 0x2ECC71, emoji: "✅", label: "Deployment succeeded" },
    "failure"  => { color: 0xE74C3C, emoji: "❌", label: "Deployment failed" },
    "rollback" => { color: 0xF39C12, emoji: "⏪", label: "Deployment rolled back" }
  }.freeze

  def self.clip(text, max)
    text = text.to_s
    text.length > max ? "#{text[0, max - 1]}…" : text
  end

  # Fills a Discordrb embed (works for both message embeds and interaction responses)
  def self.fill_embed(embed, deploy)
    style = STATUS_STYLE.fetch(deploy["status"])
    embed.title       = clip("#{style[:emoji]} #{style[:label]}: #{deploy['environment']}", 256)
    embed.color       = style[:color]
    embed.description = clip(deploy["message"], 2000) if deploy["message"]
    embed.url         = deploy["url"] if deploy["url"]
    embed.timestamp   = Time.parse(deploy["timestamp"])

    embed.add_field(name: "Version", value: clip(deploy["version"] || "n/a", 1024), inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Author",  value: clip(deploy["author"]  || "n/a", 1024), inline: true)
    if deploy["commit"]
      embed.add_field(name: "Commit", value: "`#{clip(deploy['commit'].to_s[0, 10], 20)}`", inline: true)
    end
    embed
  end

  def self.build_embed(deploy)
    fill_embed(Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new, deploy)
  end

  def self.one_line(deploy)
    style = STATUS_STYLE.fetch(deploy["status"])
    ts = Time.parse(deploy["timestamp"]).to_i
    "#{style[:emoji]} **#{deploy['environment']}** `#{deploy['version'] || 'n/a'}` " \
      "by #{deploy['author'] || 'unknown'} — <t:#{ts}:R>"
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discord bot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOT = Discordrb::Bot.new(token: Config::TOKEN, intents: [:servers])

NO_MENTIONS = { parse: [] }.freeze # never let deploy messages ping @everyone/@here/roles

def post_deployment(deploy)
  BOT.send_message(
    Config::CHANNEL_ID, "", false,
    Format.build_embed(deploy), nil, NO_MENTIONS
  )
end

reg_opts = Config::SERVER_ID ? { server_id: Config::SERVER_ID } : {}

BOT.register_application_command(:ping, "Check that the bot is alive", **reg_opts)

BOT.register_application_command(:status, "Show the latest deployment", **reg_opts) do |cmd|
  cmd.string("environment", "Environment, e.g. production", required: false)
end

BOT.register_application_command(:history, "Show recent deployments", **reg_opts) do |cmd|
  cmd.integer("limit", "How many to show (1-15, default 5)", required: false, min_value: 1, max_value: 15)
  cmd.string("environment", "Filter by environment", required: false)
end

BOT.register_application_command(:announce, "Manually post a deployment notification", **reg_opts) do |cmd|
  cmd.string("environment", "Environment name", required: true)
  cmd.string("status", "Deployment status", required: true,
             choices: Format::STATUS_STYLE.keys.to_h { |k| [k.capitalize, k] })
  cmd.string("version", "Version or tag", required: false)
  cmd.string("message", "Extra details", required: false)
end

BOT.application_command(:ping) do |event|
  latency_ms = ((Time.now - event.timestamp) * 1000).round
  event.respond(content: "🏓 Pong! (#{latency_ms} ms)", ephemeral: true)
end

BOT.application_command(:status) do |event|
  env    = event.options["environment"]
  deploy = STORE.latest(env)

  if deploy
    event.respond(content: "") { |_builder, _view| nil } if false # (keeps structure obvious)
    event.respond do |builder|
      builder.add_embed { |embed| Format.fill_embed(embed, deploy) }
    end
  else
    event.respond(content: "No deployments recorded#{" for `#{env}`" if env}.", ephemeral: true)
  end
end

BOT.application_command(:history) do |event|
  limit = (event.options["limit"] || 5).to_i.clamp(1, 15)
  env   = event.options["environment"]
  items = STORE.recent(limit, env)

  if items.empty?
    event.respond(content: "No deployments recorded#{" for `#{env}`" if env}.", ephemeral: true)
  else
    event.respond(content: Format.clip(items.map { |d| Format.one_line(d) }.join("\n"), 1900))
  end
end

BOT.application_command(:announce) do |event|
  unless event.user.respond_to?(:permission?) && event.user.permission?(:manage_server)
    next event.respond(content: "You need the **Manage Server** permission to use this.", ephemeral: true)
  end

  deploy = {
    "environment" => Format.clip(event.options["environment"], 32),
    "status"      => event.options["status"],
    "version"     => event.options["version"] && Format.clip(event.options["version"], 64),
    "message"     => event.options["message"],
    "author"      => event.user.display_name,
    "timestamp"   => Time.now.utc.iso8601
  }
  STORE.add(deploy)
  post_deployment(deploy)
  event.respond(content: "Notification posted in <##{Config::CHANNEL_ID}>.", ephemeral: true)
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP endpoint for CI/CD
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class WebhookApp < Sinatra::Base
  MAX_BODY = 64 * 1024
  ENV_NAME = /\A[\w.\-]{1,32}\z/

  set :environment, :production
  set :bind, "0.0.0.0"
  set :port, Config::PORT
  set :logging, true
  set :show_exceptions, false

  get "/health" do
    content_type :json
    { ok: true, bot_connected: BOT.connected? }.to_json
  end

  post "/deployments" do
    content_type :json

    halt 413, { error: "payload too large" }.to_json if request.content_length.to_i > MAX_BODY
    body = request.body.read(MAX_BODY + 1).to_s
    halt 413, { error: "payload too large" }.to_json if body.bytesize > MAX_BODY

    verify_signature!(body)

    data = begin
      JSON.parse(body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      halt 400, { error: "invalid JSON" }.to_json
    end
    halt 422, { error: "JSON object expected" }.to_json unless data.is_a?(Hash)

    deploy = normalize(data)
    STORE.add(deploy)

    begin
      post_deployment(deploy)
    rescue StandardError => e
      LOG.error("Failed to post to Discord: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      halt 502, { error: "recorded, but failed to notify Discord" }.to_json
    end

    status 201
    { ok: true }.to_json
  end

  error do
    LOG.error("Unhandled error: #{env['sinatra.error']&.message}")
    content_type :json
    status 500
    { error: "internal error" }.to_json
  end

  helpers do
    # Expects header: X-Signature-256: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>
    def verify_signature!(body)
      provided = request.env["HTTP_X_SIGNATURE_256"].to_s
      expected = "sha256=" + OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", Config::SECRET, body)
      return if Rack::Utils.secure_compare(expected, provided)

      halt 401, { error: "invalid signature" }.to_json
    end

    def normalize(data)
      environment = data["environment"].to_s
      status      = data["status"].to_s.downcase

      unless environment.match?(ENV_NAME)
        halt 422, { error: "environment is required (letters, digits, . _ -; max 32)" }.to_json
      end
      unless Format::STATUS_STYLE.key?(status)
        halt 422, { error: "status must be one of: #{Format::STATUS_STYLE.keys.join(', ')}" }.to_json
      end

      url = data["url"].to_s
      url = nil unless url.match?(%r{\Ahttps?://\S+\z}) && url.length <= 512

      {
        "environment" => environment,
        "status"      => status,
        "version"     => data["version"]&.to_s&.then { |v| Format.clip(v, 64) },
        "commit"      => data["commit"]&.to_s&.then { |v| Format.clip(v, 40) },
        "author"      => data["author"]&.to_s&.then { |v| Format.clip(v, 64) },
        "message"     => data["message"]&.to_s&.then { |v| Format.clip(v, 2000) },
        "url"         => url,
        "timestamp"   => Time.now.utc.iso8601
      }
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Boot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
at_exit { BOT.stop }

BOT.run(:async)          # Discord gateway in a background thread
BOT.ready { LOG.info("Discord bot ready as #{BOT.profile.username}") }
BOT.wait_until_ready if BOT.respond_to?(:wait_until_ready)

WebhookApp.run!          # Blocks; serves POST /deployments and GET /health
```

## `.env.example`

```bash
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=your-bot-token
DISCORD_NOTIFY_CHANNEL_ID=123456789012345678
DISCORD_SERVER_ID=123456789012345678   # optional, but recommended during development
WEBHOOK_SECRET=use-a-long-random-string
PORT=4567
```

## Setup and usage

1. Create an application and bot in the Discord Developer Portal. Invite it with the scopes `bot` and `applications.commands`, and the permissions **Send Messages** and **Embed Links**.
2. Run `bundle install`, copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill it in, then run `bundle exec ruby bot.rb`.
3. Send a deployment notification from CI:

```bash
BODY='{"environment":"production","status":"success","version":"v1.4.2","commit":"a1b2c3d4e5f6","author":"alice","message":"Fixed login bug","url":"https://ci.example.com/runs/42"}'
SIG="sha256=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" | awk '{print $2}')"

curl -X POST http://localhost:4567/deployments \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Signature-256: $SIG" \
  -d "$BODY"
```

**Slash commands**
- `/ping` checks that the bot is alive.
- `/status [environment]` shows the latest deployment.
- `/history [limit] [environment]` lists recent deployments.
- `/announce` posts a manual notification. It requires the Manage Server permission.

**Notes**
- Requests to `/deployments` must carry a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature. The check uses a constant-time comparison.
- Incoming text is length-limited to fit Discord's embed limits, and `allowed_mentions` is empty so a payload can't ping `@everyone`.
- Deployment history is kept in `deployments.json`, which holds the latest 200 records. Swap in a database if you need more.

path : "/" end # URL завершення сесії у провайдера (RP-Initiated Logout) def end_session_endpoint App.provider_metadata["end_session_endpoint"] end end # Метадані провайдера (кешуються) def self.provider_metadata @provider_metadata ||= begin uri = URI("#{ISSUER.chomp('/')}/.well-known/openid-configuration") body = Net::HTTP.get(uri) JSON.parse(body) rescue StandardError => e warn "Не вдалося отримати метадані OIDC: #{e.message}" {} end end # ---------- Маршрути ---------- get "/" do erb :index end get "/login" do redirect "/profile" if logged_in? erb :login end # POST /auth/keycloak — обробляється middleware OmniAuth і редіректить на Keycloak. # Callback від Keycloak get "/auth/:provider/callback" do auth = request.env["omniauth.auth"] halt 400, "Порожня відповідь автентифікації" unless auth info = auth.info extra = auth.extra&.raw_info || {} return_to = safe_return_path(session[:return_to]) # Захист від session fixation: починаємо нову сесію після входу session.clear env["rack.session.options"][:renew] = true session[:user] = { "uid" => auth.uid, # claim "sub" "name" => info.name, "email" => info.email, "username" => extra["preferred_username"], "email_verified" => extra["email_verified"] } # id_token потрібен для коректного виходу (id_token_hint) session[:id_token] = auth.credentials&.id_token redirect return_to end get "/auth/failure" do status 401 @message = params[:message].to_s erb :failure end get "/profile" do authenticate! erb :profile end post "/logout" do id_token = session[:id_token] session.clear endpoint = end_session_endpoint if endpoint && id_token uri = URI(endpoint) uri.query = URI.encode_www_form( id_token_hint: id_token, post_logout_redirect_uri: "#{BASE_URL}/", client_id: ENV.fetch("OIDC_CLIENT_ID") ) redirect uri.to_s else redirect "/" end end run! if app_file == $PROGRAM_NAME end __END__ @@ layout OIDC + Keycloak
