text:
# Надсилання шаблонних повідомлень WhatsApp через Cloud API (Ruby)

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"        # HTTP-клієнт
gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2"  # автоматичні повтори при 429/503
gem "dotenv", "~> 3.1"         # завантаження змінних з файлу .env
```

Встановлення: `bundle install`

## Файл `.env` (приклад)

```dotenv
WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN=EAAG...ваш_постійний_токен
WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=123456789012345
WHATSAPP_API_VERSION=v21.0
```

## Реалізація: `whatsapp_template_sender.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "dotenv/load"

module WhatsApp
  # ── Помилки ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ConfigurationError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end

  # Помилка, яку повернув Graph API
  class APIError < Error
    attr_reader :http_status, :code, :subcode, :type, :fbtrace_id, :body

    def initialize(http_status, body)
      @http_status = http_status
      @body        = body
      err          = body.is_a?(Hash) ? (body["error"] || {}) : {}
      @code        = err["code"]
      @subcode     = err["error_subcode"]
      @type        = err["type"]
      @fbtrace_id  = err["fbtrace_id"]
      details      = err.dig("error_data", "details")

      msg = +"HTTP #{http_status}"
      msg << " | code=#{@code}" if @code
      msg << " | subcode=#{@subcode}" if @subcode
      msg << " | #{err['message']}" if err["message"]
      msg << " | #{details}" if details
      msg << " | fbtrace_id=#{@fbtrace_id}" if @fbtrace_id
      super(msg)
    end
  end

  # ── Клієнт ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  class Client
    BASE_URL            = "https://graph.facebook.com"
    DEFAULT_API_VERSION = "v21.0"
    MEDIA_TYPES         = %i[image video document].freeze

    def initialize(access_token: ENV["WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN"],
                   phone_number_id: ENV["WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID"],
                   api_version: ENV.fetch("WHATSAPP_API_VERSION", DEFAULT_API_VERSION),
                   logger: nil)
      @access_token    = access_token.to_s.strip
      @phone_number_id = phone_number_id.to_s.strip
      @api_version     = api_version

      raise ConfigurationError, "Не задано WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN"    if @access_token.empty?
      raise ConfigurationError, "Не задано WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID" if @phone_number_id.empty?

      @connection = build_connection(logger)
    end

    # Надсилає шаблонне повідомлення.
    #
    # to       - номер одержувача у міжнародному форматі (напр. "+380501234567")
    # name     - назва схваленого шаблону
    # language - код мови шаблону ("uk", "en_US" тощо)
    # header   - nil | "текст" | { image: "https://..." } | { video: ... } | { document: ..., filename: "a.pdf" }
    # body     - масив значень для {{1}}, {{2}}...
    #            або масив хешів { name: "customer", value: "Іван" } для іменованих параметрів
    # buttons  - масив хешів:
    #            { type: :url, index: 0, text: "суфікс-посилання" }
    #            { type: :quick_reply, index: 1, payload: "MY_PAYLOAD" }
    #
    # Повертає хеш: { message_id:, wa_id:, raw: }
    def send_template(to:, name:, language: "uk", header: nil, body: [], buttons: [])
      raise ValidationError, "Назва шаблону обов'язкова" if name.to_s.strip.empty?

      payload = {
        messaging_product: "whatsapp",
        recipient_type: "individual",
        to: normalize_phone(to),
        type: "template",
        template: {
          name: name,
          language: { code: language }
        }
      }

      components = build_components(header: header, body: body, buttons: buttons)
      payload[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

      response = @connection.post("#{@api_version}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages", payload)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Мережева помилка: #{e.class}: #{e.message}"
    end

    private

    def build_connection(logger)
      Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.request :retry,
                  max: 3,
                  interval: 1,
                  backoff_factor: 2,
                  methods: %i[post],
                  # Повторюємо лише 429/503, щоб не ризикувати дублікатами повідомлень
                  retry_statuses: [429, 503]
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/
        f.response :logger, logger, bodies: false if logger
        f.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"
        f.options.timeout      = 15
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    # Залишаємо лише цифри: "+38 (050) 123-45-67" => "380501234567"
    def normalize_phone(phone)
      digits = phone.to_s.gsub(/\D/, "")
      unless digits.length.between?(8, 15)
        raise ValidationError, "Некоректний номер телефону: #{phone.inspect}"
      end
      digits
    end

    def build_components(header:, body:, buttons:)
      components = []

      if (h = build_header(header))
        components << h
      end

      body_params = Array(body).map { |p| text_parameter(p) }
      components << { type: "body", parameters: body_params } unless body_params.empty?

      Array(buttons).each { |b| components << build_button(b) }

      components
    end

    def build_header(header)
      case header
      when nil
        nil
      when String
        { type: "header", parameters: [{ type: "text", text: header }] }
      when Hash
        media_type = MEDIA_TYPES.find { |t| header.key?(t) }
        raise ValidationError, "Невідомий тип header: #{header.inspect}" unless media_type

        media = { link: header[media_type] }
        media[:filename] = header[:filename] if media_type == :document && header[:filename]
        { type: "header", parameters: [{ type: media_type.to_s, media_type => media }] }
      else
        raise ValidationError, "Header має бути String, Hash або nil"
      end
    end

    def text_parameter(param)
      if param.is_a?(Hash)
        name  = param[:name] || param["name"]
        value = param[:value] || param["value"]
        raise ValidationError, "Іменований параметр потребує :name та :value" if name.nil? || value.nil?

        { type: "text", parameter_name: name.to_s, text: value.to_s }
      else
        { type: "text", text: param.to_s }
      end
    end

    def build_button(button)
      index = button.fetch(:index, 0).to_s

      case button[:type]&.to_sym
      when :url
        {
          type: "button", sub_type: "url", index: index,
          parameters: [{ type: "text", text: button.fetch(:text).to_s }]
        }
      when :quick_reply
        {
          type: "button", sub_type: "quick_reply", index: index,
          parameters: [{ type: "payload", payload: button.fetch(:payload).to_s }]
        }
      else
        raise ValidationError, "Непідтримуваний тип кнопки: #{button.inspect}"
      end
    rescue KeyError => e
      raise ValidationError, "Для кнопки бракує поля: #{e.key}"
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      body = response.body
      raise APIError.new(response.status, body) unless response.success?

      {
        message_id: body.dig("messages", 0, "id"),
        wa_id: body.dig("contacts", 0, "wa_id"),
        raw: body
      }
    end
  end
end

# ── Приклад використання ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    client = WhatsApp::Client.new

    recipient = ARGV[0] || ENV["WHATSAPP_TEST_RECIPIENT"]
    abort "Використання: ruby #{$PROGRAM_NAME} +380501234567" unless recipient

    # 1) Стандартний тестовий шаблон Meta (без параметрів)
    result = client.send_template(
      to: recipient,
      name: "hello_world",
      language: "en_US"
    )
    puts "Надіслано: #{result[:message_id]}"

    # 2) Шаблон із заголовком-зображенням, параметрами тіла та кнопкою-посиланням
    #
    # result = client.send_template(
    #   to: recipient,
    #   name: "order_confirmation",
    #   language: "uk",
    #   header: { image: "https://example.com/banner.jpg" },
    #   body: ["Іван", "ORD-12345", "1 250 грн"],
    #   buttons: [{ type: :url, index: 0, text: "ORD-12345" }]
    # )

    # 3) Шаблон з іменованими параметрами
    #
    # result = client.send_template(
    #   to: recipient,
    #   name: "delivery_update",
    #   language: "uk",
    #   body: [
    #     { name: "customer_name", value: "Олена" },
    #     { name: "eta", value: "завтра до 18:00" }
    #   ]
    # )
  rescue WhatsApp::ValidationError, WhatsApp::ConfigurationError => e
    warn "Помилка конфігурації/валідації: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue WhatsApp::APIError => e
    warn "Помилка WhatsApp API: #{e.message}"
    exit 2
  rescue WhatsApp::Error => e
    warn "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    exit 3
  end
end
```

## Запуск

```bash
bundle install
ruby whatsapp_template_sender.rb +380501234567
```

## Важливі нотатки

- **Шаблон має бути схвалений** у WhatsApp Manager, а назва й код мови повинні точно збігатися з тими, що в Meta.
- **Токен**: для продакшену використовуйте постійний токен системного користувача (тимчасові діють ~24 години).
- **Тестовий режим**: поки номер не верифіковано, повідомлення можна надсилати лише на номери зі списку одержувачів у Meta Developer Console.
- **Повтори**: автоматично повторюються лише відповіді 429 і 503. Для інших 5xx повтор POST міг би призвести до дублікатів повідомлень.
- **Кількість параметрів** у `body`, `header` і `buttons` має відповідати кількості плейсхолдерів у шаблоні, інакше API поверне помилку `132000`.

text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for a product recommendation system using collaborative filtering:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'matrix'
gem 'json'
gem 'csv'
```

## Implementation

### `recommendation_engine.rb`

```ruby
require 'matrix'
require 'json'
require 'csv'
require 'set'

class RecommendationEngine
  attr_reader :user_product_matrix, :product_similarity_matrix, :user_ids, :product_ids

  def initialize
    @user_ids = []
    @product_ids = []
    @user_product_matrix = nil
    @product_similarity_matrix = nil
    @user_index = {}
    @product_index = {}
  end

  # Load order data and build user-product interaction matrix
  def load_orders(orders)
    # Extract unique users and products
    @user_ids = orders.map { |order| order[:user_id] }.uniq
    @product_ids = orders.flat_map { |order| order[:product_ids] }.uniq
    
    # Create index mappings
    @user_index = @user_ids.each_with_index.to_h
    @product_index = @product_ids.each_with_index.to_h
    
    # Build user-product matrix (1 if user bought product, 0 otherwise)
    matrix_data = Array.new(@user_ids.length) { Array.new(@product_ids.length, 0) }
    
    orders.each do |order|
      user_idx = @user_index[order[:user_id]]
      order[:product_ids].each do |product_id|
        product_idx = @product_index[product_id]
        matrix_data[user_idx][product_idx] = 1
      end
    end
    
    @user_product_matrix = Matrix[*matrix_data]
    calculate_product_similarity
  end

  # Calculate product-to-product similarity using cosine similarity
  def calculate_product_similarity
    return if @user_product_matrix.nil?
    
    num_products = @product_ids.length
    similarity_data = Array.new(num_products) { Array.new(num_products, 0.0) }
    
    # Calculate cosine similarity between each pair of products
    (0...num_products).each do |i|
      (0...num_products).each do |j|
        if i == j
          similarity_data[i][j] = 1.0
        elsif i < j
          similarity = cosine_similarity(i, j)
          similarity_data[i][j] = similarity
          similarity_data[j][i] = similarity
        end
      end
    end
    
    @product_similarity_matrix = Matrix[*similarity_data]
  end

  # Calculate cosine similarity between two products
  def cosine_similarity(product_idx1, product_idx2)
    vec1 = @user_product_matrix.column(product_idx1)
    vec2 = @user_product_matrix.column(product_idx2)
    
    dot_product = 0
    norm1 = 0
    norm2 = 0
    
    vec1.each_with_index do |val, idx|
      dot_product += val * vec2[idx]
      norm1 += val * val
      norm2 += vec2[idx] * vec2[idx]
    end
    
    return 0.0 if norm1 == 0 || norm2 == 0
    
    dot_product / (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2))
  end

  # Get product recommendations for a user
  def recommend_for_user(user_id, num_recommendations = 5)
    return [] unless @user_index.key?(user_id)
    
    user_idx = @user_index[user_id]
    user_products = @user_product_matrix.row(user_idx).to_a
    
    # Find products the user hasn't purchased yet
    unpurchased_products = []
    user_products.each_with_index do |purchased, product_idx|
      unpurchased_products << product_idx if purchased == 0
    end
    
    # Calculate recommendation scores for unpurchased products
    scores = {}
    unpurchased_products.each do |product_idx|
      score = calculate_recommendation_score(user_idx, product_idx)
      scores[product_idx] = score if score > 0
    end
    
    # Sort by score and return top N recommendations
    sorted_scores = scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.first(num_recommendations)
    
    sorted_scores.map do |product_idx, score|
      {
        product_id: @product_ids[product_idx],
        score: score.round(4)
      }
    end
  end

  # Calculate recommendation score for a product based on user's purchase history
  def calculate_recommendation_score(user_idx, product_idx)
    user_products = @user_product_matrix.row(user_idx).to_a
    score = 0.0
    similarity_sum = 0.0
    
    # Find products the user has purchased
    user_products.each_with_index do |purchased, idx|
      if purchased == 1
        similarity = @product_similarity_matrix[product_idx, idx]
        score += similarity
        similarity_sum += similarity.abs
      end
    end
    
    # Normalize the score
    return 0.0 if similarity_sum == 0
    score / similarity_sum
  end

  # Get similar products for a specific product
  def similar_products(product_id, num_similar = 5)
    return [] unless @product_index.key?(product_id)
    
    product_idx = @product_index[product_id]
    similarities = @product_similarity_matrix.row(product_idx).to_a
    
    # Get indices of most similar products (excluding itself)
    similar_indices = similarities.each_with_index
                                  .reject { |score, idx| idx == product_idx || score == 0 }
                                  .sort_by { |score, _| -score }
                                  .first(num_similar)
    
    similar_indices.map do |score, idx|
      {
        product_id: @product_ids[idx],
        similarity: score.round(4)
      }
    end
  end

  # Export recommendation model to JSON
  def export_model(filename = 'recommendation_model.json')
    model = {
      user_ids: @user_ids,
      product_ids: @product_ids,
      product_similarity_matrix: @product_similarity_matrix&.to_a,
      user_product_matrix: @user_product_matrix&.to_a
    }
    
    File.write(filename, JSON.pretty_generate(model))
    puts "Model exported to #{filename}"
  end

  # Import recommendation model from JSON
  def import_model(filename = 'recommendation_model.json')
    model = JSON.parse(File.read(filename))
    
    @user_ids = model['user_ids']
    @product_ids = model['product_ids']
    @user_index = @user_ids.each_with_index.to_h
    @product_index = @product_ids.each_with_index.to_h
    
    @product_similarity_matrix = Matrix[*model['product_similarity_matrix']]
    @user_product_matrix = Matrix[*model['user_product_matrix']]
    
    puts "Model imported from #{filename}"
  end
end
```

### `sample_data_loader.rb`

require 'csv'

class SampleDataLoader

  def self.load_from_csv(filename)

      { user_id: 5, product_ids: [103, 104, 105] },

### `main.rb`

```ruby
require_relative 'recommendation_engine'
require_relative 'sample_data_loader'

# Initialize recommendation engine
engine = RecommendationEngine.new

# Load sample data
orders = SampleDataLoader.create_sample_orders
engine.load_orders(orders)

puts "=== Product Recommendation System ===\n\n"

# Get recommendations for specific users
test_users = [1, 3, 6, 9]

test_users.each do |user_id|
  puts "Recommendations for User #{user_id}:"
  recommendations = engine.recommend_for_user(user_id, 3)
  
  if recommendations.empty?
    puts "  No recommendations available"
  else
    recommendations.each do |rec|
      puts "  Product #{rec[:product_id]} (score: #{rec[:score]})"
    end
  end
  puts
end

# Find similar products
puts "Similar products for Product 101:"
similar = engine.similar_products(101, 3)

```markdown
# Product Recommendation System

A collaborative filtering recommendation system that suggests related products based on past purchase history.

## Features

- User-product interaction matrix construction
- Product-to-product similarity calculation using cosine similarity
- Item-based collaborative filtering recommendations
- Model export/import functionality
- Support for CSV data loading

## Usage

1. Install dependencies:
```bash
bundle install
```

2. Run the example:
```bash
ruby main.rb
```

3. Use in your own project:
```ruby
require_relative 'recommendation_engine'

engine = RecommendationEngine.new

# Load your order data
orders = [
  { user_id: 1, product_ids: [101, 102] },
  { user_id: 2, product_ids: [101, 103] }
]
engine.load_orders(orders)

# Get recommendations
recommendations = engine.recommend_for_user(1, 5)

# Find similar products
similar = engine.similar_products(101, 3)
```

## How It Works

1. **User-Product Matrix**: Creates a binary matrix representing which users purchased which products
2. **Product Similarity**: Calculates cosine similarity between products based on co-purchase patterns
3. **Recommendations**: For each user, finds unpurchased products and scores them based on similarity to products they've already bought
4. **Scoring**: Normalizes recommendation scores to account for users with different purchase volumes

## Data Format

Orders should be provided as an array of hashes:
```ruby
{ user_id: Integer, product_ids: [Integer, ...] }
```

CSV format:
```
user_id,product_ids
1,101|102|103
2,101|103|104
```
```

This implementation provides:

1. **Collaborative Filtering**: Uses item-based collaborative filtering with cosine similarity
2. **Scalable Design**: Matrix-based calculations for efficient processing
3. **Flexible Data Input**: Supports both direct array input and CSV files
4. **Model Persistence**: Export/import functionality for saving trained models
5. **Clean Architecture**: Separated concerns with modular design
6. **Comprehensive Documentation**: README with usage examples

The system works by:
- Building a user-product interaction matrix
- Calculating product similarities based on co-purchase patterns
- Recommending products similar to what a user has already purchased
- Providing product-to-product similarity scores for "related products" features

COLORS[statuses[region] || :none] end def project(lon, lat) [(lon - LON_MIN) * @kx * @scale, (LAT_MAX - lat) * @scale] end def load_shapes(path) data = JSON.parse(File.read(path)) features = data["features"] || [] features.filter_map do |f| geom = f["geometry"] next unless geom polys = case geom["type"] when "Polygon" then [geom["coordinates"]] when "MultiPolygon" then geom["coordinates"] end next unless polys region = Regions.detect(f["properties"]) warn "⚠️ Не розпізнано область у GeoJSON: #{f['properties'].inspect}" if region.nil? && partial.empty? out = ["Активні повітряні тривоги", ""] full.each { |r| out << "🔴 #{r}" } partial.each do |r| places = snap.details[r].first(5).join(", ") extra = snap.details[r].size > 5 ? " та ще #{snap.details[r].size - 5}" : "" out << "🟠 #{r} (#{places}#{extra})" end out << "" out << "Оновлено: #{time(snap.fetched_at)} (Київ)" out.join("\n")[0, 4096] end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Telegram-бот # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class AlertBot Types = Telegram::Bot::Types HELP = <<~TEXT Привіт! Я показую поточну мапу повітряних тривог в Україні. /map — мапа тривог /alerts — список областей із тривогою /help — довідка Дані: alerts.in.ua TEXT def initialize(service) @service = service end def run Telegram::Bot::Client.run(Config::TELEGRAM_TOKEN) do |bot| register_commands(bot) puts "✅ Бот запущено" bot.listen do |update| handle(bot, update) rescue StandardError => e warn "Помилка обробки оновлення: #{e.class}: #{e.message}" end end rescue Faraday::Error => e warn "Мережева помилка Telegram: #{e.message}. Перезапуск через 5 с…" sleep 5 retry end private def register_commands(bot) bot.api.set_my_commands( commands: [ Types::BotCommand.new(command: "map", description: "Мапа повітряних тривог"), Types::BotCommand.new(command: "alerts", description: "Список активних тривог"), Types::BotCommand.new(command: "help", description: "Довідка") ] ) rescue StandardError => e warn "Не вдалося зареєструвати команди: #{e.message}" end def handle(bot, update) case update when Types::CallbackQuery bot.api.answer_callback_query(callback_query_id: update.id, text: "Оновлюю…") send_map(bot, update.message.chat.id, force: true) if update.data == "refresh" when Types::Message command = update.text.to_s[%r{\A/(\w+)}, 1]&.downcase chat_id = update.chat.id case command when "start", "help" then bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: HELP) when "map" then send_map(bot, chat_id) when "alerts" then send_list(bot, chat_id) end end end def keyboard Types::InlineKeyboardMarkup.new( inline_keyboard: [[ Types::InlineKeyboardButton.new(text: "🔄 Оновити", callback_data: "refresh") ]] ) end def send_map(bot, chat_id, force: false) bot.api.send_chat_action(chat_id: chat_id, action: "upload_photo") snap = @service.snapshot(force: force) photo = Faraday::Multipart::FilePart.new(StringIO.new(snap.png), "image/png", "alerts_map.png") bot.api.send_photo( chat_id: chat_id, photo: photo, caption: Formatter.caption(snap), parse_mode: "HTML", reply_markup: keyboard ) rescue AlertsClient::Error => e bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "⚠️ #{e.message}") end def send_list(bot, chat_id) snap = @service.snapshot bot.api.send_message( chat_id: chat_id, text: Formatter.list(snap), parse_mode: "HTML", reply_markup: keyboard ) rescue AlertsClient::Error => e bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "⚠️ #{e.message}") end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Точка входу # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def ensure_geojson! return if File.exist?(Config::GEOJSON_PATH) puts "⬇️ Завантажую GeoJSON меж областей…" resp = Faraday.get(Config::GEOJSON_URL) raise "Не вдалося завантажити GeoJSON (HTTP #{resp.status})" unless resp.success? FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(Config::GEOJSON_PATH)) File.binwrite(Config::GEOJSON_PATH, resp.body) end if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__ ensure_geojson! renderer = MapRenderer.new(Config::GEOJSON_PATH) missing = Regions::PATTERNS.keys - renderer.region_names warn "⚠️ У GeoJSON не знайдено: #{missing.join(', ')}" unless missing.empty? service = AlertMapService.new( client: AlertsClient.new(Config::ALERTS_TOKEN), renderer: renderer ) AlertBot.new(service).run end ``` ## Запуск ```bash bundle install cp .env.example .env # вкажіть токени bundle exec ruby bot.rb ``` ## Як це працює - **Дані про тривоги** беруться з API [alerts.in.ua](https://alerts.in.ua/api-request) (потрібен безкоштовний токен). Область позначається червоним, якщо тривога в усій області, і помаранчевим, якщо лише в окремих районах чи громадах. Решта областей зелені. - **Мапа** малюється самим ботом на `chunky_png` за GeoJSON-кордонами областей, тож ImageMagick чи інші системні бібліотеки не потрібні. Заливка полігонів реалізована сканувальними лініями. - **GeoJSON** завантажується один раз у `data/`. Назви областей розпізнаються за українськими та латинськими шаблонами. Якщо ваш файл має інші назви, бот під час запуску виведе попередження, і тоді слід доповнити `Regions::PATTERNS` або вказати свій файл через `GEOJSON_PATH`. - **Кеш** на 30 секунд (`CACHE_TTL`) захищає API від перевищення лімітів, а кнопка «🔄 Оновити» примусово оновлює дані. - **Команди:** `/map` показує мапу, `/alerts` виводить текстовий список, `/help` і `/start` дають довідку.

Task: Issue a fiscal receipt through the Checkbox software cash register (PRRO) API after an online payment.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

`json`, `securerandom`, `digest`, and `time` are used from the standard library, so they need no entries. I avoided `bigdecimal` and `logger` because they are no longer default gems in newer Rubies. All money is handled as integer kopecks.

## checkbox_receipt.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"
require "securerandom"
require "digest"

# Fiscalizes an online payment through the Checkbox PRRO API
# (https://api.checkbox.ua/api/v1, docs: https://docs.checkbox.ua).
module Checkbox
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(status, body)
      @status = status
      @body = body
      super("Checkbox API error #{status}: #{body}")
    end
  end

  class ReceiptFailed < Error; end

  class Client
    PROD_URL = "https://api.checkbox.ua/api/v1/"
    DEV_URL  = "https://dev-api.checkbox.in.ua/api/v1/"
    PUBLIC_RECEIPT_URL = "https://check.checkbox.ua/"

    # Namespace for deterministic (v5) receipt UUIDs
    UUID_NAMESPACE = "6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8"

    MAX_NETWORK_RETRIES = 3

    def initialize(login:, password:, license_key:, base_url: PROD_URL,
                   client_name: "ruby-checkbox-integration", client_version: "1.0")
      @login = login
      @password = password
      @license_key = license_key
      @client_name = client_name
      @client_version = client_version
      @token = nil
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f|
        f.options.timeout = 20
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
      end
    end

    # Main entry point. Call after the payment provider confirms payment.
    #
    # order = {
    #   id: "order-1001",                 # your unique order/payment id (used for idempotency)
    #   items: [{ code: "SKU1", name: "T-shirt", price: 49900, quantity: 2 }], # price in kopecks
    #   email: "buyer@example.com",       # optional, Checkbox emails the receipt
    #   card_mask: "444433******1111",    # optional
    #   discount_total: 0                 # optional, kopecks (not distributed; see note below)
    # }
    #
    # Returns { id:, status:, fiscal_code:, url:, total: }
    def issue_receipt(order)
      receipt_id = deterministic_uuid("receipt:#{order.fetch(:id)}")

      # Idempotency: webhooks get retried; never fiscalize one payment twice.
      existing = find_receipt(receipt_id)
      return summarize(existing) if existing

      ensure_shift_open
      payload = build_sell_payload(receipt_id, order)
      create_receipt_with_retry(receipt_id, payload)
      receipt = wait_for_receipt(receipt_id)
      summarize(receipt)
    end

    # ---- Auth ----------------------------------------------------------

    def sign_in
      resp = @conn.post("cashier/signin") do |r|
        r.headers.merge!(base_headers)
        r.body = JSON.generate(login: @login, password: @password)
      end
      data = parse!(resp)
      @token = data.fetch("access_token")
    end

    # ---- Shift ---------------------------------------------------------

    def ensure_shift_open
      shift = current_shift
      return shift if shift && shift["status"] == "OPENED"

      unless shift && shift["status"] == "CREATED"
        request(:post, "shifts", body: {}, license: true)
      end

      30.times do
        shift = current_shift
        return shift if shift && shift["status"] == "OPENED"
        raise Error, "Shift failed to open" if shift && shift["status"] == "CLOSED"
        sleep 1
      end
      raise Error, "Timed out waiting for shift to open"
    end

    def current_shift
      request(:get, "cashier/shift", allow_404: true)
    end

    # ---- Receipts ------------------------------------------------------

    def find_receipt(receipt_id)
      request(:get, "receipts/#{receipt_id}", allow_404: true)
    end

    def wait_for_receipt(receipt_id, timeout: 60)
      deadline = Time.now + timeout
      loop do
        receipt = find_receipt(receipt_id)
        if receipt
          status = receipt.dig("transaction", "status") || receipt["status"]
          case status
          when "DONE"  then return receipt
          when "ERROR" then raise ReceiptFailed, "Receipt #{receipt_id} failed: #{receipt.inspect}"
          end
        end
        raise Error, "Timed out waiting for receipt #{receipt_id}" if Time.now > deadline
        sleep 1
      end
    end

    private

    def build_sell_payload(receipt_id, order)
      goods = order.fetch(:items).map do |item|
        qty = (item.fetch(:quantity) * 1000).round # Checkbox: quantity in thousandths
        price = Integer(item.fetch(:price))        # kopecks
        raise ArgumentError, "price must be positive" unless price.positive?
        raise ArgumentError, "quantity must be positive" unless qty.positive?

        {
          good: { code: item.fetch(:code).to_s, name: item.fetch(:name), price: price },
          quantity: qty
        }
      end
      raise ArgumentError, "order has no items" if goods.empty?

      total = goods.sum { |g| (g[:good][:price] * g[:quantity] / 1000.0).round }
      total -= order[:discount_total].to_i
      raise ArgumentError, "total must be positive" unless total.positive?

      payment = { type: "CASHLESS", value: total, label: "Оплата карткою онлайн" }
      payment[:card_mask] = order[:card_mask] if order[:card_mask]

      payload = {
        id: receipt_id,
        goods: goods,
        payments: [payment]
      }
      payload[:delivery] = { email: order[:email] } if order[:email]
      payload
    end

    # The receipt id makes POST safe to retry: before each retry we check
    # whether the previous attempt actually created the receipt.
    def create_receipt_with_retry(receipt_id, payload)
      attempts = 0
      begin
        attempts += 1
        request(:post, "receipts/sell", body: payload, license: true)
      rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed
        raise if attempts >= MAX_NETWORK_RETRIES
        sleep(2**attempts)
        return if find_receipt(receipt_id)
        retry
      end
    end

    def summarize(receipt)
      {
        id: receipt["id"],
        status: receipt.dig("transaction", "status") || receipt["status"],
        fiscal_code: receipt["fiscal_code"],
        total: receipt["total_sum"],
        url: "#{PUBLIC_RECEIPT_URL}#{receipt['id']}"
      }
    end

    # ---- HTTP plumbing -------------------------------------------------

    def base_headers
      {
        "Content-Type" => "application/json",
        "Accept" => "application/json",
        "X-Client-Name" => @client_name,
        "X-Client-Version" => @client_version
      }
    end

    def request(method, path, body: nil, license: false, allow_404: false)
      sign_in unless @token
      reauthed = false

      begin
        resp = @conn.run_request(method, path, body && JSON.generate(body), headers(license))
        if resp.status == 401 && !reauthed
          reauthed = true
          sign_in
          raise :retry_auth.to_s if false # (kept explicit below)
          resp = @conn.run_request(method, path, body && JSON.generate(body), headers(license))
        end
      end

      return nil if allow_404 && resp.status == 404
      parse!(resp)
    end

    def headers(license)
      h = base_headers.merge("Authorization" => "Bearer #{@token}")
      h["X-License-Key"] = @license_key if license
      h
    end

    def parse!(resp)
      unless resp.status.between?(200, 299)
        raise ApiError.new(resp.status, resp.body)
      end
      resp.body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(resp.body)
    end

    # RFC 4122 UUID v5 (SHA-1, name-based) so the same order always maps to the same receipt id.
    def deterministic_uuid(name)
      ns_bytes = [UUID_NAMESPACE.delete("-")].pack("H*")
      hash = Digest::SHA1.digest(ns_bytes + name).bytes.first(16)
      hash[6] = (hash[6] & 0x0f) | 0x50
      hash[8] = (hash[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80
      hex = hash.pack("C*").unpack1("H*")
      "#{hex[0, 8]}-#{hex[8, 4]}-#{hex[12, 4]}-#{hex[16, 4]}-#{hex[20, 12]}"
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage (e.g. inside a payment-provider webhook handler)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  client = Checkbox::Client.new(
    login: ENV.fetch("CHECKBOX_LOGIN"),
    password: ENV.fetch("CHECKBOX_PASSWORD"),
    license_key: ENV.fetch("CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY"),
    base_url: ENV["CHECKBOX_ENV"] == "production" ? Checkbox::Client::PROD_URL : Checkbox::Client::DEV_URL
  )

  result = client.issue_receipt(
    id: "order-1001",
    email: "buyer@example.com",
    card_mask: "444433******1111",
    items: [
      { code: "TSHIRT-M", name: "Футболка M", price: 49_900, quantity: 2 },
      { code: "SHIP-01",  name: "Доставка",   price: 9_900,  quantity: 1 }
    ]
  )

  puts "Fiscal receipt issued: #{result[:url]} (fiscal code #{result[:fiscal_code]})"
rescue Checkbox::Error => e
  warn "Fiscalization failed: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end
```

The `request` method contains a leftover no-op line (`raise :retry_auth.to_s if false`). Here is a cleaned-up version to use in its place:

```ruby
def request(method, path, body: nil, license: false, allow_404: false)
  sign_in unless @token
  json_body = body && JSON.generate(body)

  resp = @conn.run_request(method, path, json_body, headers(license))
  if resp.status == 401        # token expired: re-authenticate once
    sign_in
    resp = @conn.run_request(method, path, json_body, headers(license))
  end

  return nil if allow_404 && resp.status == 404
  parse!(resp)
end
```

## Notes

- **Endpoints used:** `POST /cashier/signin`, `GET /cashier/shift`, `POST /shifts`, `POST /receipts/sell`, `GET /receipts/{id}`. The shift and receipt creation calls send the `X-License-Key` header for your cash register.
- **Units:** prices are in kopecks, and quantity is in thousandths (1 item = `1000`). The code converts quantity for you.
- **Idempotency:** the receipt UUID is derived from your order id (UUID v5). Retried webhooks or network timeouts return the existing receipt instead of creating a duplicate fiscal document.
- **Payment type:** `CASHLESS` fits online card payments. The payment value must equal the total of the goods, less any discount.
- **Shifts:** the code opens a shift if none is open. Checkbox requires shifts to be closed within 24 hours, so schedule `POST /shifts/close` (or enable auto-close in the back office).
- **Testing:** use the dev base URL (`dev-api.checkbox.in.ua`) with a test cash register license before going live.
- **Discounts:** `discount_total` only reduces the payment total in this code. To show discounts on the receipt itself, add a per-item `discounts` array.

text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "activesupport", "~> 7.1"   # String#parameterize + I18n transliteration
gem "minitest", "~> 5.20"       # tests
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# slugger.rb
require "active_support"
require "active_support/core_ext/string/inflections"

# Turns article titles (possibly with accents) into URL-safe slugs.
#
#   Slugger.call("Crème Brûlée à la façon d'Hélène")
#   # => "creme-brulee-a-la-facon-dhelene"
module Slugger
  DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH = 80

  # @param title      [String, nil] the article title
  # @param separator  [String]      word separator (default "-")
  # @param max_length [Integer]     maximum slug length; cuts on a word boundary when possible
  # @param fallback   [String]      returned when nothing usable remains (e.g. title is only "???" or emoji)
  def self.call(title, separator: "-", max_length: DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH, fallback: "untitled")
    # NFKC folds compatibility characters (e.g. full-width letters, ligatures like "ﬁ")
    normalized = title.to_s.unicode_normalize(:nfkc)

    # parameterize transliterates accents (é -> e, ß -> ss, ø -> o, æ -> ae),
    # downcases, replaces runs of non-alphanumerics with the separator, and
    # trims leading/trailing separators.
    slug = normalized.parameterize(separator: separator)

    slug = truncate(slug, max_length, separator)
    slug.empty? ? fallback : slug
  end

  def self.truncate(slug, max_length, separator)
    return slug if slug.length <= max_length

    cut = slug[0, max_length]
    # If we sliced through a word, back up to the previous separator (if any)
    if slug[max_length, separator.length] != separator && cut.include?(separator)
      cut = cut[0...cut.rindex(separator)]
    end
    cut.chomp(separator)
  end
  private_class_method :truncate
end
```

## Tests

```ruby
# slugger_test.rb
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "slugger"

class SluggerTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_accented_characters
    assert_equal "creme-brulee-a-la-facon-dhelene",
                 Slugger.call("Crème Brûlée à la façon d'Hélène")
  end

  def test_special_letters
    assert_equal "strasse-in-aeroskobing", Slugger.call("Straße in Ærøskøbing")
  end

  def test_punctuation_and_whitespace
    assert_equal "hello-world", Slugger.call("  Hello,   World!!!  ")
  end

  def test_custom_separator
    assert_equal "cafe_au_lait", Slugger.call("Café au lait", separator: "_")
  end

  def test_truncates_on_word_boundary
    slug = Slugger.call("Une très longue histoire sur les cafés parisiens", max_length: 25)
    assert_equal "une-tres-longue-histoire", slug
  end

  def test_fallback_for_unslugifiable_title
    assert_equal "untitled", Slugger.call("???")
    assert_equal "untitled", Slugger.call(nil)
  end
end
```

Run with:

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec ruby slugger_test.rb
```

**Notes**
- ActiveSupport's transliteration handles characters that Unicode decomposition can't, such as `ß`, `ø` and `æ`. A plain `unicode_normalize(:nfd)` plus stripping combining marks would drop or mangle these.
- Non-Latin scripts (Chinese, Arabic, etc.) aren't transliterated by default and fall through to the `fallback`. If you need those, add a transliteration gem such as `babosa` or `unidecoder`.
- Slugs aren't guaranteed unique. If two articles can share a title, append a suffix (`-2`, or the record id) at the persistence layer.

text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for parsing passport MRZ data:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'date'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'date'

class PassportMRZParser
  # MRZ format for passports (TD3):
  # Line 1: P<ISSUING_COUNTRY<<SURNAME<<GIVEN_NAMES
  # Line 2: PASSPORT_NUMBER<CHECK_DIGIT><NATIONALITY<DATE_OF_BIRTH<CHECK_DIGIT<SEX<EXPIRY_DATE<CHECK_DIGIT<PERSONAL_NUMBER<CHECK_DIGIT<FINAL_CHECK_DIGIT
  
  attr_reader :errors
  
  def initialize
    @errors = []
  end
  
  def parse(mrz_text)
    @errors = []
    lines = normalize_lines(mrz_text)
    
    return error_result("MRZ must contain exactly 2 lines") unless lines.length == 2
    return error_result("Each line must be 44 characters") unless lines.all? { |line| line.length == 44 }
    
    line1 = lines[0]
    line2 = lines[1]
    
    # Validate document type
    return error_result("Invalid document type - must start with 'P'") unless line1.start_with?('P')
    
    # Parse line 1
    issuing_country = line1[2, 3]
    names_part = line1[5, 39]
    
    # Parse names (separated by <<)
    name_parts = names_part.split('<<')
    surname = name_parts[0].gsub('<', ' ').strip
    given_names = name_parts[1].to_s.gsub('<', ' ').strip
    
    # Parse line 2
    passport_number = line2[0, 9].gsub('<', '').strip
    passport_check_digit = line2[9]
    nationality = line2[10, 3]
    date_of_birth_raw = line2[13, 6]
    birth_check_digit = line2[19]
    sex = line2[20]
    expiry_date_raw = line2[21, 6]
    expiry_check_digit = line2[27]
    personal_number = line2[28, 14].gsub('<', '').strip
    personal_check_digit = line2[42]
    final_check_digit = line2[43]
    
    # Parse dates
    date_of_birth = parse_mrz_date(date_of_birth_raw)
    expiry_date = parse_mrz_date(expiry_date_raw)
    
    # Validate dates
    if date_of_birth.nil?
      @errors << "Invalid date of birth format"
    end
    
    if expiry_date.nil?
      @errors << "Invalid expiry date format"
    end
    
    # Validate sex
    unless ['M', 'F', '<'].include?(sex)
      @errors << "Invalid sex indicator"
    end
    
    # Validate check digits
    validate_check_digit(passport_number, passport_check_digit, "passport number")
    validate_check_digit(date_of_birth_raw, birth_check_digit, "date of birth")
    validate_check_digit(expiry_date_raw, expiry_check_digit, "expiry date")
    
    if personal_number && !personal_number.empty?
      validate_check_digit(personal_number, personal_check_digit, "personal number")
    end
    
    # Validate final check digit
    composite = passport_number + passport_check_digit + 
                date_of_birth_raw + birth_check_digit + 
                expiry_date_raw + expiry_check_digit + 
                personal_number.to_s + personal_check_digit.to_s
    
    validate_check_digit(composite, final_check_digit, "final composite")
    
    if @errors.empty?
      {
        valid: true,
        document_type: 'P',
        issuing_country: issuing_country,
        surname: surname,
        given_names: given_names,
        passport_number: passport_number,
        nationality: nationality,
        date_of_birth: date_of_birth,
        sex: sex == '<' ? nil : sex,
        expiry_date: expiry_date,
        personal_number: personal_number.empty? ? nil : personal_number
      }
    else
      {
        valid: false,
        errors: @errors
      }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def normalize_lines(text)
    text.to_s
        .gsub("\r\n", "\n")
        .gsub("\r", "\n")
        .split("\n")
        .map(&:strip)
        .reject(&:empty?)
  end
  
  def parse_mrz_date(raw_date)
    return nil unless raw_date.match?(/^\d{6}$/)
    
    year = raw_date[0, 2].to_i
    month = raw_date[2, 2].to_i
    day = raw_date[4, 2].to_i
    
    # Determine century (MRZ uses 2-digit years)
    current_year = Date.today.year
    century = current_year / 100
    full_year = century * 100 + year
    
    # If the date is more than 50 years in the future, it's probably from the previous century
    if full_year > current_year + 50
      full_year -= 100
    end
    
    begin
      Date.new(full_year, month, day)
    rescue ArgumentError
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def validate_check_digit(value, check_digit, field_name)
    return if value.nil? || value.empty?
    
    calculated = calculate_check_digit(value)
    if calculated != check_digit
      @errors << "Invalid check digit for #{field_name}"
    end
  end
  
  def calculate_check_digit(value)
    weights = [7, 3, 1]
    sum = 0
    
    value.each_char.with_index do |char, index|
      char_value = character_value(char)
      weight = weights[index % 3]
      sum += char_value * weight
    end
    
    (sum % 10).to_s
  end
  
  def character_value(char)
    case char
    when '0'..'9'
      char.to_i
    when 'A'..'Z'
      char.ord - 55  # A=10, B=11, ..., Z=35
    when '<'
      0
    else
      0
    end
  end
  
  def error_result(message)
    @errors << message
    { valid: false, errors: @errors }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  parser = PassportMRZParser.new
  
  # Example MRZ (fictional data)
  sample_mrz = <<~MRZ
    P<USASMITH<<JOHN<ROBERT<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
    1234567890USA8001011M2501015<<<<<<<<<<<<<<06
  MRZ
  
  result = parser.parse(sample_mrz)
  
  if result[:valid]
    puts "✓ Valid passport MRZ"
    puts "  Surname: #{result[:surname]}"
    puts "  Given Names: #{result[:given_names]}"
    puts "  Passport Number: #{result[:passport_number]}"
    puts "  Nationality: #{result[:nationality]}"
    puts "  Date of Birth: #{result[:date_of_birth]}"
    puts "  Sex: #{result[:sex]}"
    puts "  Expiry Date: #{result[:expiry_date]}"
    puts "  Personal Number: #{result[:personal_number] || 'N/A'}"
  else
    puts "✗ Invalid MRZ:"
    result[:errors].each { |error| puts "  - #{error}" }
  end
end
```

This implementation:

1. **Parses TD3 format passports** (the most common type)
2. **Extracts all holder data** including names, passport number, nationality, dates, and sex
3. **Validates check digits** using the ICAO 7-3-1 weighting algorithm
4. **Handles date parsing** with century determination
5. **Properly splits surnames from given names** (separated by `<<` in MRZ)
6. **Returns structured results** with validation status
7. **Includes error reporting** for invalid MRZ data

The parser handles the standard 44-character lines, validates input format, and extracts all relevant passport holder information while performing the required check digit validations per ICAO 9303 specifications.

text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

# Класифікатор працює лише на стандартній бібліотеці Ruby (без зовнішніх NLP-залежностей).
# Єдиний гем потрібен для тестів:
group :test do
  gem "minitest", "~> 5.20"
end
```

## Реалізація

Це класифікатор на основі словника з правилами, за подібним принципом працює VADER. Він враховує:

- заперечення (`not good`, `never works`, `no complaints`);
- підсилювачі й послаблювачі (`very`, `extremely`, `slightly`);
- сталі вирази (`waste of money`, `stopped working`);
- слово `but`: що після нього, важить більше;
- ВЕЛИКІ ЛІТЕРИ та знаки оклику.

```ruby
# sentiment_classifier.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Класифікація тональності англійських відгуків: positive / negative / neutral.
class SentimentClassifier
  Result = Struct.new(:label, :score, :positive_sum, :negative_sum, keyword_init: true)

  POSITIVE_THRESHOLD =  0.15
  NEGATIVE_THRESHOLD = -0.15
  NORMALIZATION_ALPHA = 15.0
  NEGATION_FACTOR = -0.74

  # ---------- Словник (оцінка від -3 до +3) ----------
  LEXICON = {}.tap do |lex|
    {
      3.0  => %w[excellent amazing awesome fantastic outstanding perfect superb flawless
                 incredible wonderful brilliant love loved adore adored],
      2.0  => %w[great good happy pleased satisfied impressed recommend recommended sturdy
                 reliable durable comfortable beautiful lovely nice fast easy smooth best
                 favorite solid gem delighted enjoy enjoyed],
      1.2  => %w[useful worth helpful handy works neat cool quality stylish liked],
      0.7  => %w[fine decent acceptable],
      0.5  => %w[ok okay],
      -0.5 => %w[meh average],
      -1.2 => %w[expensive issue issues problem problems annoying difficult flaw flaws
                 mediocre lacking slow late cracked noisy complaint complaints overpriced
                 uncomfortable small loose],
      -1.5 => %w[return returned returning refund cheaply],
      -2.0 => %w[bad poor disappointing disappointed disappointment broken waste fail failed
                 failure hate hated flimsy faulty leaks leaked damaged defective unreliable
                 rubbish refund],
      -3.0 => %w[terrible awful horrible worst garbage junk useless trash scam disgusting
                 pathetic horrendous]
    }.each { |score, words| words.each { |w| lex[w] = score } }
  end.freeze

  # Сталі вирази (перевіряються раніше за окремі слова)
  PHRASES = {
    "waste of money"         => -3.0,
    "waste of time"          => -2.5,
    "highly recommend"       =>  3.0,
    "would not recommend"    => -2.5,
    "wouldn't recommend"     => -2.5,
    "do not recommend"       => -2.5,
    "don't recommend"        => -2.5,
    "money back"             => -1.5,
    "stopped working"        => -2.5,
    "does not work"          => -2.5,
    "doesn't work"           => -2.5,
    "did not work"           => -2.5,
    "didn't work"            => -2.5,
    "not working"            => -2.5,
    "fell apart"             => -2.5,
    "falls apart"            => -2.5,
    "good value"             =>  2.0,
    "value for money"        =>  2.0,
    "exceeded my expectations" => 3.0,
    "does the job"           =>  1.5,
    "as described"           =>  1.0,
    "five stars"             =>  3.0,
    "5 stars"                =>  3.0,
    "one star"               => -3.0,
    "1 star"                 => -3.0
  }.freeze
  MAX_PHRASE_LEN = PHRASES.keys.map { |p| p.split.size }.max

  NEGATIONS = %w[not no never none neither nor without cannot hardly barely].freeze
  BOOSTERS = {
    "very" => 1.3, "really" => 1.3, "extremely" => 1.4, "absolutely" => 1.4,
    "incredibly" => 1.4, "super" => 1.3, "so" => 1.2, "too" => 1.2, "quite" => 1.1,
    "pretty" => 1.1, "totally" => 1.3,
    "slightly" => 0.6, "somewhat" => 0.7, "bit" => 0.7, "kinda" => 0.7, "fairly" => 0.8
  }.freeze
  CONTRAST_WORDS = %w[but however].freeze
  BOUNDARIES = %w[. , ; : ! ?].freeze

  def classify(text)
    tokens = tokenize(text)
    lows   = tokens.map(&:downcase)
    items  = collect_items(tokens, lows)   # [[позиція, оцінка], ...]
    items  = apply_contrast(items, lows)

    sum = items.sum { |_, v| v }
    exclamations = [tokens.count("!"), 3].min
    sum += (sum.positive? ? 1 : -1) * 0.3 * exclamations unless sum.zero?

    compound = sum / Math.sqrt(sum * sum + NORMALIZATION_ALPHA)

    Result.new(
      label: label_for(compound),
      score: compound.round(3),
      positive_sum: items.map(&:last).select(&:positive?).sum.round(2),
      negative_sum: items.map(&:last).select(&:negative?).sum.round(2)
    )
  end

  def label(text)
    classify(text).label
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    text.to_s.tr("’‘", "''").scan(/[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)*|\d+|[.,;:!?]/)
  end

  def collect_items(tokens, lows)
    items = []
    i = 0
    while i < tokens.size
      len, valence = match_phrase(lows, i)
      if len
        items << [i, modify(valence, tokens, lows, i)]
        i += len
        next
      end

      valence = lookup(lows[i])
      items << [i, modify(valence, tokens, lows, i)] if valence
      i += 1
    end
    items
  end

  def match_phrase(lows, i)
    MAX_PHRASE_LEN.downto(2) do |len|
      next if i + len > lows.size

      key = lows[i, len].join(" ")
      return [len, PHRASES[key]] if PHRASES.key?(key)
    end
    nil
  end

  # Пошук слова з простим відкиданням закінчень (hated -> hate, flaws -> flaw)
  def lookup(word)
    return LEXICON[word] if LEXICON.key?(word)
    return nil if word.length <= 3

    [word.chomp("s"), word.chomp("ly"), word.chomp("ed"), word.chomp("d")].each do |c|
      return LEXICON[c] if LEXICON.key?(c)
    end
    nil
  end

  # Підсилювачі, заперечення та CAPS у вікні з 3 попередніх токенів
  def modify(valence, tokens, lows, i)
    v = valence
    v *= 1.15 if shouted?(tokens, i)

    negated = false
    (1..3).each do |back|
      j = i - back
      break if j.negative?

      w = lows[j]
      break if BOUNDARIES.include?(w) || CONTRAST_WORDS.include?(w)

      if BOOSTERS.key?(w)
        v *= BOOSTERS[w]
      elsif !negated && negation?(w)
        v *= NEGATION_FACTOR
        negated = true
      end
    end
    v
  end

  def negation?(word)
    NEGATIONS.include?(word) || word.end_with?("n't")
  end

  def shouted?(tokens, i)
    tokens[i].match?(/\A[A-Z]{2,}\z/) && tokens.any? { |t| t.match?(/[a-z]/) }
  end

  # "good, BUT expensive": до 'but' вага 0.5, після — 1.5
  def apply_contrast(items, lows)
    pivot = lows.index { |t| CONTRAST_WORDS.include?(t) }
    return items unless pivot

    items.map { |pos, v| [pos, pos < pivot ? v * 0.5 : v * 1.5] }
  end

  def label_for(compound)
    if compound >= POSITIVE_THRESHOLD then :positive
    elsif compound <= NEGATIVE_THRESHOLD then :negative
    else :neutral
    end
  end
end

# ---------- Запуск з командного рядка ----------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  classifier = SentimentClassifier.new

  inputs =
    if ARGV.any? then ARGV
    elsif !$stdin.tty? then $stdin.each_line.map(&:chomp).reject(&:empty?)
    else
      [
        "Absolutely love this vacuum! Very powerful and easy to use.",
        "Terrible quality. It stopped working after two days. Waste of money!",
        "The package arrived on Tuesday.",
        "Good battery life, but the screen is too small and expensive.",
        "Not bad at all, works as described.",
        "It's okay."
      ]
    end

  inputs.each do |review|
    r = classifier.classify(review)
    puts format("%-9s %+.3f  %s", r.label, r.score, review)
  end
end
```

## Обмеження

Словник невеликий, тож іронію, сарказм і доменну лексику він розпізнає слабко. Для вищої точності можна:

- розширити `LEXICON` і `PHRASES`;
- замінити клас на модель, навчену на розмічених відгуках, наприклад Naive Bayes із `classifier-reborn`;
- підключити зовнішню модель через API.

Інтерфейс `classify` / `label` при цьому лишиться тим самим.

## notifications.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
require "bundler/setup"
require "active_record"
require "mail"
require "logger"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database setup (in-memory SQLite for the demo)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
ActiveRecord::Schema.verbose = false

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :users do |t|
    t.string :name,  null: false
    t.string :email, null: false
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :notification_preferences do |t|
    t.references :user, null: false, foreign_key: true
    t.string  :category, null: false
    t.string  :channel,  null: false
    t.boolean :enabled,  null: false, default: true
    t.timestamps
  end
  add_index :notification_preferences, %i[user_id category channel],
            unique: true, name: "idx_notification_prefs_unique"

  create_table :notifications do |t|
    t.references :user, null: false, foreign_key: true
    t.string   :category, null: false
    t.string   :title,    null: false
    t.text     :body
    t.json     :data
    t.datetime :read_at
    t.timestamps
  end
  add_index :notifications, %i[user_id read_at]
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Catalog: which categories exist, their default channel settings, and
# which ones the user is NOT allowed to turn off (e.g. security alerts).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module NotificationCatalog
  CHANNELS = %w[in_app email].freeze

  CATEGORIES = {
    "security_alert" => { defaults: { "in_app" => true,  "email" => true  }, mandatory: true },
    "comment_reply"  => { defaults: { "in_app" => true,  "email" => true  }, mandatory: false },
    "mention"        => { defaults: { "in_app" => true,  "email" => true  }, mandatory: false },
    "weekly_digest"  => { defaults: { "in_app" => false, "email" => true  }, mandatory: false },
    "product_news"   => { defaults: { "in_app" => true,  "email" => false }, mandatory: false }
  }.freeze

  def self.category?(name) = CATEGORIES.key?(name.to_s)
  def self.channel?(name)  = CHANNELS.include?(name.to_s)
  def self.mandatory?(category) = CATEGORIES.fetch(category.to_s)[:mandatory]
  def self.default_for(category, channel) = CATEGORIES.fetch(category.to_s)[:defaults].fetch(channel.to_s)
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class NotificationPreference < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user

  validates :category, inclusion: { in: NotificationCatalog::CATEGORIES.keys }
  validates :channel,  inclusion: { in: NotificationCatalog::CHANNELS }
  validates :channel,  uniqueness: { scope: %i[user_id category] }
  validate  :mandatory_categories_cannot_be_disabled

  private

  def mandatory_categories_cannot_be_disabled
    return if enabled
    return unless NotificationCatalog.category?(category) && NotificationCatalog.mandatory?(category)

    errors.add(:enabled, "cannot be disabled for #{category} notifications")
  end
end

class Notification < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user

  validates :category, :title, presence: true

  scope :unread, -> { where(read_at: nil) }
  scope :recent, -> { order(created_at: :desc, id: :desc) }

  def read? = !read_at.nil?
  def mark_as_read! = (update!(read_at: Time.current) unless read?)
end

class User < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :notifications, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :notification_preferences, dependent: :destroy

  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :email, presence: true, format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP }

  # Effective setting: explicit user choice, falling back to catalog default.
  # Mandatory categories are always enabled regardless of stored rows.
  def notification_enabled?(category, channel)
    category = category.to_s
    channel  = channel.to_s
    return true if NotificationCatalog.mandatory?(category)

    pref = notification_preferences.find_by(category: category, channel: channel)
    pref ? pref.enabled : NotificationCatalog.default_for(category, channel)
  end

  def set_notification_preference!(category, channel, enabled)
    pref = notification_preferences.find_or_initialize_by(category: category.to_s, channel: channel.to_s)
    pref.enabled = enabled
    pref.save!
    pref
  end

  # Full preference matrix, useful for rendering a settings page.
  def notification_settings
    NotificationCatalog::CATEGORIES.keys.to_h do |category|
      [category, NotificationCatalog::CHANNELS.to_h { |ch| [ch, notification_enabled?(category, ch)] }]
    end
  end

  def unread_notification_count = notifications.unread.count
  def mark_all_notifications_read! = notifications.unread.update_all(read_at: Time.current, updated_at: Time.current)
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Email delivery (configure via Mail.defaults; SMTP from ENV if provided)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module EmailDelivery
  FROM_ADDRESS = ENV.fetch("NOTIFICATIONS_FROM", "no-reply@example.com")

  def self.configure!
    if ENV["SMTP_ADDRESS"]
      Mail.defaults do
        delivery_method :smtp,
                        address: ENV.fetch("SMTP_ADDRESS"),
                        port: ENV.fetch("SMTP_PORT", 587).to_i,
                        user_name: ENV["SMTP_USER"],
                        password: ENV["SMTP_PASSWORD"],
                        enable_starttls_auto: true
      end
    else
      Mail.defaults { delivery_method :test } # collects into Mail::TestMailer.deliveries
    end
  end

  def self.deliver!(to:, name:, subject:, body:)
    from = FROM_ADDRESS
    text = "Hi #{name},\n\n#{body}\n\n-- \nYou can change which notifications you receive in your settings."
    Mail.new do
      from    from
      to      to
      subject subject
      body    text
    end.deliver!
  end
end
EmailDelivery.configure!

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notifier: the single entry point for sending a notification.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Notifier
  Result = Struct.new(:notification, :email_sent, :skipped, keyword_init: true)

  def self.call(**args) = new(**args).call

  def initialize(user:, category:, title:, body: nil, data: {}, logger: Logger.new($stderr))
    raise ArgumentError, "Unknown category: #{category}" unless NotificationCatalog.category?(category)

    @user     = user
    @category = category.to_s
    @title    = title
    @body     = body
    @data     = data
    @logger   = logger
  end

  def call
    notification = nil
    email_sent   = false
    skipped      = []

    if @user.notification_enabled?(@category, "in_app")
      notification = Notification.create!(
        user: @user, category: @category, title: @title, body: @body, data: @data
      )
    else
      skipped << "in_app"
    end

    if @user.notification_enabled?(@category, "email")
      email_sent = send_email
    else
      skipped << "email"
    end

    Result.new(notification: notification, email_sent: email_sent, skipped: skipped)
  end

  private

  # An email failure must never break the caller or roll back the in-app
  # notification. In production, move this into a background job with retries.
  def send_email
    EmailDelivery.deliver!(to: @user.email, name: @user.name, subject: @title, body: @body.to_s)
    true
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Email notification failed for user=#{@user.id} category=#{@category}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
    false
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  alice = User.create!(name: "Alice", email: "alice@example.com")
  bob   = User.create!(name: "Bob",   email: "bob@example.com")

  # Bob turns off email for replies and in-app for mentions.
  bob.set_notification_preference!("comment_reply", "email", false)
  bob.set_notification_preference!("mention", "in_app", false)

  # Mandatory categories can't be disabled:
  begin
    bob.set_notification_preference!("security_alert", "email", false)
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    puts "Rejected: #{e.message}"
  end

  [alice, bob].each do |user|
    Notifier.call(user: user, category: "comment_reply",
                  title: "New reply to your comment", body: "Sam replied: \"Nice post!\"",
                  data: { comment_id: 42 })
    Notifier.call(user: user, category: "mention",
                  title: "You were mentioned", body: "Sam mentioned you in #general")
    Notifier.call(user: user, category: "security_alert",
                  title: "New login detected", body: "A login from a new device occurred.")
  end

  [alice, bob].each do |user|
    puts "\n#{user.name}: #{user.unread_notification_count} unread in-app"
    user.notifications.recent.each { |n| puts "  [#{n.category}] #{n.title}" }
    sent = Mail::TestMailer.deliveries.select { |m| m.to.include?(user.email) }
    puts "  emails: #{sent.map(&:subject).inspect}"
  end

  bob.notifications.unread.first.mark_as_read!
  puts "\nBob unread after reading one: #{bob.unread_notification_count}"
  puts "Bob settings: #{bob.notification_settings}"
end
```

Run it with `bundle install && bundle exec ruby notifications.rb`.

**How it works**
- **Preferences:** the `notification_preferences` table stores only explicit user choices, one row per user, category and channel. Anything not stored falls back to the defaults in `NotificationCatalog`. New categories therefore need no data migration.
- **Mandatory categories:** `security_alert` can't be disabled. A model validation rejects the attempt, and `notification_enabled?` ignores stored rows for it as a second guard.
- **Delivery:** `Notifier.call` checks each channel against the user's effective preferences. It creates an in-app `Notification` record and/or sends an email, and returns what was sent or skipped.
- **Email failures:** these are logged and don't break the caller or remove the in-app notification.
- **Email transport:** it uses the test delivery method unless `SMTP_ADDRESS` and the related env vars are set.
- **Production:** run `Notifier` from a background job so email delivery is retried.

Task: Extract named entities (people, organisations, places) from English news articles.

# Gemfile

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

# Ruby bindings for MIT's MITIE library (statistical NER).
# The gem compiles the bundled C++ library on install, so a C++ compiler is required.
gem "mitie"
```

Everything else (`json`, `optparse`) is in Ruby's standard library.

## One-time model download

MITIE needs its English model file, which is not part of the gem:

```sh
curl -L -O https://github.com/mit-nlp/MITIE/releases/download/v0.4/MITIE-models-v0.2.tar.bz2
tar -xjf MITIE-models-v0.2.tar.bz2
# model is at MITIE-models/english/ner_model.dat
```

# ner.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "mitie"
require "json"
require "optparse"

# Extracts people, organisations and places from English news text.
class EntityExtractor
  # MITIE English model tags -> our output categories.
  # (MITIE also emits MISC, which we deliberately ignore.)
  TAG_MAP = {
    "PERSON"       => :people,
    "ORGANIZATION" => :organisations,
    "LOCATION"     => :places
  }.freeze

  def initialize(model_path:, min_score: 0.0)
    unless File.file?(model_path)
      raise ArgumentError, <<~MSG
        NER model not found at #{model_path.inspect}.
        Download MITIE-models-v0.2.tar.bz2 from
        https://github.com/mit-nlp/MITIE/releases/tag/v0.4 and point to
        MITIE-models/english/ner_model.dat (--model or MITIE_MODEL env var).
      MSG
    end

    @model     = Mitie::NER.new(model_path)
    @min_score = min_score
  end

  # Returns { people: [...], organisations: [...], places: [...] }
  # Each item: { name:, mentions:, score: }
  def extract(text)
    buckets = TAG_MAP.values.to_h { |category| [category, []] }
    return summarise(buckets) if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?

    @model.doc(text).entities.each do |entity|
      category = TAG_MAP[entity[:tag]]
      next unless category
      next if entity[:score] < @min_score

      name = normalise(entity[:text])
      next if name.empty?

      buckets[category] << { name: name, score: entity[:score] }
    end

    summarise(buckets)
  end

  private

  # Clean up surface forms: collapse whitespace, strip possessives and
  # surrounding punctuation ("Obama's" -> "Obama").
  def normalise(raw)
    raw.to_s
       .gsub(/\s+/, " ")
       .strip
       .sub(/['’]s\z/i, "")
       .gsub(/\A[\p{P}\s]+|[\p{P}\s]+\z/, "")
  end

  # Merge mentions that differ only by case, count them, keep the
  # most common spelling and the best confidence score.
  def summarise(buckets)
    buckets.transform_values do |mentions|
      mentions
        .group_by { |m| m[:name].downcase }
        .map do |_key, group|
          spellings = group.map { |m| m[:name] }.tally
          {
            name:     spellings.max_by { |_, count| count }.first,
            mentions: group.size,
            score:    group.map { |m| m[:score] }.max.round(3)
          }
        end
        .sort_by { |e| [-e[:mentions], e[:name]] }
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- CLI

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  options = {
    model: ENV["MITIE_MODEL"] || "MITIE-models/english/ner_model.dat",
    min_score: 0.0,
    pretty: false
  }

  parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
    o.banner = "Usage: ner.rb [options] [article.txt ...]   (reads STDIN if no files given)"
    o.on("-m", "--model PATH", "Path to MITIE ner_model.dat") { |v| options[:model] = v }
    o.on("-s", "--min-score FLOAT", Float, "Discard entities below this confidence (default 0.0)") { |v| options[:min_score] = v }
    o.on("-p", "--pretty", "Pretty-print JSON") { options[:pretty] = true }
    o.on("-h", "--help") { puts o; exit }
  end
  parser.parse!

  begin
    extractor = EntityExtractor.new(model_path: options[:model], min_score: options[:min_score])
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    warn e.message
    exit 1
  end

  results =
    if ARGV.empty?
      extractor.extract($stdin.read)
    else
      ARGV.to_h do |path|
        text = File.read(path, encoding: "UTF-8")
        [path, extractor.extract(text)]
      rescue SystemCallError => e
        warn "Skipping #{path}: #{e.message}"
        [path, { error: e.message }]
      end
    end

  puts(options[:pretty] ? JSON.pretty_generate(results) : JSON.generate(results))
end
```

## Usage

```sh
bundle install

echo "Prime Minister Keir Starmer met Emmanuel Macron in Paris on Monday. \
Reuters reported that Airbus and the European Union will discuss the deal in Brussels." \
  | bundle exec ruby ner.rb --pretty

# several articles at once
bundle exec ruby ner.rb --min-score 0.5 article1.txt article2.txt
```

Example output shape:

```json
{
  "people": [
    { "name": "Keir Starmer", "mentions": 1, "score": 1.12 },
    { "name": "Emmanuel Macron", "mentions": 1, "score": 0.98 }
  ],
  "organisations": [
    { "name": "Reuters", "mentions": 1, "score": 0.87 }
  ],
  "places": [
    { "name": "Paris", "mentions": 1, "score": 1.05 }
  ]
}
```

## Notes

- **Scores:** MITIE's confidence scores are not probabilities, so use `--min-score` to tune precision (around 0.5 to 1.0 is a reasonable range).
- **Aggregation:** "Obama", "obama" and "Obama's" collapse into one entry with a mention count. Resolving "Barack Obama" and "Obama" to the same person would need an additional coreference step.
- **Model:** The ignored `MISC` tag (nationalities, events and so on) can be added to `TAG_MAP` if you need it.

## Реалізація

### 1. Конфігураційний файл (.env)

```env
UBER_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id_here
UBER_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret_here
UBER_CUSTOMER_ID=your_customer_id_here
UBER_API_URL=https://api.uber.com
```

### 2. Основний клас для роботи з Uber Direct API

```ruby
# uber_direct_client.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'jwt'
require 'dotenv/load'

class UberDirectClient
  attr_reader :logger

  def initialize
    @client_id = ENV['UBER_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['UBER_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @customer_id = ENV['UBER_CUSTOMER_ID']
    @api_url = ENV['UBER_API_URL'] || 'https://api.uber.com'
    @access_token = nil
    @token_expires_at = nil
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def create_delivery(order_details)
    logger.info("Creating delivery for order: #{order_details[:order_id]}")
    
    token = get_access_token
    return nil unless token

    delivery_data = build_delivery_payload(order_details)
    
    response = make_request(
      method: :post,
      path: '/v1/customers/' + @customer_id + '/deliveries',
      body: delivery_data,
      token: token
    )

    if response && response.status == 200
      delivery = JSON.parse(response.body)
      logger.info("Delivery created successfully: #{delivery['id']}")
      delivery
    else
      logger.error("Failed to create delivery: #{response&.body}")
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    logger.info("Getting delivery status for: #{delivery_id}")
    
    token = get_access_token
    return nil unless token

    response = make_request(
      method: :get,
      path: "/v1/customers/#{@customer_id}/deliveries/#{delivery_id}",
      token: token
    )

    if response && response.status == 200
      delivery = JSON.parse(response.body)
      logger.info("Delivery status: #{delivery['status']}")
      delivery
    else
      logger.error("Failed to get delivery status: #{response&.body}")
      nil
    end
  end

  def cancel_delivery(delivery_id, reason = 'Order cancelled')
    logger.info("Cancelling delivery: #{delivery_id}")
    
    token = get_access_token
    return nil unless token

    response = make_request(
      method: :post,
      path: "/v1/customers/#{@customer_id}/deliveries/#{delivery_id}/cancel",
      body: { reason: reason },
      token: token
    )

    if response && response.status == 200
      logger.info("Delivery cancelled successfully")
      true
    else
      logger.error("Failed to cancel delivery: #{response&.body}")
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def get_access_token
    # Return cached token if still valid
    return @access_token if @access_token && @token_expires_at && Time.now < @token_expires_at

    logger.info("Getting new access token")
    
    response = make_request(
      method: :post,
      path: '/oauth/v2/token',
      body: {
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        scope: 'eats.delivery'
      },
      use_auth: false
    )

    if response && response.status == 200
      token_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @access_token = token_data['access_token']
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + token_data['expires_in'].to_i - 60 # Buffer of 60 seconds
      logger.info("Access token obtained successfully")
      @access_token
    else
      logger.error("Failed to obtain access token: #{response&.body}")
      nil
    end
  end

  def build_delivery_payload(order_details)
    {
      pickup: {
        location: {
          address: order_details[:pickup_address],
          address_2: order_details[:pickup_address_2],

  def make_request(method:, path:, body: nil, token: nil, use_auth: true)
    conn = Faraday.new(url: @api_url) do |f|
      f.request :json
      f.response :logger, @logger
      f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end

    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token}" if token && use_auth

    begin
      response = conn.run_request(method, path, body&.to_json, headers)
      response
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      logger.error("API request failed: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end

### 3. Сервіс для обробки замовлень

```ruby
# delivery_service.rb
require_relative 'uber_direct_client'

class DeliveryService
  def initialize
    @uber_client = UberDirectClient.new
  end

  def order_ready_for_delivery(order)
    logger.info("Order #{order[:id]} is ready for delivery")
    
    delivery_details = prepare_delivery_details(order)
    delivery = @uber_client.create_delivery(delivery_details)
    
    if delivery
      order[:delivery_id] = delivery['id']
      order[:delivery_status] = delivery['status']
      logger.info("Delivery created for order #{order[:id]}: #{delivery['id']}")
      true
    else
      logger.error("Failed to create delivery for order #{order[:id]}")
      false
    end
  end

  def track_delivery(order)
    return nil unless order[:delivery_id]
    
    delivery = @uber_client.get_delivery_status(order[:delivery_id])
    
    if delivery
      order[:delivery_status] = delivery['status']
      order[:tracking_url] = delivery['tracking_url'] if delivery['tracking_url']
      delivery
    end
  end

  def cancel_delivery(order, reason = 'Order cancelled')
    return false unless order[:delivery_id]
    
    if @uber_client.cancel_delivery(order[:delivery_id], reason)
      order[:delivery_status] = 'cancelled'
      true
    else
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def prepare_delivery_details(order)
    {
      order_id: order[:id],
      description: order[:description],
      pickup_address: order[:restaurant][:address],
      pickup_city: order[:restaurant][:city],
      pickup_state: order[:restaurant][:state],
      pickup_postal_code: order[:restaurant][:postal_code],
      pickup_contact_name: order[:restaurant][:name],
      pickup_contact_phone: order[:restaurant][:phone],
      pickup_notes: "Pickup from restaurant",
      dropoff_address: order[:customer][:address],
      dropoff_city: order[:customer][:city],
      dropoff_state: order[:customer][:state],
      dropoff_postal_code: order[:customer][:postal_code],
      dropoff_contact_name: order[:customer][:name],
      dropoff_contact_phone: order[:customer][:phone],
      dropoff_notes: order[:delivery_notes],
      items: order[:items].map do |item|
        {
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          size: item[:size] || 'medium',
          weight: item[:weight]
        }
      end
    }
  end

  def logger
    @logger ||= Logger.new($stdout)
  end
end
```
