text:
Ось повний код на Ruby для відправки SMS через API Vonage та відстеження звітів про доставку.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'vonage', '~> 7.0'
gem 'sinatra', '~> 3.0'
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8'
gem 'puma', '~> 6.0'
```

## Основна реалізація

### 1. Файл конфігурації (.env)

```env
VONAGE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
VONAGE_API_SECRET=your_api_secret_here
VONAGE_SENDER_ID=YourSenderName
```

### 2. Клас для роботи з SMS (sms_service.rb)

```ruby
require 'vonage'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class SMSService
  attr_reader :client, :delivery_reports

  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET']
    )
    @delivery_reports = []
  end

  def send_sms(to_number, message, options = {})
    response = client.sms.send(
      from: options[:from] || ENV['VONAGE_SENDER_ID'],
      to: to_number,
      text: message,
      type: 'text',
      status_report_req: '1',  # Запитуємо звіт про доставку
      callback: options[:callback_url]  # URL для отримання звітів
    )

    if response.messages.first.status == '0'
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response.messages.first.message_id,
        message: 'SMS успішно відправлено'
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.messages.first.error_text,
        message: 'Помилка відправки SMS'
      }
    end
  rescue Vonage::Error => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message,
      message: 'Помилка з\'єднання з API Vonage'
    }
  end

  def check_delivery_status(message_id)
    # Цей метод можна використовувати для перевірки статусу
    # через API (якщо не використовуєте callback)
    response = client.delivery_status.get(message_id)
    
    {
      message_id: message_id,
      status: response.status,
      error_code: response.error_code,
      timestamp: response.timestamp
    }
  rescue Vonage::Error => e
    {
      error: e.message,
      message_id: message_id
    }
  end
end
```

### 3. Веб-сервер для отримання звітів (webhook_server.rb)

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require_relative 'sms_service'

set :port, 4567
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
set :delivery_reports, []

# Ендпоінт для отримання звітів про доставку від Vonage
post '/delivery-receipt' do
  request.body.rewind
  payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  
  delivery_report = {
    message_id: payload['messageId'],
    status: payload['status'],
    error_code: payload['err-code'],
    timestamp: payload['message-timestamp'],
    to: payload['to'],
    network_code: payload['network-code'],
    price: payload['price'],
    currency: payload['currency']
  }
  
  settings.delivery_reports << delivery_report

  # Тут можна додати логіку для збереження в базу даних

# Ендпоінт для відправки SMS
post '/send-sms' do
```

Task: Fetch Etsy shop listings and orders through the Etsy Open API v3.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

`json`, `time`, and `optparse` ship with Ruby's standard library, so `faraday` is the only gem needed.

## etsy_client.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"
require "time"

module Etsy
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  class Client
    HOST      = "https://openapi.etsy.com"
    BASE_PATH = "/v3/application"
    TOKEN_URL = "https://api.etsy.com/v3/public/oauth/token"
    MAX_PAGE  = 100 # Etsy's maximum "limit" per request
    MAX_RETRIES = 5

    attr_reader :access_token, :refresh_token

    # api_key       - your app's keystring (sent as x-api-key)
    # access_token  - OAuth2 token (needs listings_r and transactions_r scopes)
    # refresh_token - optional; used to renew the access token on 401
    # on_token_refresh - optional block called with (access_token, refresh_token)
    #                    so you can persist the new values (Etsy rotates them)
    def initialize(api_key:, access_token: nil, refresh_token: nil, &on_token_refresh)
      @api_key = api_key
      @access_token = access_token
      @refresh_token = refresh_token
      @on_token_refresh = on_token_refresh
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: HOST) do |f|
        f.options.timeout = 30
        f.options.open_timeout = 10
      end
    end

    # ---------- High-level API ----------

    # Look up a shop id by shop name (public endpoint, API key only).
    def shop_id_for_name(shop_name)
      data = get("/shops", shop_name: shop_name)
      shop = Array(data["results"]).find { |s| s["shop_name"].to_s.casecmp?(shop_name) } ||
             Array(data["results"]).first
      raise Error, "Shop '#{shop_name}' not found" unless shop

      shop["shop_id"]
    end

    # Shop id of the authenticated user (requires OAuth token).
    def my_shop_id
      data = get("/users/me", {}, auth: true)
      data["shop_id"] || raise(Error.new("Authenticated user has no shop", body: data))
    end

    # Lazily yields every listing in a shop.
    # state: "active", "inactive", "draft", "expired"
    def listings(shop_id, state: "active", includes: nil, sort_on: "created", sort_order: "desc")
      params = { state: state, sort_on: sort_on, sort_order: sort_order }
      params[:includes] = Array(includes).join(",") if includes
      paginate("/shops/#{shop_id}/listings", params, auth: state != "active")
    end

    # Lazily yields every order (Etsy calls them "receipts").
    # Options: min_created / max_created (Time or epoch), was_paid, was_shipped
    def orders(shop_id, min_created: nil, max_created: nil, was_paid: nil,
               was_shipped: nil, sort_on: "created", sort_order: "desc")
      params = { sort_on: sort_on, sort_order: sort_order }
      params[:min_created] = to_epoch(min_created) if min_created
      params[:max_created] = to_epoch(max_created) if max_created
      params[:was_paid]    = was_paid unless was_paid.nil?
      params[:was_shipped] = was_shipped unless was_shipped.nil?
      paginate("/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts", params, auth: true)
    end

    # ---------- Pagination ----------

    def paginate(path, params = {}, auth: false)
      Enumerator.new do |yielder|
        offset = 0
        loop do
          page = get(path, params.merge(limit: MAX_PAGE, offset: offset), auth: auth)
          results = Array(page["results"])
          results.each { |r| yielder << r }

          offset += results.size
          break if results.empty? || offset >= page["count"].to_i
        end
      end
    end

    # ---------- HTTP ----------

    def get(path, params = {}, auth: false)
      request(:get, "#{BASE_PATH}#{path}", params, auth: auth)
    end

    private

    def request(method, path, params, auth:, refreshed: false)
      attempts = 0

      begin
        attempts += 1
        response = @conn.run_request(method, path, nil, headers(auth)) do |req|
          req.params.update(params)
        end
      rescue Faraday::ConnectionFailed, Faraday::TimeoutError => e
        raise Error, "Network error: #{e.message}" if attempts >= MAX_RETRIES

        sleep backoff(attempts)
        retry
      end

      case response.status
      when 200..299
        parse(response.body)
      when 401
        if !refreshed && @refresh_token
          refresh_access_token!
          return request(method, path, params, auth: auth, refreshed: true)
        end
        raise Error.new("Unauthorized (401): #{error_text(response)}",
                        status: 401, body: response.body)
      when 429, 500..599
        if attempts < MAX_RETRIES
          wait = response.headers["retry-after"]&.to_f
          sleep(wait && wait.positive? ? wait : backoff(attempts))
          attempts += 1
          return request_retry(method, path, params, auth, refreshed, attempts)
        end
        raise Error.new("Etsy API error #{response.status}: #{error_text(response)}",
                        status: response.status, body: response.body)
      else
        raise Error.new("Etsy API error #{response.status}: #{error_text(response)}",
                        status: response.status, body: response.body)
      end
    end

    # Simple retry helper that keeps the attempt counter bounded.
    def request_retry(method, path, params, auth, refreshed, attempts)
      response = nil
      while attempts <= MAX_RETRIES
        response = @conn.run_request(method, path, nil, headers(auth)) do |req|
          req.params.update(params)
        end
        return parse(response.body) if response.success?
        break unless [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].include?(response.status)

        wait = response.headers["retry-after"]&.to_f
        sleep(wait && wait.positive? ? wait : backoff(attempts))
        attempts += 1
      end
      raise Error.new("Etsy API error #{response.status}: #{error_text(response)}",
                      status: response.status, body: response.body)
    end

    def headers(auth)
      h = { "x-api-key" => @api_key, "Accept" => "application/json" }
      h["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{@access_token}" if @access_token && (auth || true)
      h
    end

    def refresh_access_token!
      response = Faraday.post(TOKEN_URL, {
        grant_type: "refresh_token",
        client_id: @api_key,
        refresh_token: @refresh_token
      })
      unless response.success?
        raise Error.new("Token refresh failed (#{response.status}): #{response.body}",
                        status: response.status, body: response.body)
      end

      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @access_token  = data.fetch("access_token")
      @refresh_token = data.fetch("refresh_token", @refresh_token)
      @on_token_refresh&.call(@access_token, @refresh_token)
    end

    def parse(body)
      body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error.new("Invalid JSON in response: #{e.message}", body: body)
    end

    def error_text(response)
      JSON.parse(response.body)["error"] || response.body
    rescue StandardError
      response.body.to_s
    end

    def backoff(attempt)
      [2**attempt, 30].min + rand
    end

    def to_epoch(value)
      value.respond_to?(:to_i) ? value.to_i : Time.parse(value.to_s).to_i
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage:
#   ETSY_API_KEY=xxxx ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN=12345.abc ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN=12345.def \
#   ETSY_SHOP_NAME=MyShop ruby etsy_client.rb
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  client = Etsy::Client.new(
    api_key: ENV.fetch("ETSY_API_KEY"),
    access_token: ENV["ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN"],
    refresh_token: ENV["ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN"]
  ) do |access, refresh|
    # Etsy rotates refresh tokens: persist these somewhere durable.
    warn "Tokens refreshed. New refresh token: #{refresh}"
  end

  shop_id =
    ENV["ETSY_SHOP_ID"] ||
    (ENV["ETSY_SHOP_NAME"] && client.shop_id_for_name(ENV["ETSY_SHOP_NAME"])) ||
    client.my_shop_id

  puts "Shop ID: #{shop_id}\n\n"

  puts "== Active listings =="
  client.listings(shop_id, state: "active", includes: ["Images"]).each do |l|
    price = l["price"] || {}
    amount = price["amount"].to_f / (price["divisor"] || 100)
    puts format("%-12s %-50.50s %8.2f %-3s qty=%s",
                l["listing_id"], l["title"], amount, price["currency_code"], l["quantity"])
  end

  puts "\n== Orders from the last 30 days =="
  client.orders(shop_id, min_created: Time.now - 30 * 86_400).each do |o|
    total = o["grandtotal"] || {}
    amount = total["amount"].to_f / (total["divisor"] || 100)
    puts format("#%-12s %s  %-25.25s %8.2f %-3s status=%s items=%d",
                o["receipt_id"],
                Time.at(o["created_timestamp"]).utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                o["name"], amount, total["currency_code"],
                o["status"], Array(o["transactions"]).size)
  end
rescue Etsy::Error => e
  warn "Etsy error: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end
```

## Setup notes

1. Register an app at https://www.etsy.com/developers/your-apps to get the **keystring**, which is `ETSY_API_KEY`.
2. Complete the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE once. Request the scopes `listings_r` and `transactions_r`, plus `shops_r` if you want `/users/me` to work. That gives you the access and refresh tokens.
3. Run `bundle install`, set the environment variables shown above, and run `ruby etsy_client.rb`.

## Behavior

- **Listings** use `GET /shops/{shop_id}/listings`, and **orders** use `GET /shops/{shop_id}/receipts`, since Etsy calls orders "receipts".
- **Pagination:** `listings` and `orders` return lazy enumerators that page through results 100 at a time using `limit` and `offset`. You can call `.first(10)` or `.each` without fetching everything.
- **Retries:** 429 and 5xx responses are retried with `Retry-After` or exponential backoff. A 401 triggers one token refresh, if a refresh token is available, and then a retry.
- **Token rotation:** Etsy issues a new refresh token on each refresh, so pass a block to `Client.new` to persist it.
- **Money fields** are `{amount, divisor, currency_code}` objects, so divide `amount` by `divisor` to get the price.

## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source "https://rubygems.org" # Porter stemmer (C extension), adds String#stem gem "fast-stemmer", "~> 1.0" ``` Everything else (`set`, `cgi`) is in the Ruby standard library. Run `bundle install` before running the code below. ## Implementation ```ruby # product_indexer.rb require "bundler/setup" require "set" require "cgi" require "fast_stemmer" # provides String#stem # Turns raw product description text into a list of normalized index terms: # 1. strips HTML and decodes entities # 2. lowercases and tokenizes # 3. removes stop words # 4. stems what remains class TextAnalyzer # Negations ("no", "not", "without", "nor") are deliberately NOT included, # because "not waterproof" and "waterproof" mean opposite things in a # product catalog. DEFAULT_STOP_WORDS = %w[ a about above after again all am an and any are as at be because been before being below between both but by can could did do does doing down during each few for from further had has have having he her here hers herself him himself his how i if in into is it its itself just me more most my myself of off on once only or other our ours ourselves out over own same she should so some such than that the their theirs them themselves then there these they this those through to too under until up very was we were what when where which while who whom why will with would you your yours yourself yourselves aren't can't couldn't didn't doesn't don't hadn't hasn't haven't isn't shouldn't wasn't weren't won't wouldn't i'm i've i'll i'd you're you've you'll you'd he's she's it's we're we've we'll we'd they're they've they'll they'd that's there's what's here's let's ].to_set.freeze # Words made of letters/digits, optionally with internal apostrophes # (don't, owner's). Digits are kept so "usb3", "4k", "18650" stay searchable. TOKEN_PATTERN = /[[:alnum:]]+(?:'[[:alnum:]]+)*/ def initialize(stop_words: DEFAULT_STOP_WORDS, min_length: 2) @stop_words = stop_words.to_set @min_length = min_length @stem_cache = {} end # Returns an Array of terms (duplicates preserved, so term frequency works). def analyze(text) tokenize(text).each_with_object([]) do |token, terms| next if @stop_words.include?(token) # catches "don't", "it's", ... token = token.delete_suffix("'s").delete("'") # "owner's" -> "owner" next if token.length < @min_length next if @stop_words.include?(token) terms << stem(token) end end private def tokenize(text) clean = CGI.unescapeHTML(text.to_s.gsub(/<[^>]*>/, " ")) clean = clean.tr("\u2019\u2018", "''") # curly apostrophes -> straight clean.downcase.scan(TOKEN_PATTERN) end # Stem purely alphabetic tokens only; model numbers like "4k" or "usb3" # are left untouched. Results are memoized, since product text repeats words. def stem(token) return token unless token.match?(/\A[a-z]+\z/) @stem_cache[token] ||= token.stem end end # Minimal in-memory inverted index. The SAME analyzer is used for documents # and for queries, which is what makes stemming useful: "running shoes" # matches "run shoe". class ProductIndex def initialize(analyzer = TextAnalyzer.new) @analyzer = analyzer @postings = Hash.new { |h, term| h[term] = Hash.new(0) } # term => {id => tf} @doc_count = 0 end def add(product_id, description) terms = @analyzer.analyze(description) terms.each { |term| @postings[term][product_id] += 1 } @doc_count += 1 terms end # AND search: returns ids of products containing every query term, # ranked by summed term frequency. def search(query) terms = @analyzer.analyze(query).uniq return [] if terms.empty? lists = terms.map { |t| @postings.fetch(t, {}) } ids = lists.map(&:keys).reduce(:&) ids.sort_by { |id| -lists.sum { |l| l[id] } } end def terms_for(term_text) @analyzer.analyze(term_text) end end if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__ index = ProductIndex.new products = { 1 => "

These lightweight running shoes don't slip & are perfect for the trail.

", 2 => "Waterproof hiking boots with reinforced soles. The owner's favorite for climbing.", 3 => "A shoe cleaning kit: brushes, cleaner, and a microfiber cloth.", 4 => "4K action camera with USB3 charging, shooting stabilized videos." } products.each do |id, desc| terms = index.add(id, desc) puts "#{id}: #{terms.join(' ')}" end puts ["running shoe", "climbing boots", "the cleaning of shoes", "4k video", "usb3"].each do |q| puts "#{q.inspect} -> #{index.search(q).inspect}" end end ``` ## Notes - **Order matters**: stop words are removed before stemming, since stemming can turn a non-stop word into something that looks like one, or mangle a stop word beyond recognition. - **Same pipeline for queries**: `ProductIndex#search` runs the query through the same analyzer, so `"running shoe"` and `"runs shoes"` reduce to the same terms. - **Customization**: pass `stop_words:` to `TextAnalyzer.new` to use a domain-specific list. For example, add `"new"` or `"great"` if they are marketing filler in your catalog. - **Scope**: this is English-only (Porter stemmer plus an English stop list). For other languages you would need a different stemmer and stop list.

## Config

```ruby
# config/initializers/xero.rb
module Xero
  SCOPES = "offline_access accounting.transactions accounting.contacts".freeze

  class RateLimited < StandardError
    attr_reader :retry_after
    def initialize(retry_after)
      @retry_after = retry_after
      super("Xero rate limit hit; retry in #{retry_after}s")
```

## Xero API client (token refresh and rate-limit handling)

```ruby
# app/services/xero/client.rb
module Xero
  class Client
    REFRESH_MARGIN = 60 # seconds

    def initialize(connection = XeroConnection.current)
      @connection = connection
    end

    def tenant_id = @connection.tenant_id

    def accounting_api
      api_client.accounting_api
    end

    # Wrap every API call so 429s become a retryable error.
    def call
      yield accounting_api, tenant_id
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      if e.code == 429
        retry_after = (e.response_headers || {}).transform_keys(&:to_s).transform_keys(&:downcase)["retry-after"].to_i
        raise Xero::RateLimited.new([retry_after, 1].max)
      end
      raise
    end

    private

    def api_client
      @api_client ||= XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(credentials: Xero.credentials).tap do |c|
        c.set_token_set(fresh_token_set)
      end
    end

    # Xero refresh tokens are single-use, so serialize refreshes with a row lock.
    def fresh_token_set
      @connection.with_lock do
        token_set = @connection.token_set
        if token_expiring?(token_set)
          refresher = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(credentials: Xero.credentials)
          token_set = refresher.refresh_token_set(token_set)
          @connection.update!(token_set: token_set)
        end
        token_set
      end
    end

    def token_expiring?(token_set)
      expires_at = token_set["expires_at"] || token_set[:expires_at]
      expires_at.nil? || expires_at.to_i - REFRESH_MARGIN <= Time.now.to_i
    end
  end
end
```

## Pushing invoices

```ruby
# app/services/xero/invoice_pusher.rb
module Xero
  class InvoicePusher
    def initialize(invoice, client: Xero::Client.new)
      @invoice = invoice
      @client  = client
    end

    def call
      @invoice.with_lock do
        response = @invoice.xero_invoice_id.present? ? update_in_xero : create_in_xero
        xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
        raise "Xero returned no invoice" unless xero_invoice
        if xero_invoice.has_validation_errors
          messages = Array(xero_invoice.validation_errors).map(&:message).join("; ")
          raise "Xero validation failed for invoice #{@invoice.id}: #{messages}"
        end

        persist(xero_invoice)
      end
    end

    private

    def create_in_xero
      @client.call do |api, tenant|
        api.create_invoices(
          tenant, payload,
          idempotency_key: "invoice-#{@invoice.id}-v1"   # safe against duplicate creates on retry
        )
      end
    end

    def update_in_xero
      @client.call do |api, tenant|
        api.update_invoice(tenant, @invoice.xero_invoice_id, payload)
      end
    end

    def payload
      XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoices.new(invoices: [build_invoice])
    end

    def build_invoice
      XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice.new(
        type:              XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice::ACCREC,
        contact:           build_contact,
        invoice_number:    @invoice.number,
        reference:         "App ##{@invoice.id}",
        date:              @invoice.issued_on.iso8601,
        due_date:          @invoice.due_on&.iso8601,
        line_amount_types: XeroRuby::Accounting::LineAmountTypes::EXCLUSIVE,
        status:            XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice::AUTHORISED,
        line_items:        build_line_items
      )
    end

    def build_contact
      customer = @invoice.customer
      if customer.xero_contact_id.present?
        XeroRuby::Accounting::Contact.new(contact_id: customer.xero_contact_id)
      else
        XeroRuby::Accounting::Contact.new(name: customer.name, email_address: customer.email)
      end
    end

    def build_line_items
      @invoice.line_items.map do |li|
        XeroRuby::Accounting::LineItem.new(
          description: li.description,
          quantity:    li.quantity.to_f,
          unit_amount: li.unit_price_cents / 100.0,
          account_code: ENV.fetch("XERO_SALES_ACCOUNT_CODE", "200")
        )
      end
    end

    def persist(xero_invoice)
      @invoice.update!(
        xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
        xero_status:     xero_invoice.status,
        xero_synced_at:  Time.current
      )
      contact_id = xero_invoice.contact&.contact_id
      if contact_id && @invoice.customer.xero_contact_id.blank?
        @invoice.customer.update!(xero_contact_id: contact_id)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Syncing payment status

```ruby
# app/services/xero/payment_sync.rb
module Xero
  class PaymentSync
    BATCH_SIZE = 40 # Xero caps `IDs` filter length; keep URLs short

    def initialize(client: Xero::Client.new)
      @client = client
    end

    def sync(xero_invoice_ids)
      xero_invoice_ids.uniq.each_slice(BATCH_SIZE) do |ids|
        response = @client.call { |api, tenant| api.get_invoices(tenant, ids: ids) }
        response.invoices.each { |xi| apply(xi) }
      end
    end

    private

    def apply(xero_invoice)
      invoice = Invoice.find_by(xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id)
      return unless invoice

      amount_paid_cents = (BigDecimal(xero_invoice.amount_paid.to_s) * 100).round.to_i

      invoice.update!(
        xero_status:       xero_invoice.status,
        status:            local_status(xero_invoice, amount_paid_cents, invoice.status),
        amount_paid_cents: amount_paid_cents,
        paid_at:           xero_invoice.status == "PAID" ? paid_date(xero_invoice) : nil,
        xero_synced_at:    Time.current
      )
    end

    def local_status(xero_invoice, amount_paid_cents, current)
      case xero_invoice.status
      when "PAID"                then "paid"
      when "VOIDED", "DELETED"   then "void"
      when "AUTHORISED", "SUBMITTED"
        amount_paid_cents.positive? ? "partially_paid" : "issued"
      else current # DRAFT in Xero: leave local status alone
      end
    end

    def paid_date(xero_invoice)
      value = xero_invoice.fully_paid_on_date
      value.respond_to?(:to_date) ? value.to_date : Date.current
    end
  end
end
```

## Webhook endpoint

```ruby
# app/controllers/xero/webhooks_controller.rb
module Xero
  class WebhooksController < ActionController::API
    # Xero requires: 200 for a valid signature (even with empty events,
    # which is the "intent to receive" check) and 401 otherwise.
    def create
      payload = request.raw_post
      return head :unauthorized unless valid_signature?(payload)

      tenant_id = XeroConnection.current.tenant_id
      events = JSON.parse(payload).fetch("events", [])

      invoice_ids = events
        .select { |e| e["eventCategory"] == "INVOICE" && e["tenantId"] == tenant_id }
        .map    { |e| e["resourceId"] }
        .uniq

      Xero::SyncInvoicesJob.perform_later(invoice_ids) if invoice_ids.any?
      head :ok
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      head :bad_request
    end

    private

    def valid_signature?(payload)
      provided = request.headers["x-xero-signature"].to_s
      expected = Base64.strict_encode64(
        OpenSSL::HMAC.digest("SHA256", ENV.fetch("XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY"), payload)
      )
      ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(provided, expected)
    end
  end
end
```

## OAuth connect flow

```ruby
# app/controllers/xero/oauth_controller.rb
module Xero
  class OauthController < ApplicationController
    before_action :require_admin! # implement with your own auth

    def connect
      session[:xero_state] = SecureRandom.hex(24)
      client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(credentials: Xero.credentials(state: session[:xero_state]))
      redirect_to client.authorization_url, allow_other_host: true
    end

    def callback
      expected = session.delete(:xero_state)
      unless expected.present? && ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(params[:state].to_s, expected)
        return render plain: "Invalid OAuth state", status: :bad_request
      end

      client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(credentials: Xero.credentials(state: expected))
      token_set = client.get_token_set_from_callback(
        params.permit(:code, :scope, :state, :session_state).to_h
      )
      client.set_token_set(token_set)

      tenant = client.connections.first or
        return render plain: "No Xero organisation authorised", status: :unprocessable_entity
      tenant = tenant.with_indifferent_access

      connection = XeroConnection.find_or_initialize_by(tenant_id: tenant[:tenantId])
      connection.update!(token_set: token_set, tenant_name: tenant[:tenantName])

      redirect_to root_path, notice: "Connected to Xero: #{connection.tenant_name}"
    end

    private

    def require_admin!
      head :forbidden unless current_user&.admin?
    end
  end
end
```

## How it works

- **Push:** when an invoice moves to `issued`, `after_commit` enqueues `PushInvoiceJob`. It creates the invoice as `AUTHORISED` in Xero and stores `xero_invoice_id`. An idempotency key and a row lock prevent duplicates if a job retries. The Xero contact ID is cached on the customer.
- **Sync (primary):** Xero sends a webhook when an invoice changes, including when a payment is applied. The controller verifies the HMAC signature, extracts invoice IDs, and enqueues `SyncInvoicesJob`. That job re-fetches the invoices from Xero rather than trusting the webhook payload, then updates `status`, `amount_paid_cents` and `paid_at`.
- **Sync (fallback):** `PollPaymentsJob` runs every 15 minutes and reconciles open invoices in batches, in case webhooks are dropped.
- **Tokens:** the token set is encrypted at rest. Refreshes happen under a DB lock because Xero refresh tokens are single-use. HTTP 429 responses become `Xero::RateLimited` and the job is retried later.

Setup: create a Xero app, set `XERO_CLIENT_ID`, `XERO_CLIENT_SECRET`, `XERO_REDIRECT_URI`, `XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY` and optionally `XERO_SALES_ACCOUNT_CODE`. Point the Xero webhook at `https://your.app/xero/webhooks`, then visit `/xero/connect` once.

```ruby
require 'plaid'
require 'date'

class PlaidClient
  attr_reader :client

  def initialize
    configuration = Plaid::Configuration.new
    configuration.server_index = Plaid::Configuration::Environment[ENV['PLAID_ENV'] || 'sandbox']
    configuration.api_key['PLAID-CLIENT-ID'] = ENV['PLAID_CLIENT_ID']
    configuration.api_key['PLAID-SECRET'] = ENV['PLAID_SECRET']
    configuration.api_key['PLAID-VERSION'] = ENV['PLAID_VERSION'] || '2020-09-14'

    api_client = Plaid::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @client = Plaid::PlaidApi.new(api_client)
  end

  def get_accounts(access_token)
    request = Plaid::AccountsGetRequest.new(access_token: access_token)
    response = @client.accounts_get(request)
    response.accounts
  end

  def get_transactions(access_token, start_date:, end_date:, cursor: nil)
    request = Plaid::TransactionsSyncRequest.new(
      access_token: access_token,
      start_date: start_date,
      end_date: end_date
    )
    request.cursor = cursor if cursor

    @client.transactions_sync(request)
  end

  def get_item(access_token)
    request = Plaid::ItemGetRequest.new(access_token: access_token)
    response = @client.item_get(request)
    response.item
  end
```

### 4. Data Synchronizer (`lib/sync_service.rb`)

```ruby
require 'sequel'

class SyncService
  def initialize(plaid_client:, database:)
    @plaid_client = plaid_client
    @db = database
    @accounts_table = @db[:accounts]
    @transactions_table = @db[:transactions]
    @sync_history_table = @db[:sync_history]
  end

  def sync_item(access_token, plaid_item_id)
    sync_record_id = @sync_history_table.insert(
      plaid_item_id: plaid_item_id,
      sync_started_at: Time.now,
      status: 'in_progress'
    )

    begin
      # Get the latest cursor
      latest_cursor = @sync_history_table
        .where(plaid_item_id: plaid_item_id)
        .exclude(cursor: nil)
        .order(Sequel.desc(:sync_completed_at))
        .get(:cursor)

      # Sync accounts
      accounts = @plaid_client.get_accounts(access_token)
      sync_accounts(accounts, plaid_item_id)

      # Sync transactions
      start_date = Date.today - 730 # 2 years of history
      end_date = Date.today
      
      transaction_stats = sync_transactions(
        access_token, 
        plaid_item_id, 
        start_date: start_date,
        end_date: end_date,
        cursor: latest_cursor
      )

      # Update sync history
      @sync_history_table.where(id: sync_record_id).update(
        cursor: transaction_stats[:cursor],
        accounts_synced: accounts.count,
        transactions_added: transaction_stats[:added],
        transactions_modified: transaction_stats[:modified],
        transactions_removed: transaction_stats[:removed],
        sync_completed_at: Time.now,
        status: 'completed'
      )

      transaction_stats
    rescue => e
      @sync_history_table.where(id: sync_record_id).update(
        sync_completed_at: Time.now,
        status: 'failed',
        error_message: e.message
      )
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def sync_accounts(accounts, plaid_item_id)
    accounts.each do |account|
      @accounts_table.insert_conflict(
        target: :plaid_account_id,
        update: {
          name: account.name,
          official_name: account.official_name,
          subtype: account.subtype,
          type: account.type,
          mask: account.mask,
          current_balance: account.balances.current,
          available_balance: account.balances.available,
          iso_currency_code: account.balances.iso_currency_code,
          last_updated: Time.now,
          updated_at: Time.now
        }
      ).insert(
        plaid_account_id: account.account_id,
        plaid_item_id: plaid_item_id,
        name: account.name,
        official_name: account.official_name,
        subtype: account.subtype,
        type: account.type,
        mask: account.mask,
        current_balance: account.balances.current,
        available_balance: account.balances.available,
        iso_currency_code: account.balances.iso_currency_code,
        last_updated: Time.now,
        created_at: Time.now,
        updated_at: Time.now
      )
    end
  end

  def sync_transactions(access_token, plaid_item_id, start_date:, end_date:, cursor: nil)
    stats = { added: 0, modified: 0, removed: 0, cursor: cursor }
    has_more = true
    
    while has_more
      response = @plaid_client.get_transactions(
        access_token,
        start_date: start_date,
        end_date: end_date,
        cursor: stats[:cursor]
      )

      # Process added transactions
      response.added.each do |transaction|
        process_added_transaction(transaction, plaid_item_id)
        stats[:added] += 1
      end

      # Process modified transactions
      response.modified.each do |transaction|
        process_modified_transaction(transaction, plaid_item_id)
        stats[:modified] += 1
      end

      # Process removed transactions
      response.removed.each do |removed_transaction|
        process_removed_transaction(removed_transaction)
        stats[:removed] += 1
      end

      stats[:cursor] = response.next_cursor
      has_more = response.has_more
    end

    stats
  end

  def process_added_transaction(transaction, plaid_item_id)
    @transactions_table.insert_conflict(
      target: :plaid_transaction_id,
      update: {
        name: transaction.name,
        merchant_name: transaction.merchant_name,
        amount: transaction.amount,
        iso_currency_code: transaction.iso_currency_code,
        date: transaction.date,
        authorized_date: transaction.authorized_date,
        category: transaction.category&.to_json,
        category_id: transaction.category_id,
        pending: transaction.pending.to_s,
        payment_channel: transaction.payment_channel,
        updated_at: Time.now
      }
    ).insert(
      plaid_transaction_id: transaction.transaction_id,
      plaid_account_id: transaction.account_id,
      plaid_item_id: plaid_item_id,
      name: transaction.name,
      merchant_name: transaction.merchant_name,
      amount: transaction.amount,
      iso_currency_code: transaction.iso_currency_code,
      date: transaction.date,
      authorized_date: transaction.authorized_date,
      category: transaction.category&.to_json,
      category_id: transaction.category_id,
      pending: transaction.pending.to_s,
      payment_channel: transaction.payment_channel,
      created_at: Time.now,
      updated_at: Time.now
    )
  end

  def process_modified_transaction(transaction, plaid_item_id)
    @transactions_table.where(plaid_transaction_id: transaction.transaction_id).update(
      name: transaction.name,
      merchant_name: transaction.merchant_name,
      amount: transaction.amount,
      iso_currency_code: transaction.iso_currency_code,
      date: transaction.date,
      authorized_date: transaction.authorized_date,
      category: transaction.category&.to_json,
      category_id: transaction.category_id,
      pending: transaction.pending.to_s,
      payment_channel: transaction.payment_channel,
      updated_at: Time.now
    )
  end

  def process_removed_transaction(removed_transaction)
    @transactions_table.where(plaid_transaction_id: removed_transaction.transaction_id).delete
  end
end
```

### 5. Main Application (`app.rb`)

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'
require_relative 'lib/database'
require_relative 'lib/plaid_client'
require_relative 'lib/sync_service'

class BankDataSync
  def initialize
    @db = Database.connection
    @plaid_client = PlaidClient.new
    @sync_service = SyncService.new(
      plaid_client: @plaid_client,
      database: @db
    )
  end

  def sync_all_items
    # This would typically come from a table storing Plaid items/access tokens
    plaid_items = @db[:plaid_items].all rescue []
    
    if plaid_items.empty?
      puts "No Plaid items found. Please add items to sync."
      return
    end

    plaid_items.each do |item|
      puts "Syncing item: #{item[:plaid_item_id]}"
      begin
        stats = @sync_service.sync_item(
          item[:access_token],
          item[:plaid_item_id]
        )
        puts "Sync completed: Added #{stats[:added]}, Modified #{stats[:modified]}, Removed #{stats[:removed]} transactions"
      rescue => e
        puts "Error syncing item #{item[:plaid_item_id]}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
  end

  def sync_single_item(access_token, plaid_item_id)
    puts "Syncing item: #{plaid_item_id}"
    stats = @sync_service.sync_item(access_token, plaid_item_id)
    puts "Sync completed: Added #{stats[:added]}, Modified #{stats[:modified]}, Removed #{stats[:removed]} transactions"
    stats
  end
end

# CLI interface
if __FILE__ == $0
  app = BankDataSync.new
  
  case ARGV[0]
  when 'sync_all'
    app.sync_all_items
  when 'sync_item'
    if ARGV.length < 3
      puts "Usage: ruby app.rb sync_item <access_token> <plaid_item_id>"
      exit 1
    end
    app.sync_single_item(ARGV[1], ARGV[2])
  when 'migrate'
    Database.migrate!
    puts "Database migrated successfully"
  else
    puts "Usage:"
    puts "  ruby app.rb migrate                    # Run database migrations"
    puts "  ruby app.rb sync_all                   # Sync all Plaid items"
    puts "  ruby app.rb sync_item TOKEN ITEM_ID    # Sync a single item"
  end
end
```

### Основна логіка (flesch_reading_ease.rb)

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'uri'

class FleschReadingEase
  attr_reader :text, :statistics

  def initialize(text)
    @text = text.to_s.strip
    @statistics = {}
    calculate_statistics
  end

  # Обчислення показника Flesch Reading Ease
  # Формула: 206.835 - 1.015 * (words/sentences) - 84.6 * (syllables/words)
  def score
    return 0 if @statistics[:sentences].zero? || @statistics[:words].zero?

    score = 206.835 - 1.015 * (@statistics[:words].to_f / @statistics[:sentences]) - 
            84.6 * (@statistics[:syllables].to_f / @statistics[:words])
    
    score.round(2)
  end

  # Інтерпретація результату
  def readability_level
    case score
    when 90..100 then 'Very Easy'
    when 80..89 then 'Easy'
    when 70..79 then 'Fairly Easy'
    when 60..69 then 'Standard'
    when 50..59 then 'Fairly Difficult'
    when 30..49 then 'Difficult'
    when 0..29 then 'Very Confusing'
    else 'Invalid Score'
    end
  end

  # Детальна статистика
  def detailed_report
    {
      score: score,
      level: readability_level,
      words: @statistics[:words],
      sentences: @statistics[:sentences],
      syllables: @statistics[:syllables],
      avg_words_per_sentence: @statistics[:words].to_f / @statistics[:sentences],
      avg_syllables_per_word: @statistics[:syllables].to_f / @statistics[:words]
    }
  end

  private

  def calculate_statistics
    @statistics[:words] = count_words
    @statistics[:sentences] = count_sentences
    @statistics[:syllables] = count_syllables
  end

  def count_words
    text.split(/\s+/).count { |word| word.match?(/[a-zA-Z]/) }
  end

  def count_sentences
    sentences = text.split(/[.!?]+/)
    sentences.count { |sentence| sentence.match?(/[a-zA-Z]/) }
  end

  def count_syllables
    total_syllables = 0
    
    text.split(/\s+/).each do |word|
      next unless word.match?(/[a-zA-Z]/)
      
      # Очищення слова від пунктуації
      clean_word = word.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z]/, '')
      total_syllables += syllables_in_word(clean_word)
    end
    
    total_syllables
  end

  def syllables_in_word(word)
    return 0 if word.empty?
    
    # Спеціальні випадки
    return 1 if word.length <= 3
    
    # Видалення закінчень, які не впливають на кількість складів
    word = word.sub(/(?:[^laeiouy]es|ed|[^laeiouy]e)$/, '')
    word = word.sub(/^y/, '')
    
    # Підрахунок голосних груп
    syllables = word.scan(/[aeiouy]{1,2}/).size
    
    # Мінімум 1 склад
    [syllables, 1].max
  end
end
```

### Завантаження та обробка статей (article_analyzer.rb)

```ruby
require_relative 'flesch_reading_ease'

class ArticleAnalyzer
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://en.wikipedia.org'
  
  def self.analyze_url(url)
    response = get(url)
    
    if response.code == 200
      text = extract_text_from_html(response.body)
      analyzer = FleschReadingEase.new(text)
      analyzer.detailed_report
    else
      { error: "Failed to fetch article. Status code: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  def self.analyze_file(file_path)
    content = File.read(file_path)
    
    # Визначення типу файлу
    if file_path.end_with?('.html', '.htm')
      text = extract_text_from_html(content)
    else
      text = content
    end
    
    analyzer = FleschReadingEase.new(text)
    analyzer.detailed_report
  rescue Errno::ENOENT
    { error: "File not found: #{file_path}" }
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.extract_text_from_html(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Видалення скриптів та стилів
    doc.css('script, style').remove
    
    # Видалення навігації та інших несуттєвих елементів
    doc.css('nav, header, footer, aside').remove
    
    # Отримання тексту з основного контенту
    main_content = doc.css('article, main, .content, #content, body').first
    main_content ? main_content.text : doc.text
  end
end
```

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "roo", "~> 2.10"   # читання XLSX (офіційний формат КАТОТТГ)
```

## katottg.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Завантаження КАТОТТГ та пошук населених пунктів за назвою.
#
# Приклади:
#   bundle install
#   ruby katottg.rb --url "https://…/katottg.xlsx" Бровари
#   ruby katottg.rb --file data/katottg.xlsx "нова" --type X --oblast київська
#   ruby katottg.rb --file data/katottg.xlsx          # інтерактивний режим

require "bundler/setup"
require "net/http"
require "uri"
require "json"
require "csv"
require "fileutils"
require "optparse"
require "roo"

module Katottg
  # Категорії об'єктів КАТОТТГ
  CATEGORIES = {
    "O" => "область",
    "K" => "місто зі спец. статусом",
    "P" => "район",
    "H" => "територіальна громада",
    "M" => "місто",
    "T" => "селище міського типу",
    "C" => "селище",
    "X" => "село",
    "B" => "район у місті"
  }.freeze

  SHORT = {
    "O" => "обл.", "K" => "м.", "P" => "р-н", "H" => "громада",
    "M" => "м.", "T" => "смт", "C" => "с-ще", "X" => "с.", "B" => "р-н міста"
  }.freeze

  SETTLEMENTS = %w[K M T C X].freeze

  # Кириличні літери, схожі на латинські коди категорій
  CYR_TO_LAT = { "О" => "O", "К" => "K", "Р" => "P", "Н" => "H", "М" => "M",
                 "Т" => "T", "С" => "C", "Х" => "X", "В" => "B" }.freeze

  Record = Struct.new(:code, :category, :name, :level, :parent, keyword_init: true)

  def self.normalize(str)
    str.to_s.unicode_normalize(:nfc).downcase
       .tr("’ʼ`‘´", "'")
       .tr("–—‑", "-")
       .gsub(/\s+/, " ").strip
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Завантаження
  module Downloader
    MAX_REDIRECTS = 5

    def self.call(url, dest)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(dest))
      uri = URI(url)

      (MAX_REDIRECTS + 1).times do
        req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
        req["User-Agent"] = "katottg-ruby/1.0"
        location = nil

        Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == "https",
                        open_timeout: 15, read_timeout: 120) do |http|
          http.request(req) do |res|
            case res
            when Net::HTTPSuccess
              tmp = "#{dest}.part"
              File.open(tmp, "wb") { |f| res.read_body { |chunk| f.write(chunk) } }
              File.rename(tmp, dest)
              return dest
            when Net::HTTPRedirection
              location = URI.join(uri.to_s, res["location"])
            else
              raise "Помилка завантаження: HTTP #{res.code} #{res.message}"
            end
          end
        end
        uri = location
      end
      raise "Забагато перенаправлень"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Парсинг
  module Parser
    LEVEL_COLS = 5 # 4 рівні + додатковий

    def self.call(path)
      rows =
        case detect_format(path)
        when :xlsx then xlsx_rows(path)
        when :json then json_rows(path)
        else            csv_rows(path)
        end
      build_records(rows)
    end

    def self.detect_format(path)
      head = File.binread(path, 8).to_s
      return :xlsx if head.start_with?("PK")
      stripped = head.sub(/\A\xEF\xBB\xBF/n, "").lstrip
      return :json if stripped.start_with?("{", "[")
      :csv
    end

    # Кожен рядок: [рівень1, рівень2, рівень3, рівень4, додатковий, категорія, назва]
    def self.xlsx_rows(path)
      return enum_for(:xlsx_rows, path) unless block_given?

      book = Roo::Excelx.new(path, extension: :xlsx)
      book.each_row_streaming(pad_cells: true) do |cells|
        yield cells.first(7).map { |c| c&.value.to_s.strip }
      end
    end

    def self.csv_rows(path)
      return enum_for(:csv_rows, path) unless block_given?

      sample = File.read(path, 4096, encoding: "bom|utf-8")
      sep = sample.count(";") > sample.count(",") ? ";" : ","
      CSV.foreach(path, col_sep: sep, encoding: "bom|utf-8") do |row|
        yield row.first(7).map { |c| c.to_s.strip }
      end
    end

    # Підтримується масив об'єктів або {"items": [...]} з ключами
    # level1..level5, category, name
    def self.json_rows(path)
      return enum_for(:json_rows, path) unless block_given?

      data = JSON.parse(File.read(path, encoding: "bom|utf-8"))
      items = data.is_a?(Hash) ? (data["items"] || data["data"] || data.values.find { |v| v.is_a?(Array) }) : data
      raise "Невідома структура JSON" unless items.is_a?(Array)

      items.each do |h|
        yield [*(1..5).map { |i| h["level#{i}"].to_s.strip },
               h["category"].to_s.strip, h["name"].to_s.strip]
      end
    end

    def self.build_records(rows)
      records = []
      path = Array.new(LEVEL_COLS) # останній об'єкт кожного рівня

      rows.each do |row|
        cat = row[5].to_s.strip.upcase.chars.map { |ch| CYR_TO_LAT.fetch(ch, ch) }.join
        name = row[6].to_s.strip
        next unless CATEGORIES.key?(cat) && !name.empty? # заголовки та сміття

        level = (0...LEVEL_COLS).to_a.reverse.find { |i| !row[i].to_s.strip.empty? }
        next unless level

        parent = (0...level).to_a.reverse.map { |i| path[i] }.compact.first
        rec = Record.new(code: row[level].to_s.strip, category: cat, name: name,
                         level: level, parent: parent&.code)
        path[level] = rec
        ((level + 1)...LEVEL_COLS).each { |i| path[i] = nil }
        records << rec
      end
      records
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Індекс і пошук
  class Index
    attr_reader :records

    def initialize(records)
      @records = records
      @by_code = records.to_h { |r| [r.code, r] }
      @norm = {}
      records.each { |r| @norm[r.code] = Katottg.normalize(r.name) }
    end

    # mode: :smart (точно → початок → початок слова → підрядок) або :exact
    def search(query, types: SETTLEMENTS, oblast: nil, mode: :smart, limit: 50)
      q = Katottg.normalize(query)
      return [] if q.empty?

      oblast_q = oblast && Katottg.normalize(oblast)
      scored = []

      @records.each do |r|
        next unless types.include?(r.category)

        score = score(@norm[r.code], q, mode)
        next unless score
        next if oblast_q && !Katottg.normalize(root_of(r).name).include?(oblast_q)

        scored << [score, r]
      end

      scored.sort_by { |s, r| [s, @norm[r.code], r.code] }.first(limit).map(&:last)
    end

    def ancestors(rec)
      list = []
      cur = @by_code[rec.parent]
      while cur
        list << cur
        cur = @by_code[cur.parent]
      end
      list # від найближчого до кореня
    end

    def root_of(rec)
      ancestors(rec).last || rec
    end

    def format(rec)
      place = ancestors(rec).map(&:name).join(", ")
      line = "#{SHORT[rec.category]} #{rec.name}"
      line += " — #{place}" unless place.empty?
      "#{line}  [#{rec.code}]"
    end

    # ---- кеш розібраного індексу (JSON поруч із джерелом)
    def self.load(source_path)
      cache = "#{source_path}.index.json"
      if File.exist?(cache) && File.mtime(cache) >= File.mtime(source_path)
        data = JSON.parse(File.read(cache), symbolize_names: true)
        return new(data.map { |h| Record.new(**h) })
      end

      index = new(Parser.call(source_path))
      File.write(cache, JSON.generate(index.records.map(&:to_h)))
      index
    end

    private

    def score(name, q, mode)
      return 0 if name == q
      return nil if mode == :exact
      return 1 if name.start_with?(q)
      return 2 if name.split(/[\s\-]/).any? { |w| w.start_with?(q) }
      return 3 if name.include?(q)
      nil
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- CLI
  class CLI
    DEFAULT_PATH = File.join("data", "katottg.dat")

    def initialize(argv)
      @opts = { path: DEFAULT_PATH, types: SETTLEMENTS, limit: 50, mode: :smart }
      @queries = parse(argv)
    end

    def run
      prepare_file
      warn "Індексація…"
      index = Index.load(@opts[:path])
      warn "Завантажено об'єктів: #{index.records.size}"

      if @queries.empty?
        interactive(index)
      else
        @queries.each { |q| show(index, q) }
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      warn "Помилка: #{e.message}"
      exit 1
    end

    private

    def parse(argv)
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "Використання: ruby katottg.rb [опції] [назва ...]"
        o.on("--url URL", "URL файлу КАТОТТГ (xlsx/csv/json); також змінна KATOTTG_URL") { |v| @opts[:url] = v }
        o.on("--file PATH", "Локальний файл (замість завантаження)") { |v| @opts[:path] = v; @opts[:local] = true }
        o.on("--refresh", "Примусово перезавантажити файл") { @opts[:refresh] = true }
        o.on("--type X,M,T", Array, "Категорії: #{CATEGORIES.keys.join(',')} (типово: #{SETTLEMENTS.join(',')})") do |v|
          @opts[:types] = v.map(&:upcase)
        end
        o.on("--all", "Шукати серед усіх категорій") { @opts[:types] = CATEGORIES.keys }
        o.on("--oblast NAME", "Фільтр за областю (частина назви)") { |v| @opts[:oblast] = v }
        o.on("--exact", "Лише точний збіг назви") { @opts[:mode] = :exact }
        o.on("--limit N", Integer, "Макс. кількість результатів (50)") { |v| @opts[:limit] = v }
        o.on("-h", "--help") { puts o; exit }
      end
      parser.parse(argv)
    end

    def prepare_file
      return if @opts[:local] && File.exist?(@opts[:path]) # свій файл
      raise "Файл не знайдено: #{@opts[:path]}" if @opts[:local]

      return if File.exist?(@opts[:path]) && !@opts[:refresh]

      url = @opts[:url] || ENV["KATOTTG_URL"]
      raise "Вкажіть --url (або KATOTTG_URL) чи --file" unless url

      warn "Завантаження #{url} …"
      Downloader.call(url, @opts[:path])
      FileUtils.rm_f("#{@opts[:path]}.index.json")
    end

    def show(index, query)
      results = index.search(query, types: @opts[:types], oblast: @opts[:oblast],
                                    mode: @opts[:mode], limit: @opts[:limit])
      puts "\n«#{query}»: знайдено #{results.size}"
      results.each { |r| puts "  #{index.format(r)}" }
    end

    def interactive(index)
      puts "Введіть назву (порожній рядок — вихід)."
      loop do
        print "> "
        line = $stdin.gets&.strip
        break if line.nil? || line.empty?
        show(index, line)
      end
    end
  end
end

Katottg::CLI.new(ARGV).run if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
```

## Примітки

- **Джерело даних.** Актуальне посилання на файл КАТОТТГ беріть на сайті Мінрозвитку або на data.gov.ua. Воно змінюється з кожним оновленням, тому в коді його не зашито: передайте його через `--url` чи `KATOTTG_URL`. Файл завантажується один раз у `data/katottg.dat`, повторно його можна завантажити з `--refresh`.
- **Формат.** Тип файлу (XLSX, CSV, JSON) визначається за вмістом. Для XLSX/CSV очікується офіційний порядок колонок: 4 рівні, додатковий рівень, категорія, назва. Для JSON — ключі `level1`…`level5`, `category`, `name`. Я не міг перевірити актуальну структуру файлу, тому, якщо вона зміниться, коригувати треба `Parser`.
- **Ієрархія.** Для кожного рядка визначається найглибший заповнений рівень, а батьківські об'єкти (громада, район, область) відстежуються за порядком у файлі. У результаті показується повний «адрес».
- **Пошук.** Регістр, різні апострофи та тире нормалізуються. Результати ранжуються так: точний збіг, початок назви, початок слова, підрядок.
- **Кеш.** Розібраний індекс зберігається в `*.index.json`, тож наступні запуски стартують швидко.

Приклад виводу:

```
$ ruby katottg.rb --file data/katottg.xlsx --oblast київська Бровари
«Бровари»: знайдено 1
  м. Бровари — Броварська територіальна громада, Броварський район, КИЇВСЬКА ОБЛАСТЬ  [UA32…]
```

Task: Accept a PayPal payment in a Rails app and capture the order after the buyer approves it.
text:
# PayPal Checkout in Rails (create order, buyer approves, server captures) This uses PayPal's REST Orders v2 API directly through Faraday. PayPal's older `Checkout-Server-SDK` gem is deprecated, so I avoided it. The order amount is always computed on the server, and the capture happens on the server only after the buyer approves. ## Gemfile ```ruby source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.1" gem "rails", "~> 7.1" gem "pg" # or sqlite3 / mysql2, whichever database you use gem "puma", ">= 5.0" gem "faraday", "~> 2.9" # HTTP client for the PayPal REST API ``` Run `bundle install`. ## Credentials Run `bin/rails credentials:edit` and add: ```yaml paypal: client_id: YOUR_SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID client_secret: YOUR_SANDBOX_SECRET mode: sandbox # use "live" in production ``` ## Migration ```ruby # db/migrate/20240101000000_create_orders.rb class CreateOrders < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1] def change create_table :orders do |t| t.integer :total_cents, null: false t.string :currency, null: false, default: "USD" t.string :status, null: false, default: "pending" t.string :paypal_order_id t.string :paypal_capture_id t.datetime :paid_at t.timestamps end add_index :orders, :paypal_order_id, unique: true end end ``` ```ruby # app/models/order.rb class Order < ApplicationRecord validates :total_cents, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than: 0 } def paid? = status == "paid" def total_string format("%d.%02d", *total_cents.divmod(100)) end end ``` ## PayPal API client ```ruby # app/services/paypal_client.rb class PaypalClient class Error < StandardError attr_reader :status, :body def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil) super(message) @status = status @body = body end # e.g. "INSTRUMENT_DECLINED", the buyer should pick another funding source def issue Array(body.is_a?(Hash) ? body["details"] : nil).first&.dig("issue") end end BASE_URLS = { "sandbox" => "https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com", "live" => "https://api-m.paypal.com" }.freeze def initialize @config = Rails.application.credentials.paypal! @base_url = BASE_URLS.fetch(@config[:mode].to_s) end def create_order(order) post( "/v2/checkout/orders", { intent: "CAPTURE", purchase_units: [{ reference_id: order.id.to_s, custom_id: order.id.to_s, amount: { currency_code: order.currency, value: order.total_string } }] }, request_id: "create-#{order.id}-#{SecureRandom.uuid}" ) end def capture_order(paypal_order_id) # Stable request id => retrying the same capture is idempotent at PayPal post( "/v2/checkout/orders/#{ERB::Util.url_encode(paypal_order_id)}/capture", {}, request_id: "capture-#{paypal_order_id}" ) end private def post(path, payload, request_id:) response = connection.post(path) do |req| req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{access_token}" req.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json" req.headers["PayPal-Request-Id"] = request_id req.body = payload.to_json end handle(response) end def access_token Rails.cache.fetch("paypal/access_token/#{@config[:mode]}", expires_in: 8.hours, race_condition_ttl: 10) do response = connection.post("/v1/oauth2/token") do |req| req.headers["Authorization"] = "Basic " + Base64.strict_encode64("#{@config[:client_id]}:#{@config[:client_secret]}") req.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" req.body = "grant_type=client_credentials" end data = handle(response) # Cache entry expires a bit before the token does Rails.cache.write("paypal/access_token/#{@config[:mode]}", data["access_token"], expires_in: [data["expires_in"].to_i - 300, 60].max) data["access_token"] end end def connection @connection ||= Faraday.new(url: @base_url) do |f| f.options.timeout = 15 f.options.open_timeout = 5 end end def handle(response) body = response.body.present? ? JSON.parse(response.body) : {} return body if response.success? raise Error.new( "PayPal API error #{response.status}: #{body['message'] || body['error_description']}", status: response.status, body: body ) rescue JSON::ParserError raise Error.new("Invalid response from PayPal", status: response.status) end end ``` ## Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :orders, only: :show do post "paypal/create", to: "paypal_orders#create", as: :paypal_create post "paypal/capture", to: "paypal_orders#capture", as: :paypal_capture end end ``` ## Controllers ```ruby # app/controllers/orders_controller.rb class OrdersController < ApplicationController def show # In a real app scope this to the signed-in user: current_user.orders.find(...) @order = Order.find(params[:id]) end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/paypal_orders_controller.rb class PaypalOrdersController < ApplicationController before_action :set_order rescue_from PaypalClient::Error do |e| Rails.logger.error("[PayPal] #{e.message} #{e.body.inspect}") render json: { error: "payment_failed", issue: e.issue }, status: :unprocessable_entity end # POST /orders/:order_id/paypal/create # Called by the PayPal button's createOrder callback. def create return render(json: { error: "already_paid" }, status: :conflict) if @order.paid? paypal_order = PaypalClient.new.create_order(@order) @order.update!(paypal_order_id: paypal_order.fetch("id")) render json: { id: paypal_order["id"] } end # POST /orders/:order_id/paypal/capture # Called by the PayPal button's onApprove callback, after the buyer approves. def capture paypal_order_id = params.require(:paypal_order_id).to_s # The PayPal order must be the one we created for THIS order unless @order.paypal_order_id.present? && ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(@order.paypal_order_id, paypal_order_id) return render json: { error: "order_mismatch" }, status: :unprocessable_entity end outcome = nil # Row lock prevents double-capture on double-clicks / retries @order.with_lock do if @order.paid? outcome = :already_paid else result = PaypalClient.new.capture_order(paypal_order_id) capture = result.dig("purchase_units", 0, "payments", "captures", 0) if valid_capture?(result, capture) @order.update!(status: "paid", paypal_capture_id: capture["id"], paid_at: Time.current) outcome = :paid else # e.g. capture PENDING (eCheck / review). Don't fulfil until a webhook confirms. @order.update!(status: "payment_review", paypal_capture_id: capture&.dig("id")) outcome = :review end end end case outcome when :paid, :already_paid render json: { status: "paid", redirect_url: order_path(@order) } else render json: { status: "pending_review", redirect_url: order_path(@order) } end end private def set_order # Scope to the current user in a real app @order = Order.find(params[:order_id]) end def valid_capture?(result, capture) result["status"] == "COMPLETED" && capture.present? && capture["status"] == "COMPLETED" && capture.dig("amount", "value") == @order.total_string && capture.dig("amount", "currency_code") == @order.currency end end ``` ## View with PayPal Smart Buttons ```erb <%# app/views/orders/show.html.erb %>

Order #<%= @order.id %>

Total: <%= number_to_currency(@order.total_cents / 100.0) %>

<% if @order.paid? %>

✅ Paid. Thank you!

<% elsif @order.status == "payment_review" %>

Your payment is being reviewed by PayPal. We'll email you once it clears.

<% else %>

<%= javascript_tag nonce: true do %> const csrf = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content; const errorEl = document.getElementById("paypal-error"); const postJSON = async (url, body = {}) => { const res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf, "Accept": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }); return { ok: res.ok, data: await res.json() }; }; paypal.Buttons({ createOrder: async () => { const { ok, data } = await postJSON("<%= order_paypal_create_path(@order) %>"); if (!ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Could not create PayPal order"); return data.id; }, onApprove: async (data, actions) => { const { ok, data: result } = await postJSON("<%= order_paypal_capture_path(@order) %>", { paypal_order_id: data.orderID }); if (ok) { window.location.href = result.redirect_url; } else if (result.issue === "INSTRUMENT_DECLINED") { return actions.restart(); // let the buyer choose another funding source } else { errorEl.textContent = "Payment could not be completed. You have not been charged."; } }, onCancel: () => { errorEl.textContent = "Payment cancelled."; }, onError: (err) => { console.error(err); errorEl.textContent = "Something went wrong with PayPal. Please try again."; } }).render("#paypal-button-container"); <% end %> <% end %> ``` ## How it works 1. The buyer clicks the PayPal button, and `createOrder` posts to `paypal_orders#create`. 2. The server builds the PayPal order from `Order#total_cents` (the client never sends an amount) and returns the PayPal order ID. 3. The buyer approves in the PayPal popup, and `onApprove` posts the `orderID` to `paypal_orders#capture`. 4. The server confirms the ID belongs to this order and captures it inside a row lock. It marks the order paid only if both the order and the capture are `COMPLETED` and the amount and currency match. 5. Pending captures go to `payment_review`. For production, add a webhook for `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` and `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED` to settle those. Before going live, swap the sandbox credentials for live ones, set `mode: live`, and make sure `config.cache_store` is a real store (Redis or Memcached) so the access token is shared across processes.

# Discord-бот для сповіщень про розгортання та slash-команд

Бот складається з двох частин:
- **Discord-бот** на `discordrb`, який відповідає на slash-команди `/ping`, `/status` і `/history`.
- **HTTP-вебхук** на Sinatra та Puma, куди CI/CD надсилає події розгортання. Бот публікує їх як embed-повідомлення в канал.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
# frozen_string_literal: true

source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 3.1'

gem 'discordrb', '~> 3.5'   # Discord API: бот і slash-команди
gem 'sinatra',   '~> 4.0'   # HTTP-вебхук для CI/CD
gem 'rackup',    '~> 2.1'   # потрібен Sinatra 4 / Rack 3 для запуску сервера
gem 'puma',      '~> 6.4'   # веб-сервер
gem 'dotenv',    '~> 3.1'   # змінні середовища з .env
```

## .env.example

```dotenv
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=your-bot-token
DISCORD_DEPLOY_CHANNEL_ID=123456789012345678
# Необов'язково: реєстрація команд для одного сервера (з'являються миттєво).
# Без цього параметра команди реєструються глобально (до ~1 години).
DISCORD_SERVER_ID=123456789012345678
DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=long-random-secret
PORT=4567
DEPLOY_STORE_PATH=deploys.json
```

## bot.rb

```ruby
# bot.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'bundler/setup'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'discordrb'
require 'sinatra/base'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'time'
require 'uri'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Конфігурація
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Config
  def self.require_env(key)
    value = ENV[key].to_s.strip
    abort "Відсутня обов'язкова змінна середовища: #{key}" if value.empty?
    value
  end

  TOKEN      = require_env('DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN')
  CHANNEL_ID = require_env('DISCORD_DEPLOY_CHANNEL_ID').to_i
  SECRET     = require_env('DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET')
  SERVER_ID  = ENV['DISCORD_SERVER_ID'].to_s.empty? ? nil : ENV['DISCORD_SERVER_ID'].to_i
  PORT       = Integer(ENV.fetch('PORT', '4567'))
  STORE_PATH = ENV.fetch('DEPLOY_STORE_PATH', 'deploys.json')
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Сховище розгортань (потокобезпечне, з простою персистентністю у JSON)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class DeployStore
  MAX_ITEMS = 50

  def initialize(path)
    @path  = path
    @mutex = Mutex.new
    @items = load_from_disk
  end

  def add(deploy)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @items.unshift(deploy)
      @items = @items.first(MAX_ITEMS)
      persist
    end
    deploy
  end

  def recent(limit: 5, environment: nil)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      list = filter(environment)
      list.first(limit)
    end
  end

  # Останнє розгортання для кожного середовища (або для вказаного)
  def latest_per_environment(environment = nil)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      filter(environment).uniq { |d| d[:environment].downcase }
    end
  end

  private

  def filter(environment)
    return @items.dup if environment.nil? || environment.empty?

    @items.select { |d| d[:environment].casecmp?(environment) }
  end

  def load_from_disk
    return [] unless File.exist?(@path)

    JSON.parse(File.read(@path), symbolize_names: true)
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    []
  end

  def persist
    tmp = "#{@path}.tmp"
    File.write(tmp, JSON.pretty_generate(@items))
    File.rename(tmp, @path)
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Форматування embed-повідомлень
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Presenter
  STYLES = {
    'started'  => { color: 0x3498DB, emoji: '🚀', label: 'Розпочато' },
    'success'  => { color: 0x2ECC71, emoji: '✅', label: 'Успішно' },
    'failure'  => { color: 0xE74C3C, emoji: '❌', label: 'Помилка' },
    'rollback' => { color: 0xF39C12, emoji: '⏪', label: 'Відкат' }
  }.freeze

  def self.fill(embed, deploy)
    style = STYLES.fetch(deploy[:status], STYLES['started'])

    embed.title       = clip("#{style[:emoji]} #{deploy[:service]} → #{deploy[:environment]}", 250)
    embed.description = deploy[:message] if deploy[:message]
    embed.colour      = style[:color]
    embed.url         = deploy[:url] if deploy[:url]
    embed.timestamp   = Time.parse(deploy[:timestamp])

    embed.add_field(name: 'Статус', value: style[:label], inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: 'Версія', value: "`#{deploy[:version]}`", inline: true) if deploy[:version]
    embed.add_field(name: 'Коміт',  value: "`#{deploy[:commit]}`",  inline: true) if deploy[:commit]
    embed.add_field(name: 'Автор',  value: deploy[:author],         inline: true) if deploy[:author]
    embed
  end

  def self.clip(text, max)
    text = text.to_s
    text.length > max ? "#{text[0, max - 1]}…" : text
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Валідація та нормалізація вхідних даних вебхука
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
module DeployPayload
  REQUIRED = %i[service environment status].freeze

  class Invalid < StandardError; end

  def self.build(payload)
    raise Invalid, 'Тіло запиту має бути JSON-об\'єктом' unless payload.is_a?(Hash)

    missing = REQUIRED.select { |k| payload[k].to_s.strip.empty? }
    raise Invalid, "Відсутні поля: #{missing.join(', ')}" unless missing.empty?

    status = payload[:status].to_s.downcase
    unless Presenter::STYLES.key?(status)
      raise Invalid, "Невідомий статус '#{status}'. Дозволені: #{Presenter::STYLES.keys.join(', ')}"
    end

    {
      service:     Presenter.clip(payload[:service].to_s.strip, 100),
      environment: Presenter.clip(payload[:environment].to_s.strip, 50),
      status:      status,
      version:     optional(payload[:version], 100),
      commit:      optional(payload[:commit], 40)&.slice(0, 7),
      author:      optional(payload[:author], 100),
      message:     optional(payload[:message], 1000),
      url:         http_url(payload[:url]),
      timestamp:   Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }
  end

  def self.optional(value, max)
    str = value.to_s.strip
    str.empty? ? nil : Presenter.clip(str, max)
  end

  def self.http_url(value)
    return nil if value.to_s.strip.empty?

    uri = URI.parse(value.to_s.strip)
    uri.is_a?(URI::HTTP) ? uri.to_s : nil
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    nil
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP-вебхук (приймає події від CI/CD)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class WebhookApp < Sinatra::Base
  set :server, :puma
  set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
  set :port, Config::PORT
  set :show_exceptions, false
  set :raise_errors, false
  set :host_authorization, { permitted_hosts: [] } # дозволити будь-який Host

  helpers do
    def json_response(status_code, body)
      content_type :json
      halt status_code, JSON.generate(body)
    end

    def valid_signature?(raw_body)
      provided = request.env['HTTP_X_SIGNATURE_256'].to_s
      expected = "sha256=#{OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', Config::SECRET, raw_body)}"
      Rack::Utils.secure_compare(provided, expected)
    end
  end

  get '/health' do
    json_response 200, status: 'ok'
  end

  post '/webhooks/deploy' do
    request.body.rewind
    raw = request.body.read

    json_response 401, error: 'Невірний підпис' unless valid_signature?(raw)

    begin
      deploy = DeployPayload.build(JSON.parse(raw, symbolize_names: true))
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      json_response 400, error: 'Некоректний JSON'
    rescue DeployPayload::Invalid => e
      json_response 422, error: e.message
    end

    settings.store.add(deploy)

    begin
      channel = settings.bot.channel(Config::CHANNEL_ID)
      raise "Канал #{Config::CHANNEL_ID} не знайдено" unless channel

      channel.send_embed('') { |embed| Presenter.fill(embed, deploy) }
    rescue StandardError => e
      settings.bot.logger.error("Не вдалося надіслати сповіщення: #{e.message}") rescue nil
      json_response 502, error: 'Не вдалося надіслати повідомлення в Discord'
    end

    json_response 202, status: 'sent'
  end

  error do
    json_response 500, error: 'Внутрішня помилка сервера'
  end

  not_found do
    json_response 404, error: 'Не знайдено'
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discord-бот і slash-команди
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
store = DeployStore.new(Config::STORE_PATH)
bot   = Discordrb::Bot.new(token: Config::TOKEN, intents: [:servers])

bot.register_application_command(:ping, 'Перевірити, чи бот працює', server_id: Config::SERVER_ID)

bot.register_application_command(:status, 'Останнє розгортання по середовищах',
                                 server_id: Config::SERVER_ID) do |cmd|
  cmd.string('environment', 'Середовище (наприклад, production)', required: false)
end

bot.register_application_command(:history, 'Історія розгортань', server_id: Config::SERVER_ID) do |cmd|
  cmd.integer('limit', 'Скільки записів показати (1–10)', required: false, min_value: 1, max_value: 10)
  cmd.string('environment', 'Фільтр за середовищем', required: false)
end

bot.application_command(:ping) do |event|
  event.respond(content: '🏓 Pong!', ephemeral: true)
end

bot.application_command(:status) do |event|
  environment = event.options['environment']
  deploys     = store.latest_per_environment(environment).first(10)

  if deploys.empty?
    event.respond(content: 'Розгортань поки немає.', ephemeral: true)
  else
    event.respond(content: "Останні розгортання (#{deploys.size}):") do |builder|
      deploys.each { |d| builder.add_embed { |embed| Presenter.fill(embed, d) } }
    end
  end
end

bot.application_command(:history) do |event|
  limit       = (event.options['limit'] || 5).to_i.clamp(1, 10)
  environment = event.options['environment']
  deploys     = store.recent(limit: limit, environment: environment)

  if deploys.empty?
    event.respond(content: 'Історія порожня.', ephemeral: true)
  else
    event.respond(content: "Історія розгортань (#{deploys.size}):") do |builder|
      deploys.each { |d| builder.add_embed { |embed| Presenter.fill(embed, d) } }
    end
  end
end

bot.ready { puts "Бот запущено як #{bot.profile.username}" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Запуск: бот у фоні, HTTP-сервер у головному потоці
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WebhookApp.set :bot, bot
WebhookApp.set :store, store

bot.run(true)
at_exit { bot.stop }

WebhookApp.run!
```

## Запуск

```bash
bundle install
cp .env.example .env   # заповніть значення
bundle exec ruby bot.rb
```

Під час запрошення бота на сервер потрібні scope `bot` і `applications.commands`. Права достатні такі: `Send Messages` та `Embed Links`.

## Надсилання події з CI/CD

```bash
BODY='{"service":"api","environment":"production","status":"success","version":"v1.4.2","commit":"a1b2c3d4e5","author":"olena","message":"Оновлено залежності","url":"https://ci.example.com/runs/42"}'
SIG="sha256=$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET" | awk '{print $2}')"

curl -X POST http://localhost:4567/webhooks/deploy \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Signature-256: $SIG" \
  -d "$BODY"
```

## Основні особливості

- **Безпека:** запити до вебхука перевіряються за HMAC-SHA256 підписом (`X-Signature-256`) із порівнянням за постійний час. Вхідні поля валідуються та обрізаються за лімітами Discord, а `url` приймається лише з `http(s)`.
- **Статуси:** `started`, `success`, `failure`, `rollback`, кожен зі своїм кольором та емодзі.
- **Команди:** `/status [environment]` показує останнє розгортання кожного середовища, `/history [limit] [environment]` показує історію.
- **Зберігання:** останні 50 розгортань зберігаються у JSON-файлі, тож історія переживає перезапуск. Для більших навантажень замініть `DeployStore` на БД.
- **Реєстрація команд:** якщо задано `DISCORD_SERVER_ID`, команди з'являються миттєво. Інакше вони реєструються глобально, і це може тривати до години.
