Task: Encrypt a file for a recipient using the Ukrainian Kalyna block cipher (DSTU 7624).
text:
Ruby's OpenSSL has no Kalyna (DSTU 7624) support and I don't know of a maintained gem for it, so this is a pure-Ruby implementation of the cipher. I can't reliably reproduce the four standard 256-byte S-boxes from memory, and a wrong table would silently give a non-standard cipher. The code therefore loads the S-boxes from a file you supply from the official reference implementation, and refuses to run unless two known-answer tests pass.

The known-answer vectors in the code are also from memory. If a self-test fails, check the vector against the reference implementation as well as your S-box file.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

# RSA-OAEP key wrapping, HKDF, HMAC, and random bytes
gem "openssl", "~> 3.2"
```

## kalyna_file.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
#
# Hybrid file encryption for a recipient using Kalyna (DSTU 7624:2014).
#
#   * random 32-byte master secret, wrapped with the recipient's RSA key (OAEP-SHA256)
#   * HKDF-SHA256 -> 256-bit Kalyna key + 256-bit HMAC key
#   * Kalyna-128/256 in CTR mode, then HMAC-SHA256 (encrypt-then-MAC)
#
# Usage:
#   ruby kalyna_file.rb encrypt <in> <out> <recipient_public.pem>
#   ruby kalyna_file.rb decrypt <in> <out> <recipient_private.pem>
#
# S-boxes: file "kalyna_sboxes.txt" (or $KALYNA_SBOXES) with four lines of
# 512 hex chars each (pi0..pi3 from the DSTU 7624 reference implementation).
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.

require "openssl"

class Kalyna
  MASK = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
  MDS_ROW = [0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04].freeze
  ROUNDS = { 128 => 10, 256 => 14, 512 => 18 }.freeze
  VALID = [[128, 128], [128, 256], [256, 256], [256, 512], [512, 512]].freeze

  # GF(2^8) multiplication, polynomial x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1 (0x11d)
  def self.gmul(a, b)
    r = 0
    while b > 0
      r ^= a if b & 1 == 1
      a <<= 1
      a ^= 0x11d if a & 0x100 != 0
      b >>= 1
    end
    r
  end

  MUL = MDS_ROW.uniq.to_h { |c| [c, Array.new(256) { |x| gmul(x, c) }.freeze] }.freeze

  attr_reader :block_size

  def initialize(key, block_bits:, sboxes:)
    key_bits = key.bytesize * 8
    unless VALID.include?([block_bits, key_bits])
      raise ArgumentError, "unsupported block/key size #{block_bits}/#{key_bits}"
    end
    @sbox = sboxes
    @nb = block_bits / 64
    @nk = key_bits / 64
    @nr = ROUNDS[key_bits]
    @block_size = block_bits / 8
    expand_key(key.b)
  end

  def encrypt_block(block)
    raise ArgumentError, "bad block size" unless block.bytesize == @block_size
    st = add(block.unpack("Q<*"), @rk[0])
    (1...@nr).each { |r| st = xor(round(st), @rk[r]) }
    add(round(st), @rk[@nr]).pack("Q<*")
  end

  private

  def add(a, b) = a.each_with_index.map { |w, i| (w + b[i]) & MASK }
  def xor(a, b) = a.each_with_index.map { |w, i| w ^ b[i] }

  # SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns
  def round(state)
    nb = @nb
    bytes = state.pack("Q<*").bytes
    bytes.each_index { |i| bytes[i] = @sbox[i & 3][bytes[i]] }

    shifted = Array.new(8 * nb)
    per = 8 / nb
    8.times do |row|
      shift = row / per
      nb.times { |col| shifted[((col + shift) % nb) * 8 + row] = bytes[col * 8 + row] }
    end

    out = Array.new(8 * nb)
    nb.times do |col|
      base = col * 8
      8.times do |i|
        v = 0
        8.times { |k| v ^= MUL[MDS_ROW[(k - i) % 8]][shifted[base + k]] }
        out[base + i] = v
      end
    end
    out.pack("C*").unpack("Q<*")
  end

  def even_key(kt, tmv, part)
    ktr = add(kt, tmv)
    s = round(add(part, ktr))
    s = round(xor(s, ktr))
    round(add(s, ktr))
  end

  def expand_key(key_bytes)
    nb, nk, nr = @nb, @nk, @nr
    key = key_bytes.unpack("Q<*")

    # intermediate key Kt
    st = Array.new(nb, 0)
    st[0] = nb + nk + 1
    k0, k1 = nk == nb ? [key.dup, key.dup] : [key[0, nb], key[nb, nb]]
    st = round(add(st, k0))
    st = round(xor(st, k1))
    kt = round(add(st, k0))

    # even round keys
    rk = Array.new(nr + 1)
    tmv = Array.new(nb, 0x0001000100010001)
    init = key.dup
    r = 0
    loop do
      rk[r] = even_key(kt, tmv, init[0, nb])
      break if r == nr
      if nk != nb
        r += 2
        tmv = tmv.map { |w| (w << 1) & MASK }
        rk[r] = even_key(kt, tmv, init[nb, nb])
        break if r == nr
      end
      r += 2
      tmv = tmv.map { |w| (w << 1) & MASK }
      init = init.rotate(1)
    end

    # odd round keys: byte-rotation of the preceding even key
    rot = 2 * nb + 3
    (1...nr).step(2) do |i|
      b = rk[i - 1].pack("Q<*")
      rk[i] = (b[rot..] + b[0, rot]).unpack("Q<*")
    end
    @rk = rk
  end
end

module KalynaFile
  MAGIC = "KLN1"
  SALT_LEN = 16
  NONCE_LEN = 8
  TAG_LEN = 32
  CHUNK = 64 * 1024 # multiple of the 16-byte block
  OAEP = { "rsa_padding_mode" => "oaep", "rsa_oaep_md" => "sha256", "rsa_mgf1_md" => "sha256" }.freeze

  # Known-answer tests; the cipher refuses to run if they fail.
  KATS = [
    [128, "000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f", "101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f",
     "81bf1c7d779bac20e1c9ea39b4d2ad06"],
    [128, (0..0x1f).map { |i| format("%02x", i) }.join, "202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f",
     "58ec3e091000158a1148f7166f334f14"]
  ].freeze

  module_function

  def load_sboxes(path)
    lines = File.readlines(path, chomp: true).map(&:strip).reject { |l| l.empty? || l.start_with?("#") }
    raise "S-box file must contain 4 lines" unless lines.size == 4
    boxes = lines.map do |l|
      raise "each S-box line must be 512 hex chars" unless l.match?(/\A\h{512}\z/)
      [l].pack("H*").bytes.freeze
    end
    boxes.each { |b| raise "S-box is not a permutation" unless b.uniq.size == 256 }
    boxes.freeze
  end

  def self_test!(sboxes)
    KATS.each do |bits, key, pt, ct|
      got = Kalyna.new([key].pack("H*"), block_bits: 128, sboxes: sboxes)
                  .encrypt_block([pt].pack("H*")).unpack1("H*")
      raise "Kalyna self-test failed (Kalyna-128/#{bits * (key.size / 2 * 8 / bits)}): " \
            "got #{got}, expected #{ct}. Check your S-box table." unless got == ct
    end
  end

  def ctr(cipher, nonce)
    counter = 0
    lambda do |data|
      data.bytes.each_slice(16).flat_map do |blk|
        ks = cipher.encrypt_block(nonce + [counter].pack("Q>")).bytes
        counter += 1
        blk.each_with_index.map { |b, i| b ^ ks[i] }
      end.pack("C*")
    end
  end

  def derive(master, salt)
    okm = OpenSSL::KDF.hkdf(master, salt: salt, info: "kalyna-file-v1", length: 64, hash: "SHA256")
    [okm[0, 32], okm[32, 32]]
  end

  def encrypt(input, output, pubkey_path, sboxes)
    pub = OpenSSL::PKey.read(File.binread(pubkey_path))
    master = OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(32)
    wrapped = pub.encrypt(master, OAEP)
    salt = OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(SALT_LEN)
    nonce = OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(NONCE_LEN)
    enc_key, mac_key = derive(master, salt)

    cipher = Kalyna.new(enc_key, block_bits: 128, sboxes: sboxes)
    stream = ctr(cipher, nonce)
    mac = OpenSSL::HMAC.new(mac_key, "SHA256")
    header = MAGIC + [wrapped.bytesize].pack("n") + wrapped + salt + nonce

    File.open(input, "rb") do |inf|
      File.open(output, "wb") do |outf|
        outf.write(header)
        mac.update(header)
        while (data = inf.read(CHUNK))
          ct = stream.call(data)
          mac.update(ct)
          outf.write(ct)
        end
        outf.write(mac.digest)
      end
    end
  end

  def decrypt(input, output, privkey_path, sboxes)
    priv = OpenSSL::PKey.read(File.binread(privkey_path))
    File.open(input, "rb") do |inf|
      raise "not a KLN1 file" unless inf.read(4) == MAGIC
      wlen = inf.read(2).unpack1("n")
      wrapped = inf.read(wlen)
      salt = inf.read(SALT_LEN)
      nonce = inf.read(NONCE_LEN)
      header_len = 4 + 2 + wlen + SALT_LEN + NONCE_LEN
      ct_len = inf.size - header_len - TAG_LEN
      raise "file too short" if ct_len < 0

      master = priv.decrypt(wrapped, OAEP)
      enc_key, mac_key = derive(master, salt)

      # pass 1: verify the tag before releasing any plaintext
      inf.rewind
      mac = OpenSSL::HMAC.new(mac_key, "SHA256")
      mac.update(inf.read(header_len))
      remaining = ct_len
      while remaining > 0
        mac.update(inf.read([CHUNK, remaining].min))
        remaining -= [CHUNK, remaining].min
      end
      tag = inf.read(TAG_LEN)
      raise "authentication failed" unless OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(mac.digest, tag)

      # pass 2: decrypt
      inf.seek(header_len)
      stream = ctr(Kalyna.new(enc_key, block_bits: 128, sboxes: sboxes), nonce)
      File.open(output, "wb") do |outf|
        remaining = ct_len
        while remaining > 0
          n = [CHUNK, remaining].min
          outf.write(stream.call(inf.read(n)))
          remaining -= n
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module AddressParser
  class Parser
    attr_reader :options
    
    def initialize(options = {})
      @options = {
        strict: false,
        country: 'USA',
        auto_correct: true
      }.merge(options)
    end
    
    def parse(text)
      return nil if text.blank?
      
      address = Models::Address.new(raw_address: text.strip)
      
      # Try different parsing strategies
      parsed = parse_with_street_address_gem(text) ||
               parse_with_regex(text) ||
               parse_with_geocoder(text)
      
      if parsed
        address.street_number = parsed[:street_number]
        address.street_name = parsed[:street_name]
        address.street_type = parsed[:street_type]
        address.unit_type = parsed[:unit_type]
        address.unit_number = parsed[:unit_number]
        address.city = parsed[:city]
        address.state = parsed[:state]
        address.zip_code = parsed[:zip_code]
        address.zip_plus_four = parsed[:zip_plus_four]
        address.confidence_score = parsed[:confidence_score] || 0.5
      end
      
      address
    end
    
    private
    
    def parse_with_street_address_gem(text)
      begin
        result = StreetAddress::US.parse(text)
        return nil unless result
        
        {
          street_number: result.number,
          street_name: result.street,
          street_type: result.street_type,
          unit_type: parse_unit_type(result.unit),
          unit_number: parse_unit_number(result.unit),
          city: result.city,
          state: result.state,
          zip_code: result.postal_code,
          zip_plus_four: result.postal_code_ext,
          confidence_score: 0.8
        }
      rescue => e
        nil
      end
    end
    
    def parse_with_regex(text)
      # Comprehensive regex patterns for US addresses
      patterns = [
        # Pattern 1: Standard address with unit
        /(\d+)\s+([A-Za-z0-9\s\.]+?)\s+(St|Street|Ave|Avenue|Blvd|Boulevard|Rd|Road|Ln|Lane|Dr|Drive|Ct|Court|Pl|Place|Ter|Terrace|Way|Cir|Circle|Pkwy|Parkway|Hwy|Highway)\s*(?:,?\s*(Apt|Apartment|Suite|Ste|Unit|#)\s*([\w-]+))?\s*,?\s*([A-Za-z\s]+?)\s*,?\s*([A-Z]{2})\s*,?\s*(\d{5})(?:-(\d{4}))?/i,
        
        # Pattern 2: PO Box
        /(P\.?O\.?\s*Box\s+\d+)\s*,?\s*([A-Za-z\s]+?)\s*,?\s*([A-Z]{2})\s*,?\s*(\d{5})(?:-(\d{4}))?/i,
        
        # Pattern 3: Rural Route
        /(RR\s+\d+\s+Box\s+\d+)\s*,?\s*([A-Za-z\s]+?)\s*,?\s*([A-Z]{2})\s*,?\s*(\d{5})(?:-(\d{4}))?/i
      ]
      
      patterns.each do |pattern|
        if match = text.match(pattern)
          return extract_from_match(match)
        end
      end
      
      nil
    end
    
    def parse_with_geocoder(text)
      return nil unless options[:use_geocoder]
      
      begin
        results = Geocoder.search(text, params: {countrycodes: 'us'})
        return nil if results.empty?
        
        result = results.first
        {
          street_number: result.house_number,
          street_name: result.street,
          street_type: result.street_type,
          city: result.city,
          state: result.state_code,
          zip_code: result.postal_code,
          zip_plus_four: result.postal_code_suffix,
          confidence_score: 0.6
        }
      rescue => e
        nil
      end
    end
    
    def extract_from_match(match)
      if match[1].to_s.include?('Box') || match[1].to_s.include?('RR')
        # PO Box or Rural Route
        {
          street_name: match[1],
          city: match[2],
          state: match[3],
          zip_code: match[4],
          zip_plus_four: match[5],
          confidence_score: 0.7
        }
      else
        {
          street_number: match[1],
          street_name: match[2].strip,
          street_type: match[3],
          unit_type: match[4],
          unit_number: match[5],
          city: match[6].strip,
          state: match[7],
          zip_code: match[8],
          zip_plus_four: match[9],
          confidence_score: 0.9
        }
      end
    end
    
    def parse_unit_type(unit)
      return nil unless unit
      
      if unit.match?(/apt|apartment/i)
        'Apt'
      elsif unit.match?(/suite|ste/i)
        'Suite'
      elsif unit.match?(/unit/i)
        'Unit'
      elsif unit.match?(/^#/)
        '#'
      else
        unit
      end
    end
    
    def parse_unit_number(unit)
      return nil unless unit
      
      unit.gsub(/^(apt|apartment|suite|ste|unit|#)\s*/i, '')
    end
  end
end

```ruby
module AddressParser
  class Extractor
    attr_reader :options
    
    def initialize(options = {})
      @options = {
        max_addresses: 10,
        min_confidence: 0.5,
        include_context: false
      }.merge(options)
    end
    
    def extract(text)
      return [] if text.blank?
      
      addresses = []
      parser = Parser.new(options)
      normalizer = Normalizer.new(options)
      
      # Extract potential address candidates using regex
      candidates = extract_candidates(text)
      
      candidates.each do |candidate|
        break if addresses.length >= options[:max_addresses]
        
        address = parser.parse(candidate[:text])
        next unless address && address.valid?
        
        address.confidence_score = candidate[:confidence] * (address.confidence_score || 0.5)
        next if address.confidence_score < options[:min_confidence]
        
        address = normalizer.normalize(address)
        address.raw_address = candidate[:text]
        
        if options[:include_context]
          address.instance_variable_set(:@context, candidate[:context])
          address.define_singleton_method(:context) { @context }
        end
        
        addresses << address
      end
      
      addresses
    end
    
    private
    
    def extract_candidates(text)
      candidates = []
      
      # Pattern for complete addresses
      address_pattern = /
        (?:
          \d+\s+[A-Za-z0-9\s\.]+?\s+(?:St|Street|Ave|Avenue|Blvd|Boulevard|Rd|Road|Ln|Lane|Dr|Drive|Ct|Court|Pl|Place|Ter|Terrace|Way|Cir|Circle|Pkwy|Parkway|Hwy|Highway)
          |
          P\.?O\.?\s*Box\s+\d+
          |
          RR\s+\d+\s+Box\s+\d+
        )
        \s*(?:,?\s*(?:Apt|Apartment|Suite|Ste|Unit|#)\s*[\w-]+)?
        \s*,?\s*[A-Za-z\s]+?
        \s*,?\s*[A-Z]{2}\s*,?\s*\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?
      /ix
      
      # Find all matches with context
      text.to_enum(:scan, address_pattern).each do
        match = Regexp.last_match
        start_pos = match.begin(0)
        end_pos = match.end(0)
        
        # Get context (100 characters before and after)
        context_start = [0, start_pos - 100].max
        context_end = [text.length, end_pos + 100].min
        
        candidates << {
          text: match[0].strip,
          confidence: calculate_confidence(match[0]),
          context: text[context_start...context_end]
        }
      end
      
      # Sort by confidence and position
      candidates.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:confidence], c[:context].index(c[:text]) || 0] }
      
      candidates
    end
    
    def calculate_confidence(address_text)
      confidence = 0.5
      
      # Increase confidence based on completeness
      confidence += 0.1 if address_text.match?(/\d{5}/)  # Has zip code
      confidence += 0.1 if address_text.match?(/[A-Z]{2}/)  # Has state
      confidence += 0.1 if address_text.match?(/\d+\s+[A-Za-z]/)  # Has street number
      confidence += 0.1 if address_text.match?(/(?:St|Street|Ave|Avenue|Blvd|Boulevard|Rd|Road|Ln|Lane|Dr|Drive|Ct|Court|Pl|Place|Ter|Terrace|Way|Cir|Circle|Pkwy|Parkway|Hwy|Highway)/i)
      confidence += 0.05 if address_text.match?(/(?:Apt|Apartment|Suite|Ste|Unit|#)/i)
      
      [confidence, 1.0].min
    end
  end
end

module AddressParser
  class Validator
    attr_reader :options
    
    VALID_STATES = %w[
      AL AK AZ AR CA CO CT DE DC FL GA HI ID IL IN IA KS KY LA ME MD 
      MA MI MN MS MO MT NE NV NH NJ NM NY NC ND OH OK OR PA RI SC SD 
      TN TX UT VT VA WA WV WI WY
    ].freeze
    
    def initialize(options = {})
      @options = {
        require_zip: true,
        require_state: true,
        strict_zip: false,
        validate_against_usps: false
      }.merge(options)
    end
    
    def validate(address)
      return false unless address.is_a?(Models::Address)
      
      errors = []
      
      # Validate required fields
      errors << 'Street name is required' if address.street_name.blank?
      errors << 'City is required' if address.city.blank?
      
      if options[:require_state]
        if address.state.blank?
          errors << 'State is required'
        elsif !valid_state?(address.state)
          errors << "Invalid state: #{address.state}"
        end
      end
      
      if options[:require_zip]
        if address.zip_code.blank?
          errors << 'ZIP code is required'
        elsif !valid_zip?(address.zip_code)
          errors << "Invalid ZIP code: #{address.zip_code}"
        end
      end
      
      # Validate format
      if address.street_number.present? && !address.street_number.match?(/^\d+[A-Za-z]?$/)
        errors << "Invalid street number: #{address.street_number}"
      end
      
      if address.zip_plus_four.present? && !address.zip_plus_four.match?(/^\d{4}$/)
        errors << "Invalid ZIP+4: #{address.zip_plus_four}"
      end
      
      # Validate against USPS if requested
      if options[:validate_against_usps] && errors.empty?
        usps_errors = validate_against_usps(address)
        errors.concat(usps_errors) if usps_errors
      end
      
      {
        valid: errors.empty?,
        errors: errors
      }
    end
    
    private
    
    def valid_state?(state)
      VALID_STATES.include?(state.to_s.upcase)
    end
    
    def valid_zip?(zip)
      if options[:strict_zip]
        zip.to_s.match?(/^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$/)
      else
        zip.to_s.match?(/^\d{5}$/)
      end
    end
    
    def validate_against_usps(address)
      # This would integrate with USPS Address Validation API
      # For now, return empty array (no errors)
      []
    end
  end

require 'spec_helper'

RSpec.describe AddressParser do
  describe '.parse' do
    context 'with standard address' do
      let(:address_text) { '123 Main Street, Apt 4B, Springfield, IL 62704' }
      
      it 'parses the address correctly' do
        address = AddressParser.parse(address_text)
        
        expect(address).to be_a(AddressParser::Models::Address)
        expect(address.street_number).to eq('123')
        expect(address.street_name).to eq('Main')
        expect(address.street_type).to eq('St')
        expect(address.unit_type).to eq('Apt')
        expect(address.unit_number).to eq('4B')
        expect(address.city).to eq('Springfield')
        expect(address.state).to eq('IL')
        expect(address.zip_code).to eq('62704')
      end
    end
    
    context 'with PO Box address' do
      let(:address_text) { 'PO Box 1234, Denver, CO 80201' }
      
      it 'parses PO Box addresses' do
        address = AddressParser.parse(address_text)
        
        expect(address.street_name).to include('PO Box')
        expect(address.city).to eq('Denver')
        expect(address.state).to eq('CO')
        expect(address.zip_code).to eq('80201')
      end
    end
  end
  
  describe '.extract' do
    context 'with multiple addresses in text' do
      let(:text) do
        "Please send the package to 456 Oak Avenue, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97205. " \
        "The billing address is 789 Pine Street, New York, NY 10001."
      end
      
      it 'extracts all addresses from text' do
        addresses = AddressParser.extract(text)
        
        expect(addresses.length).to eq(2)
        expect(addresses[0].city).to eq('Portland')
        expect(addresses[1].city).to eq('New York')
      end
    end
  end
  
  describe '.normalize' do
    context 'with full state names and street types' do
      let(:address) do
        AddressParser::Models::Address.new(
          street_number: '123',
          street_name: 'main',
          street_type: 'street',
          city: 'springfield',
          state: 'illinois',
          zip_code: '62704'
        )
      end
      
      it 'normalizes the address' do
        normalized = AddressParser.normalize(address)
        
        expect(normalized.street_name).to eq('Main')
        expect(normalized.street_type).to eq('St')
        expect(normalized.city).to eq('Springfield')
        expect(normalized.state).to eq('IL')
      end
    end
  end
  
  describe '.validate' do
    context 'with valid address' do
      let(:address) do
        AddressParser::Models::Address.new(
          street_number: '123',
          street_name: 'Main',
          street_type: 'St',
          city: 'Springfield',
          state: 'IL',
          zip_code: '62704'
        )
      end
      
      it 'returns valid result' do
        result = AddressParser.validate(address)
        
        expect(result[:valid]).to be true
        expect(result[:errors]).to be_empty
      end
    end
    
    context 'with invalid address' do
      let(:address) do
        AddressParser::Models::Address.new(
          street_name: 'Main',
          city: 'Springfield',
          state: 'XX',
          zip_code: '123'

      end
      
      it 'returns invalid result with errors' do
        result = AddressParser.validate(address)
        
        expect(result[:valid]).to be false
        expect(result[:errors]).to include('Invalid state: XX')
        expect(result[:errors]).to include('Invalid ZIP code: 123')

    end
  end

# Address Parser

Бібліотека для розбору, нормалізації та валідації поштових адрес США з довільного тексту.

## Встановлення

Додайте до вашого Gemfile:

```ruby
gem 'address_parser', path: 'path/to/address_parser'
```

Потім виконайте:

```bash
bundle install
```

## Використання

### Розбір адреси

```ruby
address = AddressParser.parse("123 Main Street, Apt 4B, Springfield, IL 62704")

puts address.street_number  # => "123"
puts address.street_name    # => "Main"
puts address.city           # => "Springfield"
puts address.state          # => "IL"
puts address.zip_code       # => "62704"
```

### Витяг адрес з тексту

```ruby
text = "Please send to 456 Oak Ave, Portland, OR 97205. Billing: 789 Pine St, New York, NY 10001"
addresses = AddressParser.extract(text)

addresses.each do |addr|
  puts addr.full_address
end
```

### Нормалізація

```ruby
address = AddressParser::Models::Address.new(
  street_name: 'main',
  street_type: 'street',
  city: 'springfield',
  state: 'illinois'
)

normalized = AddressParser.normalize(address)
puts normalized.street_name  # => "Main"
puts normalized.street_type  # => "St"
puts normalized.state        # => "IL"
```

### Валідація

```ruby
result = AddressParser.validate(address)

if result[:valid]
  puts "Address is valid"
else
  puts "Errors: #{result[:errors].join(', ')}"
end
```

## Ліцензія

MIT
```

# Підписання документа Дія.Підписом у Rails **Важливо.** Публічного «SDK» для Дія.Підпису немає. Інтеграція працює через партнерське API Дії (`api2.diia.gov.ua`), доступ до якого видається після реєстрації як партнер (acquirer). У коді нижче я відтворив схему за пам'яттю, тому **точні шляхи, назви полів і формат callback перевірте за актуальною документацією партнерського API**. Я виніс їх у конфігурацію, щоб змінювати без правок логіки. Схема роботи: 1. Користувач завантажує файл, а Rails рахує SHA-256 хеш. Сам файл у Дію не передається. 2. Rails автентифікується в Дії, створює запит на підписання хешу й отримує `deeplink`. 3. Користувач відкриває QR-код або посилання в застосунку Дія й підтверджує підпис. 4. Дія викликає callback у вашому Rails-застосунку з підписом (CAdES, `.p7s`), який ми зберігаємо. ## Gemfile ```ruby source "https://rubygems.org" ruby "~> 3.3" gem "rails", "~> 7.1" gem "pg", "~> 1.5" gem "puma", ">= 6.0" # HTTP-клієнт для Дія API gem "faraday", "~> 2.9" gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2" # QR-код для відкриття підпису в застосунку Дія gem "rqrcode", "~> 2.2" gem "bootsnap", require: false group :development, :test do gem "dotenv-rails" gem "rspec-rails", "~> 6.1" gem "webmock", "~> 3.23" end ``` ## Конфігурація `rails credentials:edit`: ```yaml diia: host: https://api2.diia.gov.ua # для тестів — стенд, наданий Дією acquirer_token: "ВАШ_ACQUIRER_TOKEN" auth_token: "ВАШ_AUTH_ACQUIRER_TOKEN" branch_id: "ВАШ_BRANCH_ID" offer_id: "ВАШ_OFFER_ID" # offer зі scope hashedFilesSigning callback_secret: "довгий_випадковий_рядок" ``` `config/initializers/diia.rb`: ```ruby module Diia Config = Struct.new( :host, :acquirer_token, :auth_token, :branch_id, :offer_id, :callback_secret, :auth_path, :sign_request_path, keyword_init: true ) def self.config @config ||= begin creds = Rails.application.credentials.diia || {} Config.new( host: creds[:host] || "https://api2.diia.gov.ua", acquirer_token: creds[:acquirer_token], auth_token: creds[:auth_token], branch_id: creds[:branch_id], offer_id: creds[:offer_id], callback_secret: creds[:callback_secret], # Шляхи винесено в конфіг: звірте з актуальною документацією auth_path: "/api/v1/auth/acquirer/%s", sign_request_path: "/api/v2/acquirers/branch/%s/offer-request/dynamic" ) end end end ``` ## Міграція та модель ```ruby # db/migrate/20240101000000_create_documents.rb class CreateDocuments < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1] def change create_table :documents do |t| t.string :title, null: false t.string :file_name, null: false t.string :content_hash, null: false # base64(SHA-256) t.string :status, null: false, default: "draft" t.string :request_id t.text :deeplink t.text :error_message t.datetime :signed_at t.timestamps end add_index :documents, :request_id, unique: true end end ``` Перед міграцією виконайте `bin/rails active_storage:install`. ```ruby # app/models/document.rb class Document < ApplicationRecord STATUSES = %w[draft awaiting_signature signed failed].freeze has_one_attached :file has_one_attached :signature # .p7s validates :title, presence: true validates :status, inclusion: { in: STATUSES } validate :file_presence STATUSES.each do |s| define_method(:"#{s}?") { status == s } end private def file_presence errors.add(:file, "обов'язковий") unless file.attached? end end ``` ## HTTP-клієнт Дії ```ruby # app/services/diia/client.rb require "base64" module Diia class Error < StandardError; end class Client TOKEN_CACHE_KEY = "diia/session_token".freeze TOKEN_TTL = 50.minutes # сесійний токен Дії живе ~1 годину def initialize(config: Diia.config) @config = config end # POST із автоматичною повторною автентифікацією при 401 def post(path, body) response = authorized_post(path, body) if response.status == 401 Rails.cache.delete(TOKEN_CACHE_KEY) response = authorized_post(path, body) end handle(response) end private attr_reader :config def authorized_post(path, body) connection.post(path) do |req| req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{session_token}" req.body = body end end def session_token Rails.cache.fetch(TOKEN_CACHE_KEY, expires_in: TOKEN_TTL) { authenticate } end def authenticate path = format(config.auth_path, acquirer_token: config.acquirer_token) response = connection.get(path) do |req| req.headers["Authorization"] = "Basic #{Base64.strict_encode64(config.auth_token.to_s)}" end token = handle(response)["token"] raise Error, "Дія не повернула токен сесії" if token.blank? token end def handle(response) return response.body if response.success? && response.body.is_a?(Hash) raise Error, "Дія API: HTTP #{response.status} — #{response.body.to_s.truncate(500)}" end def connection @connection ||= Faraday.new(url: config.host) do |f| f.request :json f.request :retry, max: 2, interval: 0.3, retry_statuses: [502, 503, 504], methods: %i[get] # POST не повторюємо автоматично f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/ f.options.timeout = 15 f.options.open_timeout = 5 f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter end end end end ``` ## Сервіс підписання ```ruby # app/services/diia/document_signer.rb require "digest" require "securerandom" require "base64" module Diia class DocumentSigner def initialize(document, client: Client.new, config: Diia.config) @document = document @client = client @config = config end # Створює запит на підписання й повертає deeplink def request_signature! request_id = SecureRandom.uuid body = { offerId: config.offer_id, requestId: request_id, data: { hashedFilesSigning: { hashedFiles: [ { fileName: document.file_name, fileHash: document.content_hash } ] } } } path = format(config.sign_request_path, branch_id: config.branch_id) result = client.post(path, body) deeplink = result["deeplink"] raise Error, "Дія не повернула deeplink" if deeplink.blank? document.update!( request_id: request_id, deeplink: deeplink, status: "awaiting_signature", error_message: nil ) deeplink rescue Error, Faraday::Error => e document.update!(status: "failed", error_message: e.message) raise end # Обчислення хешу, який підписується (base64 від SHA-256) def self.hash_for(io) Base64.strict_encode64(Digest::SHA256.digest(io.read)).tap { io.rewind } end private attr_reader :document, :client, :config end end ``` Обробник callback: ```ruby # app/services/diia/callback_processor.rb require "base64" module Diia class CallbackProcessor def initialize(payload) @payload = payload.to_h.with_indifferent_access end def call request_id = payload[:request_id] || payload[:requestId] document = Document.find_by(request_id: request_id) return :unknown_request unless document return :already_processed if document.signed? item = Array(payload[:signed_items] || payload[:signedItems]).first signature_b64 = item && (item[:signature] || item["signature"]) if signature_b64.blank? document.update!(status: "failed", error_message: "Підпис відсутній у відповіді Дії") return :failed end document.transaction do document.signature.attach( io: StringIO.new(Base64.decode64(signature_b64)), filename: "#{document.file_name}.p7s", content_type: "application/pkcs7-signature" ) document.update!(status: "signed", signed_at: Time.current) end :ok end private attr_reader :payload end end ``` ## Маршрути ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :documents, only: %i[new create show] do member do post :sign get :status end end # секрет у шляху — проста перевірка автентичності виклику від Дії post "/diia/callback/:secret", to: "diia/callbacks#create", as: :diia_callback root "documents#new" end ``` ## Контролери ```ruby # app/controllers/documents_controller.rb class DocumentsController < ApplicationController before_action :set_document, only: %i[show sign status] def new @document = Document.new end def create @document = Document.new(title: params.dig(:document, :title)) uploaded = params.dig(:document, :file) if uploaded.present? @document.file.attach(uploaded) @document.file_name = uploaded.original_filename @document.content_hash = Diia::DocumentSigner.hash_for(uploaded.tempfile) end if @document.save redirect_to @document else render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end def show return unless @document.awaiting_signature? && @document.deeplink.present? @qr_svg = RQRCode::QRCode.new(@document.deeplink).as_svg( module_size: 4, standalone: true, use_path: true ) end def sign Diia::DocumentSigner.new(@document).request_signature! redirect_to @document rescue Diia::Error, Faraday::Error => e Rails.logger.error("[Diia] #{e.class}: #{e.message}") redirect_to @document, alert: "Не вдалося створити запит на підпис. Спробуйте пізніше." end def status render json: { status: @document.status } end private def set_document @document = Document.find(params[:id]) end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/diia/callbacks_controller.rb module Diia class CallbacksController < ApplicationController skip_forgery_protection def create expected = Diia.config.callback_secret.to_s unless expected.present? && ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(params[:secret].to_s, expected) return head :not_found end result = CallbackProcessor.new( request.request_parameters.presence || JSON.parse(request.raw_post) ).call Rails.logger.info("[Diia] callback result=#{result}") head :ok rescue JSON::ParserError head :bad_request end end end ``` ## Представлення ```erb <%# app/views/documents/new.html.erb %>

Підписати документ Дія.Підписом

<%= form_with model: @document, url: documents_path do |f| %> <% @document.errors.full_messages.each do |m| %>

<%= m %>

<% end %>

<%= f.label :title, "Назва" %>
<%= f.text_field :title %>

<%= f.label :file, "Файл" %>
<%= f.file_field :file %>

<%= f.submit "Завантажити" %> <% end %> ``` ```erb <%# app/views/documents/show.html.erb %>

<%= @document.title %>

Файл: <%= @document.file_name %>

Хеш (SHA-256, base64): <%= @document.content_hash %>

<%= alert %>

<% if @document.draft? || @document.failed? %> <% if @document.failed? %>

Помилка: <%= @document.error_message %>

<% end %> <%= button_to "Підписати через Дія.Підпис", sign_document_path(@document), method: :post %> <% elsif @document.awaiting_signature? %>

Відскануйте QR-код у застосунку Дія або відкрийте посилання на телефоні:

<%= raw @qr_svg %>

<%= link_to "Відкрити в Дії", @document.deeplink %>

Очікуємо підтвердження…

<% elsif @document.signed? %>

✅ Підписано <%= l @document.signed_at, format: :short %>

<%= link_to "Завантажити документ", rails_blob_path(@document.file, disposition: "attachment") %> | <%= link_to "Завантажити підпис (.p7s)", rails_blob_path(@document.signature, disposition: "attachment") %>

<% end %> ``` ## Тест сервісу (RSpec + WebMock) ```ruby # spec/services/diia/document_signer_spec.rb require "rails_helper" RSpec.describe Diia::DocumentSigner do let(:config) do Diia::Config.new( host: "https://diia.test", acquirer_token: "acq", auth_token: "auth", branch_id: "br1", offer_id: "of1", callback_secret: "s", auth_path: "/api/v1/auth/acquirer/%s", sign_request_path: "/api/v2/acquirers/branch/%s/offer-request/dynamic" ) end let(:document) do Document.new(title: "Договір", file_name: "a.pdf", content_hash: "aGFzaA==").tap do |d| d.file.attach(io: StringIO.new("pdf"), filename: "a.pdf") d.save! end end before { Rails.cache.clear } it "створює запит і зберігає deeplink" do stub_request(:get, "https://diia.test/api/v1/auth/acquirer/acq") .to_return(status: 200, body: { token: "T" }.to_json, headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json" }) stub_request(:post, "https://diia.test/api/v2/acquirers/branch/br1/offer-request/dynamic") .with(headers: { "Authorization" => "Bearer T" }) .to_return(status: 200, body: { deeplink: "https://diia.app/x" }.to_json, headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json" }) described_class.new(document, client: Diia::Client.new(config: config), config: config).request_signature! expect(document.reload).to be_awaiting_signature expect(document.deeplink).to eq("https://diia.app/x") end end ``` ## Що врахувати перед продакшном - **Формат callback.** Залежно від типу offer Дія може повертати дані зашифрованими (`encodeData`, шифрування вашим публічним ключем). Тоді в `CallbackProcessor` потрібно спершу розшифрувати payload. Для цього підійде `OpenSSL::PKey::RSA` разом з `OpenSSL::Cipher`, а точну схему дивіться в документації. - **Перевірка підпису.** Отриманий `.p7s` варто перевірити, наприклад через ІІТ або бібліотеку перевірки КЕП. Перевірте, що він відповідає `content_hash`, і лише потім ставте статус `signed`. - **Безпека callback.** Секрет у URL лише мінімальний захист. Додайте allowlist IP Дії, HTTPS і rate limiting (наприклад, `rack-attack`). - **Фонові задачі.** Обробку callback і перевірку підпису краще винести в Active Job, щоб швидко повертати `200 OK`. - **Тайм-аут.** Додайте задачу, яка переводить запити в `awaiting_signature` старші за кілька хвилин у стан `failed` або `expired`. - **Кеш.** У production для кешу токена потрібен спільний store (Redis або Solid Cache), а не `memory_store`.

text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.1"

gem "plaid", ">= 25.0"          # Official Plaid API client
gem "activerecord", "~> 7.2"    # ORM (includes ActiveRecord::Encryption)
gem "sqlite3", ">= 1.6"         # Swap for "pg" or "mysql2" in production
gem "dotenv", "~> 3.0"          # Loads credentials from .env
gem "bigdecimal"                # Exact money arithmetic
gem "base64"                    # Needed by ActiveRecord on newer Rubies
```

## .env

```bash
PLAID_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
PLAID_SECRET=your_sandbox_secret
PLAID_ENV=sandbox                # sandbox | production
DATABASE_PATH=plaid.sqlite3

# Keys for encrypting access tokens at rest. Generate each with:
#   ruby -rsecurerandom -e 'puts SecureRandom.hex(32)'
AR_ENC_PRIMARY_KEY=...
AR_ENC_DETERMINISTIC_KEY=...
AR_ENC_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT=...
```

## plaid_sync.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
#
# Usage:
#   bundle install
#   bundle exec ruby plaid_sync.rb link_sandbox   # create a sandbox bank connection (testing only)
#   bundle exec ruby plaid_sync.rb sync           # pull balances + transactions into the DB
#   bundle exec ruby plaid_sync.rb report         # print what's stored

require "bundler/setup"
require "dotenv/load"
require "json"
require "bigdecimal"
require "logger"
require "active_record"
require "plaid"

LOGGER = Logger.new($stdout)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database + encryption setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ActiveRecord::Encryption.configure(
  primary_key:         ENV.fetch("AR_ENC_PRIMARY_KEY"),
  deterministic_key:   ENV.fetch("AR_ENC_DETERMINISTIC_KEY"),
  key_derivation_salt: ENV.fetch("AR_ENC_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT")
)

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter:  "sqlite3",
  database: ENV.fetch("DATABASE_PATH", "plaid.sqlite3")
)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  unless table_exists?(:plaid_items)
    create_table :plaid_items do |t|
      t.string :item_id, null: false
      t.text   :access_token, null: false       # encrypted by the model
      t.string :institution_name
      t.text   :sync_cursor                      # Plaid transactions/sync cursor
      t.datetime :last_synced_at
      t.timestamps
    end
    add_index :plaid_items, :item_id, unique: true
  end

  unless table_exists?(:accounts)
    create_table :accounts do |t|
      t.references :plaid_item, null: false, foreign_key: true
      t.string  :plaid_account_id, null: false
      t.string  :name
      t.string  :mask
      t.string  :account_type
      t.string  :subtype
      t.string  :iso_currency_code
      t.decimal :current_balance,   precision: 14, scale: 2
      t.decimal :available_balance, precision: 14, scale: 2
      t.datetime :balance_updated_at
      t.timestamps
    end
    add_index :accounts, :plaid_account_id, unique: true
  end

  unless table_exists?(:transactions)
    create_table :transactions do |t|
      t.references :account, null: false, foreign_key: true
      t.string  :plaid_transaction_id, null: false
      t.decimal :amount, precision: 14, scale: 2, null: false  # Plaid: positive = money out
      t.string  :iso_currency_code
      t.date    :date, null: false
      t.string  :name
      t.string  :merchant_name
      t.string  :category
      t.boolean :pending, null: false, default: false
      t.timestamps
    end
    add_index :transactions, :plaid_transaction_id, unique: true
    add_index :transactions, %i[account_id date]
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PlaidItem < ActiveRecord::Base
  encrypts :access_token          # never store bank access tokens in plaintext
  has_many :accounts, dependent: :destroy
end

class Account < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :plaid_item
  has_many :transactions, dependent: :destroy
end

class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :account
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plaid client
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

module PlaidClientFactory
  def self.build
    config = Plaid::Configuration.new
    config.server_index = Plaid::Configuration::Environment.fetch(ENV.fetch("PLAID_ENV", "sandbox"))
    config.api_key["PLAID-CLIENT-ID"] = ENV.fetch("PLAID_CLIENT_ID")
    config.api_key["PLAID-SECRET"]    = ENV.fetch("PLAID_SECRET")
    Plaid::PlaidApi.new(Plaid::ApiClient.new(config))
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync service
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PlaidSyncer
  MAX_RESTARTS = 3

  def initialize(client = PlaidClientFactory.build)
    @client = client
  end

  # Sandbox only: creates a fake bank connection and stores the access token.
  def link_sandbox_item(institution_id: "ins_109508") # "First Platypus Bank"
    public_token = @client.sandbox_public_token_create(
      Plaid::SandboxPublicTokenCreateRequest.new(
        institution_id:   institution_id,
        initial_products: [Plaid::Products::TRANSACTIONS]
      )
    ).public_token

    exchange = @client.item_public_token_exchange(
      Plaid::ItemPublicTokenExchangeRequest.new(public_token: public_token)
    )

    item = PlaidItem.find_or_initialize_by(item_id: exchange.item_id)
    item.access_token     = exchange.access_token
    item.institution_name = institution_id
    item.save!
    LOGGER.info("Linked item #{item.item_id}")
    item
  end

  def sync_all
    PlaidItem.find_each { |item| sync_item(item) }
  end

  def sync_item(item)
    with_plaid_errors(item) do
      sync_accounts(item)
      sync_transactions(item)
      item.update!(last_synced_at: Time.current)
    end
  end

  private

  # --- Accounts & balances --------------------------------------------------

  def sync_accounts(item)
    response = @client.accounts_get(
      Plaid::AccountsGetRequest.new(access_token: item.access_token)
    )
    now = Time.current

    response.accounts.each do |acct|
      record = item.accounts.find_or_initialize_by(plaid_account_id: acct.account_id)
      record.assign_attributes(
        name:               acct.name,
        mask:               acct.mask,
        account_type:       acct.type.to_s,
        subtype:            acct.subtype.to_s,
        iso_currency_code:  acct.balances.iso_currency_code,
        current_balance:    to_decimal(acct.balances.current),
        available_balance:  to_decimal(acct.balances.available),
        balance_updated_at: now
      )
      record.save!
    end
    LOGGER.info("Synced #{response.accounts.size} account(s) for item #{item.item_id}")
  end

  # --- Transactions (cursor-based /transactions/sync) -----------------------

  def sync_transactions(item)
    restarts = 0
    begin
      added, modified, removed, next_cursor = fetch_all_pages(item)
    rescue Plaid::ApiError => e
      # Data changed while paginating: Plaid says to restart from the original cursor.
      if plaid_error_code(e) == "TRANSACTIONS_SYNC_MUTATION_DURING_PAGINATION" &&
         (restarts += 1) <= MAX_RESTARTS
        LOGGER.warn("Mutation during pagination, restarting (#{restarts}/#{MAX_RESTARTS})")
        retry
      end
      raise
    end

    # Apply all changes and the new cursor atomically, so a crash can't
    # leave the cursor ahead of the stored data.
    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      upsert_transactions(item, added + modified)
      delete_transactions(removed)
      item.update!(sync_cursor: next_cursor)
    end

    LOGGER.info("Transactions: +#{added.size} ~#{modified.size} -#{removed.size}")
  end

  def fetch_all_pages(item)
    cursor = item.sync_cursor
    added, modified, removed = [], [], []

    loop do
      response = @client.transactions_sync(
        Plaid::TransactionsSyncRequest.new(
          access_token: item.access_token,
          cursor:       cursor,
          count:        500
        )
      )
      added    .concat(response.added)
      modified .concat(response.modified)
      removed  .concat(response.removed)
      cursor = response.next_cursor
      break unless response.has_more
    end

    [added, modified, removed, cursor]
  end

  def upsert_transactions(item, plaid_txns)
    return if plaid_txns.empty?

    account_ids = item.accounts.pluck(:plaid_account_id, :id).to_h
    now = Time.current

    rows = plaid_txns.filter_map do |t|
      account_id = account_ids[t.account_id]
      next unless account_id # account not tracked

      {
        account_id:           account_id,
        plaid_transaction_id: t.transaction_id,
        amount:               to_decimal(t.amount),
        iso_currency_code:    t.iso_currency_code,
        date:                 t.date,
        name:                 t.name,
        merchant_name:        t.merchant_name,
        category:             t.personal_finance_category&.primary,
        pending:              t.pending ? true : false,
        created_at:           now,
        updated_at:           now
      }
    end

    # A transaction could appear in both added and modified; keep the last one.
    rows = rows.reverse.uniq { |r| r[:plaid_transaction_id] }.reverse

    rows.each_slice(500) do |batch|
      Transaction.upsert_all(
        batch,
        unique_by: :plaid_transaction_id,
        update_only: %i[account_id amount iso_currency_code date name
                        merchant_name category pending updated_at]
      )
    end
  end

  def delete_transactions(removed)
    ids = removed.map(&:transaction_id)
    Transaction.where(plaid_transaction_id: ids).delete_all if ids.any?
  end

  # --- Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------

  def to_decimal(value)
    value.nil? ? nil : BigDecimal(value.to_s)
  end

  def plaid_error_code(error)
    JSON.parse(error.response_body)["error_code"]
  rescue JSON::ParserError, TypeError
    nil
  end

  def with_plaid_errors(item)
    yield
  rescue Plaid::ApiError => e
    # Log Plaid's error details only; never log access tokens.
    LOGGER.error("Plaid error for item #{item.item_id}: #{plaid_error_code(e)} - #{e.response_body}")
    raise
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def print_report
  Account.includes(:plaid_item).find_each do |a|
    puts format("%-28s ****%-4s current=%10s available=%10s %s",
                a.name, a.mask, a.current_balance&.to_s("F"),
                a.available_balance&.to_s("F"), a.iso_currency_code)
    a.transactions.order(date: :desc).limit(5).each do |t|
      puts format("   %s  %10s  %s%s", t.date, t.amount.to_s("F"), t.name, t.pending ? " (pending)" : "")
    end
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  case ARGV.first
  when "link_sandbox"
    abort "link_sandbox is for the sandbox environment only" unless ENV["PLAID_ENV"] == "sandbox"
    PlaidSyncer.new.link_sandbox_item
  when "sync"
    PlaidSyncer.new.sync_all
  when "report"
    print_report
  else
    puts "Usage: ruby plaid_sync.rb [link_sandbox|sync|report]"
  end
end
```

## Notes

- **Security:** The Plaid `access_token` is encrypted at rest with ActiveRecord Encryption. Keep `.env` out of version control. In production, Plaid's Link flow in your front end produces the `public_token`, which you exchange with `item_public_token_exchange`. The `link_sandbox` command only simulates that for testing.
- **Incremental sync:** `/transactions/sync` uses a stored cursor. The first run pulls history, and later runs fetch only added, modified, and removed transactions. The cursor is saved in the same DB transaction as the data.
- **Idempotency:** Unique indexes and `upsert_all` make `sync` safe to re-run.
- **Amounts:** Stored as `DECIMAL`, not floats. Plaid reports positive amounts as money leaving the account.
- **Production:** Switch to `pg`, set `PLAID_ENV=production`, and run `sync` on a schedule or from Plaid's `SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE` webhook.

## Gemfile

source "https://rubygems.org"

## glovo_kyiv_courier.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"

# Orders an immediate (ASAP) Glovo courier in Kyiv via the Glovo B2B / LaaS API.
#
# Environment variables:
#   GLOVO_API_KEY     - API key from the Glovo partner dashboard
#   GLOVO_API_SECRET  - API secret
#   GLOVO_ENV         - "production" or "sandbox" (default: sandbox)
#
# NOTE: Endpoint paths and payload fields follow Glovo's B2B "orders" API as I
# know it. Confirm them, and the auth scheme enabled for your account (Basic vs
# OAuth bearer token), against the docs for your partner account before going live.
module Glovo
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  Address = Struct.new(:type, :lat, :lon, :label, :contact_phone, :contact_person,
                       :instructions, keyword_init: true) do
    # Rough bounding box around Kyiv
    KYIV_LAT = (50.20..50.65).freeze
    KYIV_LON = (30.20..30.83).freeze

    def validate!
      raise ArgumentError, "label is required" if label.to_s.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "contact_phone must be E.164, e.g. +380501234567" unless contact_phone.to_s.match?(/\A\+\d{10,15}\z/)
      raise ArgumentError, "contact_person is required" if contact_person.to_s.strip.empty?
      unless KYIV_LAT.cover?(lat.to_f) && KYIV_LON.cover?(lon.to_f)
        raise ArgumentError, "#{type} point (#{lat}, #{lon}) is outside the Kyiv area"
      end
      self
    end

    def to_payload
      {
        type: type,
        lat: lat.to_f,
        lon: lon.to_f,
        label: label,
        contactPhone: contact_phone,
        contactPerson: contact_person,
        instructions: instructions
      }.compact
    end
  end

  class Client
    URLS = {
      "production" => "https://api.glovoapp.com",
      "sandbox"    => "https://stageapi.glovoapp.com"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(api_key: ENV.fetch("GLOVO_API_KEY"),
                   api_secret: ENV.fetch("GLOVO_API_SECRET"),
                   environment: ENV.fetch("GLOVO_ENV", "sandbox"))
      base = URLS.fetch(environment) { raise ArgumentError, "Unknown GLOVO_ENV: #{environment}" }

      @http = Faraday.new(url: base) do |f|
        f.request :authorization, :basic, api_key, api_secret
        f.request :json
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/
        f.options.timeout = 15
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
      end
    end

    # Price/ETA estimate without creating an order
    def estimate(pickup:, delivery:, description:)
      post("/b2b/orders/estimate", build_payload(pickup, delivery, description))
    end

    # Creates an order. With no scheduleTime, Glovo dispatches a courier ASAP.
    def create_order(pickup:, delivery:, description:, reference_id: nil)
      payload = build_payload(pickup, delivery, description)
      payload[:reference] = { id: reference_id } if reference_id
      post("/b2b/orders", payload)
    end

    def get_order(order_id)
      request { @http.get("/b2b/orders/#{order_id}") }
    end

    def cancel_order(order_id)
      post("/b2b/orders/#{order_id}/cancel", {})
    end

    private

    def build_payload(pickup, delivery, description)
      pickup.validate!
      delivery.validate!
      {
        description: description,
        addresses: [pickup.to_payload, delivery.to_payload]
      }
    end

    def post(path, payload)
      request { @http.post(path, payload) }
    end

    def request
      response = yield
      return response.body if response.success?

      raise Glovo::Error.new(
        "Glovo API error #{response.status}: #{extract_message(response.body)}",
        status: response.status,
        body: response.body
      )
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise Glovo::Error, "Network error talking to Glovo: #{e.message}"
    end

    def extract_message(body)
      return body.to_s unless body.is_a?(Hash)

      body.dig("error", "message") || body["message"] || body.to_json
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  pickup = Glovo::Address.new(
    type: "PICKUP",
    lat: 50.4501, lon: 30.5234,
    label: "Майдан Незалежності, 1, Київ",
    contact_phone: "+380501234567",
    contact_person: "Olena (shop)",
    instructions: "Ask for the order at the front desk"
  )

  delivery = Glovo::Address.new(
    type: "DELIVERY",
    lat: 50.4390, lon: 30.5160,
    label: "вул. Велика Васильківська, 20, Київ",
    contact_phone: "+380671112233",
    contact_person: "Andrii",
    instructions: "Apt 12, intercom code 45"
  )

  client = Glovo::Client.new

  begin
    quote = client.estimate(pickup: pickup, delivery: delivery,
                            description: "Small parcel, up to 3 kg")
    puts "Estimate: #{quote.inspect}"

    order = client.create_order(
      pickup: pickup,
      delivery: delivery,
      description: "Small parcel, up to 3 kg",
      reference_id: "ORDER-#{Time.now.to_i}"
    )

    puts "Courier ordered. Glovo order id: #{order['id']}, state: #{order['state']}"
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    warn "Invalid input: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue Glovo::Error => e
    warn e.message
    exit 2
  end
end
```

## Notes

- **Fast delivery:** the order is sent without a `scheduleTime`, so Glovo treats it as immediate and dispatches the nearest courier.
- **Credentials:** run `GLOVO_API_KEY=... GLOVO_API_SECRET=... GLOVO_ENV=sandbox ruby glovo_kyiv_courier.rb`. Test in the sandbox first, then switch to `production`.
- **Kyiv check:** coordinates are validated against a rough bounding box around Kyiv, so a bad geocode fails locally instead of at the API.
- **Phone numbers:** they must be in E.164 format (`+380...`).
- **Verify against your account:** Glovo may require different auth (such as an OAuth token) or extra fields, depending on how your partner account is set up. If so, only `Client#initialize` and `build_payload` need adjusting.

## Реалізація

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# lib/ua_address_parser.rb

module UaAddress
  Result = Struct.new(
    :postal_code, :oblast, :district, :city,
    :street_type, :street, :building, :korpus, :apartment,
    keyword_init: true
  )

  class Parser
    # ---------- Будівельні блоки для регулярних виразів ----------
    # Увага: \b у Ruby для кирилиці ненадійний, тому скрізь використовуємо \p{L}.
    WORD = /[\p{L}'\-]+/
    SEP  = /(?:\.\s*|\s+)/                                   # "вул." / "вул " / "вул.Х"
    NUM  = %r{\d+\p{L}?(?!\p{L})(?:/\d+\p{L}?)?}             # 22, 22А, 22/1, 15А/2
    NOT_LETTER_BEFORE = /(?<![\p{L}])/

    POSTAL_CODE = /(?<!\d)\d{5}(?!\d)/

    CRIMEA = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:АР|Автономна\s+Республіка)\s+Крим(?![\p{L}])/i
    OBLAST_AFTER  = /(?<name>#{WORD})\s+(?:область|обл\.?)(?![\p{L}])/i
    OBLAST_BEFORE = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:область|обл\.?)\s*(?<name>[\p{L}'\-]+(?:ськ|цьк|зьк)а)(?![\p{L}])/i

    DISTRICT_AFTER  = /(?<name>#{WORD})\s+(?:район|р-н)\.?(?![\p{L}])/i
    DISTRICT_BEFORE = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:район|р-н)\.?\s*(?<name>[\p{L}'\-]+(?:ськ|цьк|зьк)ий)(?![\p{L}])/i

    APARTMENT = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:квартира|кв|офіс|оф)#{SEP}(?:№\s*)?(?<num>\d+\p{L}?(?!\p{L}))/i

    BUILDING = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:будинок|буд|б|д)#{SEP}(?:№\s*)?(?<num>#{NUM})
                (?:[\s,]*(?:корпус|корп|к)#{SEP}(?<korpus>\d+|\p{L}(?!\p{L})))?/xi

    CITY = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?:місто|село|селище|смт|с-ще|м|с)#{SEP}
            (?<name>#{WORD}(?:\s+(?-i:\p{Lu})#{WORD})?)/xi

    STREET_TYPES = {
      "вулиця" => "вулиця", "вул" => "вулиця",
      "проспект" => "проспект", "просп" => "проспект", "пр-кт" => "проспект", "пр-т" => "проспект",
      "провулок" => "провулок", "пров" => "провулок",
      "бульвар" => "бульвар", "бул" => "бульвар", "б-р" => "бульвар",
      "площа" => "площа", "пл" => "площа",
      "набережна" => "набережна", "наб" => "набережна",
      "узвіз" => "узвіз", "узв" => "узвіз",
      "шосе" => "шосе", "тупик" => "тупик", "проїзд" => "проїзд", "алея" => "алея"
    }.freeze

    STREET_TYPE_RE = STREET_TYPES.keys.sort_by { |k| -k.length }.map { |k| Regexp.escape(k) }.join("|")

    STREET = /#{NOT_LETTER_BEFORE}(?<type>#{STREET_TYPE_RE})#{SEP}
              (?<name>(?:\d+-\p{L}+\s+)?(?:(?-i:\p{Lu})\.\s*)*#{WORD}(?:\s+#{WORD}){0,3}?)
              (?=\s*,|\s*\z|\s+\d)/xi

    IMPLICIT_BUILDING = /\A[\s,]*(?<b>#{NUM})(?:[\s,]+(?<a>\d+\p{L}?(?!\p{L})))?/

    # ---------- Публічний API ----------
    def self.parse(raw_text)
      new.parse(raw_text)
    end

    def parse(raw_text)
      text = normalize(raw_text)
      res  = Result.new

      # 1. Поштовий індекс (видаляємо першим, щоб не сплутати з номерами)
      if (m = extract!(text, POSTAL_CODE))
        res.postal_code = m[0]
      end

      # 2. Область
      if (m = extract!(text, CRIMEA))
        res.oblast = "Автономна Республіка Крим"
      elsif (m = extract!(text, OBLAST_AFTER) || extract!(text, OBLAST_BEFORE))
        res.oblast = "#{titleize(m[:name])} область"
      end

      # 3. Район
      if (m = extract!(text, DISTRICT_AFTER) || extract!(text, DISTRICT_BEFORE))
        res.district = "#{titleize(m[:name])} район"
      end

      # 4. Квартира та будинок з явними префіксами (кв., буд.)
      if (m = extract!(text, APARTMENT))
        res.apartment = m[:num].upcase
      end
      if (m = extract!(text, BUILDING))
        res.building = m[:num].upcase
        res.korpus   = m[:korpus]&.upcase
      end

      # 5. Населений пункт з префіксом (м., с., смт ...)
      if (m = extract!(text, CITY))
        res.city = titleize(m[:name])
      end

      # 6. Вулиця (+ номер будинку/квартири без префіксів: "Хрещатик, 22, 5")
      if (m = STREET.match(text))
        res.street_type = STREET_TYPES[m[:type].downcase]
        res.street      = titleize(m[:name].strip)

        rest = text[m.end(0)..]
        text[m.begin(0)...m.end(0)] = ", "

        if res.building.nil? && (im = IMPLICIT_BUILDING.match(rest))
          res.building  = im[:b].upcase
          res.apartment ||= im[:a]&.upcase
        end
      end

      # 7. Запасний варіант для міста: "Київ, вул. ..." — перший «чистий» сегмент
      if res.city.nil?
        candidate = text.split(",").map(&:strip).find { |s| s.match?(/\A\p{L}[\p{L}'\- ]*\z/) }
        res.city = titleize(candidate) if candidate
      end

      res
    end

    private

    def normalize(raw)
      raw.to_s.dup
         .gsub(/[’ʼ`‘]/, "'")
         .gsub(/[\r\n;]+/, ", ")
         .gsub(/(?<![\p{L}])Україна(?![\p{L}])/i, " ")
         .gsub(/\s+/, " ")
         .strip
    end

    # Знаходить перший збіг, вирізає його з тексту (замінює на кому) і повертає MatchData
    def extract!(text, regex)
      m = regex.match(text) or return nil
      text[m.begin(0)...m.end(0)] = ", "
      m
    end

    def titleize(str)
      str.split(" ").map do |word|
        next word if word.match?(/\A\d/)
        word.gsub(/(?<![\p{L}'])\p{L}/, &:upcase)
      end.join(" ")
    end
  end
end

# ---------- Демонстрація ----------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  samples = [
    "01001, м. Київ, вул. Хрещатик, буд. 22, кв. 5",
    "Львівська обл., м. Стрий, вулиця Івана Франка 15А/2 кв 7",
    "Дніпропетровська область, Кам'янське, проспект Гагаріна 10, 25",
    "Україна, Харківська обл., Богодухівський р-н, с. Круглик, пров. Шкільний, б. 3",
    "м. Біла Церква, вул. 40-річчя Перемоги, 12, оф. 4"
  ]
  samples.each do |s|
    puts s
    puts "  => #{UaAddress::Parser.parse(s).to_h.compact}"
  end
end
```

# test/ua_address_parser_test.rb
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/ua_address_parser"

class UaAddressParserTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_full_address_with_prefixes
    r = UaAddress::Parser.parse("01001, м. Київ, вул. Хрещатик, буд. 22, кв. 5")
    assert_equal "01001", r.postal_code
    assert_equal "Київ", r.city
    assert_equal "Хрещатик", r.street
    assert_equal "22", r.building
    assert_equal "5", r.apartment
  end

  def test_oblast_and_compound_building
    r = UaAddress::Parser.parse("Львівська обл., м. Стрий, вулиця Івана Франка 15А/2 кв 7")
    assert_equal "Львівська область", r.oblast
    assert_equal "Стрий", r.city
    assert_equal "Івана Франка", r.street
    assert_equal "15А/2", r.building
    assert_equal "7", r.apartment
  end

  def test_city_without_prefix_and_implicit_numbers
    r = UaAddress::Parser.parse("Дніпропетровська область, Кам'янське, проспект Гагаріна 10, 25")
    assert_equal "Кам'янське", r.city
    assert_equal "проспект", r.street_type
    assert_equal "10", r.building
    assert_equal "25", r.apartment
  end
end
```

## Як це працює

1. **Нормалізація**: уніфікуються апострофи, переноси рядків перетворюються на коми, прибирається слово «Україна».
2. **Послідовне «вирізання» компонентів**: кожен знайдений фрагмент (індекс, область, район, квартира, будинок, місто) замінюється комою. Тому наступні регулярні вирази працюють з уже очищеним текстом, а назва вулиці не «захоплює» зайвого.
3. **Вулиця**: розпізнаються типи (вул., просп., пров., бул., пл. тощо), назви з кількох слів (`Івана Франка`), ініціали (`І. Франка`) і назви з числом (`40-річчя Перемоги`). Якщо після вулиці йдуть числа без префіксів (`Хрещатик, 22, 5`), то перше стає будинком, а друге квартирою.
4. **Місто без префікса**: якщо префікса `м.` немає, то містом вважається перший залишковий сегмент, що складається лише з літер.

## Обмеження

- Для адрес без маркерів вулиці (наприклад, `Київ Хрещатик 22`) парсер вулицю не знайде.
- Назви областей визначаються за словами «обл./область» і закінченнями `-ська/-цька/-зька`.
- Для складніших випадків (довідник КОАТУУ/КАТОТТГ, перевірка існування адрес) потрібен словник населених пунктів.

## lib/np_delivery_sms.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "json"
require "logger"
require "time"

module NpDeliverySms
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :errors

    def initialize(errors)
      @errors = Array(errors)
      super("Помилка API Нової Пошти: #{@errors.join('; ')}")
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Конфігурація
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Config = Struct.new(:api_key, :sms_model, :sms_method, :sms_sender,
                      :store_path, :dry_run, keyword_init: true) do
    def self.from_env(env = ENV)
      new(
        api_key:    env.fetch("NP_API_KEY") { raise Error, "Не задано NP_API_KEY" },
        sms_model:  env["NP_SMS_MODEL"],
        sms_method: env["NP_SMS_METHOD"],
        sms_sender: env["NP_SMS_SENDER"],
        store_path: env.fetch("STORE_PATH", "sent_notifications.json"),
        dry_run:    env.fetch("DRY_RUN", "true") == "true"
      )
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Універсальний клієнт API 2.0 (усі запити — POST JSON)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  class Client
    URL = "https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/"

    # retry: true лише для безпечних (ідемпотентних) запитів, наприклад
    # відстеження. Для відправлення SMS повтори вимкнені, щоб не дублювати.
    def initialize(api_key:, retry_requests: false, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
      @api_key = api_key
      @logger  = logger
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: URL) do |f|
        f.request :json
        if retry_requests
          f.request :retry, max: 3, interval: 0.5, backoff_factor: 2,
                            methods: %i[post],
                            retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
        end
        f.response :json, content_type: /json/
        f.options.timeout      = 20
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
      end
    end

    def call(model, method, properties = {})
      response = @conn.post("", {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: model,
        calledMethod: method,
        methodProperties: properties
      })
      body = response.body

      unless response.success? && body.is_a?(Hash)
        raise Error, "HTTP #{response.status} від API Нової Пошти"
      end
      raise ApiError, body["errors"] unless body["success"]

      Array(body["warnings"]).each { |w| @logger.warn("NP warning: #{w}") }
      body["data"]
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Мережева помилка: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Номер телефону -> формат 380XXXXXXXXX
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  module Phone
    module_function

    def normalize(raw)
      digits = raw.to_s.gsub(/\D/, "")
      digits = "38#{digits}"  if digits.length == 10 && digits.start_with?("0")
      digits = "380#{digits}" if digits.length == 9
      unless digits.match?(/\A380\d{9}\z/)
        raise ArgumentError, "Некоректний номер телефону: #{raw.inspect}"
      end
      digits
    end
  end

  Delivery = Struct.new(:ttn, :phone, :name, keyword_init: true)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Відстеження статусів ТТН (до 100 документів за запит)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  class Tracker
    def initialize(client)
      @client = client
    end

    # => масив хешів з ключами "Number", "StatusCode", "Status", ...
    def statuses(deliveries)
      deliveries.each_slice(100).flat_map do |batch|
        documents = batch.map { |d| { "DocumentNumber" => d.ttn, "Phone" => d.phone } }
        @client.call("TrackingDocument", "getStatusDocuments", { "Documents" => documents })
      end
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Шаблони повідомлень за кодами статусів НП
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  module Templates
    TEXTS = {
      5   => "%<name>s, посилка %<ttn>s прямує до міста отримання.",
      7   => "%<name>s, посилка %<ttn>s прибула у відділення %<where>s. Зберігання безкоштовне 5 днів.",
      8   => "%<name>s, посилка %<ttn>s прибула у поштомат %<where>s.",
      101 => "%<name>s, кур'єр уже в дорозі з посилкою %<ttn>s.",
      9   => "%<name>s, дякуємо! Посилку %<ttn>s отримано."
    }.freeze

    module_function

    def codes = TEXTS.keys

    def render(code, ttn:, name:, where:)
      format(TEXTS.fetch(code),
             ttn: ttn,
             name: name.to_s.empty? ? "Вітаємо" : name,
             where: where.to_s)
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Сховище надісланих повідомлень (щоб не слати дублікати)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  class Store
    def initialize(path)
      @path = path
      @data = File.exist?(path) ? JSON.parse(File.read(path)) : {}
    end

    def sent?(ttn, code) = @data.key?(key(ttn, code))

    def mark(ttn, code)
      @data[key(ttn, code)] = Time.now.utc.iso8601
      File.write(@path, JSON.pretty_generate(@data))
    end

    private

    def key(ttn, code) = "#{ttn}:#{code}"
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Відправлення SMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  class SmsSender
    def initialize(client:, model:, method:, sender: nil, dry_run: true,
                   logger: Logger.new($stdout))
      @client, @model, @method = client, model, method
      @sender, @dry_run, @logger = sender, dry_run, logger

      if !dry_run && (@model.to_s.empty? || @method.to_s.empty?)
        raise Error, "Задайте NP_SMS_MODEL і NP_SMS_METHOD згідно з документацією SMS-сервісу"
      end
    end

    def deliver(phone:, text:)
      if @dry_run
        @logger.info("[DRY RUN] SMS на #{phone}: #{text}")
        return :dry_run
      end

      # Назви полів — припущення; приведіть до специфікації вашого SMS-методу.
      props = { "Phone" => phone, "Message" => text }
      props["Sender"] = @sender if @sender && !@sender.empty?
      @client.call(@model, @method, props)
      :sent
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Основний сценарій
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  class Notifier
    def initialize(tracker:, sms:, store:, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
      @tracker, @sms, @store, @logger = tracker, sms, store, logger
    end

    def run(deliveries)
      index = deliveries.to_h { |d| [d.ttn, d] }
      result = { sent: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 }

      @tracker.statuses(deliveries).each do |st|
        ttn      = st["Number"].to_s
        code     = st["StatusCode"].to_i
        delivery = index[ttn]

        if delivery.nil? || !Templates.codes.include?(code) || @store.sent?(ttn, code)
          result[:skipped] += 1
          next
        end

        text = Templates.render(code, ttn: ttn, name: delivery.name,
                                      where: st["WarehouseRecipientAddress"] || st["WarehouseRecipient"])
        outcome = @sms.deliver(phone: delivery.phone, text: text)
        @store.mark(ttn, code) if outcome == :sent
        result[:sent] += 1
        @logger.info("ТТН #{ttn}, статус #{code}: #{outcome}")
      rescue Error, ArgumentError => e
        result[:failed] += 1
        @logger.error("ТТН #{ttn}: #{e.message}")
      end

      result
    end
  end
end
```

## bin/notify

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "dotenv/load"
require "json"
require_relative "../lib/np_delivery_sms"

include NpDeliverySms

# Використання: bin/notify deliveries.json
# Формат: [{"ttn":"20450000000000","phone":"050 123 45 67","name":"Олена"}]
path = ARGV[0] or abort("Використання: bin/notify deliveries.json")

config = Config.from_env
logger = Logger.new($stdout)

deliveries = JSON.parse(File.read(path)).filter_map do |row|
  Delivery.new(ttn: row.fetch("ttn"),
               phone: Phone.normalize(row.fetch("phone")),
               name: row["name"])
rescue ArgumentError => e
  logger.warn("Пропущено запис: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

tracker = Tracker.new(Client.new(api_key: config.api_key, retry_requests: true, logger: logger))
sms = SmsSender.new(
  client: Client.new(api_key: config.api_key, retry_requests: false, logger: logger),
  model: config.sms_model, method: config.sms_method,
  sender: config.sms_sender, dry_run: config.dry_run, logger: logger
)

notifier = Notifier.new(tracker: tracker, sms: sms,
                        store: Store.new(config.store_path), logger: logger)

puts notifier.run(deliveries).inspect
```

require "tempfile"

RSpec.describe NpDeliverySms do
  include NpDeliverySms

  it "нормалізує телефон" do
    expect(Phone.normalize("050 123-45-67")).to eq("380501234567")
    expect { Phone.normalize("123") }.to raise_error(ArgumentError)
  end

  it "надсилає SMS один раз для одного статусу" do
    tracker = instance_double(Tracker,
      statuses: [{ "Number" => "1", "StatusCode" => "7", "WarehouseRecipientAddress" => "№5" }])
    sms = instance_double(SmsSender, deliver: :sent)
    file = Tempfile.new("store"); File.delete(file.path)
    notifier = Notifier.new(tracker: tracker, sms: sms, store: Store.new(file.path),
                            logger: Logger.new(nil))
    d = [Delivery.new(ttn: "1", phone: "380501234567", name: "Олена")]

    expect(notifier.run(d)).to include(sent: 1)
    expect(notifier.run(d)).to include(sent: 0, skipped: 1)
  end
end

## Як це працює

1. Для кожної ТТН викликається `getStatusDocuments` (пачками по 100) з повторами при збоях.
2. Якщо статус входить у список шаблонів (прибуло у відділення, поштомат, кур'єр, отримано), формується текст українською.
3. `Store` запам'ятовує пари «ТТН + код статусу». Повторний запуск (наприклад, з cron кожні 10 хвилин) не дублює SMS.
4. SMS-запити виконуються без автоматичних повторів, щоб клієнт не отримав два однакові повідомлення.

```ruby
# app/services/currency_converter.rb
class CurrencyConverter
  class << self
    # Конвертація суми між валютами
    def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
      money = Money.from_amount(amount, from_currency)
      money.exchange_to(to_currency)
    rescue Money::Bank::UnknownRate
      raise ArgumentError, "Cannot convert from #{from_currency} to #{to_currency}"
    end

    # Форматування суми для відображення
    def format(amount, currency = 'USD', options = {})
      money = Money.from_amount(amount, currency)
      
      default_options = {
        symbol: true,
        thousands_separator: ',',
        decimal_mark: '.',
        no_cents_if_whole: false
      }
      
      money.format(default_options.merge(options))
    end

    # Додавання двох сум у різних валютах
    def add(amount1, currency1, amount2, currency2)
      money1 = Money.from_amount(amount1, currency1)
      money2 = Money.from_amount(amount2, currency2)
      
      # Конвертуємо другу суму в валюту першої
      money2_converted = money2.exchange_to(currency1)
      
      result = money1 + money2_converted
      { amount: result.to_f, currency: result.currency.iso_code }
    rescue Money::Bank::UnknownRate
      raise ArgumentError, "Cannot add amounts in different currencies without exchange rates"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/controllers/products_controller.rb
class ProductsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @products = Product.all
    @total = calculate_total(@products)
  end

  def show
    @product = Product.find(params[:id])
    @price_in_eur = @product.convert_to('EUR') if params[:currency] == 'EUR'
  end

  private

  def calculate_total(products)
    # Сумуємо всі продукти в USD
    total = Money.new(0, 'USD')
    
    products.each do |product|
      if product.price_currency == 'USD'
        total += product.price
      else
        # Конвертуємо в USD
        total += product.price.exchange_to('USD')
      end
    end
    
    total
  rescue Money::Bank::UnknownRate
    # Якщо немає курсу для якоїсь валюти
    nil
  end
end
