# apns_client.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "openssl"
require "time"
require "jwt"
require "httpx"

module APNs
  PRODUCTION_HOST = "https://api.push.apple.com"
  SANDBOX_HOST    = "https://api.sandbox.push.apple.com"

  MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 4096
  # Apple: токен треба оновлювати не частіше ніж раз на 20 хв і не рідше ніж раз на 60 хв
  TOKEN_TTL = 50 * 60

  class PayloadTooLarge < StandardError; end

  # Результат відправлення одному пристрою
  Result = Struct.new(:device_token, :status, :apns_id, :reason, :timestamp, :error, keyword_init: true) do
    def success?
      status == 200
    end

    # Токен недійсний — його слід видалити з вашої бази
    def invalid_token?
      status == 410 || %w[BadDeviceToken Unregistered DeviceTokenNotForTopic].include?(reason)
    end

    def to_s
      if success?
        "OK token=#{device_token[0, 8]}… apns-id=#{apns_id}"
      else
        "FAIL token=#{device_token[0, 8]}… status=#{status.inspect} reason=#{reason || error}"
      end
    end
  end

  # Генератор і кеш JWT-токена провайдера
  class TokenProvider
    def initialize(team_id:, key_id:, private_key:)
      @team_id = team_id
      @key_id  = key_id
      @key     = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(private_key)
      @mutex   = Mutex.new
      @token   = nil
      @issued_at = nil
    end

    def token
      @mutex.synchronize do
        refresh! if @token.nil? || Time.now.to_i - @issued_at >= TOKEN_TTL
        @token
      end
    end

    def invalidate!
      @mutex.synchronize { @token = nil }
    end

    private

    def refresh!
      @issued_at = Time.now.to_i
      @token = JWT.encode(
        { iss: @team_id, iat: @issued_at },
        @key,
        "ES256",
        { kid: @key_id }
      )
    end
  end

  class Client
    # team_id         — Team ID з Apple Developer (10 символів)
    # key_id          — Key ID ключа APNs (.p8)
    # private_key     — вміст .p8 файлу
    # topic           — Bundle ID застосунку (напр. "com.example.MyApp")
    # production      — true: бойовий APNs, false: sandbox
    def initialize(team_id:, key_id:, private_key:, topic:, production: true)
      @topic = topic
      @host  = production ? PRODUCTION_HOST : SANDBOX_HOST
      @tokens = TokenProvider.new(team_id: team_id, key_id: key_id, private_key: private_key)
      @http = HTTPX
              .plugin(:persistent)   # тримає HTTP/2-з'єднання відкритим (Apple це рекомендує)
              .with(timeout: { connect_timeout: 10, request_timeout: 30 })
    end

    def self.from_env
      new(
        team_id:     ENV.fetch("APNS_TEAM_ID"),
        key_id:      ENV.fetch("APNS_KEY_ID"),
        private_key: File.read(ENV.fetch("APNS_KEY_PATH")),
        topic:       ENV.fetch("APNS_TOPIC"),
        production:  ENV["APNS_ENV"] == "production"
      )
    end

    # Надіслати alert-сповіщення
    def push(device_token:, title: nil, body: nil, badge: nil, sound: "default",
             data: {}, **options)
      alert = { title: title, body: body }.compact
      aps = {}
      aps[:alert] = alert unless alert.empty?
      aps[:badge] = badge unless badge.nil?
      aps[:sound] = sound if sound
      send_payload(device_token, data.merge(aps: aps), **options)
    end

    # Тихе (background) сповіщення
    def push_silent(device_token:, data: {}, **options)
      payload = data.merge(aps: { "content-available" => 1 })
      send_payload(device_token, payload,
                   push_type: "background", priority: 5, **options)
    end

    # Надіслати довільний payload одному пристрою
    def send_payload(device_token, payload, push_type: "alert", priority: nil,
                     expiration: nil, collapse_id: nil, topic: nil, apns_id: nil)
      body = JSON.generate(payload)
      raise PayloadTooLarge, "payload #{body.bytesize}B > #{MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES}B" if body.bytesize > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES

      attempts = 0
      begin
        attempts += 1
        response = @http.post(
          "#{@host}/3/device/#{device_token}",
          headers: build_headers(push_type, priority, expiration, collapse_id, topic, apns_id),
          body: body
        )
        result = build_result(device_token, response)

        # Токен провайдера протермінований — генеруємо новий і пробуємо ще раз
        if result.reason == "ExpiredProviderToken" && attempts < 2
          @tokens.invalidate!
          raise RetryError
        end
        result
      rescue RetryError
        retry
      end
    end

    # Надіслати те саме сповіщення багатьом пристроям паралельно (мультиплексування HTTP/2)
    def push_many(device_tokens:, title: nil, body: nil, badge: nil, sound: "default", data: {})
      alert = { title: title, body: body }.compact
      aps = {}
      aps[:alert] = alert unless alert.empty?
      aps[:badge] = badge unless badge.nil?
      aps[:sound] = sound if sound
      json = JSON.generate(data.merge(aps: aps))
      raise PayloadTooLarge, "payload too large" if json.bytesize > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES

      headers = build_headers("alert", nil, nil, nil, nil, nil)
      requests = device_tokens.map do |t|
        @http.build_request("POST", "#{@host}/3/device/#{t}", headers: headers, body: json)
      end
      responses = @http.send_requests(*requests)
      device_tokens.zip(responses).map { |t, r| build_result(t, r) }
    end

    def close
      @http.close if @http.respond_to?(:close)
    end

    private

    class RetryError < StandardError; end

    def build_headers(push_type, priority, expiration, collapse_id, topic, apns_id)
      headers = {
        "authorization"  => "bearer #{@tokens.token}",
        "apns-topic"     => topic || @topic,
        "apns-push-type" => push_type,
        "content-type"   => "application/json"
      }
      priority ||= push_type == "background" ? 5 : 10
      headers["apns-priority"]    = priority.to_s
      headers["apns-expiration"]  = expiration.to_i.to_s if expiration
      headers["apns-collapse-id"] = collapse_id if collapse_id
      headers["apns-id"]          = apns_id if apns_id
      headers
    end

    def build_result(device_token, response)
      # Мережева помилка / таймаут
      if response.is_a?(HTTPX::ErrorResponse)
        return Result.new(device_token: device_token, error: response.error.message)
      end

      apns_id = response.headers["apns-id"]
      return Result.new(device_token: device_token, status: 200, apns_id: apns_id) if response.status == 200

      info = begin
        JSON.parse(response.body.to_s)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        {}
      end
      ts = info["timestamp"] && Time.at(info["timestamp"] / 1000)

      Result.new(device_token: device_token, status: response.status,
                 apns_id: apns_id, reason: info["reason"], timestamp: ts)
    end
  end
end

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Приклад використання:
#
#   APNS_TEAM_ID=ABCDE12345 APNS_KEY_ID=XYZ987TUVW \
#   APNS_KEY_PATH=./AuthKey_XYZ987TUVW.p8 \
#   APNS_TOPIC=com.example.MyApp APNS_ENV=sandbox \
#   ruby apns_client.rb <device_token>
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  device_token = ARGV[0] or abort("Використання: ruby apns_client.rb <device_token>")

  client = APNs::Client.from_env
  begin
    result = client.push(
      device_token: device_token,
      title: "Привіт!",
      body: "Це тестове push-сповіщення через APNs 🚀",
      badge: 1,
      data: { order_id: 42 },
      collapse_id: "test-1",
      expiration: Time.now + 3600
    )
    puts result

    if result.invalid_token?
      puts "Токен недійсний — видаліть його з бази (#{result.timestamp})"
    end
  ensure
    client.close
  end
end
```

## Що потрібно підготувати

1. В Apple Developer → **Keys** створіть ключ з увімкненим **Apple Push Notifications service (APNs)** і завантажте `.p8` файл (його можна завантажити лише один раз).
2. Запишіть **Key ID** та **Team ID**.
3. **Topic** — це Bundle ID застосунку. Для VoIP/Live Activity додавайте суфікси (`.voip`, `.push-type.liveactivity`).
4. Використовуйте sandbox для збірок із Xcode і production для TestFlight/App Store, інакше буде `BadDeviceToken`.

## Важливі нюанси

- **JWT** кешується на 50 хв: Apple повертає `TooManyProviderTokenUpdates`, якщо оновлювати токен занадто часто, і `ExpiredProviderToken`, якщо він старший за годину.
- **HTTP/2** з'єднання підтримується відкритим (`:persistent`), бо Apple може вважати часті відкриття нових з'єднань атакою.
- **Обробка помилок**: `410 Unregistered` або `BadDeviceToken` означають, що токен треба видалити. `429` означає ліміт, тоді слід повторити пізніше з паузою.
- **Розмір payload** обмежено 4 КБ (перевіряється перед відправленням).

<%= form.submit "Перевірити картку" %>
<% end %> ``` ### Тести ```ruby # spec/models/payment_card_form_spec.rb require 'rails_helper' RSpec.describe PaymentCardForm, type: :model do let(:valid_attributes) do { card_number: '4111111111111111', card_holder_name: 'John Doe', expiry_month: 12, expiry_year: 2025, cvv: '123' } end describe 'card_type' do it 'визначає Visa' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '4111111111111111')) expect(form.card_type).to eq('Visa') end it 'визначає Mastercard' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '5555555555554444')) expect(form.card_type).to eq('Mastercard') end it 'визначає American Express' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '378282246310005')) expect(form.card_type).to eq('American Express') end it 'визначає Discover' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '6011111111111117')) expect(form.card_type).to eq('Discover') end end describe 'luhn_valid?' do it 'повертає true для валідного номера' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes) expect(form.luhn_valid?).to be true end it 'повертає false для невалідного номера' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '4111111111111112')) expect(form.luhn_valid?).to be false end end describe 'validations' do it 'є валідним з коректними даними' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes) expect(form).to be_valid end it 'не є валідним з некоректним номером картки' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(card_number: '1234567890123456')) expect(form).not_to be_valid expect(form.errors[:card_number]).to be_present end it 'не є валідним з простроченою датою' do form = PaymentCardForm.new(valid_attributes.merge(expiry_year: 2020, expiry_month: 1)) expect(form).not_to be_valid expect(form.errors[:expiry_year]).to be_present end end end ``` Ця реалізація включає: 1. **PaymentCardForm** - модель форми з валідаціями 2. **Алгоритм Луна** - перевірка контрольного числа картки 3. **Визначення платіжної системи** - розпізнавання Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover та інших 4. **Валідації** - перевірка номера, дати закінчення терміну дії, CVV 5. **Контролер та View** - для обробки форми 6. **Тести** - для перевірки роботи коду Код готовий до використання в Rails-додатку та може бути легко розширений для додаткових платіжних систем або правил валідації.

Task: Book a delivery courier through the Uber Direct API when an order is ready.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.7"
gem "dotenv", "~> 2.8"
gem "json", "~> 2.6"
```

---

## Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file with the following:

```dotenv
UBER_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
UBER_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
UBER_DIRECT_CUSTOMER_ID=your_customer_id
```

---

## Implementation

### `lib/order.rb`

A simple value object representing an order ready for delivery.

```ruby
# lib/order.rb
Order = Struct.new(
  :id,
  :pickup_address,
  :dropoff_address,
  :pickup_phone_number,
  :dropoff_phone_number,
  :pickup_name,
  :dropoff_name,
  :pickup_notes,
  :dropoff_notes,
  :items,               # Array of hashes: { name:, quantity:, size: }
  :pickup_ready_at,     # Time
  :dropoff_ready_at,    # Time
  keyword_init: true
)
```

---

### `lib/uber_direct/client.rb`

Handles OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication and delivery creation.

```ruby
# lib/uber_direct/client.rb
require "faraday"
require "json"
require "securerandom"

module UberDirect
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < Error; end
  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(status, body)
      @status = status
      @body = body
      super("Uber Direct API error #{status}: #{body}")
    end
  end

  class Client
    DEFAULT_TOKEN_URL = "https://auth.uber.com/oauth/v2/token"
    DEFAULT_API_URL = "https://api.uber.com/v1"

    def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, customer_id:,
                   token_url: DEFAULT_TOKEN_URL, api_url: DEFAULT_API_URL)
      @client_id = client_id
      @client_secret = client_secret
      @customer_id = customer_id
      @token_url = token_url
      @api_url = api_url
      @token = nil
      @token_expires_at = nil
    end

    # Books a courier by creating a delivery request.
    # `delivery_params` is a hash with pickup/dropoff/manifest fields.
    def create_delivery(delivery_params, idempotency_key: SecureRandom.uuid)
      response = api_connection.post("/deliveries") do |req|
        req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
        req.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        req.headers["Idempotency-Key"] = idempotency_key
        req.body = JSON.generate(delivery_params.merge(customer_id: @customer_id))
      end

      handle_response(response)
    end

    private

    def access_token
      return @token if @token && @token_expires_at && Time.now < @token_expires_at

      fetch_token
    end

    def fetch_token
      response = Faraday.post(@token_url, {
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        grant_type: "client_credentials",
        scope: "direct.deliveries"
      })

      unless response.success?
        raise AuthenticationError,
              "Failed to authenticate with Uber: #{response.status} #{response.body}"
      end

      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @token = data.fetch("access_token")
      expires_in = data.fetch("expires_in", 3600).to_i
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + expires_in - 60 # small buffer
      @token
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise AuthenticationError, "Invalid token response: #{e.message}"
    end

    def api_connection
      @api_connection ||= Faraday.new(url: @api_url)
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200, 201, 202
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise ApiError.new(response.status, response.body)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

---

### `lib/order_ready_booking.rb`

Maps an `Order` to the Uber Direct payload and triggers the booking.

```ruby
# lib/order_ready_booking.rb
require "logger"
require_relative "uber_direct/client"

class OrderReadyBooking
  def initialize(client:, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
    @client = client
    @logger = logger
  end

  def call(order)
    payload = build_payload(order)
    @logger.info("Booking Uber Direct delivery for order #{order.id}")

    response = @client.create_delivery(payload, idempotency_key: "order-#{order.id}")

    @logger.info("Uber Direct delivery created: #{response["id"]}")
    response
  rescue UberDirect::Error => e
    @logger.error("Failed to book delivery for order #{order.id}: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  private

  def build_payload(order)
    {
      pickup_address: order.pickup_address,
      dropoff_address: order.dropoff_address,
      pickup_phone_number: order.pickup_phone_number,
      dropoff_phone_number: order.dropoff_phone_number,
      pickup_name: order.pickup_name,
      dropoff_name: order.dropoff_name,
      pickup_notes: order.pickup_notes,
      dropoff_notes: order.dropoff_notes,
      manifest_items: order.items.map do |item|
        {
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          size: item[:size]
        }
      end,
      pickup_ready_dt: order.pickup_ready_at&.utc&.iso8601,
      dropoff_ready_dt: order.dropoff_ready_at&.utc&.iso8601
    }.compact
  end
end
```

---

### `main.rb` / Example Trigger

```ruby
# main.rb
require "dotenv/load"
require "logger"
require_relative "lib/order"
require_relative "lib/uber_direct/client"
require_relative "lib/order_ready_booking"

if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  # Example order that is ready for delivery
  order = Order.new(
    id: "ORD-12345",
    pickup_name: "Acme Restaurant",
    pickup_address: "123 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94103",
    pickup_phone_number: "+14155551234",
    pickup_notes: "Ask for manager",
    dropoff_name: "Jane Doe",
    dropoff_address: "456 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105",
    dropoff_phone_number: "+14155556789",
    dropoff_notes: "Ring bell",
    items: [
      { name: "Burger", quantity: 2, size: "small" },
      { name: "Fries", quantity: 1, size: "medium" }
    ],
    pickup_ready_at: Time.now + 600,      # ready in 10 minutes
    dropoff_ready_at: Time.now + 1800     # deliver within 30 minutes
  )

  client = UberDirect::Client.new(
    client_id: ENV.fetch("UBER_CLIENT_ID"),
    client_secret: ENV.fetch("UBER_CLIENT_SECRET"),
    customer_id: ENV.fetch("UBER_DIRECT_CUSTOMER_ID")
  )

  booking = OrderReadyBooking.new(client: client, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
  booking.call(order)
end
```

---

## Usage Notes

- The `OrderReadyBooking` class is the entry point to be called whenever an order becomes ready.
- The Uber Direct API requires `customer_id`, which is injected automatically from the client configuration.
- The `Idempotency-Key` header is set to `order-#{order.id}` to safely allow retries without creating duplicate deliveries.
- Make sure the environment variables are set correctly in `.env`.
- Adjust `scope` in the OAuth call if your Uber Direct account requires additional scopes.

Решта (`json`, `digest`, `securerandom`, `fileutils`, `time`) входить до стандартної бібліотеки Ruby.

## Реалізація

```ruby
# gdpr_export.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "logger"
require "active_record"
require "zip"
require "json"
require "digest"
require "securerandom"
require "fileutils"
require "time"
require "bigdecimal"

# =============================================================================
# Експорт персональних даних користувача (GDPR, ст. 15 та 20)
#
# Результат: ZIP-архів, у якому
#   - README.txt     – опис вмісту архіву
#   - *.json         – дані по категоріях (профіль, адреси, замовлення тощо)
#   - manifest.json  – метадані, кількість записів, розмір і SHA-256 кожного файлу
# =============================================================================
module GdprExport
  class Error < StandardError; end

  # Опис однієї категорії даних.
  #   kind:       :object (один JSON-об'єкт) або :collection (JSON-масив)
  #   source:     lambda(user) -> Hash | ActiveRecord::Relation | Enumerable
  #   only:       білий список атрибутів (за замовчуванням, щоб випадково
  #               не експортувати password_digest, токени тощо)
  #   serializer: необов'язковий lambda(record) -> Hash для складніших випадків
  Section = Struct.new(:path, :description, :kind, :source, :only, :serializer,
                       keyword_init: true) do
    def object? = kind == :object

    def serialize(record)
      return serializer.call(record) if serializer

      attrs = record.respond_to?(:attributes) ? record.attributes : record
      attrs.slice(*only)
    end
  end

  # Обгортка над записом у ZIP: рахує байти та SHA-256 «на льоту»,
  # тож великі набори даних не потрібно тримати в пам'яті.
  class EntryWriter
    attr_reader :bytes

    def initialize(io)
      @io     = io
      @digest = Digest::SHA256.new
      @bytes  = 0
    end

    def write(str)
      @digest << str
      @bytes += str.bytesize
      @io.write(str)
    end

    def sha256 = @digest.hexdigest
  end

  # Перелік категорій даних. Додайте сюди нові джерела персональних даних.
  module Sections
    def self.default
      [
        Section.new(
          path: "profile.json",
          description: "Дані облікового запису та профілю",
          kind: :object,
          source: ->(u) { u },
          only: %w[id email name phone birth_date locale marketing_opt_in
                   created_at updated_at last_sign_in_at]
        ),
        Section.new(
          path: "addresses.json",
          description: "Збережені адреси",
          kind: :collection,
          source: ->(u) { u.addresses },
          only: %w[id label street city postal_code country created_at]
        ),
        Section.new(
          path: "orders.json",
          description: "Історія замовлень разом із позиціями",
          kind: :collection,
          source: ->(u) { u.orders.includes(:order_items) },
          only: [],
          serializer: lambda { |o|
            o.attributes.slice("id", "number", "status", "currency", "total_cents", "placed_at")
             .merge("items" => o.order_items.map do |i|
               i.attributes.slice("id", "sku", "title", "quantity", "unit_price_cents")
             end)
          }
        ),
        Section.new(
          path: "comments.json",
          description: "Коментарі, залишені користувачем",
          kind: :collection,
          source: ->(u) { u.comments },
          only: %w[id body created_at updated_at]
        ),
        Section.new(
          path: "consents.json",
          description: "Історія згод (маркетинг, cookies, політика конфіденційності)",
          kind: :collection,
          source: ->(u) { u.consents },
          only: %w[id kind granted ip_address user_agent created_at]
        ),
        Section.new(
          path: "login_events.json",
          description: "Журнал входів в акаунт",
          kind: :collection,
          source: ->(u) { u.login_events },
          only: %w[id ip_address user_agent created_at]
        )
      ]
    end
  end

  class Exporter
    BATCH_SIZE = 1_000

    def initialize(user, sections: Sections.default, clock: -> { Time.now.utc })
      @user     = user
      @sections = sections
      @clock    = clock
    end

    # Записує архів у файл. Спочатку пишемо у тимчасовий файл,
    # а потім атомарно перейменовуємо, щоб ніколи не лишити «половинний» архів.
    def write_to_file(destination)
      destination = File.expand_path(destination)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(destination))
      tmp = "#{destination}.#{SecureRandom.hex(6)}.part"

      begin
        Zip::OutputStream.open(tmp) { |zos| build(zos) }
        File.rename(tmp, destination)
      ensure
        FileUtils.rm_f(tmp)
      end

      destination
    end

    # Повертає ZIP як бінарний рядок (зручно для send_data у контролері).
    def to_zip_string
      io = Zip::OutputStream.write_buffer { |zos| build(zos) }
      io.string
    end

    private

    def build(zos)
      generated_at = @clock.call

      add_text(zos, "README.txt", readme(generated_at))

      files = @sections.map { |section| write_section(zos, section) }

      manifest = {
        format_version: "1.0",
        generated_at: generated_at,
        subject: { id: @user.id, email: @user.email },
        files: files
      }
      add_text(zos, "manifest.json", JSON.pretty_generate(normalize(manifest)) + "\n")
    end

    def add_text(zos, path, content)
      zos.put_next_entry(path)
      zos.write(content)
    end

    def write_section(zos, section)
      zos.put_next_entry(section.path)
      writer = EntryWriter.new(zos)

      count = section.object? ? write_object(writer, section) : write_collection(writer, section)

      {
        path: section.path,
        description: section.description,
        records: count,
        bytes: writer.bytes,
        sha256: writer.sha256
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      # Неповний експорт гірший за відсутній — не ковтаємо помилки мовчки.
      raise Error, "Не вдалося експортувати «#{section.path}»: #{e.class}: #{e.message}"
    end

    def write_object(writer, section)
      data = section.serialize(section.source.call(@user))
      writer.write(JSON.pretty_generate(normalize(data)))
      writer.write("\n")
      1
    end

    # Потокове формування JSON-масиву: записи пишуться по одному.
    def write_collection(writer, section)
      records = section.source.call(@user)
      iterator = records.respond_to?(:find_each) ? :find_each : :each
      args     = iterator == :find_each ? [{ batch_size: BATCH_SIZE }] : []

      count = 0
      writer.write("[")
      records.public_send(iterator, *args) do |record|
        writer.write(count.zero? ? "\n" : ",\n")
        json = JSON.pretty_generate(normalize(section.serialize(record)))
        writer.write(json.gsub(/^/, "  "))
        count += 1
      end
      writer.write(count.zero? ? "]\n" : "\n]\n")
      count
    end

    # Приводимо значення до стабільного JSON-представлення.
    def normalize(value)
      case value
      when Hash       then value.to_h { |k, v| [k.to_s, normalize(v)] }
      when Array      then value.map { |v| normalize(v) }
      when Time, DateTime then value.to_time.utc.iso8601(3)
      when Date       then value.iso8601
      when BigDecimal then value.to_s("F")
      when Symbol     then value.to_s
      else value
      end
    end

    def readme(generated_at)
      <<~TXT
        ЕКСПОРТ ПЕРСОНАЛЬНИХ ДАНИХ (GDPR, ст. 15 та 20)
        ================================================
        Користувач:   #{@user.email} (id: #{@user.id})
        Створено:     #{generated_at.utc.iso8601}

        Архів містить усі персональні дані, які ми зберігаємо про вас,
        у машинозчитуваному форматі JSON (UTF-8). Дати подано у форматі
        ISO 8601 (UTC), грошові суми – у мінорних одиницях (центи).

        Файли:
        #{@sections.map { |s| "  - #{s.path.ljust(20)} #{s.description}" }.join("\n")}
          - manifest.json        Контрольні суми SHA-256 та кількість записів

        Паролі, токени доступу та інші секрети в архів не включаються.
      TXT
    end
  end

  # Зручна точка входу.
  def self.export(user, to:)
    Exporter.new(user).write_to_file(to)
  end
end

# =============================================================================
# Моделі (у реальному застосунку вони вже існують)
# =============================================================================
class User < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :addresses
  has_many :orders
  has_many :comments
  has_many :consents
  has_many :login_events
end

class Address < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :order_items
end

class OrderItem < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :order
end

class Comment < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
end

class Consent < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
end

class LoginEvent < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
end

# =============================================================================
# Демонстраційний запуск:  ruby gdpr_export.rb
# =============================================================================
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
  ActiveRecord::Schema.verbose = false

  ActiveRecord::Schema[7.2].define do
    create_table :users do |t|
      t.string   :email, :name, :phone, :locale, :password_digest, :api_token
      t.date     :birth_date
      t.boolean  :marketing_opt_in, default: false
      t.datetime :last_sign_in_at
      t.timestamps
    end
    create_table :addresses do |t|
      t.references :user
      t.string :label, :street, :city, :postal_code, :country
      t.timestamps
    end
    create_table :orders do |t|
      t.references :user
      t.string  :number, :status, :currency
      t.integer :total_cents
      t.datetime :placed_at
      t.timestamps
    end
    create_table :order_items do |t|
      t.references :order
      t.string  :sku, :title
      t.integer :quantity, :unit_price_cents
    end
    create_table :comments do |t|
      t.references :user
      t.text :body
      t.timestamps
    end
    create_table :consents do |t|
      t.references :user
      t.string  :kind, :ip_address, :user_agent
      t.boolean :granted
      t.timestamps
    end
    create_table :login_events do |t|
      t.references :user
      t.string :ip_address, :user_agent
      t.timestamps
    end
  end

  user = User.create!(
    email: "olena@example.com", name: "Олена Коваленко", phone: "+380501112233",
    locale: "uk", birth_date: Date.new(1992, 4, 12), marketing_opt_in: true,

  )
  user.addresses.create!(label: "Дім", street: "вул. Хрещатик, 1", city: "Київ",
                         postal_code: "01001", country: "UA")
  order = user.orders.create!(number: "A-1001", status: "paid", currency: "UAH",
                              total_cents: 129_900, placed_at: Time.now)
  order.order_items.create!(sku: "BK-42", title: "Книга", quantity: 2, unit_price_cents: 64_950)
  user.comments.create!(body: "Чудовий сервіс!")
  user.consents.create!(kind: "marketing", granted: true, ip_address: "203.0.113.5",
                        user_agent: "Mozilla/5.0")
  user.login_events.create!(ip_address: "203.0.113.5", user_agent: "Mozilla/5.0")

  path = GdprExport.export(user, to: "tmp/gdpr_export_user_#{user.id}.zip")
  puts "Архів створено: #{path}\n\n"

  Zip::File.open(path) do |zip|
    zip.each { |e| puts format("%-20s %6d байт", e.name, e.size) }
    puts "\n--- manifest.json ---"
    puts zip.read("manifest.json")
  end
end
```

## Використання в Rails-контролері

```ruby
def export
  zip = GdprExport::Exporter.new(current_user).to_zip_string
  send_data zip,
            type: "application/zip",
            filename: "personal-data-#{current_user.id}-#{Date.today}.zip"
end
```

Для великих обсягів даних краще запускати експорт у фоновому завданні (Sidekiq або ActiveJob) через `write_to_file`, а користувачу надсилати захищене посилання з обмеженим терміном дії.

## Ключові рішення

- **Білий список полів (`only`)**: `password_digest`, `api_token` та інші секрети не потраплять в архів, навіть якщо в таблицю додадуть нові колонки.
- **Потокова генерація**: колекції читаються через `find_each` і пишуться безпосередньо в ZIP, тому пам'ять не росте разом з обсягом даних.
- **`manifest.json`**: містить SHA-256, розмір і кількість записів кожного файлу, щоб можна було перевірити цілісність архіву.
- **Атомарний запис**: архів спочатку пишеться у `.part`-файл, а потім перейменовується.
- **Явні помилки**: якщо якась секція не експортується, виникає `GdprExport::Error`. Неповний архів для запиту за GDPR неприйнятний.
- **Розширюваність**: нове джерело даних (наприклад, завантажені файли чи логи підтримки) додається одним `Section.new(...)` у `Sections.default`.

Task: Create an invoice through the monobank acquiring API (Plata by mono) and handle its status webhook.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.1"

gem "sinatra", "~> 4.0"
gem "rackup",  "~> 2.1"     # Sinatra 4 / Rack 3 server launcher
gem "puma",    "~> 6.4"
gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

`json`, `openssl`, `time` and `securerandom` come from the standard library. Base64 is handled with `pack`/`unpack1`, so the `base64` gem (no longer a default gem in Ruby 3.4) isn't needed.

## app.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
#
# Monobank acquiring (Plata by mono): create an invoice and handle its webhook.
#
# Run:
#   export MONO_TOKEN=your_merchant_token
#   export PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://your-public-host.example   # must be reachable by monobank
#   bundle exec ruby app.rb
#
# Create an invoice:
#   curl -X POST localhost:4567/orders -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
#        -d '{"amount":10500,"description":"Order for a T-shirt"}'
#   (amount is in kopecks: 10500 = 105.00 UAH)

require "sinatra/base"
require "faraday"
require "json"
require "openssl"
require "securerandom"
require "time"

module Monobank
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(status, body)
      @status = status
      @body   = body
      super("Monobank API error #{status}: #{body}")
    end
  end

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://api.monobank.ua"
    UAH      = 980

    def initialize(token:, base_url: BASE_URL)
      raise ArgumentError, "MONO_TOKEN is required" if token.to_s.empty?

      @conn = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.headers["X-Token"] = token
        f.options.timeout      = 15
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
      end
    end

    # amount: Integer, in minor units (kopecks)
    # Returns a Hash with "invoiceId" and "pageUrl".
    def create_invoice(amount:, reference:, destination:, redirect_url:, webhook_url:,
                       currency: UAH, validity: 3600)
      raise ArgumentError, "amount must be a positive Integer (kopecks)" unless amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount.positive?

      payload = {
        amount: amount,
        ccy: currency,
        validity: validity, # seconds the invoice stays payable
        redirectUrl: redirect_url,
        webHookUrl: webhook_url,
        merchantPaymInfo: {
          reference: reference,
          destination: destination
        }
      }

      request(:post, "/api/merchant/invoice/create", payload)
    end

    # Useful to reconcile when a webhook was missed.
    def invoice_status(invoice_id)
      request(:get, "/api/merchant/invoice/status", nil, invoiceId: invoice_id)
    end

    # Returns the merchant's webhook-signing public key as PEM text.
    def public_key_pem
      body = request(:get, "/api/merchant/pubkey")
      # The API returns the PEM document base64-encoded.
      body.fetch("key").unpack1("m")
    end

    private

    def request(method, path, body = nil, params = nil)
      response =
        case method
        when :get  then @conn.get(path, params)
        when :post then @conn.post(path, body)
        end

      parsed = response.body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(response.body)
      raise ApiError.new(response.status, parsed) unless response.success?

      parsed
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Network error talking to monobank: #{e.message}"
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise ApiError.new(response&.status, response&.body)
    end
  end

  # Verifies the X-Sign header on webhook requests.
  class WebhookVerifier
    def initialize(client)
      @client = client
      @mutex  = Mutex.new
      @key    = nil
    end

    # raw_body must be the exact bytes received (not re-serialized JSON).
    def valid?(raw_body, signature_b64)
      return false if signature_b64.to_s.empty?

      signature = signature_b64.unpack1("m")

      return true if verify_with(current_key, raw_body, signature)

      # The key may have been rotated: refresh once and retry.
      verify_with(current_key(refresh: true), raw_body, signature)
    rescue ArgumentError, OpenSSL::PKey::PKeyError, Monobank::Error
      false
    end

    private

    def verify_with(key, body, signature)
      key.verify(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, signature, body)
    rescue OpenSSL::PKey::PKeyError
      false
    end

    def current_key(refresh: false)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @key = nil if refresh
        @key ||= OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(@client.public_key_pem)
      end
    end
  end
end

# Minimal thread-safe in-memory order store. Replace with your database.
class OrderStore
  Order = Struct.new(:reference, :amount, :invoice_id, :status, :last_modified,
                     :failure_reason, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize
    @orders = {}
    @mutex  = Mutex.new
  end

  def create(reference:, amount:)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @orders[reference] = Order.new(reference: reference, amount: amount, status: "new")
    end
  end

  def find(reference)
    @mutex.synchronize { @orders[reference]&.dup }
  end

  def attach_invoice(reference, invoice_id)
    @mutex.synchronize { @orders[reference].invoice_id = invoice_id }
  end

  # Applies a webhook payload. Returns :applied, :stale, or :unknown.
  def apply_webhook(payload)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      order = @orders[payload["reference"]]
      return :unknown unless order

      modified = parse_time(payload["modifiedDate"])

      # Webhooks can arrive out of order or be retried: ignore older/duplicate ones.
      if order.last_modified && modified && modified <= order.last_modified
        return :stale
      end

      # Never leave a final state because of a late non-final event.
      return :stale if order.status == "success" && payload["status"] != "reversed"

      order.status         = payload["status"]
      order.last_modified  = modified
      order.failure_reason = payload["failureReason"]
      :applied
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_time(value)
    value && Time.iso8601(value)
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end
end

class App < Sinatra::Base
  set :show_exceptions, false
  set :host_authorization, { permitted_hosts: [] } # allow any Host (e.g. via tunnel)

  MONO   = Monobank::Client.new(token: ENV["MONO_TOKEN"])
  VERIFY = Monobank::WebhookVerifier.new(MONO)
  ORDERS = OrderStore.new

  PUBLIC_BASE_URL = ENV.fetch("PUBLIC_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:4567")

  helpers do
    def json_body
      JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      halt 400, json(error: "invalid JSON")
    end

    def json(obj)
      content_type :json
      JSON.generate(obj)
    end
  end

  # Create an order and a monobank invoice, return the payment page URL.
  post "/orders" do
    data   = json_body
    amount = data["amount"]
    halt 422, json(error: "amount must be a positive integer (kopecks)") unless amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount.positive?

    reference = "order-#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    ORDERS.create(reference: reference, amount: amount)

    invoice = MONO.create_invoice(
      amount: amount,
      reference: reference,
      destination: data["description"].to_s[0, 200].then { |d| d.empty? ? "Payment #{reference}" : d },
      redirect_url: "#{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/payment/return?ref=#{reference}",
      webhook_url: "#{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/webhooks/monobank"
    )

    ORDERS.attach_invoice(reference, invoice.fetch("invoiceId"))

    status 201
    json(reference: reference, invoice_id: invoice["invoiceId"], payment_url: invoice["pageUrl"])
  rescue Monobank::ApiError => e
    logger&.error("monobank create_invoice failed: #{e.message}")
    halt 502, json(error: "payment provider error")
  rescue Monobank::Error => e
    logger&.error(e.message)
    halt 502, json(error: "payment provider unavailable")
  end

  # Webhook endpoint called by monobank when invoice status changes.
  post "/webhooks/monobank" do
    raw_body  = request.body.read
    signature = request.env["HTTP_X_SIGN"]

    unless VERIFY.valid?(raw_body, signature)
      logger&.warn("monobank webhook: invalid signature")
      halt 401, json(error: "invalid signature")
    end

    payload = JSON.parse(raw_body)
    handle_status(payload)

    status 200 # any non-200 makes monobank retry
    json(ok: true)
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    halt 400, json(error: "invalid JSON")
  end

  # Where the customer lands after paying. Display only: the webhook is the source of truth.
  get "/payment/return" do
    order = ORDERS.find(params["ref"].to_s)
    halt 404, json(error: "order not found") unless order

    json(reference: order.reference, status: order.status)
  end

  get "/orders/:reference" do
    order = ORDERS.find(params["reference"])
    halt 404, json(error: "order not found") unless order

    json(order.to_h)
  end

  error(Monobank::Error) { halt 502, json(error: "payment provider error") }

  private

  def handle_status(payload)
    order = ORDERS.find(payload["reference"].to_s)

    # On success, make sure the paid amount matches what we expected.
    if payload["status"] == "success" && order && payload["amount"] != order.amount
      logger&.error("amount mismatch for #{order.reference}: expected #{order.amount}, got #{payload['amount']}")
      return
    end

    result = ORDERS.apply_webhook(payload)
    logger&.info("monobank webhook #{payload['invoiceId']} #{payload['status']} -> #{result}")

    return unless result == :applied

    case payload["status"]
    when "success"
      # TODO: mark order as paid, ship goods, send receipt, etc. Keep it idempotent.
    when "failure"
      # TODO: notify customer; payload["failureReason"] / payload["errCode"] explain why.
    when "reversed"
      # TODO: payment refunded/cancelled.
    when "expired"
      # TODO: release reserved stock.
    when "created", "processing", "hold"
      # Intermediate states: nothing to do.
    end
  end

  run! if app_file == $PROGRAM_NAME
end
```

## Notes

- **Amounts** are integers in kopecks, and currency `980` is UAH.
- **Signature check:** monobank signs the raw body with ECDSA/SHA-256 and sends it base64-encoded in `X-Sign`. The public key comes from `/api/merchant/pubkey`, base64-wrapped PEM. The verifier uses the raw request body, caches the key, and refetches it once if verification fails, in case the key was rotated.
- **Webhook handling is idempotent and order-safe.** It compares `modifiedDate` to drop stale or duplicate deliveries, and checks the paid amount against the order on `success`.
- **The redirect page isn't proof of payment.** Only the signed webhook, or a call to `invoice_status` for reconciliation, should mark an order as paid.
- **The webhook URL must be publicly reachable over HTTPS.** Use a tunnel such as ngrok in development, and set `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` to the tunnel address.
- **Persistence:** `OrderStore` is in-memory for demonstration. Swap it for your database, using a unique constraint on `reference` and transactions around status updates.

text: # Telegram-бот для статусів замовлень (Ruby) ## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source 'https://rubygems.org' ruby '>= 3.0' gem 'telegram-bot-ruby', '~> 2.0' # клієнт Telegram Bot API gem 'sequel', '~> 5.0' # ORM gem 'sqlite3', '~> 2.0' # база даних (SQLite) gem 'dotenv', '~> 3.0' # змінні оточення з .env gem 'logger' # логування (bundled gem у Ruby 3.5+) ``` ## Файл `.env.example` ```dotenv TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=123456:ABC-your-token # Telegram ID адміністраторів через кому (вони можуть змінювати статуси) ADMIN_IDS=111111111,222222222 DATABASE_URL=sqlite://db/bot.sqlite3 ``` ## Реалізація: `bot.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require 'bundler/setup' require 'dotenv/load' require 'logger' require 'cgi' require 'fileutils' require 'sequel' require 'telegram/bot' LOGGER = Logger.new($stdout) # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # База даних # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- FileUtils.mkdir_p('db') DB = Sequel.connect(ENV.fetch('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://db/bot.sqlite3')) DB.create_table?(:orders) do primary_key :id Bignum :chat_id, null: false String :description, null: false String :status, null: false, default: 'new' DateTime :created_at DateTime :updated_at index :chat_id end Sequel::Model.plugin :timestamps, update_on_create: true class Order < Sequel::Model(:orders) STATUSES = { 'new' => '🆕 Нове', 'processing' => '⚙️ В обробці', 'shipped' => '🚚 Відправлене', 'delivered' => '✅ Доставлене', 'cancelled' => '❌ Скасоване' }.freeze def status_label STATUSES.fetch(status, status) end def final? %w[delivered cancelled].include?(status) end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Бот # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class OrderStatusBot COMMAND_REGEX = %r{\A/(\w+)(?:@\w+)?(?:\s+(.*))?\z}m def initialize(token, admin_ids: []) @token = token @admin_ids = admin_ids end def run LOGGER.info('Бот запущено') begin Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot| @bot = bot bot.listen { |update| handle(update) } end rescue Faraday::Error, Net::ReadTimeout, SocketError => e LOGGER.error("Помилка мережі: #{e.class}: #{e.message}. Перезапуск через 5 с...") sleep 5 retry end end private def handle(update) return unless update.is_a?(Telegram::Bot::Types::Message) return if update.text.nil? match = COMMAND_REGEX.match(update.text.strip) return reply(update, 'Я розумію лише команди. Спробуйте /help') unless match command = match[1].downcase args = match[2].to_s.strip LOGGER.info("Команда /#{command} від #{update.from.id}") case command when 'start' then cmd_start(update) when 'help' then cmd_help(update) when 'neworder' then cmd_new_order(update, args) when 'myorders' then cmd_my_orders(update) when 'status' then cmd_status(update, args) when 'cancel' then cmd_cancel(update, args) when 'setstatus' then cmd_set_status(update, args) else reply(update, 'Невідома команда. Список команд: /help') end rescue Telegram::Bot::Exceptions::ResponseError => e LOGGER.error("Telegram API: #{e.message}") rescue StandardError => e LOGGER.error("#{e.class}: #{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first(5).join("\n")}") reply(update, 'Сталася внутрішня помилка. Спробуйте пізніше.') end # ----- Команди користувача ------------------------------------------------ def cmd_start(msg) name = CGI.escapeHTML(msg.from.first_name.to_s) reply(msg, "Привіт, #{name}! 👋\n" \ "Я допоможу відстежувати статуси ваших замовлень.\n\n" \ "Список команд: /help") end def cmd_help(msg) text = <<~TEXT Доступні команди: /neworder <опис> — створити замовлення /myorders — список моїх замовлень /status <id> — статус замовлення /cancel <id> — скасувати замовлення /help — ця довідка TEXT if admin?(msg) text += <<~ADMIN Для адміністраторів: /setstatus <id> <#{Order::STATUSES.keys.join('|')}> ADMIN end reply(msg, text) end def cmd_new_order(msg, args) return reply(msg, 'Вкажіть опис: /neworder Піца Маргарита') if args.empty? return reply(msg, 'Опис занадто довгий (макс. 200 символів).') if args.length > 200 order = Order.create(chat_id: msg.chat.id, description: args) reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{order.id} створено.\nСтатус: #{order.status_label}") end def cmd_my_orders(msg) orders = Order.where(chat_id: msg.chat.id).reverse_order(:id).limit(10).all return reply(msg, 'У вас ще немає замовлень.') if orders.empty? lines = orders.map do |o| "№#{o.id} — #{CGI.escapeHTML(o.description)}\n #{o.status_label}" end reply(msg, "Ваші останні замовлення:\n\n#{lines.join("\n\n")}") end def cmd_status(msg, args) id = parse_id(args) return reply(msg, 'Використання: /status 12') unless id order = find_order(msg, id) return reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{id} не знайдено.") unless order reply(msg, order_card(order)) end def cmd_cancel(msg, args) id = parse_id(args) return reply(msg, 'Використання: /cancel 12') unless id order = Order.where(id: id, chat_id: msg.chat.id).first return reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{id} не знайдено.") unless order return reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{id} вже неможливо скасувати (#{order.status_label}).") if order.final? || order.status == 'shipped' order.update(status: 'cancelled') reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{id} скасовано.") end # ----- Команди адміністратора -------------------------------------------- def cmd_set_status(msg, args) return reply(msg, '⛔ Недостатньо прав.') unless admin?(msg) id_str, new_status = args.split(/\s+/, 2) id = parse_id(id_str) unless id && Order::STATUSES.key?(new_status) return reply(msg, "Використання: /setstatus 12 shipped\n" \ "Статуси: #{Order::STATUSES.keys.join(', ')}") end order = Order[id] return reply(msg, "Замовлення №#{id} не знайдено.") unless order old_label = order.status_label order.update(status: new_status) reply(msg, "Статус замовлення №#{id} змінено: #{old_label} → #{order.status_label}") notify_customer(order) end # ----- Допоміжні методи --------------------------------------------------- # Push-сповіщення клієнту про зміну статусу def notify_customer(order) send_message( order.chat_id, "🔔 Оновлення замовлення №#{order.id}\n" \ "#{CGI.escapeHTML(order.description)}\n" \ "Новий статус: #{order.status_label}" ) rescue Telegram::Bot::Exceptions::ResponseError => e LOGGER.warn("Не вдалося сповістити #{order.chat_id}: #{e.message}") end def order_card(order) <<~TEXT Замовлення №#{order.id} Опис: #{CGI.escapeHTML(order.description)} Статус: #{order.status_label} Створено: #{order.created_at&.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')} Оновлено: #{order.updated_at&.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')} TEXT end # Адміністратор бачить усі замовлення, користувач — лише свої def find_order(msg, id) admin?(msg) ? Order[id] : Order.where(id: id, chat_id: msg.chat.id).first end def parse_id(str) str.to_s.match?(/\A\d+\z/) ? str.to_i : nil end def admin?(msg) @admin_ids.include?(msg.from.id) end def reply(msg, text) send_message(msg.chat.id, text) end def send_message(chat_id, text) @bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text, parse_mode: 'HTML') end end # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Точка входу # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__ token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN'] abort('Встановіть TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN у .env') if token.nil? || token.empty? admin_ids = ENV.fetch('ADMIN_IDS', '').split(',').map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?).map(&:to_i) trap('INT') { LOGGER.info('Зупинка бота'); exit } trap('TERM') { LOGGER.info('Зупинка бота'); exit } OrderStatusBot.new(token, admin_ids: admin_ids).run end ``` ## Запуск ```bash bundle install cp .env.example .env # впишіть токен від @BotFather та свій Telegram ID bundle exec ruby bot.rb ``` ## Приклад сценарію | Хто | Команда | Результат | |---|---|---| | Клієнт | `/neworder Піца Маргарита` | Замовлення №1 створено, 🆕 Нове | | Адмін | `/setstatus 1 shipped` | Адміністратор бачить підтвердження | | Клієнт | *(автоматично)* | 🔔 Оновлення замовлення №1 — 🚚 Відправлене | | Клієнт | `/status 1` | Картка замовлення з датами | | Клієнт | `/myorders` | Список останніх 10 замовлень | ## Особливості - Користувач бачить лише свої замовлення, адміністратор — усі. - Зміна статусу через `/setstatus` одразу надсилає клієнтові push-повідомлення. - Увесь введений користувачем текст екранується через `CGI.escapeHTML`, тому HTML-розмітка не ламається. - Помилки мережі обробляються з автоматичним перепідключенням, а помилки Telegram API (наприклад, бот заблокований) логуються й не зупиняють роботу.

## ebay_sync.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Lists products from a local table on eBay (Sell Inventory API) and pushes
# quantity changes when stock changes.
#
# Usage:
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb init     # create products table
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb seed     # insert a sample product
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb list     # publish pending products
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb sync     # push changed quantities
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb run      # list + sync once (cron-friendly)
#   bundle exec ruby ebay_sync.rb watch    # run in a loop every SYNC_INTERVAL seconds
#
# Required ENV:
#   EBAY_CLIENT_ID, EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET, EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN
#   EBAY_FULFILLMENT_POLICY_ID, EBAY_PAYMENT_POLICY_ID, EBAY_RETURN_POLICY_ID
#   EBAY_MERCHANT_LOCATION_KEY
# Optional ENV:
#   EBAY_ENV (sandbox|production, default sandbox), EBAY_MARKETPLACE_ID (default EBAY_US),
#   DATABASE_URL (default sqlite://products.db), SYNC_INTERVAL (default 60)

require "json"
require "logger"
require "sequel"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Ebay
  Config = Struct.new(
    :client_id, :client_secret, :refresh_token, :environment, :marketplace_id,
    :fulfillment_policy_id, :payment_policy_id, :return_policy_id,
    :merchant_location_key,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def self.from_env
      new(
        client_id:             ENV.fetch("EBAY_CLIENT_ID"),
        client_secret:         ENV.fetch("EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET"),
        refresh_token:         ENV.fetch("EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN"),
        environment:           ENV.fetch("EBAY_ENV", "sandbox"),
        marketplace_id:        ENV.fetch("EBAY_MARKETPLACE_ID", "EBAY_US"),
        fulfillment_policy_id: ENV.fetch("EBAY_FULFILLMENT_POLICY_ID"),
        payment_policy_id:     ENV.fetch("EBAY_PAYMENT_POLICY_ID"),
        return_policy_id:      ENV.fetch("EBAY_RETURN_POLICY_ID"),
        merchant_location_key: ENV.fetch("EBAY_MERCHANT_LOCATION_KEY")
      )
    end

    def production? = environment == "production"
    def base_url    = production? ? "https://api.ebay.com" : "https://api.sandbox.ebay.com"
  end

  class ApiError < StandardError
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(status, body)
      @status = status
      @body   = body
      super("eBay API error #{status}: #{summarize(body)}")
    end

    def error_ids
      return [] unless body.is_a?(Hash)

      Array(body["errors"]).map { |e| e["errorId"] }
    end

    private

    def summarize(body)
      return body.to_s[0, 500] unless body.is_a?(Hash) && body["errors"]

      body["errors"].map { |e| "[#{e['errorId']}] #{e['message']}" }.join("; ")
    end
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OAuth: exchanges the long-lived refresh token for short-lived access tokens
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class TokenProvider
    SCOPE = "https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.inventory"

    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
      @mutex  = Mutex.new
      @token  = nil
      @expires_at = Time.at(0)
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: config.base_url) do |f|
        f.request :authorization, :basic, config.client_id, config.client_secret
        f.request :url_encoded
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    def token
      @mutex.synchronize do
        refresh! if @token.nil? || Time.now >= @expires_at - 60
        @token
      end
    end

    def invalidate!
      @mutex.synchronize { @token = nil }
    end

    private

    def refresh!
      resp = @conn.post("/identity/v1/oauth2/token", {
        grant_type: "refresh_token",
        refresh_token: @config.refresh_token,
        scope: SCOPE
      })
      raise ApiError.new(resp.status, resp.body) unless resp.success?

      @token      = resp.body.fetch("access_token")
      @expires_at = Time.now + resp.body.fetch("expires_in").to_i
    end
  end

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Thin client over the Sell Inventory REST API
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  class Client
    BULK_LIMIT = 25 # eBay accepts at most 25 SKUs per bulk_update_price_quantity call

    def initialize(config, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
      @config = config
      @logger = logger
      @tokens = TokenProvider.new(config)
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: config.base_url) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.request :retry,
                  max: 3, interval: 1, backoff_factor: 2,
                  retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                  methods: %i[get put post delete]
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/
        f.headers["Accept"]                  = "application/json"
        f.headers["Content-Language"]        = "en-US"
        f.headers["Accept-Language"]         = "en-US"
        f.headers["X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID"] = config.marketplace_id
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    # Creates or fully replaces the inventory item for a SKU (returns 204).
    def put_inventory_item(sku, payload)
      request(:put, "/sell/inventory/v1/inventory_item/#{enc(sku)}", body: payload)
    end

    # Returns the new offerId.
    def create_offer(payload)
      request(:post, "/sell/inventory/v1/offer", body: payload).fetch("offerId")
    end

    # Returns the existing offerId for a SKU on our marketplace, or nil.
    def find_offer_id(sku)
      body = request(:get, "/sell/inventory/v1/offer",
                     params: { sku: sku, marketplace_id: @config.marketplace_id })
      Array(body && body["offers"]).first&.fetch("offerId")
    rescue ApiError => e
      raise unless e.status == 404

      nil
    end

    # Returns the listingId.
    def publish_offer(offer_id)
      request(:post, "/sell/inventory/v1/offer/#{enc(offer_id)}/publish").fetch("listingId")
    end

    # requests: array of up to 25 hashes. Returns the parsed "responses" array.
    def bulk_update_price_quantity(requests)
      raise ArgumentError, "max #{BULK_LIMIT} per call" if requests.size > BULK_LIMIT

      body = request(:post, "/sell/inventory/v1/bulk_update_price_quantity",
                     body: { requests: requests })
      Array(body && body["responses"])
    end

    private

    def enc(value) = URI.encode_www_form_component(value.to_s)

    def request(verb, path, body: nil, params: nil, retried_auth: false)
      resp = @conn.run_request(verb, path, body, nil) do |req|
        req.params.update(params) if params
        req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{@tokens.token}"
      end

      if resp.status == 401 && !retried_auth
        @tokens.invalidate!
        return request(verb, path, body: body, params: params, retried_auth: true)
      end

      # bulk_update returns 200 with per-SKU statuses; 207-style partials are
      # handled by the caller, so only raise on real HTTP failures.
      raise ApiError.new(resp.status, resp.body) unless resp.success?

      resp.body
    end
  end
end

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
DB = Sequel.connect(ENV.fetch("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite://products.db"))

def create_schema!
  DB.create_table?(:products) do
    primary_key :id
    String  :sku,            null: false, unique: true
    String  :title,          null: false
    String  :description,    null: false, text: true
    Integer :price_cents,    null: false
    String  :currency,       null: false, default: "USD"
    Integer :stock_quantity, null: false, default: 0   # <- your app updates this
    String  :condition,      null: false, default: "NEW"
    String  :category_id,    null: false               # eBay leaf category ID
    String  :brand
    String  :image_urls,     null: false, text: true, default: "[]" # JSON array
    # --- eBay sync state (managed by this script) ---
    String  :ebay_offer_id
    String  :ebay_listing_id
    String  :ebay_status,    null: false, default: "pending" # pending | listed
    Integer :synced_quantity # last quantity successfully pushed to eBay
    String  :last_error, text: true
  end
end

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync logic
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EbaySync
  OFFER_ALREADY_EXISTS = 25_002

  def initialize(db:, client:, config:, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
    @db     = db
    @client = client
    @config = config
    @log    = logger
  end

  def products = @db[:products]

  # Publish every not-yet-listed product that has stock.
  def list_pending
    products.where(ebay_status: "pending").where(Sequel[:stock_quantity] > 0).all.each do |product|
      publish(product)
    end
  end

  # Push quantity for every listed product whose stock differs from what eBay has.
  def sync_quantities
    changed = products
              .where(ebay_status: "listed")
              .where(Sequel.lit("synced_quantity IS NULL OR stock_quantity <> synced_quantity"))
              .all

    changed.each_slice(Ebay::Client::BULK_LIMIT) { |batch| push_batch(batch) }
    @log.info("Quantity sync complete (#{changed.size} product(s) changed)")
  end

  def run_once
    list_pending
    sync_quantities
  end

  private

  def publish(product)
    qty = [product[:stock_quantity], 0].max
    sku = product[:sku]

    @client.put_inventory_item(sku, inventory_item_payload(product, qty))

    offer_id = product[:ebay_offer_id] || create_or_find_offer(product, qty)
    # Persist the offer id immediately so a failed publish never creates a duplicate offer.
    products.where(id: product[:id]).update(ebay_offer_id: offer_id)

    listing_id = @client.publish_offer(offer_id)
    products.where(id: product[:id]).update(
      ebay_listing_id: listing_id,
      ebay_status: "listed",
      synced_quantity: qty,
      last_error: nil
    )
    @log.info("Listed #{sku} as listing #{listing_id} (qty #{qty})")
  rescue Ebay::ApiError => e
    @log.error("Failed to list #{product[:sku]}: #{e.message}")
    products.where(id: product[:id]).update(last_error: e.message[0, 1000])
  end

  def create_or_find_offer(product, qty)
    @client.create_offer(offer_payload(product, qty))
  rescue Ebay::ApiError => e
    raise unless e.error_ids.include?(OFFER_ALREADY_EXISTS)

    @client.find_offer_id(product[:sku]) || raise
  end

  def push_batch(batch)
    sent = batch.to_h do |p|
      [p[:sku], { product: p, qty: [p[:stock_quantity], 0].max }]
    end

    requests = sent.map do |sku, s|
      {
        sku: sku,
        shipToLocationAvailability: { quantity: s[:qty] },
        offers: [{ offerId: s[:product][:ebay_offer_id], availableQuantity: s[:qty] }]
      }
    end

    @client.bulk_update_price_quantity(requests).each do |r|
      entry = sent[r["sku"]] or next
      if r["statusCode"].to_i == 200
        # Record the quantity we actually sent, not the current stock, so a change
        # that happened mid-call is picked up on the next pass.
        products.where(id: entry[:product][:id]).update(synced_quantity: entry[:qty], last_error: nil)
        @log.info("Updated #{r['sku']} quantity -> #{entry[:qty]}")
      else
        msg = Array(r["errors"]).map { |e| "[#{e['errorId']}] #{e['message']}" }.join("; ")
        @log.error("Quantity update failed for #{r['sku']}: #{msg}")
        products.where(id: entry[:product][:id]).update(last_error: msg[0, 1000])
      end
    end
  rescue Ebay::ApiError => e
    @log.error("Bulk quantity update failed: #{e.message}")
  end

  def inventory_item_payload(product, qty)
    images = JSON.parse(product[:image_urls])
    {
      product: {
        title: product[:title][0, 80], # eBay title limit
        description: product[:description],
        imageUrls: images,
        brand: product[:brand]
      }.compact,
      condition: product[:condition],
      availability: { shipToLocationAvailability: { quantity: qty } }
    }
  end

  def offer_payload(product, qty)
    {
      sku: product[:sku],
      marketplaceId: @config.marketplace_id,
      format: "FIXED_PRICE",
      availableQuantity: qty,
      categoryId: product[:category_id],
      listingDescription: product[:description],
      merchantLocationKey: @config.merchant_location_key,
      listingPolicies: {
        fulfillmentPolicyId: @config.fulfillment_policy_id,
        paymentPolicyId: @config.payment_policy_id,
        returnPolicyId: @config.return_policy_id
      },
      pricingSummary: {
        price: {
          value: format("%.2f", product[:price_cents] / 100.0),
          currency: product[:currency]
        }
      }
    }
  end
end

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  command = ARGV.fetch(0, "run")

  case command
  when "init"
    create_schema!
    puts "products table ready"
  when "seed"
    create_schema!
    DB[:products].insert_ignore.insert(
      sku: "DEMO-001", title: "Demo Widget", description: "A very fine widget.",
      price_cents: 1999, stock_quantity: 10, category_id: "11700", brand: "Acme",
      image_urls: JSON.generate(["https://example.com/widget.jpg"])
    )
    puts "seeded"
  when "list", "sync", "run", "watch"
    create_schema!
    config = Ebay::Config.from_env
    sync   = EbaySync.new(db: DB, client: Ebay::Client.new(config, logger: logger),
                          config: config, logger: logger)
    case command
    when "list" then sync.list_pending
    when "sync" then sync.sync_quantities
    when "run"  then sync.run_once
    when "watch"
      interval = Integer(ENV.fetch("SYNC_INTERVAL", "60"))
      trap("INT") { puts "\nBye"; exit }
      loop do
        begin
          sync.run_once
        rescue StandardError => e
          logger.error("Sync cycle failed: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
        end
        sleep interval
      end
    end
  else
    warn "Unknown command #{command.inspect}. Use: init | seed | list | sync | run | watch"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## How it works

- **Stock change detection:** Your app only needs to update `products.stock_quantity`. The script compares it to `synced_quantity`, the last value eBay confirmed. Any difference gets pushed. This works without triggers, and a failed push is retried on the next run.
- **Listing:** For each `pending` product with stock, the script creates the inventory item, creates an offer, and publishes it. The offer ID is saved before publishing, and a "duplicate offer" error (25002) recovers the existing offer, so retries never create duplicates.
- **Quantity updates:** These use `bulk_update_price_quantity`, 25 SKUs per call, and each SKU's result is checked individually.
- **Auth:** The refresh token is exchanged for access tokens, which are cached and refreshed on expiry or on a 401.

## Prerequisites on the eBay side

1. Create a developer account and a keyset, and get a user refresh token with the `sell.inventory` scope.
2. Opt in to Business Policies and create fulfillment, payment, and return policies. Put their IDs in the env vars.
3. Create an inventory location with `createInventoryLocation` and use its key as `EBAY_MERCHANT_LOCATION_KEY`.
4. Store a valid leaf `category_id` per product. The Taxonomy API can look these up.
5. Test with `EBAY_ENV=sandbox` before switching to `production`.

## Notes

- Setting a published listing's quantity to 0 marks it out of stock. Whether the listing stays active depends on your account's out-of-stock-control setting.
- Failed listings stay `pending` with the reason in `last_error`, and they are retried on every run.
- To sync prices too, add `price: { value:, currency: }` to each `offers` entry in `push_batch`.

Cheap pre-checks (empty, bad characters, missing country prefix) give more specific messages first. - **BIC:** The BIC must be 8 or 11 characters: 4 letters (bank), 2 letters (country), 2 alphanumerics (location), and an optional 3 alphanumerics (branch). Each failure gets its own message. - **Errors:** Both fields are validated on every submit, so the user sees all problems at once. ## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "rqrcode", "~> 2.2"       # QR code generation
gem "chunky_png", "~> 1.4"    # PNG rendering (used by rqrcode's as_png)
```

## nbu_qr.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "rqrcode"
require "chunky_png"

# Generates payment QR codes following the National Bank of Ukraine (NBU)
# QR payment standard (Resolution No. 97, format "BCD" / "UCT").
#
# Payload layout (UTF-8, lines separated by LF):
#
#   1  BCD                 service tag
#   2  002                 format version
#   3  1                   encoding (1 = UTF-8)
#   4  UCT                 function (Ukrainian Credit Transfer)
#   5  (empty)             reserved
#   6  receiver name       up to 100 chars
#   7  receiver IBAN       29 chars, starts with UA
#   8  UAH<amount>         currency + amount (dot as the decimal separator)
#   9  receiver code       EDRPOU (8 digits) or RNOKPP (10 digits)
#  10  (empty)             reserved
#  11  (empty)             reserved
#  12  payment purpose     up to 140 chars
#  13  (empty)             reserved (display text)
#  14  (empty)             reserved (footer)
#
# The data is published either as plain text or as a link:
#   https://bank.gov.ua/qr/<base64url(payload)>
# The link form is the default, because banking apps and the phone camera
# can both open it.
module NbuQr
  class ValidationError < StandardError; end

  SERVICE_TAG = "BCD"
  VERSION     = "002"
  ENCODING    = "1" # UTF-8
  FUNCTION    = "UCT"
  CURRENCY    = "UAH"
  URL_PREFIX  = "https://bank.gov.ua/qr/"

  MAX_NAME_LENGTH    = 100
  MAX_PURPOSE_LENGTH = 140
  MAX_AMOUNT         = 999_999_999_99 # in kopecks (9 integer digits)

  Payment = Struct.new(:name, :iban, :amount, :code, :purpose, keyword_init: true)

  module_function

  # Returns the raw payload string.
  def payload(name:, iban:, code:, purpose:, amount: nil)
    payment = build_payment(name, iban, amount, code, purpose)

    [
      SERVICE_TAG,
      VERSION,
      ENCODING,
      FUNCTION,
      "",                                        # reserved
      payment.name,
      payment.iban,
      payment.amount ? "#{CURRENCY}#{payment.amount}" : "",
      payment.code,
      "",                                        # reserved
      "",                                        # reserved
      payment.purpose,
      "",                                        # display text (reserved)
      ""                                         # footer (reserved)
    ].join("\n")
  end

  # Returns the string to encode in the QR code (URL form by default).
  def qr_content(as_url: true, **fields)
    data = payload(**fields)
    as_url ? URL_PREFIX + base64url(data) : data
  end

  # Returns an RQRCode::QRCode object.
  def build_qr(as_url: true, **fields)
    RQRCode::QRCode.new(
      qr_content(as_url: as_url, **fields),
      level: :m,           # error correction level M
      mode: :byte_8bit     # needed for UTF-8 / Cyrillic text
    )
  end

  # Writes a PNG file and returns the path.
  def save_png(path, size: 600, border_modules: 4, **opts)
    qr = build_qr(**opts)
    png = qr.as_png(
      size: size,
      border_modules: border_modules,
      color: "black",
      fill: "white"
    )
    File.binwrite(path, png.to_s)
    path
  end

  # Returns an SVG string.
  def svg(**opts)
    build_qr(**opts).as_svg(
      offset: 16,
      module_size: 6,
      color: "000",
      shape_rendering: "crispEdges",
      standalone: true
    )
  end

  # ---------- validation helpers ----------

  def build_payment(name, iban, amount, code, purpose)
    Payment.new(
      name:    clean_text(name, "Receiver name", MAX_NAME_LENGTH),
      iban:    clean_iban(iban),
      amount:  format_amount(amount),
      code:    clean_code(code),
      purpose: clean_text(purpose, "Purpose", MAX_PURPOSE_LENGTH)
    )
  end

  def clean_text(value, label, max)
    text = value.to_s.strip.gsub(/\s*[\r\n]+\s*/, " ")
    raise ValidationError, "#{label} must not be empty" if text.empty?
    if text.length > max
      raise ValidationError, "#{label} is too long (#{text.length} > #{max})"
    end
    text
  end

  def clean_iban(value)
    iban = value.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, "").upcase
    unless iban.match?(/\AUA\d{2}[0-9A-Z]{25}\z/)
      raise ValidationError, "IBAN must be 29 characters: UA + 2 digits + 25 alphanumerics"
    end
    raise ValidationError, "IBAN checksum is invalid" unless valid_iban_checksum?(iban)
    iban
  end

  # ISO 13616 mod-97 check.
  def valid_iban_checksum?(iban)
    rearranged = iban[4..] + iban[0, 4]
    numeric = rearranged.each_char.map { |c| c.match?(/\d/) ? c : (c.ord - 55).to_s }.join
    numeric.to_i % 97 == 1
  end

  def clean_code(value)
    code = value.to_s.strip
    unless code.match?(/\A(\d{8}|\d{10})\z/)
      raise ValidationError, "Receiver code must be an EDRPOU (8 digits) or RNOKPP (10 digits)"
    end
    code
  end

  # Returns e.g. "150.50", or nil when no amount was given.
  # Avoids Float rounding by using Rational.
  def format_amount(value)
    return nil if value.nil? || value.to_s.strip.empty?

    rational =
      begin
        Rational(value.to_s.strip.tr(",", "."))
      rescue ArgumentError, ZeroDivisionError
        raise ValidationError, "Amount is not a valid number: #{value.inspect}"
      end

    kopecks = rational * 100
    raise ValidationError, "Amount must have at most 2 decimal places" unless kopecks.denominator == 1

    kopecks = kopecks.to_i
    raise ValidationError, "Amount must be positive" unless kopecks.positive?
    raise ValidationError, "Amount is too large" if kopecks > MAX_AMOUNT

    format("%d.%02d", kopecks / 100, kopecks % 100)
  end

  # URL-safe Base64 without padding.
  def base64url(data)
    [data.b].pack("m0").tr("+/", "-_").delete("=")
  end
end

# ---------------- example usage ----------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    fields = {
      name:    "ТОВ «Приклад»",
      iban:    "UA213223130000026007233566001",
      code:    "12345678",
      amount:  "150.50",
      purpose: "Оплата за рахунком №123 від 01.05.2024"
    }

    puts "Payload:"
    puts NbuQr.payload(**fields)
    puts
    puts "QR content (URL form):"
    puts NbuQr.qr_content(**fields)

    path = NbuQr.save_png("nbu_payment_qr.png", **fields)
    puts "\nPNG saved to #{path}"

    File.write("nbu_payment_qr.svg", NbuQr.svg(**fields))
    puts "SVG saved to nbu_payment_qr.svg"
  rescue NbuQr::ValidationError => e
    warn "Validation error: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Usage

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec ruby nbu_qr.rb
```

Notes:
- Pass `as_url: false` to encode the plain `BCD…` payload instead of the `https://bank.gov.ua/qr/...` link.
- `amount` is optional. If you omit it, the payer enters the amount in their banking app.
- Check the field length limits and reserved lines against the current NBU specification before using this in production. The standard has been revised, and the limits are constants at the top of the module.
- The sample IBAN passes the checksum test, but it is only an example. Replace it with real details.
