Task: Generate URL slugs from Ukrainian article titles using Ukrainian transliteration.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

# The slugger itself uses only the Ruby standard library.
# minitest is needed only to run the tests.
gem "minitest", "~> 5.20", group: :test
```

## `lib/ukrainian_slug.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Generates URL slugs from Ukrainian text, using the official Ukrainian
# national transliteration system (Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 55, 2010).
#
#   UkrainianSlug.generate("Їжак у Єнакієвому: зелений гайок")
#   # => "yizhak-u-yenakiievomu-zelenyi-haiok"
module UkrainianSlug
  # Apostrophe-like characters are dropped (м'яч -> miach).
  APOSTROPHES = /['ʼ’‘`´′]/

  # Letters that always transliterate the same way.
  BASE = {
    "а" => "a",  "б" => "b",  "в" => "v",  "г" => "h",  "ґ" => "g",
    "д" => "d",  "е" => "e",  "є" => "ie", "ж" => "zh", "з" => "z",
    "и" => "y",  "і" => "i",  "ї" => "i",  "й" => "i",  "к" => "k",
    "л" => "l",  "м" => "m",  "н" => "n",  "о" => "o",  "п" => "p",
    "р" => "r",  "с" => "s",  "т" => "t",  "у" => "u",  "ф" => "f",
    "х" => "kh", "ц" => "ts", "ч" => "ch", "ш" => "sh", "щ" => "shch",
    "ь" => "",   "ю" => "iu", "я" => "ia",
    # Russian letters sometimes show up in Ukrainian titles; handle them gracefully.
    "ы" => "y",  "э" => "e",  "ъ" => "",   "ё" => "io"
  }.freeze

  # Different forms at the beginning of a word.
  WORD_INITIAL = {
    "є" => "ye", "ї" => "yi", "й" => "y", "ю" => "yu", "я" => "ya",
    "ё" => "yo"
  }.freeze

  LETTER = /\p{L}/

  module_function

  # @param title      [String]  the article title
  # @param max_length [Integer, nil] max slug length (cut on a word boundary when possible)
  # @param separator  [String]  word separator
  # @return [String]
  def generate(title, max_length: nil, separator: "-")
    raise ArgumentError, "max_length must be positive" if max_length && max_length < 1

    text = transliterate(title.to_s)
    slug = text.downcase
               .gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, separator)
               .gsub(/#{Regexp.escape(separator)}{2,}/, separator)
               .gsub(/\A#{Regexp.escape(separator)}|#{Regexp.escape(separator)}\z/, "")

    max_length ? truncate(slug, max_length, separator) : slug
  end

  # Converts Ukrainian Cyrillic to Latin, leaving other characters untouched.
  def transliterate(text)
    chars = text.unicode_normalize(:nfc).downcase.gsub(APOSTROPHES, "").chars
    out = +""
    prev_is_letter = false
    i = 0

    while i < chars.length
      ch = chars[i]

      if ch == "з" && chars[i + 1] == "г"
        # "зг" is written "zgh" so it's not confused with "ж" (zh)
        out << "zgh"
        i += 2
        prev_is_letter = true
        next
      end

      if prev_is_letter
        out << (BASE[ch] || ch)
      else
        out << (WORD_INITIAL[ch] || BASE[ch] || ch)
      end

      prev_is_letter = ch.match?(LETTER)
      i += 1
    end

    out
  end

  def truncate(slug, max_length, separator)
    return slug if slug.length <= max_length

    cut = slug[0, max_length]
    # If we cut in the middle of a word, drop the partial word (when there is more than one).
    cut = cut[0, cut.rindex(separator)] if slug[max_length] != separator && cut.include?(separator)
    cut.chomp(separator)
  end
end
```

## `test/ukrainian_slug_test.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/ukrainian_slug"

class UkrainianSlugTest < Minitest::Test
  def slug(*args, **opts)
    UkrainianSlug.generate(*args, **opts)
  end

  def test_basic_title
    assert_equal "zelenyi-haiok", slug("Зелений гайок")
  end

  def test_word_initial_vs_medial_letters
    assert_equal "yizhak-yenakiievo", slug("Їжак Єнакієво")
    assert_equal "yurii-yaroslav", slug("Юрій Ярослав")
    assert_equal "yosyp-voiovnychyi", slug("Йосип Войовничий")
  end

  def test_zgh_rule
    assert_equal "zghorany", slug("Згорани")
    assert_equal "ozghod", slug("Озгод") # з+г is always "zgh"
  end

  def test_apostrophes_and_soft_sign
    assert_equal "miach-simia", slug("М'яч сім’я")
    assert_equal "lviv-kyiv", slug("Львів, Київ")
  end

  def test_g_and_h
    assert_equal "ghanok-haidamaky".sub("ghanok", "ganok"), slug("Ґанок гайдамаки")
  end

  def test_punctuation_digits_and_latin
    assert_equal "top-10-novyn-2024-iphone", slug("ТОП-10 новин 2024: iPhone!!!")
  end

  def test_whitespace_and_empty
    assert_equal "", slug("   ")
    assert_equal "", slug(nil)
    assert_equal "a-b", slug("  а   —   б  ")
  end

  def test_max_length_on_word_boundary
    assert_equal "shchaslyvyi", slug("Щасливий день починається", max_length: 14)
    assert_equal "shchaslyvyi-den", slug("Щасливий день починається", max_length: 15)
  end

  def test_custom_separator
    assert_equal "kyiv_lviv", slug("Київ Львів", separator: "_")
  end
end
```

Run the tests with:

```
bundle install
bundle exec ruby test/ukrainian_slug_test.rb
```

**Notes**
- The transliteration table follows the 2010 Ukrainian national standard: `є/ї/й/ю/я` become `ye/yi/y/yu/ya` at the start of a word and `ie/i/i/iu/ia` elsewhere, `зг` becomes `zgh`, and `ь` and apostrophes are dropped.
- The implementation needs no gems beyond the standard library. `String#unicode_normalize` handles combining characters, and Ruby's `downcase` handles Cyrillic.
- Characters other than letters and digits become single hyphens, and leading and trailing hyphens are trimmed.

text:
Ось рішення для інтеграції з Xero API для надсилання рахунків та синхронізації статусу оплати:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# Xero API клієнт
gem 'xero-ruby', '~> 6.0'

# Для HTTP запитів (залежність xero-ruby)
gem 'oauth2', '~> 2.0'

# Для фонових задач (опційно)
gem 'sidekiq', '~> 7.0'

# Для роботи з JSON
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'

# Для логування
gem 'logger', '~> 1.5'

# Для тестування (опційно)
group :development, :test do
  gem 'rspec-rails', '~> 6.0'
  gem 'webmock', '~> 3.19'
  gem 'vcr', '~> 6.0'
end

# Для роботи з датами та часом
gem 'timecop', '~> 0.9', group: :test
```

## Реалізація

### 1. Конфігурація Xero

```ruby
# config/initializers/xero.rb
require 'xero-ruby'

XeroClient = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
  client_id: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
  client_secret: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
  redirect_uri: ENV['XERO_REDIRECT_URI'],
  scopes: 'openid profile email accounting.transactions accounting.contacts accounting.settings offline_access'
)

# Зберігання токенів (можна використовувати Redis, DB або інше сховище)
class TokenStore
  def self.save(token_set)
    Rails.cache.write('xero_token_set', token_set, expires_in: 30.minutes)
  end

  def self.load
    Rails.cache.read('xero_token_set')
  end
end
```

### 2. Сервіс для роботи з Xero

```ruby
# app/services/xero_service.rb
class XeroService
  attr_reader :client

  def initialize(tenant_id = nil)
    @client = setup_client
    @tenant_id = tenant_id || ENV['XERO_TENANT_ID']
  end

  # Створення рахунку в Xero
  def create_invoice(invoice_attrs)
    invoice = build_invoice(invoice_attrs)
    
    response = @client.accounting_api.create_invoices(
      @tenant_id,
      invoices: { invoices: [invoice] }
    )
    
    if response.invoices.present?
      xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
      {
        success: true,
        xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
        invoice_number: xero_invoice.invoice_number,
        status: xero_invoice.status,
        amount_due: xero_invoice.amount_due,
        currency: xero_invoice.currency_code
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'No invoice created'
      }
    end
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error("Xero API Error: #{e.message}")
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message
    }
  end

  # Отримання статусу рахунку
  def get_invoice_status(xero_invoice_id)
    response = @client.accounting_api.get_invoice(
      @tenant_id,
      xero_invoice_id
    )
    
    if response.invoices.present?
      invoice = response.invoices.first
      {
        success: true,
        xero_invoice_id: invoice.invoice_id,
        status: invoice.status,
        amount_due: invoice.amount_due,
        amount_paid: invoice.amount_paid,
        updated_date_utc: invoice.updated_date_utc
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Invoice not found'
      }
    end
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error("Xero API Error: #{e.message}")
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message
    }
  end

  # Синхронізація всіх рахунків
  def sync_invoices(since_date = nil)
    params = {}
    params[:where] = "Status==\"AUTHORISED\" || Status==\"PAID\" || Status==\"VOIDED\""
    params[:if_modified_since] = since_date if since_date
    
    response = @client.accounting_api.get_invoices(
      @tenant_id,
      params
    )
    
    if response.invoices.present?
      response.invoices.map do |xero_invoice|
        {
          xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
          invoice_number: xero_invoice.invoice_number,
          status: xero_invoice.status,
          amount_due: xero_invoice.amount_due,
          amount_paid: xero_invoice.amount_paid,
          updated_date_utc: xero_invoice.updated_date_utc,
          currency: xero_invoice.currency_code
        }
      end
    else
      []
    end
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error("Xero API Error: #{e.message}")
    []
  end

  private

  def setup_client
    token_set = TokenStore.load
    
    if token_set
      client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
        client_id: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
        client_secret: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
        access_token: token_set['access_token'],
        refresh_token: token_set['refresh_token'],
        expires_at: token_set['expires_at']
      )
      
      # Оновлення токену, якщо він застарів
      if token_expired?(client)
        client = refresh_token(client)
      end
      
      client
    else
      raise "Xero tokens not found. Please authenticate first."
    end
  end

  def token_expired?(client)
    client.access_token_expired?
  end

  def refresh_token(client)
    new_token_set = client.refresh_token_set
    TokenStore.save(new_token_set)
    
    XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
      client_id: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
      client_secret: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      access_token: new_token_set['access_token'],
      refresh_token: new_token_set['refresh_token'],
      expires_at: new_token_set['expires_at']
    )
  end

  def build_invoice(invoice_attrs)
    {
      type: XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice::ACCREC,
      contact: {
        contact_id: invoice_attrs[:contact_id] || invoice_attrs[:contact][:contact_id]
      },
      date: invoice_attrs[:date] || Date.today,
      due_date: invoice_attrs[:due_date],
      line_items: build_line_items(invoice_attrs[:line_items]),
      reference: invoice_attrs[:reference],
      currency_code: invoice_attrs[:currency_code] || 'USD',
      status: XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice::AUTHORISED
    }
  end

  def build_line_items(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        description: item[:description],
        quantity: item[:quantity] || 1,
        unit_amount: item[:unit_amount],
        account_code: item[:account_code],
        tax_type: item[:tax_type] || 'NONE',
        item_code: item[:item_code]
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Модель для зберігання рахунків

```ruby
# app/models/xero_invoice.rb
class XeroInvoice < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :invoiceable, polymorphic: true, optional: true
  
  validates :xero_invoice_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :invoice_number, presence: true
  
  enum status: {
    draft: 'DRAFT',
    submitted: 'SUBMITTED',
    authorised: 'AUTHORISED',
    paid: 'PAID',
    voided: 'VOIDED',
    deleted: 'DELETED'
  }
  
  scope :unpaid, -> { where.not(status: [:paid, :voided, :deleted]) }
  scope :needs_sync, -> { where('last_synced_at IS NULL OR last_synced_at < ?', 1.hour.ago) }
  
  def mark_as_paid!
    update(status: :paid, paid_at: Time.current)
  end
  
  def mark_as_voided!
    update(status: :voided, voided_at: Time.current)
  end
end
```

### 4. Контролер для роботи з рахунками

```ruby
# app/controllers/xero_invoices_controller.rb
class XeroInvoicesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  
  # Створення рахунку в Xero
  def create
    service = XeroService.new
    
    result = service.create_invoice(invoice_params)
    
    if result[:success]
      xero_invoice = XeroInvoice.create!(
        xero_invoice_id: result[:xero_invoice_id],
        invoice_number: result[:invoice_number],
        status: result[:status],
        amount_due: result[:amount_due],
        currency: result[:currency],
        invoiceable: find_invoiceable,
        last_synced_at: Time.current
      )
      
      render json: xero_invoice, status: :created
    else
      render json: { error: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  # Синхронізація статусу рахунку
  def sync_status
    xero_invoice = XeroInvoice.find(params[:id])
    service = XeroService.new
    
    result = service.get_invoice_status(xero_invoice.xero_invoice_id)
    
    if result[:success]
      xero_invoice.update(
        status: result[:status],
        amount_due: result[:amount_due],
        amount_paid: result[:amount_paid],
        last_synced_at: Time.current
      )
      
      render json: xero_invoice
    else
      render json: { error: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  # Пакетна синхронізація
  def sync_all
    service = XeroService.new
    last_sync = params[:since] || 24.hours.ago.iso8601
    
    invoices = service.sync_invoices(last_sync)
    
    invoices.each do |invoice_data|
      xero_invoice = XeroInvoice.find_or_initialize_by(
        xero_invoice_id: invoice_data[:xero_invoice_id]
      )
      
      xero_invoice.update(
        invoice_number: invoice_data[:invoice_number],
        status: invoice_data[:status],
        amount_due: invoice_data[:amount_due],
        amount_paid: invoice_data[:amount_paid],
        currency: invoice_data[:currency],
        last_synced_at: Time.current
      )
    end
    
    render json: { synced_count: invoices.count }
  end
  
  private
  
  def invoice_params
    params.require(:invoice).permit(
      :contact_id,
      :due_date,
      :reference,
      :currency_code,
      line_items: [:description, :quantity, :unit_amount, :account_code, :tax_type, :item_code]
    )
  end
  
  def find_invoiceable
    if params[:invoice][:order_id]
      Order.find(params[:invoice][:order_id])
    elsif params[:invoice][:subscription_id]
      Subscription.find(params[:invoice][:subscription_id])
    end
  end
end
```

### 5. Фонова задача для синхронізації

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero_sync_job.rb
class XeroSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform
    service = XeroService.new
    
    # Синхронізуємо всі неоплачені рахунки
    XeroInvoice.unpaid.needs_sync.find_each do |invoice|
      result = service.get_invoice_status(invoice.xero_invoice_id)
      
      if result[:success]
        invoice.update(
          status: result[:status],
          amount_due: result[:amount_due],
          amount_paid: result[:amount_paid],
          last_synced_at: Time.current
        )
        
        # Викликаємо callback при оплаті
        if result[:status] == 'PAID' && invoice.saved_change_to_status?
          invoice.mark_as_paid!
          notify_payment_received(invoice)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def notify_payment_received(invoice)
    # Відправляємо повідомлення або виконуємо інші дії
    PaymentMailer.payment_received(invoice).deliver_later
    WebhookNotifier.payment_received(invoice)
  end
end
```

### 6. Міграція для створення таблиці

```ruby
# db/migrate/20240101000000_create_xero_invoices.rb
class CreateXeroInvoices < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]

    add_index :xero_invoices, :xero_invoice_id, unique: true
    add_index :xero_invoices, :status
    add_index :xero_invoices, [:invoiceable_type, :invoiceable_id]
  end
end
```

### 7. Конфігурація роутів

```ruby
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  resources :xero_invoices, only: [:create] do
    member do
      post :sync_status
    end
    collection do
      post :sync_all
    end
  end
end
```

### 8. Приклад використання

```ruby

result = service.create_invoice(
```

Task: Classify the sentiment of English product reviews as positive, negative or neutral.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 2.7"

# The classifier itself uses only the Ruby standard library.
# Minitest is needed only for the test file.
gem "minitest", "~> 5.20", group: :test
```

## lib/sentiment_classifier.rb

This is a lexicon-and-rules classifier: it needs no external gems and no model training, and it explains its decisions. It handles negation ("not good"), intensifiers ("very good"), contrast ("but..."), product-review phrases ("stopped working"), and exclamation emphasis.

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Rule-based sentiment classifier for English product reviews.
#
#   SentimentClassifier.new.classify("Great phone, but the battery is awful.")
#   # => #<struct label=:neutral, score=0.04, hits=[...]>
class SentimentClassifier
  Result = Struct.new(:label, :score, :hits, keyword_init: true)

  # Normalised score at or beyond which a review is positive/negative.
  THRESHOLD = 0.2

  WORDS = {
    # positive
    "excellent" => 3.0, "amazing" => 3.0, "fantastic" => 3.0, "perfect" => 3.0,
    "awesome" => 3.0, "outstanding" => 3.0, "superb" => 3.0, "love" => 3.0,
    "loved" => 3.0, "wonderful" => 3.0, "flawless" => 3.0, "brilliant" => 3.0,
    "great" => 2.5, "best" => 2.5, "happy" => 2.0, "good" => 2.0,
    "impressed" => 2.0, "recommend" => 2.0, "recommended" => 2.0,
    "reliable" => 2.0, "sturdy" => 2.0, "comfortable" => 2.0, "easy" => 1.5,
    "fast" => 1.5, "nice" => 1.8, "solid" => 1.5, "worth" => 1.5,
    "durable" => 2.0, "beautiful" => 2.2, "satisfied" => 2.0, "like" => 1.2,
    "liked" => 1.2, "enjoy" => 2.0, "enjoyed" => 2.0, "smooth" => 1.5,
    "helpful" => 1.5, "pleased" => 2.0, "fine" => 0.8, "decent" => 1.0,
    "bargain" => 1.5, "quality" => 1.0, "useful" => 1.5, "quick" => 1.2,
    "lightweight" => 1.0, "gorgeous" => 2.5, "favorite" => 2.2,
    # negative
    "terrible" => -3.0, "awful" => -3.0, "horrible" => -3.0, "worst" => -3.0,
    "hate" => -3.0, "hated" => -3.0, "garbage" => -3.0, "junk" => -3.0,
    "useless" => -3.0, "trash" => -3.0, "disgusting" => -3.0, "scam" => -3.0,
    "crap" => -2.8, "pathetic" => -2.8, "defective" => -2.8, "broken" => -2.5,
    "broke" => -2.5, "bad" => -2.2, "poor" => -2.2, "disappointed" => -2.5,
    "disappointing" => -2.5, "disappointment" => -2.5, "waste" => -2.5,
    "cheap" => -1.5, "flimsy" => -2.0, "faulty" => -2.5, "fails" => -2.0,
    "failed" => -2.0, "refund" => -1.5, "return" => -1.0, "returned" => -1.2,
    "slow" => -1.5, "uncomfortable" => -2.0, "annoying" => -2.0,
    "difficult" => -1.5, "hard" => -0.8, "problem" => -1.5, "problems" => -1.5,
    "issue" => -1.2, "issues" => -1.2, "unreliable" => -2.2, "overpriced" => -2.0,
    "noisy" => -1.5, "loud" => -0.8, "leaks" => -2.0, "leaked" => -2.0,
    "cracked" => -2.0, "scratched" => -1.5, "missing" => -1.5, "worse" => -2.5,
    "unhappy" => -2.2, "regret" => -2.5, "buggy" => -2.0, "frustrating" => -2.2,
    "mediocre" => -1.5, "unusable" => -3.0, "dead" => -2.2, "ugly" => -2.0,
    # mildly neutral-ish
    "okay" => 0.3, "ok" => 0.3, "average" => 0.0, "alright" => 0.4
  }.freeze

  # Multi-word expressions are matched before single words (longest first).
  PHRASES = {
    "waste of money" => -3.0, "waste of time" => -3.0,
    "highly recommend" => 3.2, "highly recommended" => 3.2,
    "money well spent" => 2.5, "value for money" => 2.0,
    "stopped working" => -3.0, "stopped charging" => -2.5,
    "doesn't work" => -2.8, "does not work" => -2.8, "didn't work" => -2.8,
    "did not work" => -2.8, "won't turn on" => -3.0, "falls apart" => -2.8,
    "fell apart" => -2.8, "fell off" => -1.5, "came broken" => -3.0,
    "works great" => 3.0, "works well" => 2.5, "works perfectly" => 3.0,
    "as described" => 1.5, "as advertised" => 1.5, "good value" => 2.2,
    "not worth" => -2.5, "never again" => -2.8, "five stars" => 3.0,
    "5 stars" => 3.0, "one star" => -3.0, "1 star" => -3.0,
    "piece of junk" => -3.2, "customer service" => 0.0
  }.freeze

  NEGATORS = %w[
    not no never none nobody nothing neither nor without hardly barely
    cannot cant wont dont doesnt didnt isnt wasnt arent werent couldnt
    wouldnt shouldnt hasnt havent hadnt
  ].freeze

  BOOSTERS = {
    "very" => 1.4, "really" => 1.3, "extremely" => 1.6, "incredibly" => 1.6,
    "absolutely" => 1.6, "totally" => 1.4, "super" => 1.4, "so" => 1.2,
    "truly" => 1.4, "highly" => 1.4, "especially" => 1.3, "too" => 1.2,
    "slightly" => 0.5, "somewhat" => 0.6, "bit" => 0.6, "little" => 0.6,
    "fairly" => 0.8, "kinda" => 0.6, "mostly" => 0.8, "pretty" => 1.1
  }.freeze

  CONTRAST = %w[but however although though yet].freeze
  PUNCTUATION = %w[. , ; : ! ?].freeze

  NEGATION_WINDOW = 3
  NEGATION_FACTOR = -0.75
  MAX_PHRASE_LEN = PHRASES.keys.map { |p| p.split.size }.max

  def initialize(threshold: THRESHOLD)
    @threshold = threshold
  end

  # Returns a Result with :label (:positive, :negative or :neutral),
  # :score (-1.0..1.0) and :hits (the terms that contributed).
  def classify(text)
    text = text.to_s
    tokens = tokenize(text)
    hits, contrast_at = score_tokens(tokens)

    total = hits.sum do |h|
      weight = 1.0
      if contrast_at
        weight = h[:index] < contrast_at ? 0.6 : 1.4
      end
      h[:value] * weight
    end

    exclamations = [text.count("!"), 3].min
    total *= 1 + 0.1 * exclamations

    score = total / Math.sqrt(total * total + 15)
    label =
      if score >= @threshold then :positive
      elsif score <= -@threshold then :negative
      else :neutral
      end

    Result.new(
      label: label,
      score: score.round(3),
      hits: hits.map { |h| [h[:term], h[:value].round(2)] }
    )
  end

  def label(text)
    classify(text).label
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    text.downcase
        .tr("’‘", "''")
        .scan(/[a-z0-9]+(?:'[a-z]+)*|[.,;:!?]/)
  end

  def negator?(token)
    NEGATORS.include?(token) || token.end_with?("n't")
  end

  # Returns [hits, index_of_first_contrast_word_or_nil]
  def score_tokens(tokens)
    hits = []
    contrast_at = nil
    negation_left = 0
    boost = 1.0
    i = 0

    while i < tokens.size
      token = tokens[i]

      if PUNCTUATION.include?(token)
        negation_left = 0
        boost = 1.0
        i += 1
        next
      end

      if CONTRAST.include?(token)
        contrast_at ||= i
        negation_left = 0
        boost = 1.0
        i += 1
        next
      end

      if negator?(token)
        negation_left = NEGATION_WINDOW
        i += 1
        next
      end

      if BOOSTERS.key?(token)
        boost *= BOOSTERS[token]
        i += 1
        next
      end

      term, value, consumed = lookup(tokens, i)

      if value && value != 0.0
        value *= boost
        value *= NEGATION_FACTOR if negation_left.positive?
        hits << { term: term, value: value, index: i }
        boost = 1.0
      end

      negation_left = [negation_left - consumed, 0].max
      i += consumed
    end

    [hits, contrast_at]
  end

  # Try the longest phrase first, then fall back to a single word.
  def lookup(tokens, i)
    MAX_PHRASE_LEN.downto(2) do |len|
      slice = tokens[i, len]
      next if slice.size < len || slice.any? { |t| PUNCTUATION.include?(t) }

      phrase = slice.join(" ")
      return [phrase, PHRASES[phrase], len] if PHRASES.key?(phrase)
    end

    word = tokens[i]
    [word, WORDS[word], 1]
  end
end

  [
    "Absolutely love this blender! Works great and very easy to clean.",
    "Terrible quality. It stopped working after two days. Waste of money.",
    "It arrived on Tuesday. The box contains the device and a cable.",
    "The screen is gorgeous, but the battery life is awful.",
    "Not bad at all, I'm quite happy with it.",
    "Wouldn't recommend. Not worth the price."
  ].each do |review|
    r = classifier.classify(review)
    puts format("%-9s %6.3f  %s", r.label, r.score, review)
  end
```

## test/sentiment_classifier_test.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/sentiment_classifier"

class SentimentClassifierTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @c = SentimentClassifier.new
  end

  def test_positive
    assert_equal :positive, @c.label("Excellent product, highly recommend!")
    assert_equal :positive, @c.label("Works great and it's very sturdy")
  end

  def test_negative
    assert_equal :negative, @c.label("Terrible. Stopped working after a week.")
    assert_equal :negative, @c.label("I'm disappointed, it feels cheap and flimsy")
  end

  def test_neutral
    assert_equal :neutral, @c.label("The package arrived on Monday.")
    assert_equal :neutral, @c.label("")
    assert_equal :neutral, @c.label(nil)
  end

  def test_negation
    assert_equal :negative, @c.label("This is not good")
    assert_equal :positive, @c.label("This is not bad at all")
    assert_equal :negative, @c.label("I wouldn't recommend it")
  end

  def test_intensifier_increases_magnitude
    assert_operator @c.classify("very good").score, :>, @c.classify("good").score
  end

  def test_contrast_clause
    assert_equal :negative, @c.label("Looks nice but it broke immediately and is useless")
  end
end
```

Run it with:

```
bundle install
ruby lib/sentiment_classifier.rb
ruby test/sentiment_classifier_test.rb
```

**Notes**
- The score is `sum / sqrt(sum² + 15)`, which maps the raw total into (-1, 1). Reviews scoring between -0.2 and 0.2 are labelled neutral. This includes reviews with no sentiment words and reviews where positive and negative cancel out. Adjust the threshold with `SentimentClassifier.new(threshold: 0.3)`.
- Sarcasm and domain-specific vocabulary are not handled well. You can extend `WORDS` and `PHRASES` for your product category.
- If you have labelled review data, a trained model such as Naive Bayes or logistic regression will generally be more accurate than this lexicon approach.

Task: Send email newsletters through the SendPulse API.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

Everything else the code uses (`json`, `time`, `optparse`) is in Ruby's standard library. Base64 encoding uses `Array#pack`, so the `base64` gem, which became a bundled gem in Ruby 3.4, isn't needed.

## sendpulse_newsletter.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"
require "time"
require "optparse"

module SendPulse
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://api.sendpulse.com"

    def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:)
      @client_id = client_id
      @client_secret = client_secret
      @token = nil
      @token_expires_at = Time.at(0)

      @http = Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson\b/
        f.options.timeout = 30
        f.options.open_timeout = 10
      end
    end

    # List all address books (mailing lists).
    def address_books
      request(:get, "/addressbooks")
    end

    # Add subscribers to an address book.
    # emails: array of strings or hashes like
    #   { email: "a@b.com", variables: { "Name" => "Alice" } }
    def add_emails(book_id, emails)
      payload = emails.map { |e| e.is_a?(Hash) ? e : { email: e } }
      request(:post, "/addressbooks/#{book_id}/emails", emails: payload)
    end

    # Create a campaign. It is sent immediately unless send_date is given.
    #
    # send_date: Time (scheduled; converted to UTC) or nil for immediate send.
    def create_campaign(sender_name:, sender_email:, subject:, html:, list_id:,
                        name: nil, send_date: nil, attachments: nil)
      raise ArgumentError, "html body is empty" if html.to_s.strip.empty?

      params = {
        sender_name: sender_name,
        sender_email: sender_email,
        subject: subject,
        body: [html].pack("m0"), # strict Base64, as required by the API
        list_id: Integer(list_id)
      }
      params[:name] = name if name
      params[:attachments] = attachments if attachments
      params[:send_date] = send_date.utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") if send_date

      request(:post, "/campaigns", params)
    end

    # Fetch campaign details/status.
    def campaign(id)
      request(:get, "/campaigns/#{id}")
    end

    private

    def access_token
      return @token if @token && Time.now < @token_expires_at

      refresh_token!
    end

    def refresh_token!
      resp = @http.post("/oauth/access_token", {
        grant_type: "client_credentials",
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret
      })

      unless resp.success? && resp.body.is_a?(Hash) && resp.body["access_token"]
        raise Error.new("Authentication failed (HTTP #{resp.status})",
                        status: resp.status, body: resp.body)
      end

      @token = resp.body["access_token"]
      # Refresh a minute early to avoid using an expired token
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + resp.body.fetch("expires_in", 3600).to_i - 60
      @token
    end

    def request(verb, path, params = nil, retried: false)
      resp = @http.run_request(verb, path, nil, nil) do |req|
        req.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
        if verb == :get
          req.params.update(params) if params
        elsif params
          req.body = params
        end
      end

      if resp.status == 401 && !retried
        @token = nil # force re-auth once
        return request(verb, path, params, retried: true)
      end

      unless resp.success?
        raise Error.new("SendPulse API error: HTTP #{resp.status} - #{resp.body}",
                        status: resp.status, body: resp.body)
      end

      # Some endpoints return 200 with result: false
      if resp.body.is_a?(Hash) && resp.body["result"] == false
        raise Error.new("SendPulse API rejected request: #{resp.body}",
                        status: resp.status, body: resp.body)
      end

      resp.body
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Network error talking to SendPulse: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  options = { name: nil, schedule: nil, list: false }

  parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
    o.banner = "Usage: SENDPULSE_ID=... SENDPULSE_SECRET=... #{$PROGRAM_NAME} [options]"
    o.on("--list-books", "List address books and exit") { options[:list] = true }
    o.on("--book-id ID", Integer, "Address book (list) ID to send to") { |v| options[:book_id] = v }
    o.on("--from-name NAME", "Sender name") { |v| options[:from_name] = v }
    o.on("--from-email EMAIL", "Sender email (must be verified in SendPulse)") { |v| options[:from_email] = v }
    o.on("--subject SUBJECT", "Email subject") { |v| options[:subject] = v }
    o.on("--html FILE", "Path to HTML file with newsletter body") { |v| options[:html] = v }
    o.on("--name NAME", "Internal campaign name") { |v| options[:name] = v }
    o.on("--schedule TIME", "Schedule send, e.g. '2025-12-01 09:00 UTC'") { |v| options[:schedule] = Time.parse(v) }
  end
  parser.parse!

  client = SendPulse::Client.new(
    client_id: ENV.fetch("SENDPULSE_ID") { abort "Set SENDPULSE_ID" },
    client_secret: ENV.fetch("SENDPULSE_SECRET") { abort "Set SENDPULSE_SECRET" }
  )

  begin
    if options[:list]
      client.address_books.each do |book|
        puts format("%-10s %-30s active: %s", book["id"], book["name"], book["active_email_qty"])
      end
      exit
    end

    missing = %i[book_id from_name from_email subject html].select { |k| options[k].nil? }
    abort "Missing options: #{missing.join(', ')}\n\n#{parser}" unless missing.empty?
    abort "HTML file not found: #{options[:html]}" unless File.file?(options[:html])

    result = client.create_campaign(
      sender_name: options[:from_name],
      sender_email: options[:from_email],
      subject: options[:subject],
      html: File.read(options[:html]),
      list_id: options[:book_id],
      name: options[:name],
      send_date: options[:schedule]
    )

    puts "Campaign created: #{result.inspect}"
  rescue SendPulse::Error => e
    warn "Error: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Usage

```bash
bundle install

export SENDPULSE_ID="your_api_id"
export SENDPULSE_SECRET="your_api_secret"

# Find the address book ID
bundle exec ruby sendpulse_newsletter.rb --list-books

# Send immediately
bundle exec ruby sendpulse_newsletter.rb \
  --book-id 123456 \
  --from-name "Acme News" \
  --from-email news@example.com \
  --subject "March update" \
  --html newsletter.html \
  --name "March 2025 newsletter"

# Schedule for later
bundle exec ruby sendpulse_newsletter.rb --book-id 123456 \
  --from-name "Acme" --from-email news@example.com \
  --subject "Launch" --html launch.html \
  --schedule "2025-12-01 09:00 UTC"
```

Notes:
- Get the API ID and secret in SendPulse under **Account Settings → API**.
- The sender email must be a verified sender in your SendPulse account, or the API will reject the campaign.
- Tokens are cached and refreshed automatically, and a 401 triggers one re-authentication retry.
- You can also use the client as a library, for example `client.add_emails(book_id, [{ email: "a@b.com", variables: { "Name" => "Alice" } }])` before creating a campaign.

```ruby
# app/services/ringostat_call_recorder.rb
require "phonelib"

# Перетворює payload вебхука Ringostat на запис у таблиці incoming_calls.
#
# Назви полів у вебхуку Ringostat залежать від налаштувань інтеграції,
# тому для кожного поля передбачено кілька псевдонімів (FIELD_ALIASES).
# Звірте їх зі своїм акаунтом і за потреби додайте свої.
class RingostatCallRecorder
  Result = Struct.new(:status, :call, :reason, keyword_init: true)

  FIELD_ALIASES = {
    call_id:         %w[call_id unique_id uniqueid id],
    called_at:       %w[calldate call_date date start_time],
    caller_number:   %w[caller caller_number src from],
    tracking_number: %w[called_did called_number callee dst to],
    disposition:     %w[disposition status call_status],
    duration:        %w[duration call_duration],
    talk_time:       %w[billsec talk_time talk_duration],
    employee:        %w[employee employee_name manager answered_by],
    recording_url:   %w[recording recording_url link_to_record],
    call_type:       %w[call_type direction type],
    utm_source:      %w[utm_source],
    utm_medium:      %w[utm_medium],
    utm_campaign:    %w[utm_campaign],
    utm_term:        %w[utm_term],
    utm_content:     %w[utm_content]
  }.freeze

  INCOMING_TYPES = %w[in incoming inbound].freeze

  def initialize(payload,
                 time_zone: ENV.fetch("RINGOSTAT_TIME_ZONE", "Europe/Kyiv"),
                 default_country: ENV.fetch("DEFAULT_PHONE_COUNTRY", "UA"))
    @payload         = payload.to_h.transform_keys(&:to_s)
    @time_zone       = ActiveSupport::TimeZone[time_zone] || ActiveSupport::TimeZone["UTC"]
    @default_country = default_country
  end

  def call
    call_type = pick(:call_type).to_s.downcase
    if !call_type.empty? && !INCOMING_TYPES.include?(call_type)
      return Result.new(status: :ignored, reason: "not an incoming call")
    end

    call_id = pick(:call_id).to_s.strip
    return Result.new(status: :invalid, reason: "call_id is missing") if call_id.empty?

    save_with_retry(call_id)
  end

  private

  def save_with_retry(call_id)
    attempts = 0
    begin
      record = IncomingCall.find_or_initialize_by(ringostat_call_id: call_id)
      status = record.new_record? ? :created : :updated
      record.assign_attributes(attributes)
      record.save!
      Result.new(status: status, call: record)
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      # Гонка: паралельний запит уже створив запис. Повторюємо як оновлення.
      attempts += 1
      retry if attempts < 3
      raise
    end
  end

  def attributes
    {
      called_at:       parse_time(pick(:called_at)),
      caller_number:   normalize_phone(pick(:caller_number)),
      tracking_number: normalize_phone(pick(:tracking_number)),
      disposition:     pick(:disposition)&.to_s&.upcase,
      duration:        to_int(pick(:duration)),
      talk_time:       to_int(pick(:talk_time)),
      employee:        pick(:employee),
      recording_url:   pick(:recording_url),
      utm_source:      pick(:utm_source),
      utm_medium:      pick(:utm_medium),
      utm_campaign:    pick(:utm_campaign),
      utm_term:        pick(:utm_term),
      utm_content:     pick(:utm_content),
      raw_payload:     @payload
    }
  end

  def pick(field)
    FIELD_ALIASES.fetch(field).each do |key|
      value = @payload[key]
      return value.to_s.strip if !value.nil? && !value.to_s.strip.empty?
    end
    nil
  end

  def parse_time(value)
    return nil if value.nil?
    # Unix timestamp або рядок "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" у часовому поясі акаунта
    return Time.at(value.to_i).utc if value.match?(/\A\d{10}\z/)

    @time_zone.parse(value)
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end

  def to_int(value)
    Integer(value, exception: false)
  end

  def normalize_phone(raw)
    return nil if raw.nil?

    phone = Phonelib.parse(raw, @default_country)
    phone.valid? ? phone.e164 : raw.gsub(/[^\d+]/, "")
  end
end
```

## Застосунок (вебхук)

```ruby
# app.rb
require "json"
require "dotenv/load"
require "sinatra/base"
require "sinatra/activerecord"
require "active_support"
require "active_support/time"

require_relative "app/models/incoming_call"
require_relative "app/services/ringostat_call_recorder"

class App < Sinatra::Base
  register Sinatra::ActiveRecordExtension

  set :database, ENV.fetch("DATABASE_URL")
  set :show_exceptions, false
  set :raise_errors, false

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Ringostat шле POST із даними дзвінка.
  # URL у налаштуваннях вебхука: https://your-domain/webhooks/ringostat?token=...
  post "/webhooks/ringostat" do
    halt 401, { error: "unauthorized" }.to_json unless authorized?

    payload = parse_payload
    halt 400, { error: "empty or invalid payload" }.to_json if payload.empty?

    result = RingostatCallRecorder.new(payload).call

    case result.status
    when :created
      status 201
      { status: "created", id: result.call.id }.to_json
    when :updated
      { status: "updated", id: result.call.id }.to_json
    when :ignored
      # 200, щоб Ringostat не повторював доставку
      { status: "ignored", reason: result.reason }.to_json
    else
      status 422
      { error: result.reason }.to_json
    end
  end

  get "/health" do
    { status: "ok" }.to_json
  end

  error do
    err = env["sinatra.error"]
    logger&.error("#{err.class}: #{err.message}\n#{err.backtrace.first(5).join("\n")}")
    status 500
    { error: "internal server error" }.to_json
  end

  helpers do
    def authorized?
      expected = ENV["RINGOSTAT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN"].to_s
      return false if expected.empty? # без налаштованого токена запити не приймаємо

      provided = request.env["HTTP_X_WEBHOOK_TOKEN"] || params["token"]
      provided = provided.to_s
      provided.bytesize == expected.bytesize &&
        Rack::Utils.secure_compare(provided, expected)
    end

    def parse_payload
      if request.media_type.to_s.include?("json")
        body = request.body.read
        data = JSON.parse(body)
        data.is_a?(Hash) ? data : {}
      else
        # form-urlencoded або query-параметри; токен у payload не потрапляє
        params.reject { |k, _| %w[token splat captures].include?(k) }
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {}
    end
  end
end
```

## Важливі нюанси

- **Назви полів.** Набір і назви полів залежать від того, що ви налаштували у вебхуку Ringostat. Звірте їх із реальним payload і за потреби додайте псевдоніми у `FIELD_ALIASES`. Повний оригінальний payload зберігається в `raw_payload`, тож дані не втрачаються.
- **Автентифікація.** Токен передається в заголовку `X-Webhook-Token` або в параметрі `?token=`. Якщо Ringostat не вміє додавати власні заголовки, використовуйте параметр у URL і обов'язково HTTPS.
- **Повторні доставки.** Унікальний індекс на `ringostat_call_id` разом із `find_or_initialize_by` і повтором при `RecordNotUnique` гарантує ідемпотентність, навіть якщо Ringostat надішле кілька подій по одному дзвінку (наприклад, початок і завершення).
- **Часовий пояс.** Дата без зони трактується в часовому поясі `RINGOSTAT_TIME_ZONE`, а в БД зберігається в UTC.

# Верифікація особи через Onfido (документ + селфі)

Я використовую напряму REST API Onfido (v3.6) через Faraday, а не офіційний SDK. Так код не залежить від версії SDK, а кожен крок видно явно.

Потік такий:
1. створити applicant;
2. завантажити документ (`/documents`);
3. завантажити селфі (`/live_photos`);
4. створити check із звітами `document` і `facial_similarity_photo`;
5. дочекатися завершення check і прочитати результат.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
gem "faraday-multipart", "~> 1.0"
gem "dotenv", "~> 3.1"
```

Встановлення: `bundle install`

## .env

```
ONFIDO_API_TOKEN=api_sandbox.xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
# EU (за замовчуванням), US або CA
ONFIDO_REGION=EU
```

## lib/onfido_verifier.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "faraday/multipart"
require "json"
require "marcel" rescue nil # необов'язково; MIME визначаємо за розширенням нижче

module Onfido
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  class TimeoutError < Error; end

  # Результат верифікації
  Result = Struct.new(:applicant_id, :check_id, :status, :result, :reports, keyword_init: true) do
    # "clear" — усі звіти пройдені успішно
    def verified?
      status == "complete" && result == "clear"
    end
  end

  class Verifier
    BASE_URLS = {
      "EU" => "https://api.eu.onfido.com/v3.6/",
      "US" => "https://api.us.onfido.com/v3.6/",
      "CA" => "https://api.ca.onfido.com/v3.6/"
    }.freeze

    MIME_TYPES = {
      ".jpg"  => "image/jpeg",
      ".jpeg" => "image/jpeg",
      ".png"  => "image/png",
      ".pdf"  => "application/pdf"
    }.freeze

    DOCUMENT_TYPES = %w[
      passport driving_licence national_identity_card residence_permit
      voter_id tax_id passport_card unknown
    ].freeze

    def initialize(api_token:, region: "EU", poll_interval: 3, poll_timeout: 180)
      raise ArgumentError, "api_token is required" if api_token.to_s.empty?

      base_url = BASE_URLS.fetch(region.to_s.upcase) do
        raise ArgumentError, "Unknown region: #{region}"
      end

      @poll_interval = poll_interval
      @poll_timeout = poll_timeout

      @http = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f|
        f.request :multipart
        f.headers["Authorization"] = "Token token=#{api_token}"
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.options.timeout = 60
        f.options.open_timeout = 10
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    # Повний цикл верифікації
    def verify(first_name:, last_name:, document_path:, selfie_path:,
               document_type: "passport", document_side: nil, wait: true)
      applicant = create_applicant(first_name: first_name, last_name: last_name)
      applicant_id = applicant.fetch("id")

      upload_document(applicant_id: applicant_id, file_path: document_path,
                      type: document_type, side: document_side)
      upload_selfie(applicant_id: applicant_id, file_path: selfie_path)

      check = create_check(applicant_id: applicant_id)
      check = wait_for_check(check.fetch("id")) if wait

      build_result(applicant_id, check)
    end

    def create_applicant(first_name:, last_name:)
      post_json("applicants", first_name: first_name, last_name: last_name)
    end

    def upload_document(applicant_id:, file_path:, type: "passport", side: nil)
      unless DOCUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
        raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported document type: #{type}"
      end

      payload = {
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        type: type,
        file: file_part(file_path)
      }
      payload[:side] = side if side # "front" або "back"

      post_multipart("documents", payload)
    end

    # Селфі завантажується як live photo — потрібне для звіту facial_similarity_photo
    def upload_selfie(applicant_id:, file_path:)
      post_multipart("live_photos", applicant_id: applicant_id, file: file_part(file_path))
    end

    def create_check(applicant_id:, report_names: %w[document facial_similarity_photo])
      post_json("checks", applicant_id: applicant_id, report_names: report_names)
    end

    def get_check(check_id)
      get("checks/#{check_id}")
    end

    def get_report(report_id)
      get("reports/#{report_id}")
    end

    # Опитування, доки check не матиме статус complete (або withdrawn)
    def wait_for_check(check_id)
      deadline = Time.now + @poll_timeout

      loop do
        check = get_check(check_id)
        return check if %w[complete withdrawn].include?(check["status"])

        if Time.now >= deadline
          raise TimeoutError, "Check #{check_id} did not complete in #{@poll_timeout}s"
        end

        sleep @poll_interval
      end
    end

    private

    def build_result(applicant_id, check)
      reports = Array(check["report_ids"]).map do |id|
        r = get_report(id)
        {
          id: r["id"],
          name: r["name"],
          status: r["status"],
          result: r["result"],
          sub_result: r["sub_result"]
        }
      end

      Result.new(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        check_id: check["id"],
        status: check["status"],
        result: check["result"],
        reports: reports
      )
    end

    def file_part(path)
      raise ArgumentError, "File not found: #{path}" unless File.file?(path)

      mime = MIME_TYPES[File.extname(path).downcase]
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported file type: #{path}" unless mime

      Faraday::Multipart::FilePart.new(path, mime)
    end

    def get(path)
      handle(@http.get(path))
    end

    def post_json(path, body)
      response = @http.post(path) do |req|
        req.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        req.body = JSON.generate(body)
      end
      handle(response)
    end

    def post_multipart(path, payload)
      handle(@http.post(path, payload))
    end

    def handle(response)
      body = response.body.to_s.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(response.body)
      return body if response.success?

      message = body.dig("error", "message") || "HTTP #{response.status}"
      raise Error.new("Onfido API error: #{message}", status: response.status, body: body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise Error.new("Invalid JSON response (HTTP #{response.status})",
                      status: response.status, body: response.body)
    end
  end
end
```

## verify.rb (приклад використання)

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "dotenv/load"
require_relative "lib/onfido_verifier"

verifier = Onfido::Verifier.new(
  api_token: ENV.fetch("ONFIDO_API_TOKEN"),
  region: ENV.fetch("ONFIDO_REGION", "EU")
)

begin
  result = verifier.verify(
    first_name: "Тарас",
    last_name: "Шевченко",
    document_path: "samples/passport.jpg",
    selfie_path: "samples/selfie.jpg",
    document_type: "passport"
  )

  puts "Applicant: #{result.applicant_id}"
  puts "Check:     #{result.check_id}"
  puts "Статус:    #{result.status}"
  puts "Результат: #{result.result}"
  result.reports.each do |r|
    puts "  - #{r[:name]}: #{r[:result]} (#{r[:sub_result] || '-'})"
  end

  puts result.verified? ? "✅ Особу підтверджено" : "⚠️ Потрібна ручна перевірка / відхилено"
rescue Onfido::TimeoutError => e
  warn "Таймаут: #{e.message}"
  exit 2
rescue Onfido::Error => e
  warn "Помилка Onfido (#{e.status}): #{e.message}"
  exit 1
rescue ArgumentError => e
  warn "Некоректні дані: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end
```

Запуск: `bundle exec ruby verify.rb`

## Примітки

- **Результати:** `clear` означає успіх, `consider` означає, що потрібен ручний розгляд (підозра на підробку, не збігається обличчя тощо).
- **Для ID-карток** з двома сторонами завантажуйте документ двічі через `upload_document` із `side: "front"` і `side: "back"`.
- **У продакшені** замість опитування краще використовувати вебхуки Onfido (подія `check.completed`). У цьому разі викликайте `verify(..., wait: false)` і за `check_id` отримуйте результат у вебхуці.
- **Токен** `api_sandbox.*` працює в тестовому середовищі, де результати перевірок симульовані. Для реальних перевірок потрібен live-токен.
- **Персональні дані та згода.** Фото документів і селфі є біометричними даними. Перед відправленням в Onfido отримайте згоду користувача відповідно до GDPR.

Task: Convert Ukrainian text to speech with a Ukrainian voice and save it as an MP3 file.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "google-cloud-text_to_speech", "~> 2.0"
```

Install with `bundle install`.

## Implementation

```ruby
# ukrainian_tts.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "google/cloud/text_to_speech"
require "optparse"

class UkrainianTextToSpeech
  LANGUAGE_CODE = "uk-UA"
  DEFAULT_VOICE = "uk-UA-Wavenet-A" # Ukrainian voice; "uk-UA-Standard-A" is a cheaper alternative
  MAX_CHUNK_BYTES = 4500            # API limit is 5000 bytes of text per request

  def initialize(voice: DEFAULT_VOICE, speaking_rate: 1.0)
    @voice = voice
    @speaking_rate = speaking_rate
    @client = Google::Cloud::TextToSpeech.text_to_speech
  end

  # Synthesizes +text+ and writes the resulting MP3 to +output_path+.
  def synthesize_to_file(text, output_path)
    text = text.to_s.strip
    raise ArgumentError, "Text is empty" if text.empty?

    audio = chunk_text(text).map { |chunk| synthesize_chunk(chunk) }.join
    File.binwrite(output_path, audio)
    output_path
  end

  private

  def synthesize_chunk(chunk)
    response = @client.synthesize_speech(
      input: { text: chunk },
      voice: { language_code: LANGUAGE_CODE, name: @voice },
      audio_config: { audio_encoding: :MP3, speaking_rate: @speaking_rate }
    )
    response.audio_content
  end

  # Splits text into pieces under MAX_CHUNK_BYTES, preferring sentence boundaries.
  def chunk_text(text)
    sentences = text.split(/(?<=[.!?…])\s+/)
    chunks = []
    current = +""

    sentences.each do |sentence|
      pieces = sentence.bytesize > MAX_CHUNK_BYTES ? split_long(sentence) : [sentence]

      pieces.each do |piece|
        candidate = current.empty? ? piece : "#{current} #{piece}"
        if candidate.bytesize > MAX_CHUNK_BYTES
          chunks << current unless current.empty?
          current = +piece
        else
          current = +candidate
        end
      end
    end

    chunks << current unless current.empty?
    chunks
  end

  # Fallback for a single very long sentence: split by words.
  def split_long(sentence)
    parts = []
    buf = +""
    sentence.split(/\s+/).each do |word|
      candidate = buf.empty? ? word : "#{buf} #{word}"
      if candidate.bytesize > MAX_CHUNK_BYTES
        parts << buf unless buf.empty?
        buf = +word
      else
        buf = +candidate
      end
    end
    parts << buf unless buf.empty?
    parts
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  options = {
    output: "output.mp3",
    voice: UkrainianTextToSpeech::DEFAULT_VOICE,
    rate: 1.0,
    file: nil
  }

  parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
    o.banner = "Usage: ruby ukrainian_tts.rb [options] [\"текст\"]"
    o.on("-o", "--output PATH", "Output MP3 path (default: output.mp3)") { |v| options[:output] = v }
    o.on("-f", "--file PATH", "Read text from a UTF-8 file") { |v| options[:file] = v }
    o.on("-v", "--voice NAME", "Voice name (default: #{options[:voice]})") { |v| options[:voice] = v }
    o.on("-r", "--rate FLOAT", Float, "Speaking rate 0.25–4.0 (default: 1.0)") { |v| options[:rate] = v }
  end
  parser.parse!

  text =
    if options[:file]
      File.read(options[:file], encoding: "UTF-8")
    elsif !ARGV.empty?
      ARGV.join(" ")
    else
      "Привіт, світе! Це перевірка синтезу українського мовлення."
    end

  unless ENV["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] || ENV["GOOGLE_CLOUD_CREDENTIALS"]
    warn "Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is not set; relying on default credentials."
  end

  begin
    tts = UkrainianTextToSpeech.new(voice: options[:voice], speaking_rate: options[:rate])
    path = tts.synthesize_to_file(text, options[:output])
    puts "Saved MP3 to #{path} (#{File.size(path)} bytes)"
  rescue Google::Cloud::Error => e
    warn "Google Cloud error: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue ArgumentError, Errno::ENOENT => e
    warn "Error: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Setup and usage

1. Enable the **Cloud Text-to-Speech API** in a Google Cloud project and create a service account key (JSON).
2. Point to the key:
   ```bash
   export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/key.json
   ```
3. Run:
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ruby ukrainian_tts.rb "Доброго дня! Як справи?" -o hello.mp3
   ruby ukrainian_tts.rb -f story.txt -o story.mp3 -r 0.9
   ```

Long texts are split on sentence boundaries to stay within the API's per-request limit, and the resulting MP3 segments are concatenated into a single file.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

Everything else (`json`, `securerandom`, `logger`) is in the Ruby standard library.

## vodafone_ua_messaging.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"
require "securerandom"
require "logger"

# Client for sending SMS and Viber messages through the Vodafone Ukraine
# messaging API.
#
# IMPORTANT: I don't have the official Vodafone Ukraine API specification, so
# the endpoint path, auth scheme, and JSON field names below are assumptions
# based on typical A2P messaging APIs. They are isolated in SEND_PATH,
# #build_payload and #connection, so you can adjust them to match the
# documentation you received with your account.
#
# Configuration via environment variables:
#   VODAFONE_UA_BASE_URL   (e.g. the base URL from your contract/docs)
#   VODAFONE_UA_LOGIN
#   VODAFONE_UA_PASSWORD
#   VODAFONE_UA_SENDER     (registered alpha-name)
module VodafoneUa
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ConfigurationError < Error; end
  class InvalidPhoneError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end
  class ConnectionError < Error; end

  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  class AuthenticationError < ApiError; end
  class RequestError < ApiError; end
  class ServerError < ApiError; end

  Result = Struct.new(:reference, :status, :body, keyword_init: true)

  class Client
    SEND_PATH = "/communication/message/send" # assumption: adjust to the docs
    SMS_MAX_LENGTH = 1000
    VIBER_MAX_LENGTH = 1000

    def initialize(base_url: ENV["VODAFONE_UA_BASE_URL"],
                   login: ENV["VODAFONE_UA_LOGIN"],
                   password: ENV["VODAFONE_UA_PASSWORD"],
                   default_sender: ENV["VODAFONE_UA_SENDER"],
                   timeout: 10,
                   open_timeout: 5,
                   logger: Logger.new($stdout, level: Logger::INFO))
      @base_url = base_url
      @login = login
      @password = password
      @default_sender = default_sender
      @timeout = timeout
      @open_timeout = open_timeout
      @logger = logger

      missing = { base_url: @base_url, login: @login, password: @password }
                .select { |_, v| v.nil? || v.to_s.empty? }.keys
      raise ConfigurationError, "Missing configuration: #{missing.join(', ')}" unless missing.empty?
    end

    # Send a plain SMS.
    def send_sms(to:, text:, from: @default_sender)
      validate_text!(text, SMS_MAX_LENGTH)
      deliver(
        channel: "sms",
        to: to,
        from: from,
        content: { text: text }
      )
    end

    # Send a Viber message. Optional rich content: a button (needs both
    # button_text and button_url) and an image. When sms_fallback is given,
    # the platform is asked to deliver that text as SMS if Viber delivery fails.
    def send_viber(to:, text:, from: @default_sender,
                   button_text: nil, button_url: nil, image_url: nil,
                   ttl_seconds: nil, sms_fallback: nil)
      validate_text!(text, VIBER_MAX_LENGTH)
      if button_text.nil? ^ button_url.nil?
        raise ValidationError, "button_text and button_url must be given together"
      end

      content = { text: text }
      content[:button] = { caption: button_text, url: button_url } if button_text
      content[:image_url] = image_url if image_url

      extra = {}
      extra[:ttl] = Integer(ttl_seconds) if ttl_seconds
      extra[:fallback] = { channel: "sms", text: sms_fallback } if sms_fallback

      deliver(channel: "viber", to: to, from: from, content: content, extra: extra)
    end

    # Normalizes Ukrainian numbers to the 380XXXXXXXXX format.
    # Accepts: +380501234567, 380501234567, 0501234567, 050 123-45-67, etc.
    def self.normalize_phone(raw)
      digits = raw.to_s.gsub(/\D/, "")
      digits = "38#{digits}" if digits.length == 10 && digits.start_with?("0")
      digits = "380#{digits}" if digits.length == 9
      unless digits.match?(/\A380\d{9}\z/)
        raise InvalidPhoneError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number: #{raw.inspect}"
      end

      digits
    end

    private

    def deliver(channel:, to:, from:, content:, extra: {})
      raise ValidationError, "sender (from) is required" if from.nil? || from.to_s.empty?

      phone = self.class.normalize_phone(to)
      reference = SecureRandom.uuid
      payload = build_payload(reference: reference, channel: channel, phone: phone,
                              from: from, content: content, extra: extra)

      @logger.info("[VodafoneUa] sending #{channel} to #{mask(phone)} ref=#{reference}")
      response = post(payload)
      handle_response(response, reference)
    end

    # Isolated so the wire format is easy to change.
    def build_payload(reference:, channel:, phone:, from:, content:, extra:)
      {
        id: reference,
        type: channel.upcase,
        sender: { id: from },
        receiver: [{ id: 1, phone: phone.to_i }],
        content: content[:text],
        characteristic: content.reject { |k, _| k == :text }.merge(extra)
      }
    end

    def post(payload)
      connection.post(SEND_PATH) do |req|
        req.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        req.body = JSON.generate(payload)
      end
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      # Not retried automatically: a retried POST could deliver the message twice.
      raise ConnectionError, "Could not reach Vodafone API: #{e.message}"
    end

    def connection
      @connection ||= Faraday.new(url: @base_url) do |f|
        f.request :authorization, :basic, @login, @password # assumption: Basic auth
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.options.timeout = @timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = @open_timeout
      end
    end

    def handle_response(response, reference)
      body = parse_body(response.body)
      status = response.status

      case status
      when 200..299
        Result.new(reference: reference, status: status, body: body)
      when 401, 403
        raise AuthenticationError.new("Authentication failed (HTTP #{status})", status: status, body: body)
      when 400..499
        raise RequestError.new("Request rejected (HTTP #{status}): #{body}", status: status, body: body)
      else
        raise ServerError.new("Vodafone API error (HTTP #{status})", status: status, body: body)
      end
    end

    def parse_body(raw)
      return {} if raw.nil? || raw.empty?

      JSON.parse(raw)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raw
    end

    def validate_text!(text, max)
      raise ValidationError, "text must not be empty" if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?
      raise ValidationError, "text exceeds #{max} characters" if text.length > max
    end

    def mask(phone)
      "#{phone[0, 5]}****#{phone[-2, 2]}"
    end
  end
end

# --- Example usage -----------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  client = VodafoneUa::Client.new

  begin
    sms = client.send_sms(to: "050 123 45 67", text: "Your verification code is 4821")
    puts "SMS accepted: ref=#{sms.reference} status=#{sms.status}"

    viber = client.send_viber(
      to: "+380501234567",
      text: "Your order #1042 has shipped!",
      button_text: "Track order",
      button_url: "https://example.com/orders/1042",
      ttl_seconds: 3600,
      sms_fallback: "Order #1042 shipped: https://example.com/orders/1042"
    )
    puts "Viber accepted: ref=#{viber.reference} status=#{viber.status}"
  rescue VodafoneUa::InvalidPhoneError, VodafoneUa::ValidationError => e
    warn "Bad input: #{e.message}"
  rescue VodafoneUa::AuthenticationError => e
    warn "Check credentials: #{e.message}"
  rescue VodafoneUa::ApiError, VodafoneUa::ConnectionError => e
    warn "Sending failed: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Notes

- **Verify against the official docs.** I don't have Vodafone Ukraine's API specification, so the path (`SEND_PATH`), Basic auth, and JSON field names are my assumptions. Changes should be confined to `SEND_PATH`, `connection`, and `build_payload`.
- **No automatic retries.** Retrying a POST could send a customer the same message twice. Each message gets a UUID `reference` that is returned in the `Result` and logged, so you can reconcile or retry safely if the API supports client-supplied IDs.
- **Phone numbers** are normalized to `380XXXXXXXXX` and masked in logs.
- **Credentials** come from environment variables, so keep them out of source control.
