Завдання: Надсилайте листи через Amazon SES та обробляйте сповіщення про недоставлені листи з SNS.
text:
# Надсилання листів через Amazon SES та обробка bounce/complaint-сповіщень із SNS ## Gemfile ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.1" gem "aws-sdk-sesv2", "~> 1.0" # надсилання листів через SES (API v2) gem "aws-sdk-sns", "~> 1.0" # перевірка підпису SNS-повідомлень gem "sinatra", "~> 4.0" # HTTP-ендпоінт для вебхуків SNS gem "rackup", "~> 2.1" gem "puma", "~> 6.4" gem "sequel", "~> 5.80" # зберігання списку блокувань і подій gem "sqlite3", "~> 1.7" gem "dotenv", "~> 3.1" group :test do gem "rspec", "~> 3.13" gem "rack-test", "~> 2.1" end ``` ## Структура проєкту ``` . ├── Gemfile ├── .env ├── config.ru ├── app.rb ├── send_example.rb └── lib/ ├── config.rb ├── database.rb ├── mailer.rb └── sns_handler.rb ``` ## `.env` ```dotenv AWS_REGION=eu-west-1 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=... SES_FROM_ADDRESS=noreply@example.com SES_CONFIGURATION_SET=my-config-set # Через кому: ARN тем SNS, від яких приймаємо повідомлення SNS_ALLOWED_TOPIC_ARNS=arn:aws:sns:eu-west-1:123456789012:ses-notifications DATABASE_URL=sqlite://db/mailer.sqlite3 SOFT_BOUNCE_LIMIT=3 ``` ## `lib/config.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "dotenv" require "logger" Dotenv.load module Config module_function def region = ENV.fetch("AWS_REGION", "eu-west-1") def from_address = ENV.fetch("SES_FROM_ADDRESS") def configuration_set = ENV["SES_CONFIGURATION_SET"] def database_url = ENV.fetch("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite://db/mailer.sqlite3") def soft_bounce_limit = Integer(ENV.fetch("SOFT_BOUNCE_LIMIT", "3")) def allowed_topic_arns ENV.fetch("SNS_ALLOWED_TOPIC_ARNS", "").split(",").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?) end def logger @logger ||= Logger.new($stdout, progname: "ses-mailer") end end ``` ## `lib/database.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "sequel" require "fileutils" require_relative "config" FileUtils.mkdir_p("db") if Config.database_url.start_with?("sqlite://db") DB = Sequel.connect(Config.database_url) # Адреси, на які більше не можна надсилати листи DB.create_table?(:suppressions) do primary_key :id String :email, null: false, unique: true String :reason, null: false # hard_bounce | soft_bounce_limit | complaint String :details, text: true DateTime :created_at, null: false DateTime :updated_at, null: false end # Журнал усіх отриманих подій DB.create_table?(:email_events) do primary_key :id String :message_id String :event_type, null: false # Bounce | Complaint | Delivery String :bounce_type # Permanent | Transient | Undetermined String :bounce_subtype String :email, null: false String :diagnostic, text: true String :feedback_id DateTime :occurred_at DateTime :created_at, null: false index :email index %i[email event_type bounce_type] end module Suppression module_function def normalize(email) = email.to_s.strip.downcase def suppressed?(email) DB[:suppressions].where(email: normalize(email)).count.positive? end def add(email, reason:, details: nil) now = Time.now.utc DB[:suppressions] .insert_conflict(target: :email, update: { reason: reason, details: details, updated_at: now }) .insert(email: normalize(email), reason: reason, details: details, created_at: now, updated_at: now) end def remove(email) DB[:suppressions].where(email: normalize(email)).delete end end ``` ## `lib/mailer.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "aws-sdk-sesv2" require_relative "config" require_relative "database" class SesMailer class SuppressedRecipientError < StandardError; end Result = Struct.new(:message_id, :recipients, keyword_init: true) def initialize(client: nil, from: Config.from_address) @client = client || Aws::SESV2::Client.new(region: Config.region) @from = from end # Надсилає лист одному або кільком отримувачам. # Адреси зі списку блокувань пропускаються. def deliver(to:, subject:, text: nil, html: nil, reply_to: nil, tags: {}) raise ArgumentError, "потрібен text або html" if text.nil? && html.nil? recipients = Array(to).map { |e| Suppression.normalize(e) }.uniq allowed, blocked = recipients.partition { |e| !Suppression.suppressed?(e) } blocked.each { |e| Config.logger.warn("Пропущено (у списку блокувань): #{e}") } raise SuppressedRecipientError, "Усі отримувачі заблоковані: #{blocked.join(', ')}" if allowed.empty? body = {} body[:text] = { data: text, charset: "UTF-8" } if text body[:html] = { data: html, charset: "UTF-8" } if html params = { from_email_address: @from, destination: { to_addresses: allowed }, content: { simple: { subject: { data: subject, charset: "UTF-8" }, body: body } } } params[:reply_to_addresses] = Array(reply_to) if reply_to params[:configuration_set_name] = Config.configuration_set if Config.configuration_set unless tags.empty? params[:email_tags] = tags.map { |k, v| { name: k.to_s, value: v.to_s } } end resp = @client.send_email(params) Config.logger.info("Лист надіслано: #{resp.message_id} -> #{allowed.join(', ')}") Result.new(message_id: resp.message_id, recipients: allowed) rescue Aws::SESV2::Errors::MessageRejected, Aws::SESV2::Errors::AccountSuspendedException, Aws::SESV2::Errors::SendingPausedException, Aws::SESV2::Errors::TooManyRequestsException => e Config.logger.error("SES відхилив лист: #{e.class}: #{e.message}") raise end end ``` ## `lib/sns_handler.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "json" require "net/http" require "uri" require "time" require "aws-sdk-sns" require_relative "config" require_relative "database" # Перевіряє та обробляє HTTP-повідомлення від SNS. class SnsHandler class InvalidMessage < StandardError; end def initialize(verifier: Aws::SNS::MessageVerifier.new, allowed_topics: Config.allowed_topic_arns, logger: Config.logger) @verifier = verifier @allowed_topics = allowed_topics @logger = logger end def handle(raw_body) envelope = parse_json(raw_body) authenticate!(raw_body) check_topic!(envelope) case envelope["Type"] when "SubscriptionConfirmation" then confirm_subscription(envelope) when "UnsubscribeConfirmation" then @logger.info("UnsubscribeConfirmation: #{envelope['TopicArn']}") when "Notification" then process_notification(envelope) else raise InvalidMessage, "Невідомий тип повідомлення: #{envelope['Type'].inspect}" end end private def parse_json(str) JSON.parse(str) rescue JSON::ParserError => e raise InvalidMessage, "Некоректний JSON: #{e.message}" end def authenticate!(raw_body) @verifier.authenticate!(raw_body) rescue Aws::SNS::MessageVerifier::VerificationError => e raise InvalidMessage, "Підпис SNS недійсний: #{e.message}" end def check_topic!(envelope) return if @allowed_topics.empty? # у dev-режимі без обмежень return if @allowed_topics.include?(envelope["TopicArn"]) raise InvalidMessage, "Тема не дозволена: #{envelope['TopicArn']}" end def confirm_subscription(envelope) uri = URI.parse(envelope.fetch("SubscribeURL")) unless uri.scheme == "https" && uri.host.match?(/\Asns\.[a-z0-9-]+\.amazonaws\.com(\.cn)?\z/) raise InvalidMessage, "Підозрілий SubscribeURL: #{uri}" end res = Net::HTTP.get_response(uri) @logger.info("Підписку підтверджено (HTTP #{res.code}) для #{envelope['TopicArn']}") end def process_notification(envelope) message = parse_json(envelope["Message"]) type = message["notificationType"] || message["eventType"] message_id = message.dig("mail", "messageId") case type when "Bounce" then process_bounce(message["bounce"], message_id) when "Complaint" then process_complaint(message["complaint"], message_id) when "Delivery" then @logger.debug("Delivered: #{message_id}") else @logger.info("Ігнорую подію SES: #{type.inspect}") end end def process_bounce(bounce, message_id) type = bounce["bounceType"] # Permanent | Transient | Undetermined subtype = bounce["bounceSubType"] bounce.fetch("bouncedRecipients", []).each do |rcpt| email = Suppression.normalize(rcpt["emailAddress"]) diagnostic = rcpt["diagnosticCode"] || rcpt["status"] record_event( message_id: message_id, event_type: "Bounce", bounce_type: type, bounce_subtype: subtype, email: email, diagnostic: diagnostic, feedback_id: bounce["feedbackId"], occurred_at: bounce["timestamp"] ) if type == "Permanent" Suppression.add(email, reason: "hard_bounce", details: "#{subtype}: #{diagnostic}") @logger.warn("Hard bounce, адресу заблоковано: #{email}") else soft_count = DB[:email_events] .where(email: email, event_type: "Bounce") .exclude(bounce_type: "Permanent").count @logger.info("Soft bounce ##{soft_count} для #{email} (#{subtype})") if soft_count >= Config.soft_bounce_limit Suppression.add(email, reason: "soft_bounce_limit", details: "#{soft_count} тимчасових відмов; остання: #{diagnostic}") @logger.warn("Перевищено ліміт soft bounce, адресу заблоковано: #{email}") end end end end def process_complaint(complaint, message_id) complaint.fetch("complainedRecipients", []).each do |rcpt| email = Suppression.normalize(rcpt["emailAddress"]) record_event( message_id: message_id, event_type: "Complaint", email: email, bounce_subtype: complaint["complaintFeedbackType"], feedback_id: complaint["feedbackId"], occurred_at: complaint["timestamp"] ) Suppression.add(email, reason: "complaint", details: complaint["complaintFeedbackType"].to_s) @logger.warn("Скарга на спам, адресу заблоковано: #{email}") end end def record_event(message_id:, event_type:, email:, bounce_type: nil, bounce_subtype: nil, diagnostic: nil, feedback_id: nil, occurred_at: nil) DB[:email_events].insert( message_id: message_id, event_type: event_type, bounce_type: bounce_type, bounce_subtype: bounce_subtype, email: email, diagnostic: diagnostic, feedback_id: feedback_id, occurred_at: occurred_at ? Time.parse(occurred_at) : nil, created_at: Time.now.utc ) end end ``` ## `app.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "sinatra/base" require "json" require_relative "lib/config" require_relative "lib/database" require_relative "lib/mailer" require_relative "lib/sns_handler" class App < Sinatra::Base set :show_exceptions, false set :sns_handler, SnsHandler.new get "/health" do content_type :json { status: "ok" }.to_json end # Ендпоінт, на який SNS надсилає HTTPS POST (Content-Type: text/plain) post "/sns" do raw = request.body.read begin settings.sns_handler.handle(raw) status 200 "OK" rescue SnsHandler::InvalidMessage => e Config.logger.warn("Відхилено SNS-повідомлення: #{e.message}") halt 400, "Bad Request" rescue StandardError => e # 500 змусить SNS повторити доставку Config.logger.error("Помилка обробки SNS: #{e.class}: #{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first(5).join("\n")}") halt 500, "Internal Server Error" end end end ``` ## `config.ru` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require_relative "app" run App ``` Запуск: `bundle exec rackup -p 4567` ## `send_example.rb` ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require_relative "lib/mailer" mailer = SesMailer.new begin result = mailer.deliver( to: ARGV.fetch(0, "recipient@example.com"), subject: "Вітаємо!", text: "Привіт! Це тестовий лист, надісланий через Amazon SES.", html: "

Привіт!

Це тестовий лист, надісланий через Amazon SES.

", tags: { campaign: "welcome" } ) puts "Надіслано, MessageId: #{result.message_id}" rescue SesMailer::SuppressedRecipientError => e warn "Не надіслано: #{e.message}" rescue Aws::SESV2::Errors::ServiceError => e warn "Помилка SES: #{e.message}" exit 1 end ``` ## Налаштування в AWS 1. **SES**: верифікуйте домен або адресу відправника. Поки акаунт у sandbox, верифікуйте й адреси отримувачів. 2. **SNS**: створіть тему (наприклад, `ses-notifications`) і додайте її ARN у `SNS_ALLOWED_TOPIC_ARNS`. 3. **Джерело подій** (один із варіантів): - SES → Configuration sets → Event destinations → SNS, з подіями Bounce і Complaint (бажано також Delivery). Ім'я набору вкажіть у `SES_CONFIGURATION_SET`. - Або SES → Verified identities → Notifications → Feedback notifications. Код розуміє обидва формати (`notificationType` та `eventType`). 4. **Підписка**: у темі SNS створіть підписку з протоколом HTTPS і URL `https://your-domain.com/sns`. Сервіс автоматично підтвердить її, перейшовши за `SubscribeURL`. ## Основні рішення - **Безпека.** Підпис кожного повідомлення перевіряє `Aws::SNS::MessageVerifier`. Додатково перевіряється `TopicArn`, а `SubscribeURL` має вести лише на `sns.*.amazonaws.com`. - **Hard bounce** (`Permanent`) і **complaint** одразу додають адресу до списку блокувань. - **Soft bounce** (`Transient`) блокує адресу лише після `SOFT_BOUNCE_LIMIT` невдач. - **Перед відправленням** `SesMailer` перевіряє список блокувань, тож повторних листів на погані адреси не буде. Це захищає репутацію відправника. - **Помилки обробки** повертають HTTP 500, і SNS повторює доставку. Запис у `suppressions` ідемпотентний (`insert_conflict`).

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

# PDF generation (used by the demo; the hyphenator itself needs no gems)
gem "prawn", "~> 2.5"
```

## ukrainian_hyphenator.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "prawn"

# Rule-based hyphenation of Ukrainian words.
#
# The hyphenator inserts soft hyphens (U+00AD) at permitted break points.
# Prawn treats a soft hyphen as an invisible break opportunity and draws a
# visible "-" only where a line actually breaks.
#
# Rules implemented (simplified from the Ukrainian orthography):
#   * a word is split into syllables, one syllable per vowel;
#   * one consonant between vowels goes to the following syllable (ма-ма);
#   * two or more consonants: the first stays with the previous syllable
#     (мис-тецтво -> мис-тец-тво);
#   * "дж" and "дз" before a vowel are never split (хо-джу);
#   * "ь" and the apostrophe stay with the preceding letter (кіль-ка, м'я-со);
#   * "й" is treated as a consonant and closes a syllable (бай-ка);
#   * two vowels in a row may be split (по-ет);
#   * after prefixes ending in a consonant plus an apostrophe, the break goes
#     after the apostrophe (під'-їзд);
#   * minimum number of letters left on the line and carried over (default 2/2).
#
# This is a heuristic. It does not do full morphological analysis, so a few
# words may break at a syllable boundary where a morphological one is preferred.
module UkrainianHyphenator
  SOFT_HYPHEN = "\u00AD"

  VOWELS      = "аеєиіїоуюя"
  APOSTROPHES = "'’ʼ"
  SIGNS       = "ь" + APOSTROPHES

  # Cyrillic letters that do not occur in Ukrainian words; if present we skip the word.
  FOREIGN_LETTERS = /[ыэёъЫЭЁЪ]/

  # Prefixes ending in a consonant that are often followed by an apostrophe.
  APOSTROPHE_PREFIX = /\A(?:під|від|над|об|між|без|роз|пере?д|пред|ад|суб|дез|ін|кон)[#{APOSTROPHES}]/i

  WORD_REGEX = /\p{Cyrillic}+(?:[#{APOSTROPHES}]\p{Cyrillic}+)*/

  Token = Struct.new(:text, :vowel)

  module_function

  # Returns the word with `separator` inserted at every allowed break point.
  def hyphenate(word, separator: SOFT_HYPHEN, min_left: 2, min_right: 2, min_length: 5)
    offsets = break_offsets(word, min_left: min_left, min_right: min_right, min_length: min_length)
    return word.dup if offsets.empty?

    result = +""
    word.each_char.with_index do |ch, i|
      result << separator if offsets.include?(i)
      result << ch
    end
    result
  end

  # Hyphenates every Ukrainian word in a text. Other characters, existing
  # hyphens and non-Cyrillic words are left untouched.
  def hyphenate_text(text, **opts)
    text.gsub(WORD_REGEX) { |word| hyphenate(word, **opts) }
  end

  # Returns the word as an array of hyphenation fragments, e.g.
  # "мистецтво" => ["мис", "тец", "тво"] (min_left / min_right applied).
  def syllables(word, **opts)
    offsets = break_offsets(word, **opts)
    bounds = [0, *offsets, word.length]
    bounds.each_cons(2).map { |a, b| word[a...b] }
  end

  # Sorted character offsets before which a break is allowed.
  def break_offsets(word, min_left: 2, min_right: 2, min_length: 5)
    return [] if word.length < min_length
    return [] unless word.match?(/\A\p{Cyrillic}+(?:[#{APOSTROPHES}]\p{Cyrillic}+)*\z/)
    return [] if word.match?(FOREIGN_LETTERS)

    tokens = tokenize(word)
    vowel_idx = tokens.each_index.select { |i| tokens[i].vowel }
    return [] if vowel_idx.size < 2

    # Starting character offset of every token.
    starts = []
    pos = 0
    tokens.each do |t|
      starts << pos
      pos += t.text.length
    end

    token_breaks = []
    vowel_idx.each_cons(2) do |a, b|
      consonants = b - a - 1
      token_breaks <<
        case consonants
        when 0 then b       # по-ет
        when 1 then a + 1   # ма-ма
        else a + 2          # мис-тецтво (first consonant stays behind)
        end
    end

    offsets = token_breaks.map { |i| starts[i] }

    # Prefix + apostrophe: під'-їзд, об'-єм
    if (m = word.match(APOSTROPHE_PREFIX))
      boundary = m[0].length
      offsets.reject! { |o| o.positive? && o < boundary }
      offsets << boundary
    end

    letters_before = letter_counts(word)
    total = letters_before.last
    offsets.uniq.sort.select do |o|
      letters_before[o] >= min_left && (total - letters_before[o]) >= min_right
    end
  end

  # --- internals -----------------------------------------------------------

  def tokenize(word)
    chars = word.chars
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    while i < chars.length
      c = chars[i]
      lc = c.downcase

      if VOWELS.include?(lc)
        tokens << Token.new(+c, true)
      elsif SIGNS.include?(lc) && !tokens.empty? && !tokens.last.vowel
        tokens.last.text << c # ь and apostrophe stick to the previous consonant
      elsif lc == "д" && %w[ж з].include?(chars[i + 1]&.downcase) &&
            chars[i + 2] && VOWELS.include?(chars[i + 2].downcase)
        tokens << Token.new(+(c + chars[i + 1]), false) # дж / дз
        i += 1
      else
        tokens << Token.new(+c, false)
      end
      i += 1
    end
    tokens
  end

  # letter_counts[i] = number of letters (apostrophes excluded) in word[0...i]
  def letter_counts(word)
    counts = [0]
    word.each_char { |ch| counts << counts.last + (APOSTROPHES.include?(ch) ? 0 : 1) }
    counts
  end
end

# --- PDF demo ---------------------------------------------------------------

module UkrainianPdfDemo
  FONT_CANDIDATES = [
    ENV["PDF_FONT"],
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/TTF/DejaVuSerif.ttf",
    "/Library/Fonts/Arial Unicode.ttf",

  ].compact.freeze

  SAMPLE = <<~TEXT.tr("\n", " ").strip

    системою словотворення. Комп'ютерна верстка потребує коректного переносу слів,
    щоб міжслівні проміжки у вирівняному тексті залишались рівномірними.
    Під'їзд, об'єм, джерело, дзеркало, мистецтво, бджільництво та українознавство.
  TEXT

  def self.font_path
    path = FONT_CANDIDATES.find { |p| File.exist?(p) }
    raise "No Cyrillic TTF font found. Set PDF_FONT=/path/to/font.ttf" unless path

  end

  def self.run(output = "hyphenated_ukrainian.pdf")

    end
    output
  end
end
```

Ось рішення для перевірки орфографії англійського тексту з пропозиціями виправлень на Ruby:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'ffi-hunspell'
gem 'colorize'
```

## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'ffi/hunspell'
require 'colorize'

class SpellChecker
  attr_reader :dictionary

  def initialize(dictionary_path = nil)
    @dictionary = FFI::Hunspell.dict('en_US')
    @suggestions_cache = {}
  rescue => e
    puts "Error loading dictionary: #{e.message}".red
    puts "Please ensure hunspell and English dictionary are installed:".yellow
    puts "  Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt-get install hunspell hunspell-en-us".yellow
    puts "  macOS: brew install hunspell".yellow
    exit 1
  end

  def check_text(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    words = tokenize(text)
    errors = []
    
    words.each do |word_info|
      word = word_info[:word]
      position = word_info[:position]
      
      unless correct?(word)
        suggestions = get_suggestions(word)
        errors << {
          word: word,
          position: position,
          suggestions: suggestions,
          context: get_context(text, position, word.length)
        }
      end
    end
    
    errors
  end

  def check_and_display(text)
    errors = check_text(text)
    
    if errors.empty?
      puts "✓ No spelling errors found!".green
      return
    end
    
    puts "Found #{errors.length} spelling error(s):\n\n".yellow
    
    errors.each do |error|
      puts "Word: #{error[:word].red.bold}"
      puts "Position: #{error[:position]}"
      puts "Context: \"#{error[:context]}\""
      
      if error[:suggestions].empty?
        puts "Suggestions: None found".yellow
      else
        puts "Suggestions: #{error[:suggestions].first(5).join(', ').cyan}"
      end
      puts "-" * 60
    end
    
    errors
  end

  def correct?(word)
    # Skip checking for:
    # - Numbers
    # - Email addresses
    # - URLs
    # - Words with digits
    return true if word.match?(/\d/) || 
                   word.match?(/^[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+\.\w+$/) ||
                   word.match?(/^(http|https|ftp):\/\//)
    
    @dictionary.check?(word)
  end

  def get_suggestions(word)
    return @suggestions_cache[word] if @suggestions_cache.key?(word)
    
    suggestions = @dictionary.suggest(word)
    @suggestions_cache[word] = suggestions
    suggestions
  end

  def add_word_to_dictionary(word)
    @dictionary.add(word)
    @suggestions_cache.clear
    puts "Added '#{word}' to dictionary".green
  end

  def ignore_word(word)
    @suggestions_cache[word] = []
    puts "Ignoring '#{word}'".yellow
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    words = []
    current_word = ''
    current_position = 0
    
    text.each_char.with_index do |char, index|
      if char.match?(/[a-zA-Z']/)
        if current_word.empty?
          current_position = index
        end
        current_word += char
      else
        unless current_word.empty?
          words << { word: current_word, position: current_position }
          current_word = ''
        end
      end
    end
    
    # Add last word if exists
    unless current_word.empty?
      words << { word: current_word, position: current_position }
    end
    
    words
  end

  def get_context(text, position, length)
    start_pos = [position - 20, 0].max
    end_pos = [position + length + 20, text.length].min
    
    context = text[start_pos...end_pos]
    context = "..." + context if start_pos > 0
    context = context + "..." if end_pos < text.length
    
    context
  end
end

# CLI Interface
class SpellCheckerCLI
  def initialize
    @checker = SpellChecker.new
  end

  def run
    puts "=" * 60
    puts "English Spell Checker".bold
    puts "=" * 60
    puts
    
    if ARGV.empty?
      interactive_mode
    else
      file_mode(ARGV[0])
    end
  end

  private

  def interactive_mode
    puts "Enter text to check (type 'quit' to exit, 'help' for options):"
    puts
    
    loop do
      print "> ".green
      input = gets.chomp
      
      case input.downcase
      when 'quit', 'exit', 'q'
        puts "Goodbye!".green
        break
      when 'help', 'h'
        show_help
        next
      when ''
        next
      end
      
      if input.start_with?('add ')
        word = input[4..-1].strip
        @checker.add_word_to_dictionary(word)
      elsif input.start_with?('ignore ')
        word = input[7..-1].strip
        @checker.ignore_word(word)
      else
        @checker.check_and_display(input)
        puts
      end
    end
  end

  def file_mode(filename)
    unless File.exist?(filename)
      puts "File not found: #{filename}".red
      exit 1
    end
    
    text = File.read(filename)
    puts "Checking file: #{filename}".bold
    puts "=" * 60
    puts
    
    @checker.check_and_display(text)
    
    # Option to save corrections
    print "\nSave corrected text? (y/n): ".yellow
    answer = gets.chomp.downcase
    
    if answer == 'y' || answer == 'yes'
      corrected_text = auto_correct(text)
      output_filename = filename.sub(/\.txt$/, '_corrected.txt')
      File.write(output_filename, corrected_text)
      puts "Corrected text saved to: #{output_filename}".green
    end
  end

  def auto_correct(text)
    errors = @checker.check_text(text)
    corrected = text.dup
    
    # Apply corrections from the end to maintain positions
    errors.sort_by { |e| -e[:position] }.each do |error|
      if error[:suggestions].any?
        correction = error[:suggestions].first
        corrected[error[:position], error[:word].length] = correction
      end
    end
    
    corrected
  end

  def show_help
    puts "Commands:".bold
    puts "  text          - Check spelling of the text"
    puts "  add <word>    - Add word to dictionary"
    puts "  ignore <word> - Ignore word in this session"
    puts "  help          - Show this help"
    puts "  quit          - Exit the program"
    puts
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  cli = SpellCheckerCLI.new
  cli.run
end
```

## Особливості реалізації:

1. **Використання Hunspell** - потужного spell-checker движка через `ffi-hunspell`
2. **Контекстний аналіз** - показує контекст навколо помилки
3. **Кешування** - кешує пропозиції для швидшого повторного доступу
4. **Інтерактивний режим** - можливість додавати слова в словник
5. **Робота з файлами** - перевірка текстових файлів
6. **Автокорекція** - можливість автоматично виправити всі помилки
7. **Кольоровий вивід** - покращена читабельність результатів

Ця реалізація забезпечує повноцінну перевірку орфографії з пропозиціями виправлень для англійського тексту.

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for fetching company data from the OpenCorporates API:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8'

```

## Implementation

### `opencorporates_client.rb`

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'terminal-table'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load if File.exist?('.env')

class OpenCorporatesClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.opencorporates.com/v0.4'
  
  attr_reader :api_key
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['OPENCORPORATES_API_KEY']
    raise ArgumentError, "API key is required. Set OPENCORPORATES_API_KEY or pass it as an argument." if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end
  
  def search_companies(name:, jurisdiction: nil, limit: 10)
    query = {
      q: name,
      per_page: limit,
      api_token: api_key
    }
    
    query[:jurisdiction_code] = jurisdiction if jurisdiction
    
    response = self.class.get("#{BASE_URL}/companies/search", query: query)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_company(jurisdiction_code:, company_number:)
    query = { api_token: api_key }
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/companies/#{jurisdiction_code}/#{company_number}",
      query: query
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def format_company_results(results)
    return [] if results.nil? || results.empty?
    
    results.map do |result|
      company = result['company']
      {
        name: company['name'],
        company_number: company['company_number'],
        jurisdiction: company['jurisdiction_code'],
        incorporation_date: company['incorporation_date'],
        company_type: company['company_type'],
        current_status: company['current_status'],
        registry_url: company['registry_url']
      }
    end
  end
  
  def display_results(companies)
    if companies.empty?
      puts "No companies found."
      return
    end
    
    table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
      t.title = "Company Search Results"
      t.headings = ['Name', 'Company Number', 'Jurisdiction', 'Type', 'Status', 'Incorporated']
      
      companies.each do |company|
        t.add_row([
          company[:name] || 'N/A',
          company[:company_number] || 'N/A',
          company[:jurisdiction] || 'N/A',
          company[:company_type] || 'N/A',
          company[:current_status] || 'N/A',
          company[:incorporation_date] || 'N/A'
        ])
      end
    end
    
    puts table
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Authentication failed. Please check your API key."
    when 403
      raise "Access forbidden. You don't have permission to access this resource."
    when 404
      raise "Resource not found."
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."
    when 500..599
      raise "OpenCorporates API server error. Please try again later."
    else
      raise "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

### `main.rb`

```ruby
require_relative 'opencorporates_client'
require 'optparse'

class CompanySearchCLI
  def initialize
    @client = OpenCorporatesClient.new
  end
  
  def run
    options = parse_options
    
    puts "Searching for companies..."
    puts "Query: #{options[:name]}"
    puts "Jurisdiction: #{options[:jurisdiction] || 'All'}"
    puts "-" * 50
    
    results = @client.search_companies(
      name: options[:name],
      jurisdiction: options[:jurisdiction],
      limit: options[:limit]
    )
    
    companies = @client.format_company_results(results.dig('results', 'companies'))
    @client.display_results(companies)
    
    if options[:save_json]
      save_to_json(companies, options[:name])
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_options
    options = {
      name: nil,
      jurisdiction: nil,
      limit: 10,
      save_json: false
    }
    
    parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
      opts.banner = "Usage: ruby main.rb [options]"
      
      opts.on("-n", "--name NAME", String, "Company name to search for (required)") do |name|
        options[:name] = name
      end
      
      opts.on("-j", "--jurisdiction CODE", String, "Jurisdiction code (e.g., us_de, gb, ca_on)") do |jurisdiction|
        options[:jurisdiction] = jurisdiction
      end
      
      opts.on("-l", "--limit NUMBER", Integer, "Number of results to return (default: 10)") do |limit|
        options[:limit] = limit
      end
      
      opts.on("-s", "--save-json", "Save results to JSON file") do
        options[:save_json] = true
      end
      
      opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") do
        puts opts
        exit
      end
    end
    
    parser.parse!
    
    if options[:name].nil? || options[:name].empty?
      puts "Error: Company name is required."
      puts parser
      exit 1
    end
    
    options
  end
  
  def save_to_json(companies, search_term)
    filename = "company_search_#{search_term.downcase.gsub(/\s+/, '_')}_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.json"
    
    File.open(filename, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(companies))
    end
    
    puts "\nResults saved to #{filename}"
  end
end

# Run the CLI

    cli.run
  rescue StandardError => e

    exit 1
  end
```

Task: Compute TF-IDF keywords for a set of documents and find similar documents.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 2.7"

# The TF-IDF implementation itself uses only the Ruby standard library.
# Minitest is the only gem needed, and only for the test file.
gem "minitest", "~> 5.20", group: :test
```

## lib/tfidf.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "set"

# Computes TF-IDF weights for a corpus, extracts per-document keywords,
# and finds similar documents using cosine similarity.
#
#   corpus = TfIdf.new("a" => "text...", "b" => "text...")
#   corpus.keywords("a", top_n: 5)   # => [["term", 0.42], ...]
#   corpus.similar("a", top_n: 3)    # => [["b", 0.31], ...]
class TfIdf
  STOPWORDS = Set.new(%w[
    a an and are as at be but by for from has have he her his i if in into is it
    its me my not of on or our she so that the their them then there these they
    this those to was we were what when which who will with you your
  ]).freeze

  attr_reader :ids

  # documents: Hash of { id => text }
  # sublinear_tf: use 1 + log(count) instead of raw relative frequency
  def initialize(documents, stopwords: STOPWORDS, min_token_length: 2, sublinear_tf: false)
    raise ArgumentError, "documents must be a non-empty Hash" unless documents.is_a?(Hash) && !documents.empty?

    @stopwords = stopwords
    @min_token_length = min_token_length
    @sublinear_tf = sublinear_tf
    @ids = documents.keys

    tokenized = documents.transform_values { |text| tokenize(text) }
    @idf = compute_idf(tokenized.values)
    @vectors = tokenized.transform_values { |tokens| vectorize(tokens) }
  end

  # Top N keywords for a document, as [[term, weight], ...] (highest first).
  def keywords(id, top_n: 5)
    vector = fetch_vector(id)
    vector.sort_by { |term, weight| [-weight, term] }.first(top_n)
  end

  # Documents most similar to the given document id, as [[id, cosine], ...].
  def similar(id, top_n: 3, min_score: 0.0)
    target = fetch_vector(id)
    rank(target, exclude: id, top_n: top_n, min_score: min_score)
  end

  # Documents most similar to arbitrary text (e.g. a search query).
  # Terms not seen in the corpus are ignored.
  def similar_to_text(text, top_n: 3, min_score: 0.0)
    query = vectorize(tokenize(text))
    rank(query, exclude: nil, top_n: top_n, min_score: min_score)
  end

  # Cosine similarity between two documents in the corpus.
  def similarity(id_a, id_b)
    cosine(fetch_vector(id_a), fetch_vector(id_b))
  end

  def idf(term)
    @idf[term]
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    text.to_s.downcase.scan(/\p{L}[\p{L}\p{N}']*/).map { |t| t.delete_suffix("'s") }
        .reject { |t| t.length < @min_token_length || @stopwords.include?(t) }
  end

  # Smoothed IDF (same formula as scikit-learn): ln((1 + N) / (1 + df)) + 1
  # Always positive, and avoids division by zero.
  def compute_idf(token_lists)
    n = token_lists.size
    df = Hash.new(0)
    token_lists.each { |tokens| tokens.uniq.each { |t| df[t] += 1 } }
    df.to_h { |term, count| [term, Math.log((1.0 + n) / (1.0 + count)) + 1.0] }
  end

  # Builds an L2-normalized sparse TF-IDF vector (Hash term => weight).
  def vectorize(tokens)
    return {} if tokens.empty?

    total = tokens.size.to_f
    weights = {}
    tokens.tally.each do |term, count|
      idf = @idf[term]
      next unless idf # unseen term (only possible for queries)

      tf = @sublinear_tf ? 1.0 + Math.log(count) : count / total
      weights[term] = tf * idf
    end
    normalize(weights)
  end

  def normalize(weights)
    norm = Math.sqrt(weights.values.sum { |w| w * w })
    return {} if norm.zero?

    weights.transform_values { |w| w / norm }
  end

  # Vectors are unit length, so cosine similarity is just the dot product.
  def cosine(a, b)
    a, b = b, a if b.size < a.size
    a.sum { |term, weight| weight * (b[term] || 0.0) }
  end

  def rank(vector, exclude:, top_n:, min_score:)
    @vectors
      .reject { |id, _| id == exclude }
      .map { |id, other| [id, cosine(vector, other)] }
      .select { |_, score| score > min_score }
      .sort_by { |id, score| [-score, id.to_s] }
      .first(top_n)
  end

  def fetch_vector(id)
    @vectors.fetch(id) { raise KeyError, "unknown document id: #{id.inspect}" }
  end
end

# Demo: ruby lib/tfidf.rb
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  docs = {
    "ruby_intro"   => "Ruby is a dynamic programming language focused on simplicity and productivity. " \
                      "Ruby on Rails is a popular web framework written in Ruby.",
    "rails_guide"  => "Rails is a web framework that follows the model view controller pattern. " \
                      "Rails makes building web applications in Ruby productive.",
    "python_intro" => "Python is a programming language known for readability. " \
                      "Python is widely used for data science and machine learning.",
    "ml_basics"    => "Machine learning models learn patterns from data. " \
                      "Data science uses machine learning to make predictions.",
    "cooking"      => "Simmer the tomatoes with garlic and olive oil. " \
                      "Add basil and serve the pasta with fresh tomatoes."
  }

  corpus = TfIdf.new(docs)

  puts "== Keywords =="
  docs.each_key do |id|
    kws = corpus.keywords(id, top_n: 5).map { |term, w| format("%s (%.3f)", term, w) }
    puts "#{id}: #{kws.join(', ')}"
  end

  puts "\n== Similar documents =="
  docs.each_key do |id|
    sims = corpus.similar(id, top_n: 2).map { |other, s| format("%s (%.3f)", other, s) }
    puts "#{id} -> #{sims.empty? ? '(none)' : sims.join(', ')}"
  end

  puts "\n== Query: 'machine learning with python' =="
  corpus.similar_to_text("machine learning with python").each do |id, score|
    puts format("%s (%.3f)", id, score)
  end
end
```

## test/tfidf_test.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/tfidf"

class TfIdfTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @docs = {
      "a" => "ruby rails web framework ruby",
      "b" => "rails web applications framework",
      "c" => "tomato garlic basil pasta tomato"
    }
    @corpus = TfIdf.new(@docs)
  end

  def test_top_keyword_is_most_distinctive_term
    assert_equal "tomato", @corpus.keywords("c", top_n: 1).first.first
  end

  def test_similar_ranks_related_document_first
    assert_equal "b", @corpus.similar("a", top_n: 1).first.first
  end

  def test_unrelated_documents_have_zero_similarity
    assert_in_delta 0.0, @corpus.similarity("a", "c")
    assert_empty @corpus.similar("c")
  end

  def test_self_similarity_is_one
    assert_in_delta 1.0, @corpus.similarity("a", "a")
  end

  def test_query_search
    assert_equal "c", @corpus.similar_to_text("garlic pasta").first.first
  end

  def test_unknown_id_raises
    assert_raises(KeyError) { @corpus.keywords("zzz") }
  end

  def test_empty_document_is_handled
    corpus = TfIdf.new("x" => "", "y" => "hello world")
    assert_empty corpus.keywords("x")
    assert_empty corpus.similar("x")
  end
end
```

## Usage

```sh
bundle install
ruby lib/tfidf.rb          # run the demo
ruby test/tfidf_test.rb    # run the tests
```

## Notes

- **TF**: term count divided by document length, or `1 + ln(count)` if `sublinear_tf: true`.
- **IDF**: smoothed, `ln((1+N)/(1+df)) + 1`, so it is always positive and never divides by zero.
- **Vectors**: each document is a sparse `Hash` of term to weight, L2-normalized. Cosine similarity is therefore just a dot product over the shared terms.
- **Dependencies**: none at runtime. Tokenization is Unicode-aware, with a built-in English stopword list you can override via `stopwords:`.

## lib/number_to_words.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Перетворює цілі числа на англійські слова.
#
#   NumberToWords.convert(1234)  # => "one thousand two hundred thirty-four"
#   NumberToWords.convert(-15)   # => "minus fifteen"
#   NumberToWords.convert("0")   # => "zero"
module NumberToWords
  ONES = %w[
    zero one two three four five six seven eight nine ten
    eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen
  ].freeze

  TENS = %w[
    _ _ twenty thirty forty fifty sixty seventy eighty ninety
  ].freeze

  SCALES = [
    "", "thousand", "million", "billion", "trillion", "quadrillion",
    "quintillion", "sextillion", "septillion", "octillion", "nonillion",
    "decillion"
  ].freeze

  module_function

  # Приймає Integer або рядок із десятковим цілим числом.
  def convert(input)
    number = parse(input)

    return "zero" if number.zero?
    return "minus #{convert(-number)}" if number.negative?

    groups = []
    scale = 0

    while number.positive?
      number, chunk = number.divmod(1000)

      if scale >= SCALES.size
        raise ArgumentError, "число завелике (підтримується до 10^#{SCALES.size * 3} - 1)"
      end

      unless chunk.zero?
        words = below_thousand(chunk)
        words = "#{words} #{SCALES[scale]}" unless scale.zero?
        groups.unshift(words)
      end

      scale += 1
    end

    groups.join(" ")
  end

  def parse(input)
    case input
    when Integer then input
    when String  then Integer(input.strip, 10)
    else
      raise TypeError, "очікується Integer або String, отримано #{input.class}"
    end
  end

  # 1..999
  def below_thousand(number)
    hundreds, rest = number.divmod(100)
    parts = []
    parts << "#{ONES[hundreds]} hundred" if hundreds.positive?
    parts << below_hundred(rest) if rest.positive?
    parts.join(" ")
  end

  # 1..99
  def below_hundred(number)
    return ONES[number] if number < 20

    tens, ones = number.divmod(10)
    ones.zero? ? TENS[tens] : "#{TENS[tens]}-#{ONES[ones]}"
  end

  private_class_method :parse if respond_to?(:private_class_method)
end

# Запуск з командного рядка: ruby lib/number_to_words.rb 1234
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  if ARGV.empty?
    warn "Використання: ruby #{$PROGRAM_NAME} <число> [число ...]"
    exit 1
  end

  ARGV.each do |arg|
    puts "#{arg} => #{NumberToWords.convert(arg)}"
  rescue ArgumentError, TypeError => e
    warn "#{arg}: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

Below is a Rails implementation for creating and managing WooCommerce products from an admin area using the WooCommerce REST API. ## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source "https://rubygems.org" gem "rails", "~> 7.1" gem "sqlite3" gem "puma" gem "woocommerce_api" gem "httparty" # explicit dependency of woocommerce_api gem "dotenv-rails", groups: [:development, :test] ``` ## Environment Variables Create a `.env` file or set environment variables: ``` WOOCOMMERCE_URL=https://your-store.com WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY=ck_xxxxxxxx WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET=cs_xxxxxxxx ``` ## Initializer ```ruby # config/initializers/woocommerce_client.rb require "woocommerce_api" module WooCommerceClient class << self def client @client ||= WooCommerce::API.new( ENV.fetch("WOOCOMMERCE_URL"), ENV.fetch("WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY"), ENV.fetch("WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET"), { wp_api: true, version: "wc/v3", query_string_auth: true } ) end end end ``` ## Model ```ruby # app/models/woo_product.rb require "json" class WooProduct include ActiveModel::Model attr_accessor :id, :name, :type, :regular_price, :sale_price, :description, :short_description, :sku, :stock_quantity, :manage_stock, :status, :categories, :images validates :name, presence: true validates :regular_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_blank: true validates :sale_price, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }, allow_blank: true validates :status, inclusion: { in: %w[draft pending private publish] } validate :categories_and_images_are_valid_json def initialize(attributes = {}) super @type ||= "simple" @status ||= "draft" @manage_stock = false if @manage_stock.nil? @categories ||= [] @images ||= [] end def self.all response = WooCommerceClient.client.get("products", per_page: 100) raise WooCommerceError, extract_error(response) unless response.success? response.parsed_response.map { |attrs| new(build_attributes(attrs)) } end def self.find(id) response = WooCommerceClient.client.get("products/#{id}") raise WooCommerceError, extract_error(response) unless response.success? new(build_attributes(response.parsed_response)) end def save return false unless valid? payload = to_woocommerce_payload response = if id.present? WooCommerceClient.client.put("products/#{id}", payload) else WooCommerceClient.client.post("products", payload) end if response.success? self.id = response.parsed_response["id"] true else errors.add(:base, self.class.extract_error(response)) false end end def update(attributes) assign_attributes(attributes) save end def destroy return false if id.blank? response = WooCommerceClient.client.delete("products/#{id}") if response.success? true else errors.add(:base, self.class.extract_error(response)) false end end def assign_attributes(attributes) attributes.each do |key, value| setter = "#{key}=" public_send(setter, value) if respond_to?(setter) end end def persisted? id.present? end def manage_stock=(value) @manage_stock = %w[1 true].include?(value.to_s) end private def self.build_attributes(attrs) { id: attrs["id"], name: attrs["name"], type: attrs["type"], regular_price: attrs["regular_price"], sale_price: attrs["sale_price"], description: attrs["description"], short_description: attrs["short_description"], sku: attrs["sku"], stock_quantity: attrs["stock_quantity"], manage_stock: attrs["manage_stock"], status: attrs["status"], categories: attrs["categories"] || [], images: attrs["images"] || [] } end def to_woocommerce_payload { name: name, type: type, regular_price: regular_price, sale_price: sale_price, description: description, short_description: short_description, sku: sku, stock_quantity: stock_quantity, manage_stock: manage_stock, status: status, categories: parse_json_or_array(categories), images: parse_json_or_array(images) }.compact end def categories_and_images_are_valid_json parse_json_or_array(categories) if categories.present? parse_json_or_array(images) if images.present? rescue JSON::ParserError errors.add(:base, "Categories and images must be valid JSON") end def parse_json_or_array(value) case value when Array value when String value.strip.empty? ? [] : JSON.parse(value) else [] end end def self.extract_error(response) parsed = response.parsed_response if parsed.is_a?(Hash) && parsed["message"] parsed["message"] else "Request failed with status #{response.code}" end end end class WooCommerceError < StandardError; end ``` ## Controller ```ruby # app/controllers/admin/woo_products_controller.rb module Admin class WooProductsController < ApplicationController before_action :set_woo_product, only: [:edit, :update, :destroy] def index @woo_products = WooProduct.all end def new @woo_product = WooProduct.new end def create @woo_product = WooProduct.new(woo_product_params) if @woo_product.save redirect_to admin_woo_products_path, notice: "Product was successfully created." else render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end def edit end def update if @woo_product.update(woo_product_params) redirect_to admin_woo_products_path, notice: "Product was successfully updated." else render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity end end def destroy if @woo_product.destroy redirect_to admin_woo_products_path, notice: "Product was successfully deleted." else redirect_to admin_woo_products_path, alert: @woo_product.errors.full_messages.to_sentence end end private def set_woo_product @woo_product = WooProduct.find(params[:id]) end def woo_product_params params.require(:woo_product).permit( :name, :type, :regular_price, :sale_price, :description, :short_description, :sku, :stock_quantity, :manage_stock, :status, :categories, :images ) end end end ``` ## Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do namespace :admin do resources :woo_products, only: [:index, :new, :create, :edit, :update, :destroy] end end ``` ## Views ### `app/views/admin/woo_products/index.html.erb` ```erb

WooCommerce Products

<%= link_to "New Product", new_admin_woo_product_path %> <% @woo_products.each do |product| %> <% end %>
ID Name Type Price Status
<%= product.id %> <%= product.name %> <%= product.type %> <%= product.regular_price %> <%= product.status %> <%= link_to "Edit", edit_admin_woo_product_path(product) %> <%= button_to "Delete", admin_woo_product_path(product), method: :delete, data: { confirm: "Are you sure?" } %>
``` ### `app/views/admin/woo_products/new.html.erb` ```erb

New WooCommerce Product

<%= render "form", woo_product: @woo_product %> ``` ### `app/views/admin/woo_products/edit.html.erb` ```erb

Edit WooCommerce Product

<%= render "form", woo_product: @woo_product %> ``` ### `app/views/admin/woo_products/_form.html.erb` ```erb <%= form_with(model: [:admin, woo_product]) do |form| %> <% if woo_product.errors.any? %>

<%= pluralize(woo_product.errors.count, "error") %> prohibited this product from being saved:

    <% woo_product.errors.full_messages.each do |message| %>
  • <%= message %>
    • <% end %>
<% end %>
<%= form.label :name %> <%= form.text_field :name %>
<%= form.label :type %> <%= form.select :type, ["simple", "variable", "external", "grouped"] %>
<%= form.label :regular_price %> <%= form.text_field :regular_price %>
<%= form.label :sale_price %> <%= form.text_field :sale_price %>
<%= form.label :description %> <%= form.text_area :description %>
<%= form.label :short_description %> <%= form.text_area :short_description %>
<%= form.label :sku %> <%= form.text_field :sku %>
<%= form.label :manage_stock %> <%= form.check_box :manage_stock %>
<%= form.label :stock_quantity %> <%= form.number_field :stock_quantity %>
<%= form.label :status %> <%= form.select :status, ["draft", "pending", "private", "publish"] %>
<%= form.label :categories, "Categories (JSON)" %> <%= form.text_area :categories, value: woo_product.categories.to_json %> Example: [{"id": 1}]
<%= form.label :images, "Images (JSON)" %> <%= form.text_area :images, value: woo_product.images.to_json %> Example: [{"src": "https://example.com/image.jpg"}]
<%= form.submit %>
<% end %> ``` ## Usage 1. Run `bundle install`. 2. Set the environment variables for your WooCommerce store. 3. Start Rails: `rails server`. 4. Visit `/admin/woo_products` to create, edit, and delete products.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "activerecord", "~> 7.1"   # ORM (pulls in activesupport and i18n)
gem "sqlite3", ">= 1.6"        # database driver for the demo
gem "money", "~> 6.19"         # integer-based money arithmetic, currencies, formatting

```

## Implementation

```ruby
# money_demo.rb
require "bundler/setup"
require "active_record"
require "bigdecimal"
require "money"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Money configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Money.locale_backend    = :currency                  # format using the currency's own symbol/separators
Money.rounding_mode     = BigDecimal::ROUND_HALF_UP  # 2.675 -> 2.68 (the way people expect)
Money.default_currency  = Money::Currency.new("USD")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database (in-memory SQLite for the demo)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
ActiveRecord::Schema.verbose = false

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :products do |t|
    t.string  :name,           null: false
    # Amount is stored as an INTEGER count of the currency's smallest unit
    # (cents, pence, yen...), so there is never any floating-point rounding.
    t.integer :price_cents,    null: false, default: 0, limit: 8   # bigint-sized
    t.string  :price_currency, null: false, default: "USD", limit: 3
    t.timestamps
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :price_cents, numericality: { only_integer: true }
  validates :price_currency,
            inclusion: { in: ->(_) { Money::Currency.all.map(&:iso_code) },
                         message: "%{value} is not a supported currency" }
  validate :price_amount_must_be_valid

  # Returns a Money object (or nil if nothing is set).
  def price
    return nil if price_cents.nil? || Money::Currency.find(price_currency).nil?
    Money.new(price_cents, price_currency)
  end

  # Accepts a Money, Integer, BigDecimal, Rational, or a numeric String ("19.99").
  # Floats are accepted but converted via their shortest string form, so 19.99 -> "19.99".
  # Prefer Strings/BigDecimals for user input.
  def price=(value)
    @price_amount_error = nil

    case value
    when nil
      @price_amount = nil
      self.price_cents = nil
    when Money
      @price_amount = nil
      self.price_cents = value.cents
      self.price_currency = value.currency.iso_code
    else
      @price_amount = parse_amount(value)
      sync_price_cents
    end
  end

  # Changing the currency re-applies a pending decimal amount, so attribute
  # order in `Product.new(price: "10", price_currency: "JPY")` doesn't matter.
  def price_currency=(code)
    super(code.nil? ? nil : code.to_s.strip.upcase)
    sync_price_cents
  end

  # "$19.99", "19,99 €", "¥1,500", ...
  def formatted_price(**options)
    price&.format(**options)
  end

  private

  def parse_amount(value)
    case value
    when BigDecimal then value
    when Integer    then BigDecimal(value)
    when Float      then BigDecimal(value.to_s)
    when Rational   then BigDecimal(value, 20)
    when String     then BigDecimal(value.strip.delete(","))
    else raise ArgumentError, "unsupported type #{value.class}"
    end
  rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
    @price_amount_error = "is not a valid amount"
    nil
  end

  def sync_price_cents
    return if @price_amount.nil?
    currency = Money::Currency.find(price_currency.presence || Money.default_currency.iso_code)
    return if currency.nil? # the inclusion validation will report it

    self.price_cents = Money.from_amount(@price_amount, currency).cents
  end

  def price_amount_must_be_valid
    errors.add(:price, @price_amount_error) if @price_amount_error
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  # 1. Floats go wrong, integer cents don't
  puts "Float:  0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 ? #{0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3}"
  puts "Money:  $0.10 + $0.20 == $0.30 ? #{Money.new(10, 'USD') + Money.new(20, 'USD') == Money.new(30, 'USD')}"
  puts

  # 2. Create records with different input styles
  book   = Product.create!(name: "Book",   price: "19.99")
  coffee = Product.create!(name: "Coffee", price: "4.5", price_currency: "EUR")
  ramen  = Product.create!(name: "Ramen",  price: "1500", price_currency: "JPY") # 0 decimals
  gadget = Product.create!(name: "Gadget", price: Money.new(129_99, "GBP"))

  Product.order(:id).each do |p|
    puts format("%-7s stored as %-6s %s  =>  %s",
                p.name, p.price_cents, p.price_currency, p.formatted_price)
  end
  puts

  # 3. Exact arithmetic and rounding
  total = book.price * 3
  puts "3 books:           #{total.format}"             # $59.97
  puts "Split 3 ways:      #{book.price.allocate([1, 1, 1]).map(&:format).join(', ')}" # no lost cents
  puts "Rounds half up:    #{Product.new(name: 'x', price: '2.675').formatted_price}"  # $2.68
  puts "No symbol:         #{book.formatted_price(symbol: false)}"
  puts "With ISO code:     #{book.formatted_price(with_currency: true)}"
  puts

  # 4. Validation
  bad = Product.new(name: "Bad", price: "abc")
  puts "Invalid amount:    #{bad.valid?} #{bad.errors.full_messages}"
  bad = Product.new(name: "Bad", price: "5", price_currency: "XXZ")
  puts "Invalid currency: #{bad.valid?} #{bad.errors.full_messages}"
end
```

## How it works

- **Storage:** the amount is an integer number of minor units (`price_cents`) and the currency is a separate 3-letter column. Integers are exact, and the column is bigint-sized so large amounts fit.
- **Parsing:** user input goes through `BigDecimal` (never `Float` math) and then `Money.from_amount`. That handles each currency's own decimal places, for example 2 for USD and 0 for JPY.
- **Rounding:** it is set explicitly to half-up so `2.675` becomes `2.68`.
- **Arithmetic:** `Money` supports `+`, `-`, `*` and `allocate`. `allocate` splits an amount without losing or creating cents, and mixing currencies raises an error.
- **Display:** `formatted_price` delegates to `Money#format`, which uses the currency's symbol and separators and accepts options such as `symbol: false` and `with_currency: true`.
- **Validation:** unparseable amounts and unknown currency codes are rejected with normal ActiveRecord errors.
- **Attribute order:** `price` and `price_currency` can be assigned in either order.

Run it with `bundle install && ruby money_demo.rb`.

**Please read before using:**

- This code does no cryptography. The legally required qualified e-signature (КЕП) and the sending step are delegated to M.E.Doc, which holds the keys. Test against a sandbox or test company first.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2"
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# medoc_tax_invoice.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bigdecimal"
require "bigdecimal/util"
require "date"
require "json"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "nokogiri"

module MedocTax
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end
  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(message, status: nil, body: nil)
      super(message)
      @status = status
      @body = body
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Config
  Config = Struct.new(
    :base_url,        # e.g. "http://localhost:63777" (local M.E.Doc API) - check your setup
    :login,
    :password,
    :company_edrpou,  # sender's EDRPOU / TIN (8 or 10 digits)
    :tax_office_code, # C_STI_ORIG, 4-digit code of the tax office, e.g. "2650"
    :timeout,
    :poll_interval,
    :poll_timeout,
    keyword_init: true
  ) do
    def self.from_env
      new(
        base_url: ENV.fetch("MEDOC_BASE_URL"),
        login: ENV.fetch("MEDOC_LOGIN"),
        password: ENV.fetch("MEDOC_PASSWORD"),
        company_edrpou: ENV.fetch("MEDOC_COMPANY_EDRPOU"),
        tax_office_code: ENV.fetch("MEDOC_TAX_OFFICE_CODE"),
        timeout: Integer(ENV.fetch("MEDOC_TIMEOUT", "30")),
        poll_interval: Integer(ENV.fetch("MEDOC_POLL_INTERVAL", "5")),
        poll_timeout: Integer(ENV.fetch("MEDOC_POLL_TIMEOUT", "300"))
      )
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Models
  Party = Struct.new(:name, :ipn, :edrpou, :address, keyword_init: true)
  Line = Struct.new(:name, :unit, :quantity, :price, :vat_rate, keyword_init: true) do
    # price is WITHOUT VAT
    def amount = (BigDecimal(quantity.to_s) * BigDecimal(price.to_s)).round(2)
    def vat = (amount * BigDecimal(vat_rate.to_s) / 100).round(2)
  end

  Invoice = Struct.new(:number, :date, :seller, :buyer, :lines, keyword_init: true) do
    def total_without_vat = lines.sum(BigDecimal("0")) { |l| l.amount }
    def total_vat = lines.sum(BigDecimal("0")) { |l| l.vat }
    def total_with_vat = total_without_vat + total_vat
  end

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Validation
  module Validator
    module_function

    def validate!(invoice)
      errors = []
      errors << "number is required" if invoice.number.to_s.strip.empty?
      errors << "date must be a Date" unless invoice.date.is_a?(Date)
      errors.concat(party_errors("seller", invoice.seller))
      errors.concat(party_errors("buyer", invoice.buyer))
      errors << "at least one line is required" if invoice.lines.nil? || invoice.lines.empty?

      Array(invoice.lines).each_with_index do |l, i|
        n = i + 1
        errors << "line #{n}: name is required" if l.name.to_s.strip.empty?
        errors << "line #{n}: quantity must be > 0" unless positive?(l.quantity)
        errors << "line #{n}: price must be > 0" unless positive?(l.price)
        errors << "line #{n}: vat_rate must be 0, 7 or 20" unless [0, 7, 20].include?(l.vat_rate.to_i)
      end

      raise ValidationError, errors.join("; ") unless errors.empty?
    end

    def party_errors(role, p)
      return ["#{role} is required"] if p.nil?

      errs = []
      errs << "#{role}.name is required" if p.name.to_s.strip.empty?
      errs << "#{role}.ipn must be 12 digits" unless p.ipn.to_s.match?(/\A\d{12}\z/)
      errs << "#{role}.edrpou must be 8 or 10 digits" unless p.edrpou.to_s.match?(/\A(\d{8}|\d{10})\z/)
      errs
    end

    def positive?(v)
      BigDecimal(v.to_s) > 0
    rescue ArgumentError
      false
    end
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- XML builder
  # Builds a tax invoice (J1201010) XML in windows-1251, as the tax service expects.
  # NOTE: verify tag names / form version against the current official XSD.
  class XmlBuilder
    FORM_CODE = "J12"
    FORM_SUB  = "010"
    FORM_VER  = "1" # set to the version currently in force

    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
    end

    def build(invoice)
      Validator.validate!(invoice)
      d = invoice.date

      builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: "windows-1251") do |xml|
        xml.DECLAR("xmlns:xsi" => "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance",
                   "xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation" => "#{FORM_CODE}#{FORM_SUB}.xsd") do
          xml.DECLARHEAD do
            xml.TIN @config.company_edrpou
            xml.C_DOC FORM_CODE
            xml.C_DOC_SUB FORM_SUB
            xml.C_DOC_VER FORM_VER
            xml.C_DOC_TYPE 0
            xml.C_DOC_CNT 1
            xml.C_REG @config.tax_office_code[0, 2]
            xml.C_RAJ @config.tax_office_code[2, 2]
            xml.PERIOD_MONTH d.month
            xml.PERIOD_TYPE 1
            xml.PERIOD_YEAR d.year
            xml.C_STI_ORIG @config.tax_office_code
            xml.C_DOC_STAN 1
            xml.D_FILL fmt_date(Date.today)
            xml.SOFTWARE "ruby-medoc-client"
          end

          xml.DECLARBODY do
            xml.HORIG1 1
            xml.HFILL fmt_date(d)
            xml.HNUM invoice.number
            xml.HNAMESEL invoice.seller.name
            xml.HNAMEBUY invoice.buyer.name
            xml.HKSEL invoice.seller.ipn
            xml.HKBUY invoice.buyer.ipn
            xml.HTINSEL invoice.seller.edrpou
            xml.HTINBUY invoice.buyer.edrpou
            xml.HLOCSEL invoice.seller.address.to_s
            xml.HLOCBUY invoice.buyer.address.to_s

            invoice.lines.each_with_index do |line, i|
              row = i + 1
              xml.send(:"RXXXXG3S", line.name, ROWNUM: row)
              xml.send(:"RXXXXG4S", line.unit.to_s, ROWNUM: row)
              xml.send(:"RXXXXG5", money(line.quantity, 3), ROWNUM: row)
              xml.send(:"RXXXXG6", money(line.price), ROWNUM: row)
              xml.send(:"RXXXXG008", money(line.amount), ROWNUM: row)
            end

            xml.R01G7 money(invoice.total_without_vat)
            xml.R03G7 money(invoice.total_vat)
            xml.R04G11 money(invoice.total_with_vat)
          end
        end
      end

      builder.to_xml(encoding: "windows-1251")
    end

    private

    def fmt_date(date) = date.strftime("%d%m%Y")

    def money(value, scale = 2)
      format("%.#{scale}f", BigDecimal(value.to_s).round(scale))
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Client
  # Thin wrapper over the M.E.Doc HTTP API.
  # ADJUST ENDPOINTS to your M.E.Doc API documentation.
  class Client
    ENDPOINTS = {
      login:  "/api/v1/auth/login",
      upload: "/api/v1/documents",
      sign:   "/api/v1/documents/%<id>s/sign",
      send:   "/api/v1/documents/%<id>s/send",
      status: "/api/v1/documents/%<id>s/status"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(config, connection: nil)
      @config = config
      @token = nil
      @conn = connection || build_connection
    end

    def authenticate!
      body = post(ENDPOINTS[:login], login: @config.login, password: @config.password)
      @token = body["token"] || body["access_token"] or
        raise ApiError.new("Authentication response has no token", body: body)
      @token
    end

    # Uploads raw XML; returns the document id assigned by M.E.Doc.
    def upload_document(xml, file_name:)
      body = post(ENDPOINTS[:upload],
                  fileName: file_name,
                  content: [xml.b].pack("m0"), # base64 without the base64 gem
                  encoding: "windows-1251")
      body["id"] or raise ApiError.new("Upload response has no document id", body: body)
    end

    def sign_document(id)   = post(format(ENDPOINTS[:sign], id: id))
    def send_document(id)   = post(format(ENDPOINTS[:send], id: id))
    def document_status(id) = get(format(ENDPOINTS[:status], id: id))

    private

    def build_connection
      Faraday.new(url: @config.base_url) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.request :retry, max: 3, interval: 1, backoff_factor: 2,
                          retry_statuses: [502, 503, 504],
                          methods: %i[get] # never auto-retry POST (could double-send)
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson\b/
        f.options.timeout = @config.timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = 10
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    def post(path, payload = nil) = handle(@conn.post(path, payload) { |r| auth(r) })
    def get(path)                 = handle(@conn.get(path) { |r| auth(r) })

    def auth(request)
      request.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{@token}" if @token
    end

    def handle(response)
      return response.body.is_a?(Hash) ? response.body : {} if response.success?

      raise ApiError.new("M.E.Doc API error (HTTP #{response.status})",
                         status: response.status, body: response.body)
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise ApiError, "Network error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Sender
  class InvoiceSender
    FINAL_OK     = %w[accepted registered delivered].freeze
    FINAL_FAILED = %w[rejected error failed].freeze

    def initialize(config, client: Client.new(config), logger: nil)
      @config = config
      @client = client
      @builder = XmlBuilder.new(config)
      @logger = logger
    end

    # Returns { id:, status:, details: }
    def call(invoice, wait: true)
      xml = @builder.build(invoice)
      log "XML built for invoice #{invoice.number}"

      @client.authenticate!
      id = @client.upload_document(xml, file_name: file_name(invoice))
      log "Uploaded as document #{id}"

      @client.sign_document(id)
      log "Signed"
      @client.send_document(id)
      log "Sent to tax service"

      return { id: id, status: "sent", details: {} } unless wait

      wait_for_result(id)
    end

    private

    def wait_for_result(id)
      deadline = Time.now + @config.poll_timeout
      loop do
        details = @client.document_status(id)
        status = details["status"].to_s.downcase
        log "Status: #{status}"

        return { id: id, status: status, details: details } if FINAL_OK.include?(status)
        raise ApiError.new("Tax service rejected document #{id}", body: details) if FINAL_FAILED.include?(status)
        raise Error, "Timed out waiting for document #{id} (last status: #{status})" if Time.now > deadline

        sleep @config.poll_interval
      end
    end

    def file_name(invoice)
      "J1201010_#{@config.company_edrpou}_#{invoice.date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}_#{invoice.number}.xml"
    end

    def log(msg) = @logger&.info(msg)
  end
end

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ Example
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require "logger"

  config = MedocTax::Config.from_env

  invoice = MedocTax::Invoice.new(
    number: "125",
    date: Date.today,
    seller: MedocTax::Party.new(name: 'ТОВ "Продавець"', ipn: "123456789012",
                                edrpou: config.company_edrpou, address: "м. Київ, вул. Хрещатик, 1"),
    buyer: MedocTax::Party.new(name: 'ТОВ "Покупець"', ipn: "210987654321",
                               edrpou: "87654321", address: "м. Львів, пл. Ринок, 2"),
    lines: [
      MedocTax::Line.new(name: "Консультаційні послуги", unit: "послуга",
                         quantity: 1, price: "10000.00", vat_rate: 20)
    ]
  )

  begin
    result = MedocTax::InvoiceSender.new(config, logger: Logger.new($stdout)).call(invoice)
    puts "Done: #{result[:status]} (document #{result[:id]})"
  rescue MedocTax::ValidationError => e
    warn "Invalid invoice: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue MedocTax::ApiError => e
    warn "API error: #{e.message} #{e.body.inspect}"
    exit 2
  end
end
```

```bash
export MEDOC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:63777
```

## Things to check before production

1. **Endpoints and payloads:** update `Client::ENDPOINTS` and the request/response field names (`token`, `id`, `status`) to match your M.E.Doc API docs.
2. **XML schema:** compare `XmlBuilder` against the official J1201010 XSD. Row tags, totals, form version, and optional fields such as the delivery type, payment terms, and UKTZED codes vary by version.
3. **Signing:** the invoice needs the КЕП of an authorized person (and a stamp, if used). Make sure the key is available to M.E.Doc, or adapt `sign_document` to your signing flow.
4. **Idempotency:** POSTs are deliberately not retried automatically, to avoid double submission. Before re-sending after a failure, check the document status.
5. **Deadlines:** tax invoices must be registered in the ЄРПН within the legally set period, so handle rejections and alert on them.
