## Product and variant sync

`app/services/shopify_sync/product_sync.rb`
```ruby
module ShopifySync
  class ProductSync
    PRODUCTS_PER_PAGE = 10 # kept small to stay under Shopify's 1000-point query cost limit
    VARIANTS_PER_PAGE = 40

    VARIANT_FIELDS = <<~GQL
      id title sku barcode price position updatedAt
      inventoryItem { id tracked }
    GQL

    PRODUCTS_QUERY = <<~GQL
      query($cursor: String) {
        products(first: #{PRODUCTS_PER_PAGE}, after: $cursor) {
          pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
          nodes {
            id title handle status vendor productType tags createdAt updatedAt
            variants(first: #{VARIANTS_PER_PAGE}) {
              pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
              nodes { #{VARIANT_FIELDS} }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    GQL

    MORE_VARIANTS_QUERY = <<~GQL
      query($id: ID!, $cursor: String) {
        product(id: $id) {
          variants(first: 100, after: $cursor) {
            pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
            nodes { #{VARIANT_FIELDS} }
          }
        }
      }
    GQL

    def initialize(client:, started_at:)
      @client = client
      @started_at = started_at
      @product_count = 0
      @variant_count = 0
    end

    def call
      cursor = nil
      loop do
        products = @client.query(PRODUCTS_QUERY, { cursor: cursor }).fetch("products")
        persist_page(products.fetch("nodes"))

        break unless products.dig("pageInfo", "hasNextPage")

        cursor = products.dig("pageInfo", "endCursor")
      end

      # Anything not touched during this run no longer exists in Shopify.
      removed_products = ShopifyProduct.where("last_synced_at < ?", @started_at).delete_all
      removed_variants = ShopifyVariant.where("last_synced_at < ?", @started_at).delete_all

      Rails.logger.info("[ShopifySync] products=#{@product_count} variants=#{@variant_count} " \
                        "removed_products=#{removed_products} removed_variants=#{removed_variants}")
    end

    private

    def persist_page(nodes)
      return if nodes.empty?

      product_rows = []
      variant_rows = []

      nodes.each do |product|
        product_id = Ids.numeric(product["id"])
        product_rows << product_row(product, product_id)

        variants = product.dig("variants", "nodes").dup
        variants.concat(fetch_remaining_variants(product)) if product.dig("variants", "pageInfo", "hasNextPage")
        variants.each { |variant| variant_rows << variant_row(variant, product_id) }
      end

      ShopifyProduct.upsert_all(product_rows, unique_by: :shopify_id)
      ShopifyVariant.upsert_all(variant_rows, unique_by: :shopify_id) if variant_rows.any?

      @product_count += product_rows.size
      @variant_count += variant_rows.size
    end

    def fetch_remaining_variants(product)
      collected = []
      cursor = product.dig("variants", "pageInfo", "endCursor")

      loop do
        data = @client.query(MORE_VARIANTS_QUERY, { id: product["id"], cursor: cursor })
        connection = data.dig("product", "variants")
        break unless connection

        collected.concat(connection["nodes"])
        break unless connection.dig("pageInfo", "hasNextPage")

        cursor = connection.dig("pageInfo", "endCursor")
      end

      collected
    end

    def product_row(p, id)
      {
        shopify_id: id,
        title: p["title"],
        handle: p["handle"],
        status: p["status"],
        vendor: p["vendor"],
        product_type: p["productType"],
        tags: p["tags"] || [],
        shopify_created_at: p["createdAt"],
        shopify_updated_at: p["updatedAt"],
        last_synced_at: @started_at
      }
    end

    def variant_row(v, product_id)
      {
        shopify_id: Ids.numeric(v["id"]),
        product_shopify_id: product_id,
        inventory_item_id: Ids.numeric(v.dig("inventoryItem", "id")),
        title: v["title"],
        sku: v["sku"],
        barcode: v["barcode"],
        price: v["price"],
        position: v["position"],
        inventory_tracked: v.dig("inventoryItem", "tracked") || false,
        shopify_updated_at: v["updatedAt"],
        last_synced_at: @started_at
      }
    end
  end
end
```

## Locations and inventory levels sync

`app/services/shopify_sync/inventory_sync.rb`
```ruby
module ShopifySync
  class InventorySync
    LOCATIONS_QUERY = <<~GQL
      query($cursor: String) {
        locations(first: 50, after: $cursor) {
          pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
          nodes { id name isActive }
        }
      }
    GQL

    LEVELS_QUERY = <<~GQL
      query($id: ID!, $cursor: String) {
        location(id: $id) {
          inventoryLevels(first: 100, after: $cursor) {
            pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
            nodes {
              updatedAt
              item { id }
              quantities(names: ["available"]) { name quantity }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    GQL

    def initialize(client:, started_at:)
      @client = client
      @started_at = started_at
      @level_count = 0
    end

    def call
      locations = sync_locations
      locations.each { |location| sync_levels(location) }

      removed_levels = ShopifyInventoryLevel.where("last_synced_at < ?", @started_at).delete_all
      removed_locations = ShopifyLocation.where("last_synced_at < ?", @started_at).delete_all

      Rails.logger.info("[ShopifySync] locations=#{locations.size} levels=#{@level_count} " \
                        "removed_levels=#{removed_levels} removed_locations=#{removed_locations}")
    end

    private

    def sync_locations
      all = []
      cursor = nil

      loop do
        connection = @client.query(LOCATIONS_QUERY, { cursor: cursor }).fetch("locations")
        all.concat(connection.fetch("nodes"))
        break unless connection.dig("pageInfo", "hasNextPage")

        cursor = connection.dig("pageInfo", "endCursor")
      end

      rows = all.map do |l|
        { shopify_id: Ids.numeric(l["id"]), name: l["name"],
          active: l["isActive"], last_synced_at: @started_at }
      end
      ShopifyLocation.upsert_all(rows, unique_by: :shopify_id) if rows.any?

      all
    end

    def sync_levels(location)
      location_id = Ids.numeric(location["id"])
      cursor = nil

      loop do
        data = @client.query(LEVELS_QUERY, { id: location["id"], cursor: cursor })
        connection = data.dig("location", "inventoryLevels")
        break unless connection

        rows = connection["nodes"].map do |level|
          available = level["quantities"].find { |q| q["name"] == "available" }&.fetch("quantity", 0) || 0
          {
            inventory_item_id: Ids.numeric(level.dig("item", "id")),
            location_shopify_id: location_id,
            available: available,
            shopify_updated_at: level["updatedAt"],
            last_synced_at: @started_at
          }
        end

        if rows.any?
          ShopifyInventoryLevel.upsert_all(rows, unique_by: %i[inventory_item_id location_shopify_id])
          @level_count += rows.size
        end

        break unless connection.dig("pageInfo", "hasNextPage")

        cursor = connection.dig("pageInfo", "endCursor")
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Helpers and orchestration

`app/services/shopify_sync/ids.rb`

```ruby
  module Ids
```

`app/services/shopify_sync/runner.rb`
```ruby
module ShopifySync
  class Runner
    LOCK_KEY = 7_203_001 # arbitrary app-wide advisory lock id

    def self.call = new.call

    def call
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.with_connection do |conn|
        unless conn.select_value("SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(#{LOCK_KEY})")
          Rails.logger.warn("[ShopifySync] another sync is already running, skipping")
          return false
        end

        begin
          run
          true
        ensure
          conn.execute("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(#{LOCK_KEY})")
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def run
      started_at = Time.current
      client = AdminClient.new

      # Order matters: if either step raises, nothing is deleted for that step,
      # so a failed run never wipes data.
      ProductSync.new(client: client, started_at: started_at).call
      InventorySync.new(client: client, started_at: started_at).call

      Rails.logger.info("[ShopifySync] finished in #{(Time.current - started_at).round(1)}s")
    end
  end
end
```


## Design notes

- **Idempotent upserts:** `upsert_all` is keyed on Shopify IDs, so re-running never creates duplicates.
- **Deletion handling:** every row is stamped with `last_synced_at`. After a fully successful pass, rows with an older stamp are deleted. If the sync fails midway, no deletion happens.
- **Overlap protection:** a Postgres advisory lock stops a slow sync from running concurrently with the next hourly one.
- **Rate limits:** the client reads Shopify's cost throttle status and sleeps when the bucket is low. It also retries `THROTTLED` errors, 429s, 5xx responses and timeouts with backoff.
- **Query cost:** page sizes are small enough to stay under the 1000-point query limit. Products with more than 40 variants are paginated separately.
- **Large catalogs:** for stores with hundreds of thousands of SKUs, switch to Shopify's Bulk Operations API (`bulkOperationRunQuery`). The models and upsert logic stay the same.

Task: Summarise long support tickets with the Anthropic Claude API.
text:
Here is the Ruby implementation with a Gemfile listing the required gems.

### Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "anthropic", "~> 0.3"
```

### summarizer.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "anthropic"

# Summarizes long support tickets using the Anthropic Claude API.
# The ticket is split into chunks that fit within the model's context window,
# each chunk is summarized, and the partial summaries are combined into one
# final summary.
class SupportTicketSummarizer
  # Default model: one of the widely available Claude 3.5 Sonnet models.
  DEFAULT_MODEL = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"

  # Approximate English characters per token. Used for chunk sizing.
  TOKEN_TO_CHAR_RATIO = 4

  # Maximum tokens per chunk sent to the API. Leave room for the summary output.
  DEFAULT_CHUNK_TOKENS = 40_000

  # Maximum tokens for each API-generated summary.
  DEFAULT_SUMMARY_TOKENS = 1_024

  TICKET_SYSTEM_PROMPT = <<~PROMPT.freeze
    You are an expert support analyst. Write a concise summary of the support ticket below.
    Include:
    - The main issue or question
    - Key technical details
    - Troubleshooting steps taken
    - Resolution (if any)
    - Outstanding action items and recommendations
  PROMPT

  def initialize(
    api_key: ENV["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"],
    model: DEFAULT_MODEL,
    chunk_tokens: DEFAULT_CHUNK_TOKENS,
    summary_tokens: DEFAULT_SUMMARY_TOKENS
  )
    raise ArgumentError, "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required" if api_key.nil? || api_key.strip.empty?

    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: api_key)
    @model = model
    @chunk_tokens = chunk_tokens
    @summary_tokens = summary_tokens
  end

  # Public: summarize a long support ticket.
  def summarize(ticket_text)
    raise ArgumentError, "ticket_text cannot be empty" if ticket_text.nil? || ticket_text.strip.empty?

    chunks = split_into_chunks(ticket_text)

    # Small enough for a single API call.
    if chunks.length == 1
      return call_claude(chunks.first, TICKET_SYSTEM_PROMPT)
    end

    # First pass: summarize each chunk independently.
    section_summaries = chunks.each_with_index.map do |chunk, index|
      call_claude(chunk, section_system_prompt(index + 1, chunks.length))
    end

    combined = section_summaries.join("\n\n---\n\n")

    # If the combined summaries are still too large, reduce them recursively.
    if estimated_tokens(combined) > @chunk_tokens
      return summarize(combined)
    end

    # Final pass: create a single coherent summary.
    call_claude(combined, final_system_prompt)
  end

  private

  def section_system_prompt(section_number, total_sections)
    <<~PROMPT
      You are an expert support analyst. This is section #{section_number} of #{total_sections} from a long support ticket.
      Summarize this section, preserving all important facts:
      - The main issue or question in this section
      - Technical details and error messages
      - Steps taken by support or customer
      - Any partial resolution or updates
      Write a detailed summary that can stand alone without the original text.
    PROMPT
  end

  def final_system_prompt
    <<~PROMPT
      You are an expert support analyst. Below are summaries of sections from a long support ticket.
      Create a single, coherent final summary that combines all sections. Include:
      - Overall issue
      - Important events in chronological order
      - Root cause (if identified)
      - Final resolution or workaround
      - Remaining action items
      Remove duplicate information and write in a clear, professional tone.
    PROMPT
  end

  # Split text into chunks that are under the token limit.
  def split_into_chunks(text)
    max_chars = @chunk_tokens * TOKEN_TO_CHAR_RATIO
    text = text.gsub("\r\n", "\n")

    # Split by blank lines to respect paragraph boundaries.
    paragraphs = text.split(/\n{2,}/)
    chunks = []
    current_chunk = +""

    paragraphs.each do |para|
      if para.length > max_chars
        # Flush current chunk first.
        unless current_chunk.empty?
          chunks << current_chunk
          current_chunk = +""
        end

        # Split long paragraph further.
        chunks.concat(split_long_paragraph(para, max_chars))
      else
        if current_chunk.empty?
          current_chunk << para
        elsif current_chunk.length + para.length + 2 <= max_chars
          current_chunk << "\n\n" << para
        else
          chunks << current_chunk unless current_chunk.empty?
          current_chunk = para.dup
        end
      end
    end

    chunks << current_chunk unless current_chunk.empty?
    chunks
  end

  # Split a paragraph that exceeds max_chars using sentence boundaries, then
  # word boundaries as a fallback.
  def split_long_paragraph(para, max_chars)
    return [para] if para.length <= max_chars

    sentences = para.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z0-9])/)
    chunks = []
    current = +""

    sentences.each do |sentence|
      if sentence.length > max_chars
        # Flush current sentence chunk.
        unless current.empty?
          chunks << current
          current = +""
        end

        # Split by words as a fallback.
        words = sentence.split(/\s+/)
        word_chunk = +""
        words.each do |word|
          if word_chunk.empty?
            word_chunk << word
          elsif word_chunk.length + word.length + 1 <= max_chars
            word_chunk << " " << word
          else
            chunks << word_chunk
            word_chunk = word.dup
          end
        end
        chunks << word_chunk unless word_chunk.empty?
      else
        if current.empty?
          current << sentence
        elsif current.length + sentence.length + 1 <= max_chars
          current << " " << sentence
        else
          chunks << current
          current = sentence.dup
        end
      end
    end

    chunks << current unless current.empty?
    chunks
  end

  # Rough token count estimate. Not exact, but sufficient for chunk sizing.
  def estimated_tokens(text)
    (text.length / TOKEN_TO_CHAR_RATIO).ceil
  end

  # Call the Claude API and return the text of the generated response.
  def call_claude(text, system_prompt)
    response = @client.messages.create(
      parameters: {
        model: @model,
        max_tokens: @summary_tokens,
        system: system_prompt,
        messages: [
          { role: "user", content: text }
        ]
      }
    )

    content = response.dig("content", 0, "text")
    raise "Anthropic API returned no content" if content.nil? || content.strip.empty?

    content.strip
  rescue Anthropic::Error => e
    raise "Anthropic API error: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# Example CLI usage (optional):
# ruby summarizer.rb ticket.txt
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    warn "Usage: ruby summarizer.rb <ticket_file>"
    exit 1
  end

  ticket_text = File.read(ARGV[0])
  summarizer = SupportTicketSummarizer.new
  puts summarizer.summarize(ticket_text)
end
```

### Usage

1. Set your Anthropic API key:
   ```bash
   export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-api-key"
   ```
2. Run `bundle install`.
3. Summarize a ticket file:
   ```bash
   ruby summarizer.rb path/to/ticket.txt
   ```

# Two-factor authentication (TOTP + QR enrolment) for Rails **Assumptions:** Rails 7.1 or later (tested against the 8.0 API) and an existing `User` model with `email` and `has_secure_password`. TOTP secrets are encrypted at rest with Rails' built-in Active Record Encryption, so no extra gem is needed for that. ## Gemfile ```ruby source "https://rubygems.org" ruby ">= 3.2" gem "rails", "~> 8.0" gem "sqlite3", ">= 2.1" # swap for "pg" in production gem "puma", ">= 5.0" gem "bcrypt", "~> 3.1" # has_secure_password + hashing backup codes gem "rotp", "~> 6.3" # TOTP generation / verification (RFC 6238) gem "rqrcode", "~> 2.2" # QR code rendering for enrolment ``` One-time setup: ```bash bundle install bin/rails db:encryption:init # copy the output into credentials (bin/rails credentials:edit) ``` ```ruby # config/application.rb (or an initializer): keep codes out of logs config.filter_parameters += [:code, :otp_secret] ``` ## Migration ```ruby # db/migrate/20250101000000_add_two_factor_to_users.rb class AddTwoFactorToUsers < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1] def change add_column :users, :otp_secret, :text # encrypted by AR add_column :users, :otp_required_for_login, :boolean, null: false, default: false add_column :users, :otp_last_used_at, :bigint # replay protection add_column :users, :otp_failed_attempts, :integer, null: false, default: 0 add_column :users, :otp_locked_until, :datetime add_column :users, :otp_backup_code_digests, :text # JSON array of bcrypt digests end end ``` ## Model concern ```ruby # app/models/concerns/two_factor_authenticatable.rb module TwoFactorAuthenticatable extend ActiveSupport::Concern ISSUER = "MyApp".freeze MAX_FAILED = 5 LOCK_FOR = 15.minutes BACKUP_CODE_COUNT = 10 DRIFT_SECONDS = 15 included do encrypts :otp_secret serialize :otp_backup_code_digests, coder: JSON, type: Array end def two_factor_enabled? otp_required_for_login? end def otp_locked? otp_locked_until.present? && otp_locked_until.future? end # Creates (or reuses) a pending secret during enrolment. def prepare_otp_secret! persist!(otp_secret: ROTP::Base32.random) if otp_secret.blank? otp_secret end def otp_provisioning_uri otp_totp.provisioning_uri(email) end # Verifies a TOTP code, or (optionally) a single-use backup code. # Enforces lockout after repeated failures and rejects code replay. def authenticate_second_factor(code, allow_backup: true) with_lock do if otp_locked? false elsif verify_otp(code) || (allow_backup && consume_backup_code(code)) persist!(otp_failed_attempts: 0, otp_locked_until: nil) true else failures = otp_failed_attempts + 1 if failures >= MAX_FAILED persist!(otp_failed_attempts: 0, otp_locked_until: LOCK_FOR.from_now) else persist!(otp_failed_attempts: failures) end false end end end # Turns 2FA on and returns the plaintext backup codes (shown to the user once). def enable_two_factor! persist!(otp_required_for_login: true, otp_failed_attempts: 0, otp_locked_until: nil) generate_backup_codes! end def disable_two_factor! persist!( otp_required_for_login: false, otp_secret: nil, otp_last_used_at: nil, otp_failed_attempts: 0, otp_locked_until: nil, otp_backup_code_digests: [] ) end def generate_backup_codes! codes = Array.new(BACKUP_CODE_COUNT) { SecureRandom.hex(6).scan(/.{4}/).join("-") } digests = codes.map { |c| BCrypt::Password.create(normalize_backup_code(c)).to_s } persist!(otp_backup_code_digests: digests) codes end private def otp_totp ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret, issuer: ISSUER) end def verify_otp(code) return false if otp_secret.blank? code = code.to_s.gsub(/\s/, "") return false unless code.match?(/\A\d{6}\z/) # `after:` rejects any timestep already used, so a code works only once. timestamp = otp_totp.verify( code, drift_ahead: DRIFT_SECONDS, drift_behind: DRIFT_SECONDS, after: otp_last_used_at ) return false unless timestamp persist!(otp_last_used_at: timestamp) true end def consume_backup_code(code) normalized = normalize_backup_code(code) return false unless normalized.length == 12 digest = otp_backup_code_digests.find { |d| BCrypt::Password.new(d) == normalized } return false unless digest persist!(otp_backup_code_digests: otp_backup_code_digests - [digest]) true end def normalize_backup_code(code) code.to_s.downcase.gsub(/[^0-9a-f]/, "") end # Save without running unrelated user validations. def persist!(attrs) assign_attributes(attrs) save!(validate: false) end end ``` ```ruby # app/models/user.rb class User < ApplicationRecord include TwoFactorAuthenticatable has_secure_password normalizes :email, with: ->(e) { e.strip.downcase } validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true end ``` ## Controllers ```ruby # app/controllers/application_controller.rb class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base helper_method :current_user private def current_user @current_user ||= User.find_by(id: session[:user_id]) if session[:user_id] end def require_login redirect_to new_session_path, alert: "Please sign in." unless current_user end # reset_session prevents session fixation def start_session_for(user) reset_session session[:user_id] = user.id end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/sessions_controller.rb (step 1: password) class SessionsController < ApplicationController def new; end def create user = User.find_by(email: params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase) if user&.authenticate(params[:password].to_s) if user.two_factor_enabled? # Password OK, but NOT signed in until the second factor passes. reset_session session[:pending_2fa_user_id] = user.id session[:pending_2fa_at] = Time.current.to_i redirect_to new_two_factor_challenge_path else start_session_for(user) redirect_to root_path end else flash.now[:alert] = "Invalid email or password." render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end def destroy reset_session redirect_to new_session_path, notice: "Signed out." end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/two_factor_challenges_controller.rb (step 2: code) class TwoFactorChallengesController < ApplicationController PENDING_TTL = 5.minutes before_action :load_pending_user def new; end def create if @user.authenticate_second_factor(params[:code]) start_session_for(@user) redirect_to root_path, notice: "Signed in." else flash.now[:alert] = if @user.otp_locked? "Too many failed attempts. Try again later." else "Invalid authentication code." end render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end private def load_pending_user started = session[:pending_2fa_at].to_i @user = User.find_by(id: session[:pending_2fa_user_id]) if @user.nil? || Time.current.to_i - started > PENDING_TTL.to_i reset_session redirect_to new_session_path, alert: "Please sign in again." end end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/two_factors_controller.rb (enrolment / disable) class TwoFactorsController < ApplicationController before_action :require_login before_action :no_store # GET /two_factor/new: show QR code def new return redirect_to(root_path, notice: "Two-factor is already enabled.") if current_user.two_factor_enabled? load_enrolment end # POST /two_factor: confirm first code, enable, reveal backup codes once def create return redirect_to(root_path) if current_user.two_factor_enabled? if current_user.authenticate_second_factor(params[:code], allow_backup: false) @backup_codes = current_user.enable_two_factor! render :backup_codes else load_enrolment flash.now[:alert] = current_user.otp_locked? ? "Too many attempts. Try later." : "That code didn't match. Try again." render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end # DELETE /two_factor: requires password AND a current code def destroy if current_user.authenticate(params[:password].to_s) && current_user.authenticate_second_factor(params[:code]) current_user.disable_two_factor! redirect_to root_path, notice: "Two-factor authentication disabled." else redirect_to root_path, alert: "Password or code incorrect." end end private def load_enrolment current_user.prepare_otp_secret! uri = current_user.otp_provisioning_uri svg = RQRCode::QRCode.new(uri).as_svg( offset: 0, color: "000", shape_rendering: "crispEdges", module_size: 5, standalone: true, use_path: true ) # Data URI keeps the SVG inert (no html_safe needed). @qr_data_uri = "data:image/svg+xml;base64,#{[svg].pack('m0')}" @manual_key = current_user.otp_secret.scan(/.{1,4}/).join(" ") end def no_store response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store" end end ``` ## Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resource :session, only: %i[new create destroy] resource :two_factor, only: %i[new create destroy] resource :two_factor_challenge, only: %i[new create] root "home#index" # your own root end ``` ## Views ```erb <%# app/views/two_factors/new.html.erb %>

Enable two-factor authentication

  1. Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, ...).
  2. Scan this QR code:
    <%= image_tag @qr_data_uri, alt: "2FA QR code", width: 220, height: 220 %>
  3. Or enter this key manually: <%= @manual_key %>
  4. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows:
<% if flash[:alert] %>

<%= flash[:alert] %>

<% end %> <%= form_with url: two_factor_path, method: :post do |f| %> <%= f.text_field :code, inputmode: "numeric", autocomplete: "one-time-code", pattern: "[0-9 ]*", maxlength: 7, required: true, autofocus: true %> <%= f.submit "Verify and enable" %> <% end %> ``` ```erb <%# app/views/two_factors/backup_codes.html.erb %>

Two-factor authentication enabled

Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once, and they will not be shown again.

    <% @backup_codes.each do |code| %>
  • <%= code %>
    • <% end %>
<%= link_to "Done", root_path %> ``` ```erb <%# app/views/two_factor_challenges/new.html.erb %>

Two-factor authentication

<% if flash[:alert] %>

<%= flash[:alert] %>

<% end %>

Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.

<%= form_with url: two_factor_challenge_path, method: :post do |f| %> <%= f.text_field :code, autocomplete: "one-time-code", required: true, autofocus: true %> <%= f.submit "Verify" %> <% end %> ``` ```erb <%# Example "disable" form for a settings page %> <%= form_with url: two_factor_path, method: :delete do |f| %> <%= f.password_field :password, placeholder: "Password", required: true %> <%= f.text_field :code, placeholder: "Authentication code", required: true %> <%= f.submit "Disable two-factor" %> <% end %> ``` ## Test ```ruby # test/models/two_factor_test.rb require "test_helper" class TwoFactorTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase setup do @user = User.create!(email: "a@example.com", password: "s3cret-pass") @user.prepare_otp_secret! end test "valid code enables 2FA and cannot be replayed" do code = ROTP::TOTP.new(@user.otp_secret).now assert @user.authenticate_second_factor(code, allow_backup: false) refute @user.authenticate_second_factor(code, allow_backup: false), "replay must fail" end test "backup codes are single use" do codes = @user.enable_two_factor! assert @user.authenticate_second_factor(codes.first) refute @user.authenticate_second_factor(codes.first) end test "locks after repeated failures" do TwoFactorAuthenticatable::MAX_FAILED.times { @user.authenticate_second_factor("000000") } assert @user.otp_locked? refute @user.authenticate_second_factor(ROTP::TOTP.new(@user.otp_secret).now) end end ``` For tests, set static keys in `config/environments/test.rb`: `config.active_record.encryption.primary_key = "test"`, `deterministic_key = "test"` and `key_derivation_salt = "test"`. ## Design notes - **Two-step login:** the password step only stores a short-lived `pending_2fa_user_id`. `session[:user_id]` is set only after the code verifies, and the session is reset at each transition. - **Secrets at rest:** `otp_secret` is encrypted with Active Record Encryption. Backup codes are stored only as bcrypt digests. - **Replay and brute force:** `otp_last_used_at` plus ROTP's `after:` makes each code single-use. Five failures trigger a 15-minute lock, enforced under a row lock (`with_lock`) so parallel guesses can't bypass it. - **Enrolment:** the QR code is a base64 SVG data URI, served with `Cache-Control: no-store`. 2FA is only switched on after the user proves their app works by entering a valid code. - **Disabling:** requires both the password and a current code.

Task: Receive and reply to Facebook Messenger messages from a Rails webhook.
text:
# Facebook Messenger webhook in Rails

## Gemfile

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.1"

gem "rails", "~> 7.1"
gem "puma", ">= 5.0"
gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"          # HTTP client for the Send API
gem "bootsnap", require: false

group :development, :test do
  gem "dotenv-rails"             # loads .env with the Messenger credentials
end
```

Create the app as an API-only app without a database:

```bash
rails new messenger_bot --api --skip-active-record
```

Then replace the Gemfile with the one above and run `bundle install`.

## .env

```bash
FB_VERIFY_TOKEN=some-long-random-string-you-choose
FB_APP_SECRET=your_app_secret_from_app_dashboard
FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN=your_page_access_token
```

## config/routes.rb

```ruby
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  get  "/webhooks/messenger", to: "messenger_webhooks#verify"
  post "/webhooks/messenger", to: "messenger_webhooks#receive"
end
```

## config/initializers/messenger.rb

```ruby
Rails.application.config.x.messenger = ActiveSupport::OrderedOptions.new.tap do |m|
  m.verify_token      = ENV.fetch("FB_VERIFY_TOKEN")
  m.app_secret        = ENV.fetch("FB_APP_SECRET")
  m.page_access_token = ENV.fetch("FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN")
  m.graph_version     = ENV.fetch("FB_GRAPH_VERSION", "v19.0")
end
```

## app/controllers/messenger_webhooks_controller.rb

```ruby
class MessengerWebhooksController < ActionController::API
  before_action :verify_signature, only: :receive

  # GET /webhooks/messenger
  # Facebook calls this once when you register the webhook.
  def verify
    config = Rails.configuration.x.messenger

    token_ok = ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(
      params["hub.verify_token"].to_s, config.verify_token
    )

    if params["hub.mode"] == "subscribe" && token_ok
      render plain: params["hub.challenge"].to_s, status: :ok
    else
      head :forbidden
    end
  end

  # POST /webhooks/messenger
  # Must return 200 quickly, so the real work is pushed to a background job.
  def receive
    payload = JSON.parse(request.raw_post)
    return head :not_found unless payload["object"] == "page"

    Array(payload["entry"]).each do |entry|
      Array(entry["messaging"]).each do |event|
        HandleMessengerEventJob.perform_later(event)
      end
    end

    render plain: "EVENT_RECEIVED", status: :ok
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    head :bad_request
  end

  private

  # Verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256 header against the raw request body.
  def verify_signature
    header = request.headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].to_s
    expected = "sha256=" + OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
      "SHA256", Rails.configuration.x.messenger.app_secret, request.raw_post
    )

    unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(header, expected)
      Rails.logger.warn("[Messenger] Invalid webhook signature")
      head :forbidden
    end
  end
end
```

## app/jobs/handle_messenger_event_job.rb

```ruby
class HandleMessengerEventJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(event)
    sender_id = event.dig("sender", "id")
    return if sender_id.blank?

    client = MessengerClient.new

    if (message = event["message"])
      return if message["is_echo"]   # ignore copies of our own messages

      client.send_typing(sender_id)
      client.send_text(sender_id, build_reply(message))
    elsif (postback = event["postback"])
      client.send_text(sender_id, "You selected: #{postback['title'] || postback['payload']}")
    end
  end

  private

  def build_reply(message)
    if message["text"].present?
      "You said: #{message['text']}"
    elsif message["attachments"].present?
      "Thanks for the #{message['attachments'].first['type']}!"
    else
      "Sorry, I didn't understand that."
    end
  end
end
```

Make sure `app/jobs/application_job.rb` exists (the generator creates it). In API apps, the default `:async` adapter works for development. For production, use a persistent backend such as Solid Queue or Sidekiq.

## app/services/messenger_client.rb

```ruby
class MessengerClient
  class Error < StandardError; end

  MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 2000

  def initialize(config = Rails.configuration.x.messenger)
    @config = config
  end

  def send_text(recipient_id, text)
    post(
      recipient:      { id: recipient_id },
      messaging_type: "RESPONSE",
      message:        { text: text.to_s[0, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH] }
    )
  end

  def send_typing(recipient_id)
    post(recipient: { id: recipient_id }, sender_action: "typing_on")
  end

  private

  def post(body)
    response = connection.post("me/messages", body)

    unless response.success?
      raise Error, "Send API error #{response.status}: #{response.body}"
    end

    response.body
  end

  def connection
    @connection ||= Faraday.new(
      url: "https://graph.facebook.com/#{@config.graph_version}/",
      headers: { "Authorization" => "Bearer #{@config.page_access_token}" }
    ) do |f|
      f.request :json
      f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson/
      f.options.timeout = 10
```

```ruby
# xml_dsig.rb
require "openssl"
require "xmldsig"

class XmlDsig
  attr_reader :certificate, :private_key

  def initialize(certificate:, private_key:)
    @certificate = certificate
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  # Load an X.509 certificate and private key from files.
  def self.from_files(certificate_path:, private_key_path:)
    certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(certificate_path))
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey.read(File.read(private_key_path))

    new(certificate: certificate, private_key: private_key)
  end

  # Sign an XML string and return a new XML string containing the XMLDSig signature.
  def sign(xml)
    Xmldsig::Signer.new(xml).sign(
      private_key: private_key,
      certificate: certificate
    )
  end

  # Verify the signature in a signed XML string using the configured certificate's public key.
  def verify(signed_xml)
    !!Xmldsig::SignedDocument.new(signed_xml).validate(certificate.public_key)
  rescue StandardError
    false
  end

  # Helper for generating a self-signed certificate for demo/testing purposes.
  def self.generate_self_signed_certificate(private_key, common_name: "XMLDSig Test")
    cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new
    cert.version    = 2
    cert.serial     = 1
    cert.subject    = OpenSSL::X509::Name.parse("/CN=#{common_name}")
    cert.issuer     = cert.subject
    cert.public_key = private_key.public_key
    cert.not_before = Time.now - 3600
    cert.not_after  = Time.now + 3600 * 24 * 365

    ef = OpenSSL::X509::ExtensionFactory.new
    ef.subject_certificate = cert
    ef.issuer_certificate  = cert

    cert.add_extension(ef.create_extension("basicConstraints", "CA:FALSE", true))
    cert.add_extension(ef.create_extension("keyUsage", "digitalSignature, nonRepudiation", true))
    cert.add_extension(ef.create_extension("subjectKeyIdentifier", "hash"))

    cert.sign(private_key, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new)
    cert
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  # Demo: generate a keypair/certificate, sign an XML document, then verify it.
  rsa_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(2048)
  cert = XmlDsig.generate_self_signed_certificate(rsa_key)

  xml = <<~XML
    <PurchaseOrder>
      <Id>12345</Id>
      <Amount currency="USD">99.99</Amount>
    </PurchaseOrder>
  XML

  signer = XmlDsig.new(certificate: cert, private_key: rsa_key)

  signed_xml = signer.sign(xml)
  puts signed_xml
  puts "Signature valid: #{signer.verify(signed_xml)}"
end
```

text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "csv"           # bundled gem (no longer default) as of Ruby 3.4
gem "jaro_winkler"  # fuzzy name matching
```

Everything else (`net/http`, `fileutils`, `time`, `uri`) is in the standard library.

## Implementation

```ruby
# ofac_screener.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "csv"
require "fileutils"
require "jaro_winkler"
require "net/http"
require "time"
require "uri"

# Screens a person against the OFAC SDN (Specially Designated Nationals) list.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#  * A :potential_match result must go to a human compliance reviewer. Never
#    auto-reject or auto-clear based on fuzzy matching alone.
#  * Screening fails CLOSED: if no list can be loaded, an error is raised
#    rather than returning "clear".
#  * This is a technical aid, not legal advice. Check OFAC's guidance and your
#    own compliance program for thresholds and procedures.
module OfacScreener
  SDN_URL = "https://www.treasury.gov/ofac/downloads/sdn.csv"
  ALT_URL = "https://www.treasury.gov/ofac/downloads/alt.csv"

  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ListUnavailableError < Error; end

  Entry = Struct.new(:ent_num, :name, :type, :programs, :remarks, :aliases, :birth_years,
                     keyword_init: true)

  Match = Struct.new(:entry, :matched_name, :score, :dob_match, keyword_init: true) do
    def to_h
      {
        ent_num: entry.ent_num,
        sdn_name: entry.name,
        matched_name: matched_name,
        type: entry.type,
        programs: entry.programs,
        score: score.round(4),
        dob_match: dob_match,
        remarks: entry.remarks
      }
    end
  end

  Result = Struct.new(:status, :matches, :list_fetched_at, :query, keyword_init: true) do
    def clear?;            status == :clear;           end
    def potential_match?;  status == :potential_match; end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Normalizer
  module Normalizer
    module_function

    # "José  O'Brien-Smith" => "jose o brien smith"
    def normalize(str)
      str.to_s
         .unicode_normalize(:nfd)
         .gsub(/\p{Mn}/, "")
         .downcase
         .gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, " ")
         .strip
    end

    def tokens(str)
      normalize(str).split
    end

    # OFAC lists individuals as "LAST, First Middle". Flip to "First Middle Last".
    def flip_sdn_name(name)
      last, first = name.to_s.split(",", 2).map(&:strip)
      first.nil? || first.empty? ? last.to_s : "#{first} #{last}"
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Loader
  class ListLoader
    CACHE_DIR = ENV.fetch("OFAC_CACHE_DIR", File.join(Dir.tmpdir, "ofac_cache"))
    CACHE_TTL = 24 * 60 * 60 # seconds

    attr_reader :fetched_at

    def initialize(cache_dir: CACHE_DIR, ttl: CACHE_TTL, logger: nil)
      @cache_dir = cache_dir
      @ttl = ttl
      @logger = logger
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@cache_dir)
    end

    def load
      sdn_body, sdn_time = fetch_cached("sdn.csv", SDN_URL)
      alt_body, alt_time = fetch_cached("alt.csv", ALT_URL)
      @fetched_at = [sdn_time, alt_time].min
      build_entries(sdn_body, alt_body)
    end

    private

    def fetch_cached(filename, url)
      path = File.join(@cache_dir, filename)
      fresh = File.exist?(path) && (Time.now - File.mtime(path)) < @ttl
      return [File.binread(path), File.mtime(path)] if fresh

      begin
        body = http_get(url)
        tmp = "#{path}.#{Process.pid}.tmp"
        File.binwrite(tmp, body)
        File.rename(tmp, path) # atomic replace
        [body, File.mtime(path)]
      rescue StandardError => e
        if File.exist?(path)
          @logger&.warn("OFAC download failed (#{e.message}); using stale cache for #{filename}")
          [File.binread(path), File.mtime(path)]
        else
          raise ListUnavailableError, "Could not download #{url}: #{e.message}"
        end
      end
    end

    def http_get(url, limit = 5)
      raise Error, "Too many redirects" if limit.zero?

      uri = URI(url)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == "https"
      http.open_timeout = 10
      http.read_timeout = 60
      res = http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri))

      case res
      when Net::HTTPSuccess     then res.body
      when Net::HTTPRedirection then http_get(URI.join(url, res["location"]).to_s, limit - 1)
      else raise Error, "HTTP #{res.code} from #{url}"
      end
    end

    def utf8(body)
      s = body.dup.force_encoding("UTF-8")
      s = body.dup.force_encoding("ISO-8859-1").encode("UTF-8") unless s.valid_encoding?
      s
    end

    def clean(value)
      v = value.to_s.strip
      v == "-0-" ? nil : v
    end

    # sdn.csv columns (no header row):
    #  0 ent_num, 1 SDN_Name, 2 SDN_Type, 3 Program, 4 Title, 5 Call_Sign,
    #  6 Vess_type, 7 Tonnage, 8 GRT, 9 Vess_flag, 10 Vess_owner, 11 Remarks
    # alt.csv columns: 0 ent_num, 1 alt_num, 2 alt_type, 3 alt_name, 4 alt_remarks
    def build_entries(sdn_body, alt_body)
      aliases = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }
      CSV.parse(utf8(alt_body), liberal_parsing: true) do |row|
        next unless row[0].to_s.strip.match?(/\A\d+\z/)

        name = clean(row[3])
        aliases[row[0].strip] << name if name
      end

      entries = []
      CSV.parse(utf8(sdn_body), liberal_parsing: true) do |row|
        next unless row[0].to_s.strip.match?(/\A\d+\z/)

        remarks = clean(row[11])
        entries << Entry.new(
          ent_num: row[0].strip,
          name: clean(row[1]),
          type: clean(row[2])&.downcase, # "individual", "vessel", nil (entity)
          programs: clean(row[3]),
          remarks: remarks,
          aliases: aliases[row[0].strip],
          birth_years: extract_birth_years(remarks)
        )
      end

      raise ListUnavailableError, "SDN list parsed as empty" if entries.empty?

      entries
    end

    # Remarks look like: "DOB 12 Jan 1970; alt. DOB 1971; POB Cuba; ..."
    def extract_birth_years(remarks)
      return [] unless remarks

      remarks.scan(/DOB\s+([^;]+)/i).flatten.flat_map { |s| s.scan(/\b(1[89]\d{2}|20\d{2})\b/) }
             .flatten.map(&:to_i).uniq
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Screener
  class Screener
    DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.88

    def initialize(entries:, fetched_at:, threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, include_entities: false)
      @threshold = threshold
      @fetched_at = fetched_at
      @candidates = build_candidates(entries, include_entities)
    end

    def self.build(threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, include_entities: false, logger: nil)
      loader = ListLoader.new(logger: logger)
      entries = loader.load
      new(entries: entries, fetched_at: loader.fetched_at,
          threshold: threshold, include_entities: include_entities)
    end

    # name:          full name as supplied by the applicant (required)
    # date_of_birth: Date/String (optional, used to help the reviewer)
    def screen(name:, date_of_birth: nil)
      query_tokens = Normalizer.tokens(name)
      raise ArgumentError, "name is blank" if query_tokens.empty?

      birth_year = parse_year(date_of_birth)
      query_sorted = query_tokens.sort.join(" ")

      best = {} # ent_num => Match (best per SDN entry)
      @candidates.each do |cand|
        score = score_names(query_tokens, query_sorted, cand)
        next if score < @threshold

        entry = cand[:entry]
        match = Match.new(entry: entry, matched_name: cand[:display], score: score,
                          dob_match: dob_match(birth_year, entry))
        best[entry.ent_num] = match if best[entry.ent_num].nil? || best[entry.ent_num].score < score
      end

      matches = best.values.sort_by { |m| -m.score }
      Result.new(status: matches.empty? ? :clear : :potential_match,
                 matches: matches, list_fetched_at: @fetched_at,
                 query: { name: name, date_of_birth: date_of_birth&.to_s })
    end

    private

    def build_candidates(entries, include_entities)
      entries.flat_map do |e|
        next [] unless e.type == "individual" || (include_entities && e.type.nil?)

        ([e.name] + e.aliases).compact.uniq.map do |raw|
          full = e.type == "individual" ? Normalizer.flip_sdn_name(raw) : raw
          toks = Normalizer.tokens(full)
          next if toks.empty?

          { entry: e, display: raw, tokens: toks, sorted: toks.sort.join(" ") }
        end.compact
      end
    end

    def score_names(q_tokens, q_sorted, cand)
      # 1. Whole-name similarity, word-order independent
      whole = JaroWinkler.distance(q_sorted, cand[:sorted])

      # 2. Token coverage: handles a missing middle name, e.g. "John Smith"
      #    vs "John Michael Smith". Needs 2+ query tokens to avoid matching
      #    on a single common word.
      coverage = 0.0
      if q_tokens.size >= 2
        per_token = q_tokens.map { |qt| cand[:tokens].map { |ct| JaroWinkler.distance(qt, ct) }.max }
        coverage = per_token.min >= 0.9 ? (per_token.sum / per_token.size) * 0.97 : 0.0
      end

      [whole, coverage].max
    end

    # true/false when both sides have data, nil when it can't be determined
    def dob_match(birth_year, entry)
      return nil if birth_year.nil? || entry.birth_years.empty?

      entry.birth_years.include?(birth_year)
    end

    def parse_year(dob)
      return nil if dob.nil?
      return dob.year if dob.respond_to?(:year)

      dob.to_s[/\b(1[89]\d{2}|20\d{2})\b/, 1]&.to_i
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Example
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require "logger"
  require "json"

  name = ARGV[0] or abort("Usage: ruby ofac_screener.rb \"Full Name\" [YYYY-MM-DD]")
  dob  = ARGV[1]

  begin
    screener = OfacScreener::Screener.build(logger: Logger.new($stderr))
    result = screener.screen(name: name, date_of_birth: dob)

    puts "List fetched at: #{result.list_fetched_at.iso8601}"
    if result.clear?
      puts "No potential OFAC matches for #{name.inspect}."
    else
      puts "POTENTIAL MATCH - hold onboarding and send to compliance review:"
      puts JSON.pretty_generate(result.matches.first(10).map(&:to_h))
      exit 2
    end
  rescue OfacScreener::ListUnavailableError => e
    warn "Screening unavailable, do NOT onboard automatically: #{e.message}"
    exit 3
  end
end
```

## Usage

```ruby
screener = OfacScreener::Screener.build            # downloads + caches the SDN list for 24h
result   = screener.screen(name: "Jane Q. Doe", date_of_birth: "1980-04-12")

if result.clear?
  # continue onboarding, and store the result and list_fetched_at as an audit record
else
  # pause onboarding and queue for manual review
  result.matches.each { |m| puts m.to_h }
end
```

Command line: `bundle exec ruby ofac_screener.rb "Jane Doe" 1980-04-12`

## Notes

- **Data source**: it uses Treasury's published `sdn.csv` and `alt.csv` (primary names plus aliases). If the URLs change, check the OFAC Sanctions List Service pages and update the two constants. The non-SDN Consolidated list is not covered.
- **Matching**: names are normalized (accents, punctuation, case). "LAST, First" is flipped, word order is ignored, and Jaro-Winkler scoring is used. A token-coverage rule catches cases like a missing middle name. Lower `threshold` for more recall and more false positives.
- **DOB**: it only annotates each match with `dob_match` (`true`, `false` or `nil`) to help the reviewer. It never auto-clears a name hit.
- **Fail closed**: if the list cannot be downloaded and no cache exists, it raises `ListUnavailableError`. If a download fails but a stale cache exists, it uses the cache and logs a warning. `list_fetched_at` is returned so you can record it.
- **Audit trail**: persist the query, result, list timestamp and reviewer decision for each screening, as regulators expect.

Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(([secret_key] + values).join("|")) end # Перевірка підпису відповіді/callback-а (порівняння за сталий час) def valid?(params, secret_key) given = (params["signature"] || params[:signature]).to_s return false if given.empty? expected = build(params, secret_key) given = given.downcase return false unless given.bytesize == expected.bytesize OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(expected, given) end def stringify(value) case value when nil then "" when Hash, Array then value.to_json else value.to_s end end private_class_method :stringify end end ``` ## lib/fondy/client.rb ```ruby # Перевірка підпису callback-а / відповіді на response_url def valid_signature?(params) Signature.valid?(params, @secret_key) end # Повна перевірка callback-а: підпис + merchant_id. # Повертає Hash параметрів, інакше кидає виняток. def verify_callback!(params) params = params["response"] if params["response"].is_a?(Hash) raise InvalidSignature, "Невірний підпис" unless valid_signature?(params) raise InvalidSignature, "Невірний merchant_id" unless params["merchant_id"].to_s == @merchant_id params end # Чи успішно проведено платіж def approved?(params) params["response_status"] == "success" && params["order_status"] == "approved" end private def parse_checkout_response(resp) raise Error, "HTTP #{resp.status}: #{resp.body}" unless resp.status == 200 data = JSON.parse(resp.body).fetch("response") if data["response_status"] != "success" raise Error, "Fondy: #{data['error_message']} (код #{data['error_code']})" end raise InvalidSignature, "Невірний підпис відповіді Fondy" unless valid_signature?(data) { checkout_url: data["checkout_url"], payment_id: data["payment_id"] } rescue JSON::ParserError, KeyError => e raise Error, "Некоректна відповідь Fondy: #{e.message}" rescue Faraday::Error => e raise Error, "Помилка мережі: #{e.message}" end end end ``` ## app.rb ```ruby # text:
# Створення повернення замовлення Нової Пошти через API (Ruby)

## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"   # HTTP-клієнт (JSON-запити/відповіді вбудовані у Faraday 2)
gem "dotenv",  "~> 3.1"   # завантаження NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY з файлу .env
```

Файл `.env` (поруч зі скриптом):

```
NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY=ваш_ключ_з_кабінету_Нової_Пошти
```

## Реалізація: `np_return.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "dotenv/load"
require "faraday"
require "json"

module NovaPoshta
  # Базова помилка бібліотеки
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :errors, :error_codes

    def initialize(message, errors: [], error_codes: [])
      super(message)
      @errors = errors
      @error_codes = error_codes
    end
  end

  # Низькорівневий клієнт API 2.0 (єдина точка входу, усі запити — POST JSON)
  class Client
    API_URL = "https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/"

    def initialize(api_key:, timeout: 15)
      raise ArgumentError, "Не вказано API-ключ" if api_key.to_s.strip.empty?

      @api_key = api_key
      @connection = Faraday.new(url: API_URL) do |f|
        f.request :json
        f.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        f.options.timeout = timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = timeout
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    # Повертає масив data з відповіді або кидає NovaPoshta::Error
    def call(model_name, called_method, method_properties = {})
      payload = {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: model_name,
        calledMethod: called_method,
        methodProperties: method_properties
      }

      response = @connection.post("", payload)

      unless response.success?
        raise Error, "HTTP #{response.status} від API Нової Пошти"
      end

      body = response.body
      raise Error, "Неочікувана відповідь API: #{body.inspect}" unless body.is_a?(Hash)

      unless body["success"]
        errors = Array(body["errors"]).reject { |e| e.to_s.empty? }
        codes  = Array(body["errorCodes"])
        raise Error.new(
          "Помилка API: #{errors.join('; ')}".strip,
          errors: errors,
          error_codes: codes
        )
      end

      body["data"] || []
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      raise Error, "Помилка мережі: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # Сервіс для роботи з поверненнями (модель AdditionalService)
  class ReturnService
    PAYMENT_METHODS = %w[Cash NonCash].freeze

    def initialize(client)
      @client = client
    end

    # Перевіряє, чи можна створити повернення для ЕН
    def check_possibility(document_number)
      @client.call(
        "AdditionalService",
        "CheckPossibilityCreateReturn",
        { "Number" => document_number.to_s }
      )
    end

    # Довідник причин повернення
    def reasons
      @client.call("AdditionalService", "getReturnReasons", {})
    end

    # Підтипи (деталізація) конкретної причини
    def reason_subtypes(reason_ref)
      @client.call(
        "AdditionalService",
        "getReturnReasonsSubtypes",
        { "ReasonRef" => reason_ref }
      )
    end

    # Створює заявку на повернення.
    #
    # document_number    - номер експрес-накладної (IntDocNumber)
    # reason_ref         - Ref причини повернення
    # subtype_reason_ref - Ref підтипу причини
    # payment_method     - "Cash" або "NonCash" (оплата зворотної доставки)
    # note               - коментар (необов'язково)
    # return_address_ref - Ref адреси/відділення повернення (необов'язково;
    #                      якщо не вказано — повернення відправнику за замовчуванням)
    def create(document_number:, reason_ref:, subtype_reason_ref:,
               payment_method: "Cash", note: nil, return_address_ref: nil)
      unless PAYMENT_METHODS.include?(payment_method)
        raise ArgumentError,
              "payment_method має бути одним із: #{PAYMENT_METHODS.join(', ')}"
      end

      props = {
        "IntDocNumber"  => document_number.to_s,
        "PaymentMethod" => payment_method,
        "Reason"        => reason_ref,
        "SubtypeReason" => subtype_reason_ref,
        "OrderType"     => "orderCargoReturn"
      }
      props["Note"]             = note if note && !note.empty?
      props["ReturnAddressRef"] = return_address_ref if return_address_ref

      result = @client.call("AdditionalService", "save", props)
      result.first # => { "Number" => "...", "Ref" => "..." }
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Приклад використання з командного рядка:
#   bundle exec ruby np_return.rb 20400048799000
#
# Необов'язкові змінні оточення:
#   NP_REASON_REF, NP_SUBTYPE_REF, NP_PAYMENT_METHOD (Cash/NonCash),
#   NP_NOTE, NP_RETURN_ADDRESS_REF
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  document_number = ARGV[0]
  if document_number.to_s.empty?
    warn "Використання: ruby #{__FILE__} <номер_ЕН>"
    exit 1
  end

  begin
    client  = NovaPoshta::Client.new(api_key: ENV["NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY"])
    service = NovaPoshta::ReturnService.new(client)

    # 1. Перевіряємо можливість повернення
    puts "Перевірка можливості повернення для ЕН #{document_number}..."
    possibility = service.check_possibility(document_number)
    puts "Повернення можливе. Дані: #{possibility.inspect}"

    # 2. Визначаємо причину та підтип (з ENV або беремо першу доступну)
    reason_ref = ENV["NP_REASON_REF"]
    if reason_ref.to_s.empty?
      reason = service.reasons.first or raise NovaPoshta::Error, "Порожній довідник причин"
      reason_ref = reason["Ref"]
      puts "Причина: #{reason['Description']}"
    end

    subtype_ref = ENV["NP_SUBTYPE_REF"]
    if subtype_ref.to_s.empty?
      subtype = service.reason_subtypes(reason_ref).first or
        raise NovaPoshta::Error, "Для причини немає підтипів"
      subtype_ref = subtype["Ref"]
      puts "Підтип: #{subtype['Description']}"
    end

    # 3. Створюємо заявку на повернення
    result = service.create(
      document_number:    document_number,
      reason_ref:         reason_ref,
      subtype_reason_ref: subtype_ref,
      payment_method:     ENV.fetch("NP_PAYMENT_METHOD", "Cash"),
      note:               ENV["NP_NOTE"],
      return_address_ref: ENV["NP_RETURN_ADDRESS_REF"]
    )

    puts "Заявку на повернення створено!"
    puts "Номер заявки: #{result['Number']}"
    puts "Ref: #{result['Ref']}"
  rescue NovaPoshta::Error => e
    warn "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    warn "Коди помилок: #{e.error_codes.join(', ')}" unless e.error_codes.empty?
    exit 1
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    warn "Невірні параметри: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Як це працює

1. **`CheckPossibilityCreateReturn`** перевіряє, чи можна створити повернення для накладної. Якщо ні, API поверне помилку, і скрипт зупиниться.
2. **`getReturnReasons`** і **`getReturnReasonsSubtypes`** отримують довідники причин і підтипів. Їхні `Ref` потрібні для створення заявки.
3. **`AdditionalService.save`** з `OrderType: "orderCargoReturn"` створює заявку на повернення. У відповіді приходять `Number` і `Ref` заявки.

## Запуск

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec ruby np_return.rb 20400048799000
```

**Примітки:**
- Повернення доступне лише для посилок у відповідних статусах (наприклад, коли посилка прибула у відділення і ще не отримана), тому перший крок може повернути помилку.
- Для повернення на іншу адресу передайте `NP_RETURN_ADDRESS_REF`. Точні вимоги до цього поля залежать від типу повернення, тому звіряйтеся з актуальною документацією: https://developers.novaposhta.ua

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for validating EU VAT numbers through the VIES service:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 2.7.0'

gem 'savon', '~> 2.14'      # SOAP client for VIES service
gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0' # HTTP client for REST API fallback
gem 'dry-validation', '~> 1.10' # Input validation
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8'      # Environment variables management
gem 'redis', '~> 5.0'       # Caching validation results
gem 'logger', '~> 1.5'      # Logging

group :development, :test do
  gem 'rspec', '~> 3.12'
  gem 'webmock', '~> 3.19'
  gem 'vcr', '~> 6.1'
  gem 'pry', '~> 0.14'
end
```

## Implementation

### `lib/vat_validator.rb`

```ruby
require 'savon'
require 'httparty'
require 'dry-validation'
require 'redis'
require 'logger'
require 'json'

class VatValidator
  class ValidationError < StandardError; end
  class ServiceUnavailableError < StandardError; end
  
  class VatNumberSchema < Dry::Validation::Contract
    params do
      required(:country_code).filled(:string, max_size?: 2)
      required(:vat_number).filled(:string, max_size?: 15)
    end
    
    rule(:country_code) do
      key.failure('must be a valid EU country code') unless valid_eu_country_code?(value)
    end
    
    rule(:vat_number) do
      key.failure('must contain only alphanumeric characters') unless value.match?(/\A[A-Z0-9]+\z/i)
    end
    
    private
    
    def valid_eu_country_code?(code)
      %w[
        AT BE BG CY CZ DE DK EE EL ES FI FR HR HU IE IT LT LU LV MT NL PL PT RO SE SI SK XI
      ].include?(code.upcase)
    end
  end

  attr_reader :logger, :cache

  def initialize(cache_url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379/0'),
                 logger: Logger.new(STDOUT),
                 enable_cache: true)
    @logger = logger
    @enable_cache = enable_cache
    @cache = enable_cache ? Redis.new(url: cache_url) : nil
    @schema = VatNumberSchema.new
    @soap_client = create_soap_client
  end

  def validate_vat_number(country_code:, vat_number:)
    # Normalize inputs
    country_code = country_code.to_s.upcase.strip
    vat_number = vat_number.to_s.upcase.strip
    
    # Remove country code prefix if present
    vat_number = vat_number.sub(/\A#{country_code}/, '')
    
    # Validate input
    validation_result = @schema.call(country_code: country_code, vat_number: vat_number)
    raise ValidationError, validation_result.errors.to_h.inspect unless validation_result.success?
    
    # Check cache first
    cache_key = "vat_validation:#{country_code}:#{vat_number}"
    if @enable_cache && (cached_result = @cache.get(cache_key))
      logger.info("Cache hit for #{country_code}#{vat_number}")
      return JSON.parse(cached_result, symbolize_names: true)
    end
    
    # Perform validation
    result = perform_validation(country_code, vat_number)
    
    # Cache the result
    if @enable_cache && result[:valid]
      # Cache valid results for 1 hour, invalid for 15 minutes
      ttl = result[:valid] ? 3600 : 900
      @cache.setex(cache_key, ttl, result.to_json)
    end
    
    result
  rescue ValidationError => e
    logger.error("Validation error: #{e.message}")
    { valid: false, error: e.message }
  rescue ServiceUnavailableError => e
    logger.error("Service unavailable: #{e.message}")
    { valid: false, error: "VIES service is currently unavailable" }
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")
    { valid: false, error: "An unexpected error occurred" }
  end

  def validate_for_reverse_charge(country_code:, vat_number:)
    result = validate_vat_number(country_code: country_code, vat_number: vat_number)
    
    if result[:valid]
      {
        valid: true,
        can_issue_reverse_charge_invoice: true,
        business_name: result[:name],
        business_address: result[:address],
        validated_at: result[:request_date]
      }
    else
      {
        valid: false,
        can_issue_reverse_charge_invoice: false,
        error: result[:error] || "VAT number is not valid"
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def create_soap_client
    Savon.client(
      wsdl: 'https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl',
      log: false,
      log_level: :debug,
      open_timeout: 10,
      read_timeout: 30,
      convert_request_keys_to: :camelcase,
      env_namespace: :soap,
      namespace_identifier: :urn
    )
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.warn("Failed to create SOAP client: #{e.message}")
    nil
  end

  def perform_validation(country_code, vat_number)
    # Try SOAP first
    begin
      return validate_via_soap(country_code, vat_number) if @soap_client
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.warn("SOAP validation failed: #{e.message}")
    end
    
    # Fallback to REST API
    validate_via_rest(country_code, vat_number)
  end

  def validate_via_soap(country_code, vat_number)
    response = @soap_client.call(
      :check_vat,
      message: {
        country_code: country_code,
        vat_number: vat_number
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      data = response.body.dig(:check_vat_response, :check_vat_result) ||
             response.body.dig(:check_vat_response)
      
      {
        valid: data[:valid] == true,
        name: data[:name],
        address: data[:address],
        country_code: country_code,
        vat_number: vat_number,
        request_date: data[:request_date] || Time.now.iso8601
      }
    else
      raise ServiceUnavailableError, "SOAP request failed"
    end
  rescue Savon::SOAPFault => e
    logger.error("SOAP fault: #{e.message}")
    { valid: false, error: "Invalid VAT number or service error" }
  rescue Savon::HTTPError => e
    raise ServiceUnavailableError, "HTTP error: #{e.message}"
  end

  def validate_via_rest(country_code, vat_number)
    # REST API fallback (using a hypothetical REST endpoint)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      'https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/check-vat-number',
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      body: {
        countryCode: country_code,
        vatNumber: vat_number
      }.to_json,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      {
        valid: data[:valid],
        name: data[:name],
        address: data[:address],
        country_code: country_code,
        vat_number: vat_number,
        request_date: Time.now.iso8601
      }
    else
      raise ServiceUnavailableError, "REST API returned #{response.code}"
    end
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    raise ServiceUnavailableError, "REST API error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

### `lib/invoice_validator.rb`

```ruby
require_relative 'vat_validator'

class InvoiceValidator
  attr_reader :vat_validator

  def initialize(vat_validator: VatValidator.new)
    @vat_validator = vat_validator
  end

  def validate_reverse_charge_invoice(customer_country_code:, customer_vat_number:)
    result = @vat_validator.validate_for_reverse_charge(
      country_code: customer_country_code,
      vat_number: customer_vat_number
    )
    
    if result[:can_issue_reverse_charge_invoice]
      {
        status: :approved,
        message: "Reverse charge invoice can be issued",
        details: result
      }
    else
      {
        status: :rejected,
        message: "Cannot issue reverse charge invoice: #{result[:error]}",
        details: result
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### `main.rb`

```ruby
require_relative 'lib/vat_validator'
require_relative 'lib/invoice_validator'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Example usage
def main
  # Initialize validators
  vat_validator = VatValidator.new(
    cache_url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379/0'),
    logger: Logger.new(STDOUT)
  )
  
  invoice_validator = InvoiceValidator.new(vat_validator: vat_validator)
  
  # Example: Validate a German VAT number
  puts "Validating VAT number for reverse charge invoice..."
  result = invoice_validator.validate_reverse_charge_invoice(
    customer_country_code: 'DE',
    customer_vat_number: '123456789'
  )
  
  puts "\nResult:"
  puts "Status: #{result[:status]}"
  puts "Message: #{result[:message]}"
  puts "Details: #{result[:details]}"
  
  # Example with invalid VAT number
  puts "\n" + "="*50 + "\n"
  puts "Testing with invalid VAT number..."
  invalid_result = invoice_validator.validate_reverse_charge_invoice(
    customer_country_code: 'DE',
    customer_vat_number: 'INVALID123'
  )
  
  puts "\nResult:"
  puts "Status: #{invalid_result[:status]}"
  puts "Message: #{invalid_result[:message]}"
  puts "Details: #{invalid_result[:details]}"
end

main if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
```

```ruby
# Simple validation

if invoice_check[:can_issue_reverse_charge_invoice]
  puts "You can issue a reverse charge invoice"
  puts "Customer: #{invoice_check[:business_name]}"
else
  puts "Cannot issue reverse charge invoice: #{invoice_check[:error]}"
end
```

## Key Features

1. **SOAP Client**: Uses the official VIES SOAP API
2. **REST Fallback**: Falls back to REST API if SOAP fails
3. **Input Validation**: Validates country codes and VAT number format
4. **Caching**: Redis caching to reduce API calls and improve performance
5. **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling for various failure scenarios
6. **Logging**: Detailed logging for debugging and monitoring
7. **Reverse Charge Specific**: Specialized method for reverse charge invoice validation

## Notes

- The VIES service has rate limits, so caching is important
- VAT numbers for reverse charge must be validated at the time of transaction
- Keep records of validation results for audit purposes
- The service can be unavailable, so implement retry logic in production
- Consider storing validation results in your database for compliance

## Реалізація (`nbu_qr.rb`)

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
require "bundler/setup"
require "base64"
require "rqrcode"

# Генератор платіжного QR-коду за форматом НБУ (службова мітка BCD, версія 002, UCT).
#
# Структура даних (рядки розділені LF):
#   1  BCD                       – службова мітка
#   2  002                       – версія
#   3  1                         – кодування (UTF-8)
#   4  UCT                       – ідентифікатор (Ukrainian Credit Transfer)
#   5  (порожньо)                – BIC
#   6  Отримувач                 – до 70 символів
#   7  IBAN                      – UA + 27 символів
#   8  UAH<сума>                 – необов'язково, напр. UAH125.50
#   9  Код отримувача            – ЄДРПОУ (8) або РНОКПП (10 цифр)
#  10  (порожньо)                – код цілі
#  11  (порожньо)                – структурований референс
#  12  Призначення платежу       – до 140 символів
#  13  Відображуваний текст      – необов'язково
#
# Для сканування банківськими застосунками дані кодуються у base64url (без "=")
# і додаються до посилання https://bank.gov.ua/qr/
module NbuQr
  class ValidationError < StandardError; end

  class Payment
    URL_PREFIX     = "https://bank.gov.ua/qr/"
    SERVICE_TAG    = "BCD"
    VERSION        = "002"
    ENCODING       = "1" # UTF-8
    IDENTIFICATION = "UCT"
    CURRENCY       = "UAH"

    MAX_NAME    = 70
    MAX_PURPOSE = 140
    MAX_DISPLAY = 70
    MAX_BYTES   = 331 # обмеження на розмір корисних даних

    attr_reader :name, :iban, :amount, :code, :purpose, :display_text

    # @param name         [String]  назва отримувача
    # @param iban         [String]  IBAN отримувача (UA...)
    # @param code         [String]  ЄДРПОУ / РНОКПП отримувача
    # @param purpose      [String]  призначення платежу
    # @param amount       [Numeric, String, nil] сума в гривнях
    # @param display_text [String, nil] додатковий текст для відображення
    def initialize(name:, iban:, code:, purpose:, amount: nil, display_text: nil)
      @name         = name.to_s.strip
      @iban         = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, "").upcase
      @code         = code.to_s.strip
      @purpose      = purpose.to_s.strip
      @amount       = amount.nil? || amount.to_s.strip.empty? ? nil : parse_amount(amount)
      @display_text = display_text.to_s.strip
      validate!
    end

    # Сирі дані у форматі НБУ
    def raw_data
      [
        SERVICE_TAG,
        VERSION,
        ENCODING,
        IDENTIFICATION,
        "",                                   # BIC
        name,
        iban,
        amount ? format("%s%.2f", CURRENCY, amount) : "",
        code,
        "",                                   # код цілі
        "",                                   # референс
        purpose,
        display_text
      ].join("\n")
    end

    # Посилання, яке записується в QR-код
    def url
      URL_PREFIX + Base64.urlsafe_encode64(raw_data, padding: false)
    end

    def qr_code(content: :url, level: :m)
      text = content == :raw ? raw_data : url
      RQRCode::QRCode.new(text, level: level)
    end

    def to_png(path, size: 480, content: :url)
      png = qr_code(content: content).as_png(
        size: size, border_modules: 4,
        color: "black", fill: "white"
      )
      File.binwrite(path, png.to_s)
      path
    end

    def to_svg(path, module_size: 6, content: :url)
      svg = qr_code(content: content).as_svg(
        module_size: module_size, standalone: true,
        use_path: true, color: "000", offset: 24
      )
      File.write(path, svg)
      path
    end

    # Контроль IBAN за алгоритмом mod-97
    def self.valid_iban?(iban)
      return false unless iban.match?(/\AUA\d{27}\z/)

      rearranged = iban[4..] + iban[0, 4]
      numeric = rearranged.chars.map { |c| c =~ /\d/ ? c : (c.ord - 55).to_s }.join
      numeric.to_i % 97 == 1
    end

    private

    def parse_amount(value)
      r = Rational(value.to_s.tr(",", "."))
      r.round(2)
    rescue ArgumentError, ZeroDivisionError
      raise ValidationError, "Некоректна сума: #{value.inspect}"
    end

    def validate!
      errors = []
      errors << "Не вказано назву отримувача" if name.empty?
      errors << "Назва отримувача довша за #{MAX_NAME} символів" if name.length > MAX_NAME
      errors << "Некоректний IBAN (формат або контрольна сума)" unless self.class.valid_iban?(iban)
      errors << "Код отримувача має містити 8 (ЄДРПОУ) або 10 (РНОКПП) цифр" unless code.match?(/\A(\d{8}|\d{10})\z/)
      errors << "Не вказано призначення платежу" if purpose.empty?
      errors << "Призначення платежу довше за #{MAX_PURPOSE} символів" if purpose.length > MAX_PURPOSE
      errors << "Відображуваний текст довший за #{MAX_DISPLAY} символів" if display_text.length > MAX_DISPLAY
      if amount && (amount < Rational(1, 100) || amount > 999_999_999.99r)
        errors << "Сума поза допустимим діапазоном (0.01 – 999999999.99)"
      end
      [name, purpose, display_text].each do |field|
        errors << "Поля не можуть містити переноси рядків" if field.include?("\n") || field.include?("\r")
      end
      errors << "Перевищено максимальний розмір даних (#{MAX_BYTES} байт)" if errors.empty? && raw_data.bytesize > MAX_BYTES

      raise ValidationError, errors.uniq.join("; ") unless errors.empty?
    end
  end
end

# ---------- Приклад використання ----------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  begin
    payment = NbuQr::Payment.new(
      name:    'ТОВ "Ромашка"',
      iban:    "UA213223130000026007233566001", # тестовий IBAN із коректною контрольною сумою
      code:    "12345678",
      purpose: "Оплата за рахунком №123 від 01.01.2025",
      amount:  "125.50"
    )

    puts "Дані:\n#{payment.raw_data}\n\n"
    puts "Посилання: #{payment.url}"

    puts "Збережено: #{payment.to_png('payment_qr.png')}"
    puts "Збережено: #{payment.to_svg('payment_qr.svg')}"
  rescue NbuQr::ValidationError => e
    warn "Помилка валідації: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Запуск

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec ruby nbu_qr.rb
```

## Примітки

- Формат реалізовано за специфікацією НБУ для платіжних QR-кодів, яка ґрунтується на EPC QR (`BCD` / `002` / `UCT`). Перед промисловим використанням звірте порядок полів і ліміти з чинною редакцією документа на bank.gov.ua, оскільки НБУ може змінювати вимоги.
- Параметр `content: :raw` у `to_png` і `to_svg` дає QR із «сирими» даними без посилання, а за замовчуванням використовується посилання `https://bank.gov.ua/qr/...`.
- Рівень корекції помилок `M` типовий для платіжних QR-кодів.
- Якщо суму не вказано, поле лишається порожнім, і платник вводить її сам у банківському застосунку.
- IBAN у прикладі взято лише для демонстрації: у реальних платежах підставляйте справжні реквізити.

Ось приклад коду на Ruby для підписання XML-документа за XMLDSig з використанням сертифіката X.509 та перевірки підпису.

## Gemfile
