## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"        # HTTP-клієнт
gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2"  # автоматичні повтори при 429/5xx
```

Решта (`json`, `optparse`, `uri`) входить до стандартної бібліотеки Ruby.

## Реалізація (`opencorporates.rb`)

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "faraday"
require "faraday/retry"
require "json"

module OpenCorporates
  class Error               < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < Error; end
  class RateLimitError      < Error; end
  class NotFoundError       < Error; end
  class ValidationError     < Error; end

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://api.opencorporates.com/v0.4"
    JURISDICTION_FORMAT = /\A[a-z]{2}(_[a-z0-9]{1,3})?\z/ # напр. "gb", "us_ca"

    def initialize(api_token: ENV["OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN"], timeout: 10)
      @api_token = api_token
      @connection = Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
        f.request :retry,
                  max: 3,
                  interval: 1,
                  backoff_factor: 2,
                  retry_statuses: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                  methods: %i[get]
        f.options.timeout = timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = timeout
        f.headers["Accept"] = "application/json"
        f.headers["User-Agent"] = "ruby-opencorporates-client/1.0"
      end
    end

    # Пошук компаній за назвою та юрисдикцією.
    # Повертає масив хешів з даними компаній.
    def search_companies(name:, jurisdiction_code:, page: 1, per_page: 30)
      validate!(name, jurisdiction_code)

      body = get(
        "companies/search",
        q: name.strip,
        jurisdiction_code: jurisdiction_code.downcase,
        page: page,
        per_page: per_page
      )

      Array(body.dig("results", "companies")).map { |item| item["company"] }
    end

    # Детальні дані компанії за юрисдикцією та реєстраційним номером.
    def company(jurisdiction_code:, company_number:)
      body = get("companies/#{jurisdiction_code.downcase}/#{company_number}")
      body.dig("results", "company") or raise NotFoundError, "Компанію не знайдено"
    end

    # Зручний метод: шукає компанію за назвою, вибирає найкращий збіг
    # (точний за назвою, інакше перший результат) і повертає повні дані.
    def find_company(name:, jurisdiction_code:)
      candidates = search_companies(name: name, jurisdiction_code: jurisdiction_code)
      raise NotFoundError, "Нічого не знайдено для '#{name}' (#{jurisdiction_code})" if candidates.empty?

      best = candidates.find { |c| normalize(c["name"]) == normalize(name) } || candidates.first

      company(jurisdiction_code: best["jurisdiction_code"], company_number: best["company_number"])
    end

    private

    def get(path, params = {})
      params = params.merge(api_token: @api_token) if @api_token && !@api_token.empty?
      response = @connection.get(path, params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise Error, "Помилка з'єднання з OpenCorporates: #{e.message}"
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      when 401, 403
        raise AuthenticationError,
              "Доступ заборонено (#{response.status}). Перевірте API-токен або ліміти."
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "Ресурс не знайдено (404)"
      when 429
        raise RateLimitError, "Перевищено ліміт запитів (429)"
      else
        raise Error, "Неочікувана відповідь API: HTTP #{response.status}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error, "Некоректна JSON-відповідь: #{e.message}"
    end

    def validate!(name, jurisdiction_code)
      raise ValidationError, "Назва компанії не може бути порожньою" if name.to_s.strip.empty?

      return if jurisdiction_code.to_s.downcase.match?(JURISDICTION_FORMAT)

      raise ValidationError,
            "Некоректний код юрисдикції: #{jurisdiction_code.inspect} (приклади: gb, de, us_ca)"
    end

    def normalize(str)
      str.to_s.downcase.gsub(/[[:punct:]]/, "").squeeze(" ").strip
    end
  end
end

# ---------- Запуск із командного рядка ----------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require "optparse"

  options = { all: false }
  parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
    o.banner = "Використання: ruby #{$PROGRAM_NAME} -n НАЗВА -j ЮРИСДИКЦІЯ [--all]"
    o.on("-n", "--name NAME", "Назва компанії")        { |v| options[:name] = v }
    o.on("-j", "--jurisdiction CODE", "Код юрисдикції") { |v| options[:jurisdiction] = v }
    o.on("--all", "Показати всі результати пошуку")     { options[:all] = true }
  end
  parser.parse!

  unless options[:name] && options[:jurisdiction]
    puts parser
    exit 1
  end

  begin
    client = OpenCorporates::Client.new

    if options[:all]
      results = client.search_companies(name: options[:name], jurisdiction_code: options[:jurisdiction])
      puts JSON.pretty_generate(results)
    else
      data = client.find_company(name: options[:name], jurisdiction_code: options[:jurisdiction])
      puts JSON.pretty_generate(
        "name"                => data["name"],
        "company_number"      => data["company_number"],
        "jurisdiction_code"   => data["jurisdiction_code"],
        "incorporation_date"  => data["incorporation_date"],
        "company_type"        => data["company_type"],
        "current_status"      => data["current_status"],
        "registered_address"  => data["registered_address_in_full"],
        "opencorporates_url"  => data["opencorporates_url"]
      )
    end
  rescue OpenCorporates::Error => e
    warn "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Використання

```bash
bundle install
export OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN="ваш_токен"

ruby opencorporates.rb -n "Tesco PLC" -j gb
ruby opencorporates.rb -n "Tesla" -j us_de --all
```

Або з коду:

```ruby
client = OpenCorporates::Client.new(api_token: "ваш_токен")
company = client.find_company(name: "Tesco PLC", jurisdiction_code: "gb")
puts company["company_number"], company["current_status"]
```

## Примітки

- **API-токен**: OpenCorporates вимагає `api_token` для більшості запитів. Токен передається через змінну середовища `OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN`. Без нього API часто повертає 401 або 403.
- **Коди юрисдикцій** мають формат ISO: `gb`, `de`, `us_ca`, `us_de` тощо.
- **Ліміти**: при відповідях 429 і 5xx запит автоматично повторюється до 3 разів з експоненційною затримкою, після чого викидається `RateLimitError` або `Error`.
- `find_company` робить два запити: пошук і запит за деталями. Це потрібно, бо результати пошуку містять скорочений набір полів.

## Реалізація

```ruby
# invoice_generator.rb
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'
require 'mail'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class InvoiceGenerator
  VAT_RATE = 0.20 # 20% ПДВ

  attr_reader :invoice_data

  def initialize(invoice_data)
    @invoice_data = invoice_data
  end

  def generate_pdf
    Prawn::Document.new do |pdf|
      add_header(pdf)
      add_invoice_details(pdf)
      add_items_table(pdf)
      add_totals(pdf)
      add_footer(pdf)
    end
  end

  def save_pdf(filename = nil)
    filename ||= "invoice_#{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}.pdf"
    pdf = generate_pdf
    pdf.render_file(filename)
    filename
  end

  def send_email(pdf_path, recipient_email, subject = nil)
    subject ||= "Рахунок #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]} від #{invoice_data[:date]}"

    Mail.deliver do
      from     ENV['SMTP_FROM'] || 'billing@example.com'
      to       recipient_email
      subject  subject

      text_part do
        body "Шановний клієнт,\n\nУ вкладенні ви знайдете рахунок #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}.\n\nЗ повагою,\nВідділ білінгу"
      end

      add_file pdf_path
    end
  end

  private

  def add_header(pdf)
    pdf.text "РАХУНОК-ФАКТУРА", size: 24, style: :bold, align: :center
    pdf.move_down 20
    pdf.text invoice_data[:company_name], size: 16, style: :bold
    pdf.text invoice_data[:company_address]
    pdf.text "Тел: #{invoice_data[:company_phone]}" if invoice_data[:company_phone]
    pdf.text "Email: #{invoice_data[:company_email]}" if invoice_data[:company_email]
    pdf.move_down 20
  end

  def add_invoice_details(pdf)
    data = [
      ["Номер рахунку:", invoice_data[:invoice_number]],
      ["Дата:", invoice_data[:date]],
      ["Клієнт:", invoice_data[:client_name]],
      ["Адреса клієнта:", invoice_data[:client_address]],
      ["ІПН/ЄДРПОУ:", invoice_data[:client_tax_id]]
    ]

    pdf.table(data, cell_style: { borders: [], padding: [2, 5] }) do
      columns(0).font_style = :bold
      columns(0).width = 150
      columns(1).width = 350
    end
    pdf.move_down 20
  end

  def add_items_table(pdf)
    items = invoice_data[:items]

    table_data = [
      ["№", "Опис", "Кількість", "Ціна, грн", "Сума, грн"]
    ]

    items.each_with_index do |item, index|
      table_data << [
        index + 1,
        item[:description],
        item[:quantity],
        format('%.2f', item[:unit_price]),
        format('%.2f', item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price])
      ]
    end

    pdf.table(table_data, header: true, width: pdf.bounds.width) do
      row(0).font_style = :bold
      row(0).background_color = "DDDDDD"
      cells.padding = [5, 10]
      cells.borders = [:bottom]
      row(0).borders = [:bottom, :top]
      row(-1).borders = [:bottom, :top]
      columns(2..4).align = :right
    end
    pdf.move_down 20
  end

  def add_totals(pdf)
    subtotal = calculate_subtotal
    vat = calculate_vat(subtotal)
    total = subtotal + vat

    pdf.bounding_box([pdf.bounds.right - 300, pdf.cursor], width: 300) do
      pdf.table([
        ["Проміжний підсумок:", format('%.2f грн', subtotal)],
        ["ПДВ (#{(VAT_RATE * 100).to_i}%):", format('%.2f грн', vat)],
        ["Всього до сплати:", format('%.2f грн', total)]
      ], cell_style: { borders: [], padding: [5, 10] }) do
        columns(0).font_style = :bold
        columns(1).align = :right
        row(2).font_style = :bold
        row(2).size = 14
        row(2).borders = [:top, :bottom]
      end
    end
  end

  def add_footer(pdf)
    pdf.move_down 40
    pdf.text "Дякуємо за співпрацю!", align: :center, style: :italic
    pdf.text "Цей документ згенеровано автоматично #{DateTime.now.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')}", 
             align: :center, size: 8, color: "999999"
  end

  def calculate_subtotal
    invoice_data[:items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price] }
  end

  def calculate_vat(subtotal)
    subtotal * VAT_RATE
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Конфігурація SMTP (створіть файл .env)
  # SMTP_ADDRESS=smtp.gmail.com

  # SMTP_FROM=billing@example.com

  Mail.defaults do
    delivery_method :smtp, {
      address: ENV['SMTP_ADDRESS'] || 'smtp.gmail.com',
      port: ENV['SMTP_PORT'] || 587,
      user_name: ENV['SMTP_USERNAME'],
      password: ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'],

      enable_starttls_auto: true

  end

  invoice_data = {
    invoice_number: "INV-2024-001",
    date: Date.today.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
    company_name: "ТОВ «Ваша Компанія»",
    company_address: "вул. Прикладна, 1, Київ, 01001",
    company_phone: "+380 44 123 4567",
    company_email: "billing@example.com",
    client_name: "ТОВ «Клієнт»",
    client_address: "вул. Клієнтська, 5, Львів, 79000",
    client_tax_id: "12345678",
    items: [
      { description: "Консультаційні послуги", quantity: 10, unit_price: 1500.00 },
      { description: "Розробка програмного забезпечення", quantity: 1, unit_price: 25000.00 },
      { description: "Технічна підтримка", quantity: 20, unit_price: 500.00 }
    ]
  }

  generator = InvoiceGenerator.new(invoice_data)
  
  # Генерація PDF
  pdf_path = generator.save_pdf
  puts "PDF збережено: #{pdf_path}"

  # Відправка електронною поштою
  begin
    generator.send_email(pdf_path, "client@example.com")

end
```

```ruby
module Bigcommerce
  class ProductService
    class << self
      def create(product)
        client = Bigcommerce::Client.new
        
        product_data = {
          name: product.name,
          type: 'physical',
          sku: product.sku,
          description: product.description,
          weight: product.weight,
          width: product.width,
          depth: product.depth,
          height: product.height,
          price: product.price,
          cost_price: product.cost_price,
          retail_price: product.retail_price,
          sale_price: product.sale_price,
          categories: product.category_ids,
          availability: 'available',
          is_visible: product.is_visible,
          inventory_level: product.inventory_level,
          inventory_tracking: 'sku',
          brand_name: product.brand_name,
          custom_url: product.custom_url
        }
        
        response = client.create_product(product_data)
        
        if response && response['data']
          product.update(
            bigcommerce_id: response['data']['id'],
            status: :synced
          )
          return response['data']
        else
          product.update(status: :failed)
          raise "Failed to create product: #{response.inspect}"
        end
      rescue => e
        product.update(status: :failed)
        Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce Product Creation Error: #{e.message}")
        raise
      end
      
      def update(product)
        return unless product.bigcommerce_id.present?
        
        client = Bigcommerce::Client.new
        
        product_data = {
          name: product.name,
          sku: product.sku,
          description: product.description,
          price: product.price,
          inventory_level: product.inventory_level,
          is_visible: product.is_visible
        }
        
        response = client.update_product(product.bigcommerce_id, product_data)
        
        if response && response['data']
          product.update(status: :synced)
          return response['data']
        else
          product.update(status: :failed)
          raise "Failed to update product: #{response.inspect}"
        end
      rescue => e
        product.update(status: :failed)
        Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce Product Update Error: #{e.message}")
        raise
      end
      
      def delete(product)
        return unless product.bigcommerce_id.present?
        
        client = Bigcommerce::Client.new
        client.delete_product(product.bigcommerce_id)
        
        product.destroy
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce Product Deletion Error: #{e.message}")
        raise
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### app/services/bigcommerce/order_service.rb

```ruby
module Bigcommerce
  class OrderService
    class << self
      def create(order)
        client = Bigcommerce::Client.new
        
        order_data = {
          customer_id: order.customer&.bigcommerce_customer_id,
          billing_address: format_address(order.billing_address),
          shipping_addresses: [format_address(order.shipping_address)],
          products: format_order_items(order),
          status_id: map_order_status(order.order_status),
          payment_method: order.payment_method,
          payment_provider_id: order.payment_provider_id,
          external_source: 'Rails App',
          custom_status: order.custom_status
        }
        
        response = client.create_order(order_data)
        
        if response && response['data']
          order.update(
            bigcommerce_id: response['data']['id'],
            status: :synced
          )
          return response['data']
        else
          order.update(status: :failed)
          raise "Failed to create order: #{response.inspect}"
        end
      rescue => e
        order.update(status: :failed)
        Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce Order Creation Error: #{e.message}")
        raise
      end
      
      def update(order)
        return unless order.bigcommerce_id.present?
        
        client = Bigcommerce::Client.new
        
        order_data = {
          status_id: map_order_status(order.order_status),
          custom_status: order.custom_status
        }
        
        response = client.update_order(order.bigcommerce_id, order_data)
        
        if response && response['data']
          order.update(status: :synced)
          return response['data']
        else
          order.update(status: :failed)
          raise "Failed to update order: #{response.inspect}"
        end
      rescue => e
        order.update(status: :failed)
        Rails.logger.error("BigCommerce Order Update Error: #{e.message}")
        raise
      end
      
      private
      
      def format_address(address)
        return {} unless address
        {
          first_name: address['first_name'],
          last_name: address['last_name'],
          company: address['company'],
          street_1: address['street_1'],
          street_2: address['street_2'],
          city: address['city'],
          state: address['state'],
          zip: address['zip'],
          country: address['country'],
          country_iso2: address['country_iso2'],
          phone: address['phone'],
          email: address['email']
        }.compact
      end
      
      def format_order_items(order)
        order.order_items.map do |item|
          {
            product_id: item.product.bigcommerce_id,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price_inc_tax: item.price,
            price_ex_tax: item.price
          }
        end
      end
      
      def map_order_status(status)
        case status.to_sym
        when :incomplete then 0
        when :completed then 2
        when :shipped then 3
        when :cancelled then 5
        else 0
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sequel'
require 'dotenv/load'

DB = Sequel.connect(
  adapter: 'postgres',
  host: ENV['DB_HOST'] || 'localhost',
  database: ENV['DB_NAME'] || 'shop_development',
  user: ENV['DB_USER'] || 'postgres',
  password: ENV['DB_PASSWORD'] || 'password'
)

# Модель замовлення
class Order < Sequel::Model
  plugin :timestamps, update_on_create: true
  
  def pending?
    status == 'pending'
  end
  
  def paid?
    status == 'paid'
  end
  
  def mark_as_paid!
    update(status: 'paid', paid_at: Time.now)
  end
  
  def mark_as_failed!
    update(status: 'failed', failed_at: Time.now)
  end
end
```

### services/mollie_service.rb

```ruby
require 'faraday'
require 'json'

class MollieService
  attr_reader :api_key, :base_url

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['MOLLIE_API_KEY']
    @base_url = 'https://api.mollie.com/v2'
  end

  def create_payment(order)
    payment_data = {
      amount: {
        currency: 'EUR',
        value: format('%.2f', order.total_amount)
      },
      description: "Order ##{order.id}",
      redirectUrl: ENV['MOLLIE_REDIRECT_URL'],
      webhookUrl: ENV['MOLLIE_WEBHOOK_URL'],
      metadata: {
        order_id: order.id
      }
    }

    response = connection.post('/payments') do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}"
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = payment_data.to_json
    end

    if response.success?
      payment = JSON.parse(response.body)
      order.update(
        mollie_payment_id: payment['id'],
        payment_url: payment.dig('_links', 'checkout', 'href')
      )
      payment
    else
      raise "Mollie API error: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_payment(payment_id)
    response = connection.get("/payments/#{payment_id}") do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}"
    end

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Mollie API error: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  private

  def connection
    @connection ||= Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.response :logger
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
  end
end
```

### app.rb

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'sinatra/json'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require_relative 'config/database'
require_relative 'services/mollie_service'

class ShopApp < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :show_exceptions, false
    set :raise_errors, false
    enable :logging
    
    # Встановлення обробника помилок
    error do
      status 500
      json error: { message: env['sinatra.error']&.message || 'Internal Server Error' }
    end
  end

  # Створення платежу для замовлення
  post '/orders/:id/pay' do
    order = Order[params[:id]]
    
    if order.nil?
      status 404
      return json error: { message: 'Order not found' }
    end

    unless order.pending?
      status 400
      return json error: { message: 'Order is not in pending state' }
    end

    mollie_service = MollieService.new
    payment = mollie_service.create_payment(order)

    json({
      payment_id: payment['id'],
      checkout_url: payment.dig('_links', 'checkout', 'href'),
      status: payment['status']
    })
  end

  # Вебхук від Mollie
  post '/webhooks/mollie' do
    request_body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    payment_id = request_body['id']
    
    if payment_id.nil?
      status 400
      return json error: { message: 'Payment ID is required' }
    end

    mollie_service = MollieService.new
    payment = mollie_service.get_payment(payment_id)
    
    # Отримуємо ID замовлення з метаданих
    order_id = payment.dig('metadata', 'order_id')
    order = Order[order_id]

    if order.nil?
      status 404
      return json error: { message: 'Order not found' }
    end

    # Обробляємо статус платежу
    case payment['status']
    when 'paid'
      order.mark_as_paid!
      # Тут можна додати додаткову логіку:
      # - Відправка email підтвердження
      # - Оновлення інвентарю
      # - Створення рахунку тощо
      
      json status: 'success', message: 'Order marked as paid'
    when 'failed', 'canceled', 'expired'
      order.mark_as_failed!
      json status: 'success', message: 'Order marked as failed'
    else
      # pending, open, authorized - ще не остаточний статус
      json status: 'pending', message: 'Payment is still processing'
    end
  end

  # Отримання статусу замовлення
  get '/orders/:id/status' do
    order = Order[params[:id]]
    
    if order.nil?
      status 404
      return json error: { message: 'Order not found' }
    end

    json({
      order_id: order.id,
      status: order.status,
      payment_id: order.mollie_payment_id,
      payment_url: order.payment_url,
      created_at: order.created_at,
      updated_at: order.updated_at
    })
  end
end
```

```ruby
require "chronic"

module NaturalDateParser
  module_function

  DEFAULT_OPTIONS = {
    context: :future,   # prefer future dates when ambiguous
    guess: true         # return a Time object rather than a Span
  }.freeze

  # Parses natural-language date/time strings.
  #
  # @param text [String] e.g. "next Friday at 5pm"
  # @param options [Hash] additional Chronic options
  # @return [Time, nil] the parsed time, or nil if parsing fails
  def parse(text, options = {})
    text = text.to_s.strip
    return nil if text.empty?

    Chronic.parse(text, DEFAULT_OPTIONS.merge(options))
  end

  # Like parse, but raises an ArgumentError when parsing fails.
  def parse!(text, options = {})
    parse(text, options) || raise(ArgumentError, "Could not parse date: #{text.inspect}")
  end
end

# Command-line example usage:
# ruby natural_date_parser.rb "next Friday at 5pm"
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  input = ARGV[0] || "next Friday at 5pm"
  puts NaturalDateParser.parse!(input)
end
```

text:
Here's a complete Ruby solution for tracking DHL Express parcels:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'nokogiri'
gem 'json'
gem 'date'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# dhl_tracker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class DHLTracker
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api-dhl.com'
  
  # DHL Express API endpoint for tracking
  TRACKING_ENDPOINT = '/track/shipments'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['DHL_API_KEY']
    raise ArgumentError, "DHL API key is required" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end
  
  def track(tracking_number)
    validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    
    response = make_tracking_request(tracking_number)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_tracking_response(response)
    else
      handle_error_response(response)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    if tracking_number.nil? || tracking_number.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Tracking number cannot be empty"
    end
    
    # DHL Express tracking numbers are typically 10 digits
    # but can vary by service type
    unless tracking_number.match?(/^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,30}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid DHL tracking number format"
    end
  end
  
  def make_tracking_request(tracking_number)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    query = {
      trackingNumber: tracking_number,
      service: 'express'
    }
    
    self.class.get(TRACKING_ENDPOINT, 
                   headers: headers, 
                   query: query,
                   timeout: 30)
  end
  
  def parse_tracking_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['shipments'] && !data['shipments'].empty?
      shipment = data['shipments'].first
      format_shipment_info(shipment)
    else
      { status: 'not_found', message: 'No shipment found with the provided tracking number' }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    { status: 'error', message: "Failed to parse API response: #{e.message}" }
  end
  
  def format_shipment_info(shipment)
    {
      status: 'success',
      tracking_number: shipment['trackingNumber'],
      service: shipment['service'],
      status_description: shipment.dig('status', 'description'),
      status_code: shipment.dig('status', 'code'),
      estimated_delivery: shipment.dig('estimatedDelivery', 'timestamp'),
      origin: format_address(shipment.dig('origin', 'address')),
      destination: format_address(shipment.dig('destination', 'address')),
      events: format_events(shipment['events'])
    }
  end
  
  def format_address(address)
    return nil unless address
    
    {
      city: address['city'],
      country: address['country'],
      postal_code: address['postalCode'],
      address_lines: address['addressLines'] || []
    }
  end
  
  def format_events(events)
    return [] unless events
    
    events.map do |event|
      {
        timestamp: event['timestamp'],
        location: format_address(event.dig('location', 'address')),
        description: event['description'],
        status: event['status']
      }
    end.sort_by { |e| e[:timestamp] }.reverse
  end
  
  def handle_error_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 401
      { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid API key' }
    when 404
      { status: 'not_found', message: 'Tracking number not found' }
    when 429
      { status: 'error', message: 'Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later' }
    else
      { status: 'error', message: "API error (HTTP #{response.code}): #{response.body}" }
    end
  end
end

# Alternative implementation using DHL's public tracking page scraping
class DHLPublicTracker
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://www.dhl.com'
  
  def track(tracking_number)
    validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/global-en/home/tracking.html",
      query: { trackingNumber: tracking_number },
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'
      },
      timeout: 30,
      follow_redirects: true
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_tracking_page(response.body)
    else
      { status: 'error', message: "Failed to fetch tracking information (HTTP #{response.code})" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    if tracking_number.nil? || tracking_number.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Tracking number cannot be empty"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_tracking_page(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Extract tracking information from the page
    # Note: Selectors may need to be updated based on DHL's actual HTML structure
    tracking_number = doc.at_css('.tracking-number')&.text&.strip
    status = doc.at_css('.shipment-status')&.text&.strip
    
    events = doc.css('.tracking-event').map do |event|
      {
        timestamp: event.at_css('.event-time')&.text&.strip,
        location: event.at_css('.event-location')&.text&.strip,
        description: event.at_css('.event-description')&.text&.strip
      }
    end
    
    if tracking_number
      {
        status: 'success',
        tracking_number: tracking_number,
        current_status: status,
        events: events
      }
    else
      { status: 'not_found', message: 'Tracking information not found' }
    end
  end
end

# CLI interface
class DHLTrackerCLI
  def self.run
    if ARGV.empty?
      puts "Usage: ruby dhl_tracker.rb <tracking_number>"
      puts "       ruby dhl_tracker.rb --api <tracking_number> (use API)"
      exit 1
    end
    
    use_api = ARGV[0] == '--api'
    tracking_number = use_api ? ARGV[1] : ARGV[0]
    
    tracker = if use_api
                DHLTracker.new(ENV['DHL_API_KEY'])
              else
                DHLPublicTracker.new
              end
    
    result = tracker.track(tracking_number)
    
    format_output(result)
  end
  
  def self.format_output(result)
    case result[:status]
    when 'success'
      puts "=" * 60
      puts "DHL Express Tracking"
      puts "=" * 60
      puts "Tracking Number: #{result[:tracking_number]}"
      puts "Service: #{result[:service]}" if result[:service]
      puts "Status: #{result[:status_description] || result[:current_status]}"
      puts "Estimated Delivery: #{result[:estimated_delivery]}" if result[:estimated_delivery]
      
      if result[:origin]
        puts "\nOrigin:"
        puts "  #{format_address_text(result[:origin])}"
      end
      
      if result[:destination]
        puts "\nDestination:"
        puts "  #{format_address_text(result[:destination])}"
      end
      
      if result[:events] && !result[:events].empty?
        puts "\nDelivery Events (most recent first):"
        puts "-" * 60
        result[:events].each_with_index do |event, index|
          puts "\n#{index + 1}. #{format_event(event)}"
        end
      end
      
    when 'not_found'
      puts "❌ #{result[:message]}"
    when 'error'
      puts "⚠️  Error: #{result[:message]}"
    else
      puts "Unknown response format"
    end
  end
  
  def self.format_address_text(address)
    parts = []
    parts.concat(address[:address_lines]) if address[:address_lines]
    parts << address[:city] if address[:city]
    parts << address[:postal_code] if address[:postal_code]
    parts << address[:country] if address[:country]
    parts.join(', ')
  end
  
  def self.format_event(event)
    time = event[:timestamp] ? DateTime.parse(event[:timestamp]).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') : 'Unknown time'
    location = event[:location] ? format_address_text(event[:location]) : 'Unknown location'
    description = event[:description] || event[:status] || 'Status update'
    
    "#{time} - #{location}\n   #{description}"
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  DHLTrackerCLI.run
end
```

## Example Usage

### Command Line

```bash
# Install dependencies
bundle install

# Track a package using the public website (no API key needed)
ruby dhl_tracker.rb 1234567890

# Track using the API (requires DHL_API_KEY environment variable)
export DHL_API_KEY="your_api_key_here"
ruby dhl_tracker.rb --api 1234567890
```

### In Your Ruby Code

```ruby
require_relative 'dhl_tracker'

# Using the API
tracker = DHLTracker.new('your_api_key')
result = tracker.track('1234567890')

# Using the public website (no API key required)
public_tracker = DHLPublicTracker.new
result = public_tracker.track('1234567890')

# Process the result
if result[:status] == 'success'
  puts "Package status: #{result[:status_description]}"
  result[:events].each do |event|
    puts "#{event[:timestamp]}: #{event[:description]} at #{event[:location]}"
  end
end
```

## Features

1. **Two tracking methods**: API-based (requires DHL API key) and public website scraping (no key required)
2. **Comprehensive event history**: Shows all tracking events sorted by date
3. **Error handling**: Gracefully handles invalid tracking numbers, API errors, and network issues
4. **Formatted output**: Clean CLI output with proper formatting
5. **Flexible usage**: Can be used as a CLI tool or integrated into other Ruby applications

## Notes

- For production use with the API, you'll need to register for a DHL Express API key
- The public website scraper may break if DHL changes their HTML structure
- Consider adding rate limiting and caching for high-volume tracking
- The API implementation assumes DHL's standard REST API structure - you may need to adjust endpoints based on your specific DHL API access level

## Implementation

### lib/german_tax_validator.rb

```ruby
require 'active_model'

# Validation module for German tax numbers
module GermanTaxValidator
  # Validator for German Steuer-ID (Tax Identification Number)
  class SteuerIdValidator < ActiveModel::EachValidator
    def validate_each(record, attribute, value)
      return if value.blank? && options[:allow_blank]
      
      unless GermanTaxValidator::SteuerId.valid?(value)
        record.errors.add(attribute, options[:message] || :invalid_steuer_id)
      end
    end
  end

  # Validator for German VAT number (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer)
  class VatValidator < ActiveModel::EachValidator
    def validate_each(record, attribute, value)
      return if value.blank? && options[:allow_blank]
      
      unless GermanTaxValidator::VatNumber.valid?(value)
        record.errors.add(attribute, options[:message] || :invalid_vat_number)
      end
    end
  end

  # German Tax Identification Number (Steuer-ID) validation
  module SteuerId
    class << self
      def valid?(number)
        return false if number.nil?
        
        # Remove any whitespace
        number = number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
        
        # Must be exactly 11 digits
        return false unless number.match?(/^\d{11}$/)
        
        # Check that not all digits are the same
        return false if number.chars.uniq.length == 1
        
        # Validate checksum
        validate_checksum(number)
      end

      private

      def validate_checksum(number)
        digits = number.chars.map(&:to_i)
        
        # The 11th digit is the check digit
        check_digit = digits[10]
        calculation_digits = digits[0..9]
        
        # Calculate the checksum
        product = 10
        calculation_digits.each do |digit|
          sum = (digit + product) % 10
          sum = 10 if sum == 0
          product = (2 * sum) % 11
        end
        
        check_value = 11 - product
        check_value = 0 if check_value == 10
        
        check_value == check_digit
      end
    end
  end

  # German VAT number (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer) validation
  module VatNumber
    class << self
      def valid?(number)
        return false if number.nil?
        
        # Normalize: remove spaces, dots, and dashes
        normalized = normalize(number)
        
        # Check basic format: DE followed by 9 digits
        return false unless normalized.match?(/^DE\d{9}$/)
        
        # Extract digits and validate checksum
        digits = normalized[2..-1]
        validate_checksum(digits)
      end

      private

      def normalize(number)
        number.to_s
              .upcase
              .gsub(/[\s\.\-\/]/, '')
              .gsub(/^DEUTSCHLAND/, 'DE')
      end

      def validate_checksum(digits)
        # The first 8 digits are the base number, the 9th is the check digit
        base_digits = digits[0..7].chars.map(&:to_i)
        check_digit = digits[8].to_i
        
        # Calculate checksum using mod-10 algorithm
        sum = 0
        base_digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
          if index.even?
            sum += digit * 1
          else
            sum += digit * 2
          end
        end
        
        calculated_check = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
        
        calculated_check == check_digit
      end
    end
  end
end
```

Task: Fill a PDF form (AcroForm) with data from a model and flatten it.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

# Pure-Ruby PDF library with AcroForm filling and flattening.
# Note: HexaPDF is licensed under AGPL-3.0 (a commercial license is available).
gem "hexapdf", "~> 1.0"
```

Run `bundle install`. No external tools such as pdftk are needed.

## Implementation

```ruby
# fill_pdf_form.rb
require "bundler/setup"
require "hexapdf"
require "date"

# Fills an AcroForm PDF template from a model object and flattens it, so the
# result is plain, non-editable page content.
#
# mapping: { "pdf_field_name" => source }
# where source is one of:
#   - Symbol / String : method name or dotted path on the model ("address.city")
#   - Proc            : called with the model, returns the value
class PdfFormFiller
  class MissingFieldError < StandardError; end

  AF = HexaPDF::Type::AcroForm

  def initialize(template_path, mapping, strict: true)
    @template_path = template_path
    @mapping       = mapping
    @strict        = strict # raise if a mapped field is missing from the PDF
  end

  def call(model, output_path)
    doc  = HexaPDF::Document.open(@template_path)
    form = doc.acro_form
    raise ArgumentError, "#{@template_path} has no AcroForm" unless form

    # Drop XFA data if present so viewers use the AcroForm content we fill in.
    form.delete(:XFA) if form.key?(:XFA)

    @mapping.each do |field_name, source|
      field = form.field_by_name(field_name)
      if field.nil?
        raise MissingFieldError, "PDF field not found: #{field_name}" if @strict
        warn "Skipping missing PDF field: #{field_name}"
        next
      end
      assign(field, resolve(model, source))
    end

    # Generates appearance streams for the filled fields, merges them into the
    # page content, and removes the interactive form elements.
    form.flatten

    doc.write(output_path, optimize: true)
    output_path
  end

  private

  def resolve(model, source)
    case source
    when Proc
      source.call(model)
    when Symbol, String
      source.to_s.split(".").reduce(model) do |obj, meth|
        obj.nil? ? nil : obj.public_send(meth)
      end
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported mapping source: #{source.inspect}"
    end
  end

  def assign(field, value)
    case field
    when AF::CheckBox
      truthy?(value) ? field.check : field.uncheck
    when AF::RadioButton
      field.field_value = value.to_s.to_sym unless value.nil? || value.to_s.empty?
    when AF::ComboBox, AF::ListBox
      field.field_value = format(value) unless value.nil?
    when AF::TextField
      field.field_value = format(value)
    else
      warn "Unsupported field type #{field.class} for #{field.full_name}"
    end
  end

  def format(value)
    case value
    when Date, Time, DateTime then value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    when nil                  then ""
    else value.to_s
    end
  end

  def truthy?(value)
    case value
    when String then %w[true yes y 1 on x].include?(value.strip.downcase)
    else !!value
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example usage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  Address = Struct.new(:street, :city, :zip, keyword_init: true)
  Person  = Struct.new(:first_name, :last_name, :birth_date, :newsletter,
                       :gender, :country, :address, keyword_init: true) do
    def full_name = "#{first_name} #{last_name}"
  end

  person = Person.new(
    first_name: "Ada",
    last_name: "Lovelace",
    birth_date: Date.new(1815, 12, 10),
    newsletter: true,
    gender: "female",
    country: "UK",
    address: Address.new(street: "12 St James's Sq", city: "London", zip: "SW1Y 4JH")
  )

  mapping = {
    "full_name"   => :full_name,
    "birth_date"  => :birth_date,
    "street"      => "address.street",
    "city"        => "address.city",
    "zip"         => "address.zip",
    "newsletter"  => :newsletter,                      # check box
    "gender"      => :gender,                          # radio group
    "country"     => ->(p) { p.country.upcase }        # combo/list box
  }

  filler = PdfFormFiller.new("template.pdf", mapping, strict: false)
  puts "Wrote #{filler.call(person, 'filled_flattened.pdf')}"
end
```

## Notes

- **Field names:** To list the names in your template, run `HexaPDF::Document.open("template.pdf").acro_form.each_field { |f| puts "#{f.full_name} (#{f.class})" }`.
- **Radio buttons and check boxes:** The value you pass for a radio group must match one of its export names. Check boxes accept booleans or strings such as `"yes"`.
- **Fonts:** Text appearances use the font from each field's default appearance string, typically a standard Helvetica. Standard fonts only cover Latin/WinAnsi characters, so for other scripts you would need to set a TrueType font in the field's default appearance.
- **Flattening:** `form.flatten` is called after all values are set, so the output has no editable fields left.

Task: Validate a Ukrainian IBAN (UA, 29 characters) and extract the bank MFO code from it.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 2.7"

# The validator itself uses only the Ruby standard library.
# minitest is only needed to run the tests below.
gem "minitest", "~> 5.20", group: :test
```

## ukrainian_iban.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Validation and parsing of Ukrainian IBANs.
#
# Structure (29 characters):
#   UA  kk  BBBBBB  CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC
#   |   |   |       +-- 19-character account number (digits/uppercase letters)
#   |   |   +---------- 6-digit bank MFO code
#   |   +-------------- 2 check digits (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10)
#   +------------------ country code
module UkrainianIban
  COUNTRY_CODE = "UA"
  LENGTH       = 29
  FORMAT       = /\AUA\d{2}(?<mfo>\d{6})(?<account>[0-9A-Z]{19})\z/

  Result = Struct.new(:valid, :iban, :mfo, :account_number, :error, keyword_init: true) do
    def valid?
      valid
    end
  end

  module_function

  # Removes spaces/hyphens and upcases.
  def normalize(input)
    input.to_s.gsub(/[\s-]/, "").upcase
  end

  # Returns true if the IBAN is a valid Ukrainian IBAN.
  def valid?(input)
    parse(input).valid?
  end

  # Returns the 6-digit MFO code, or nil if the IBAN is invalid.
  def extract_mfo(input)
    parse(input).mfo
  end

  # Full validation; returns a Result with details or an error message.
  def parse(input)
    iban = normalize(input)

    return failure(iban, "IBAN is empty") if iban.empty?
    return failure(iban, "must start with #{COUNTRY_CODE}") unless iban.start_with?(COUNTRY_CODE)
    return failure(iban, "must be #{LENGTH} characters long (got #{iban.length})") unless iban.length == LENGTH

    match = FORMAT.match(iban)
    return failure(iban, "invalid format: expected UA + 2 digits + 6-digit MFO + 19 alphanumeric characters") unless match

    return failure(iban, "checksum (MOD 97-10) verification failed") unless checksum_valid?(iban)

    Result.new(valid: true, iban: iban, mfo: match[:mfo], account_number: match[:account], error: nil)
  end

  # ISO 7064 MOD 97-10: move first 4 chars to the end, map letters to 10..35,
  # the resulting number mod 97 must equal 1.
  def checksum_valid?(iban)
    numeric_string(iban[4..] + iban[0, 4]).to_i % 97 == 1
  end

  # Computes the two check digits for a given MFO and 19-char account number.
  def check_digits(mfo, account_number)
    bban = "#{mfo}#{account_number.to_s.rjust(19, '0')}".upcase
    remainder = numeric_string("#{bban}#{COUNTRY_CODE}00").to_i % 97
    format("%02d", 98 - remainder)
  end

  # Builds a full IBAN from an MFO and an account number.
  def build(mfo, account_number)
    account = account_number.to_s.rjust(19, "0").upcase
    "#{COUNTRY_CODE}#{check_digits(mfo, account)}#{mfo}#{account}"
  end

  def numeric_string(str)
    str.each_char.map { |c| c =~ /\d/ ? c : (c.ord - "A".ord + 10).to_s }.join
  end

  def failure(iban, message)
    Result.new(valid: false, iban: iban, mfo: nil, account_number: nil, error: message)
  end
  private_class_method :failure
end

# CLI usage: ruby ukrainian_iban.rb "UA21 3223 1300 0002 6007 2335 6600 1"
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  ARGV.each do |arg|
    r = UkrainianIban.parse(arg)
    if r.valid?
      puts "#{r.iban}: valid, MFO=#{r.mfo}, account=#{r.account_number}"
    else
      puts "#{r.iban}: INVALID (#{r.error})"
    end
  end
end
```

## ukrainian_iban_test.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "ukrainian_iban"

class UkrainianIbanTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @iban = UkrainianIban.build("322313", "26007233566")  # generated with correct check digits
  end

  def test_built_iban_is_valid
    assert_equal 29, @iban.length
    assert UkrainianIban.valid?(@iban)
  end

  def test_extracts_mfo
    assert_equal "322313", UkrainianIban.extract_mfo(@iban)
  end

  def test_accepts_spaces_and_lowercase
    spaced = @iban.scan(/.{1,4}/).join(" ").downcase
    assert UkrainianIban.valid?(spaced)
    assert_equal "322313", UkrainianIban.extract_mfo(spaced)
  end

  def test_rejects_bad_checksum
    bad = @iban.dup
    bad[-1] = (bad[-1].to_i + 1).to_s[-1]
    refute UkrainianIban.valid?(bad)
    assert_match(/checksum/, UkrainianIban.parse(bad).error)
  end

  def test_rejects_wrong_length
    refute UkrainianIban.valid?(@iban[0..-2])
    assert_nil UkrainianIban.extract_mfo(@iban + "0")
  end

  def test_rejects_other_country
    refute UkrainianIban.valid?("DE89370400440532013000")
  end

  def test_rejects_empty_and_nil
    refute UkrainianIban.valid?("")
    refute UkrainianIban.valid?(nil)
  end
end
```

```
ruby ukrainian_iban.rb "UA21 3223 1300 0002 6007 2335 6600 1"
```

The validator normalizes the input by stripping spaces and hyphens and upcasing. It then checks the `UA` prefix, the 29-character length, and the format: 2 check digits, a 6-digit MFO, and a 19-character alphanumeric account number. Finally it runs the ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum. For a valid IBAN, the MFO is characters 5–10 (`extract_mfo` returns `nil` otherwise). The `build` and `check_digits` helpers generate valid IBANs, which the tests use.

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for fetching Etsy shop listings and orders through the Etsy Open API v3:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8.1'
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'
gem 'oauth2', '~> 2.0'
```

## Implementation

### etsy_client.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  
  attr_reader :client, :access_token, :shop_id
  
  def initialize(access_token: nil, refresh_token: nil, shop_id: nil)
    @access_token = access_token || ENV['ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @refresh_token = refresh_token || ENV['ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    @shop_id = shop_id || ENV['ETSY_SHOP_ID']
    
    unless @access_token && @shop_id
      raise ArgumentError, "Access token and shop ID are required"
    end
    
    setup_oauth_client
    refresh_access_token if @refresh_token
  end
  
  # Get shop information
  def get_shop
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{@shop_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get all active listings for the shop
  def get_listings(limit: 100, offset: 0, state: 'active')
    query = {
      limit: limit,
      offset: offset,
      state: state
    }
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{@shop_id}/listings",
      headers: auth_headers,
      query: query
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get a specific listing by ID
  def get_listing(listing_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/listings/#{listing_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get all listings with pagination
  def get_all_listings(state: 'active', page_size: 100)
    all_listings = []
    offset = 0
    
    loop do
      response = get_listings(limit: page_size, offset: offset, state: state)
      listings = response['results'] || []
      
      all_listings.concat(listings)
      
      # Check if we've reached the end
      total = response['count'] || 0
      break if all_listings.length >= total || listings.empty?
      
      offset += page_size
    end
    
    all_listings
  end
  
  # Get shop receipts (orders)
  def get_orders(limit: 100, offset: 0, status: nil)
    query = {
      limit: limit,
      offset: offset
    }
    
    # Add status filter if provided
    query[:status] = status if status
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{@shop_id}/receipts",
      headers: auth_headers,
      query: query
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get all orders with pagination
  def get_all_orders(status: nil, page_size: 100)
    all_orders = []
    offset = 0
    
    loop do
      response = get_orders(limit: page_size, offset: offset, status: status)
      orders = response['results'] || []
      
      all_orders.concat(orders)
      
      # Check if we've reached the end
      total = response['count'] || 0
      break if all_orders.length >= total || orders.empty?
      
      offset += page_size
    end
    
    all_orders
  end
  
  # Get a specific order by receipt ID
  def get_order(receipt_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{@shop_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get listings purchased in a specific order
  def get_order_listings(receipt_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{@shop_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}/listings",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get listing images
  def get_listing_images(listing_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/listings/#{listing_id}/images",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get listing variations (if applicable)
  def get_listing_variations(listing_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/listings/#{listing_id}/variations",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def setup_oauth_client
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['ETSY_API_KEY'],
      ENV['ETSY_API_SECRET'],
      site: BASE_URL,
      authorize_url: 'https://www.etsy.com/oauth/connect',
      token_url: 'https://api.etsy.com/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end
  
  def refresh_access_token
    token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      @client,
      @access_token,
      refresh_token: @refresh_token,
      expires_at: Time.now.to_i + 3600 # Assume expired
    )
    
    begin
      new_token = token.refresh!
      @access_token = new_token.token
      @refresh_token = new_token.refresh_token
      
      # Optionally save the new tokens
      save_tokens(@access_token, @refresh_token)
      
      puts "Access token refreshed successfully"
    rescue OAuth2::Error => e
      puts "Failed to refresh token: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end
  
  def save_tokens(access_token, refresh_token)
    # Save tokens to a file or database for future use
    # This is a simple example - in production, use a secure storage solution
    File.write('.etsy_tokens.json', JSON.pretty_generate({
      access_token: access_token,
      refresh_token: refresh_token,
      updated_at: Time.now.iso8601
    }))
  end
  
  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => ENV['ETSY_API_KEY']
    }
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      if @refresh_token
        refresh_access_token
        # Retry the request once after refreshing
        retry_request
      else
        raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
      end
    when 403
      raise "Forbidden: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise "Not found: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "API error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def retry_request
    # This is a simplified retry - in production, you'd want to re-execute the original request
    puts "Token refreshed, please retry your request"
  end
end
```

### example_usage.rb

```ruby
require_relative 'etsy_client'

# Initialize the Etsy client
client = EtsyClient.new

# Get shop information
begin
  shop = client.get_shop
  puts "Shop Name: #{shop['shop_name']}"
  puts "Shop Title: #{shop['title']}"
rescue => e
  puts "Error getting shop: #{e.message}"
end

# Get all active listings
begin
  listings = client.get_all_listings(state: 'active')
  puts "\nTotal active listings: #{listings.length}"
  
  listings.each do |listing|
    puts "- #{listing['title']} (ID: #{listing['listing_id']})"
    puts "  Price: #{listing['price']['amount']} #{listing['price']['currency_code']}"
    puts "  URL: #{listing['url']}"
    
    # Get listing images
    images = client.get_listing_images(listing['listing_id'])
    if images['results'] && images['results'].any?
      puts "  Main image: #{images['results'][0]['url_570xN']}"
    end
    puts ""
  end
rescue => e
  puts "Error getting listings: #{e.message}"
end

# Get all orders (receipts)
begin
  orders = client.get_all_orders
  puts "\nTotal orders: #{orders.length}"
  
  orders.each do |order|
    puts "- Order ID: #{order['receipt_id']}"
    puts "  Buyer: #{order['buyer_user_id']}"
    puts "  Total: #{order['total_price']['amount']} #{order['total_price']['currency_code']}"
    puts "  Status: #{order['status']}"
    puts "  Created: #{order['created_timestamp']}"
    
    # Get listings in this order
    order_listings = client.get_order_listings(order['receipt_id'])
    if order_listings['results'] && order_listings['results'].any?
      puts "  Items:"
      order_listings['results'].each do |item|
        puts "    - #{item['title']} (Qty: #{item['quantity']})"
      end
    end
    puts ""
  end
rescue => e
  puts "Error getting orders: #{e.message}"
end

# Get a specific order
begin
  specific_order = client.get_order(123456789) # Replace with actual receipt ID
  puts "\nSpecific order details:"
  puts JSON.pretty_generate(specific_order)
rescue => e
  puts "Error getting specific order: #{e.message}"
end
```

```ruby
require 'oauth2'

class EtsyOAuthSetup

    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(

      token_url: 'https://api.etsy.com/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end
  
  def generate_authorization_url
    @client.auth_code.authorize_url(
      redirect_uri: 'https://localhost:3000/callback',
      scope: 'listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w shops_r'
    )
  end
  
  def get_access_token(authorization_code)
    token = @client.auth_code.get_token(
      authorization_code,
      redirect_uri: 'https://localhost:3000/callback'
    )
    
    {
      access_token: token.token,
      refresh_token: token.refresh_token,
      expires_in: token.expires_in
    }
  end
end
```

## Setup Instructions

1. **Install dependencies:**
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. **Get Etsy API credentials:**
   - Go to https://www.etsy.com/developers/
   - Create a new app to get your API key and secret
   - Set up OAuth 2.0 to get access and refresh tokens
   - Find your shop ID in your Etsy shop URL

3. **Configure environment variables:**

Task: Call a customer with a voice message through the Binotel telephony API.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.9"
```

(`json`, `uri`, and `optparse` ship with Ruby's standard library, so they need no entries.)

## binotel_voice_call.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/setup"
require "faraday"
require "json"

# Minimal client for the Binotel REST API (JSON over HTTPS, key/secret in body).
#
# NOTE: The endpoint path and the parameter names for the "call with voice
# message" method below are based on my recollection of Binotel's docs.
# Check them against your account's API documentation and adjust the
# constants if they differ.
module Binotel
  class Error < StandardError
    attr_reader :code

    def initialize(message, code: nil)
      super(message)
      @code = code
    end
  end

  class Client
    BASE_URL = "https://api.binotel.com/api/4.0/"

    # Adjust here if your API version uses different names.
    VOICE_CALL_ENDPOINT   = "calls/call-with-announcement"
    PARAM_PHONE           = "externalNumber"
    PARAM_VOICE_MESSAGE   = "announcementId"

    def initialize(key:, secret:, base_url: BASE_URL, timeout: 15)
      raise ArgumentError, "Binotel API key is required"    if key.to_s.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Binotel API secret is required" if secret.to_s.empty?

      @key = key
      @secret = secret
      @conn = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |f|
        f.options.timeout = timeout
        f.options.open_timeout = 5
        f.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end

    # Calls a customer and plays a pre-uploaded voice message.
    #
    # phone            - customer's phone number (digits, optional leading +)
    # voice_message_id - ID of the voice message/announcement in Binotel
    #
    # Returns the parsed API response Hash on success; raises Binotel::Error otherwise.
    def call_with_voice_message(phone:, voice_message_id:)
      number = normalize_phone(phone)
      post(
        VOICE_CALL_ENDPOINT,
        PARAM_PHONE => number,
        PARAM_VOICE_MESSAGE => voice_message_id
      )
    end

    private

    def normalize_phone(phone)
      digits = phone.to_s.gsub(/[^\d]/, "")
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid phone number: #{phone.inspect}" if digits.length < 9

      digits
    end

    def post(endpoint, params = {})
      payload = { "key" => @key, "secret" => @secret }.merge(params)
      response = @conn.post("#{endpoint}.json", JSON.generate(payload))

      unless response.success?
        raise Error.new("HTTP #{response.status} from Binotel: #{response.body}")
      end

      data = parse_json(response.body)

      if data["status"] != "success"
        raise Error.new(
          "Binotel API error: #{data['message'] || 'unknown error'}",
          code: data["code"]
        )
      end

      data
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise Error.new("Network error talking to Binotel: #{e.message}")
    end

    def parse_json(body)
      JSON.parse(body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error.new("Invalid JSON from Binotel: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
end

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Command-line usage:
#
#   export BINOTEL_KEY=your_key
#   export BINOTEL_SECRET=your_secret
#   bundle exec ruby binotel_voice_call.rb +380441234567 42
#
# where 42 is the ID of the voice message uploaded in your Binotel account.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  phone, message_id = ARGV

  if phone.nil? || message_id.nil?
    warn "Usage: #{$PROGRAM_NAME} <phone> <voice_message_id>"
    exit 1
  end

  begin
    client = Binotel::Client.new(
      key: ENV.fetch("BINOTEL_KEY"),
      secret: ENV.fetch("BINOTEL_SECRET")
    )

    result = client.call_with_voice_message(phone: phone, voice_message_id: message_id)
    puts "Call started successfully:"
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(result)
  rescue KeyError => e
    warn "Missing environment variable: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue ArgumentError, Binotel::Error => e
    warn "Error: #{e.message}"
    exit 2
  end
end
```

## Notes

- **Credentials**: the API key and secret come from environment variables, so they stay out of the source.
- **Auth**: Binotel expects `key` and `secret` in the JSON body of each POST, which is what `post` does.
- **Errors**: HTTP failures, timeouts, malformed JSON, and `status: "error"` responses are all raised as `Binotel::Error`. The API's error code is available through `#code`.
- **Verify before use**: I'm not certain of the exact endpoint name (`calls/call-with-announcement`) or its parameter names (`externalNumber`, `announcementId`). Confirm them in your Binotel API docs. If they differ, only the three constants at the top of `Client` need changing.

```ruby
# fcm_client.rb
require "json"
require "net/http"
require "uri"
require "stringio"
require "googleauth"

class FirebaseCloudMessaging
  FCM_SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging".freeze
  FCM_SCOPES = [FCM_SCOPE].freeze
  FCM_ENDPOINT = "https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/%s/messages:send".freeze

  # project_id:        Firebase/GCP project ID
  # credentials_path:  optional path to a Firebase service account JSON file
  # json_key:          optional JSON key string instead of a file path
  def initialize(project_id:, credentials_path: nil, json_key: nil)
    @project_id = project_id
    @credentials_path = credentials_path || ENV["FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH"]
    @json_key = json_key

    raise ArgumentError, "project_id is required" if @project_id.to_s.empty?
  end

  # Send a message to a single device token.
  def send_to_token(token:, title: nil, body: nil, data: {}, android: nil, apns: nil, notification: nil)
    message = { token: token }
    build_message(
      message,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      android: android,
      apns: apns,
      notification: notification
    )
    send_message(message)
  end

  # Send a message to a topic, e.g. topic: "news"
  def send_to_topic(topic:, title: nil, body: nil, data: {}, android: nil, apns: nil, notification: nil)
    message = { topic: topic }
    build_message(
      message,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      android: android,
      apns: apns,
      notification: notification
    )
    send_message(message)
  end

  # Send a message to a condition, e.g. "'iOS' in topics || 'Android' in topics"
  def send_to_condition(condition:, title: nil, body: nil, data: {}, android: nil, apns: nil, notification: nil)
    message = { condition: condition }
    build_message(
      message,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      android: android,
      apns: apns,
      notification: notification
    )
    send_message(message)
  end

  # Accepts a pre-built FCM v1 message hash and sends it.
  def send_message(message)
    uri = URI(format(FCM_ENDPOINT, @project_id))

    request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
    request["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{access_token}"
    request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    request.body = JSON.generate(message: message)

    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.hostname, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 10

    response = http.request(request)

    unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
      raise "FCM request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  private

  def build_message(message, title:, body:, data:, android:, apns:, notification:)
    common_notification = {}
    (notification || {}).each { |key, value| common_notification[key.to_s] = value }
    common_notification["title"] = title if title && !common_notification.key?("title")
    common_notification["body"] = body if body && !common_notification.key?("body")

    message[:notification] = common_notification unless common_notification.empty?
    message[:data] = stringify_values(data) if data && !data.empty?
    message[:android] = android if android && !android.empty?
    message[:apns] = apns if apns && !apns.empty?

    message
  end

  def stringify_values(hash)
    hash.each_with_object({}) do |(key, value), result|
      result[key.to_s] = value.to_s
    end
  end

  def access_token
    credentials.fetch_access_token!["access_token"]
  end

  def credentials
    @credentials ||= begin
      key = @json_key
      key ||= File.read(@credentials_path) if @credentials_path

      if key
        Google::Auth::ServiceAccountCredentials.make_creds(
          json_key_io: StringIO.new(key),
          scope: FCM_SCOPES
        )
      else
        Google::Auth.get_application_default(FCM_SCOPES)
      end
    end
  end
end

# Usage example:
#
# client = FirebaseCloudMessaging.new(
#   project_id: "your-firebase-project-id",
#   credentials_path: "./service-account.json"
# )
#
# client.send_to_token(
#   token: "device-registration-token",
#   title: "Hello",
#   body: "World",
#   data: { "route" => "home" },
#   android: {
#     priority: "high",
#     notification: { channel_id: "default", sound: "default" }
#   },
#   apns: {
#     headers: { "apns-priority" => "10" },
#     payload: {
#       aps: {
#         sound: "default",
#         badge: 1
#       }
#     }
#   }
# )
```

```ruby
require 'oauth2'

Dotenv.load

module QuickBooks
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :client_id, :client_secret, :redirect_uri, 
                  :environment, :access_token, :refresh_token, 
                  :realm_id, :token_expires_at

    def initialize
      @client_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID']
      @client_secret = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET']
      @redirect_uri = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI']
      @environment = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'sandbox'
      @access_token = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN']
      @refresh_token = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN']
      @realm_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
      @token_expires_at = Time.parse(ENV['QUICKBOOKS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT'] || Time.now.to_s)
    end

    def base_url
      if environment == 'production'
        'https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com'
      else
        'https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com'
      end
    end
  end

  class << self
    attr_writer :configuration
  end

  def self.configuration
    @configuration ||= Configuration.new
  end

  def self.configure
    yield(configuration)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/initializers/quickbooks'

class QuickBooksClient
  include HTTParty

  attr_reader :config, :logger

  def initialize(config = QuickBooks.configuration)
    @config = config
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    setup_http_client
  end

  def setup_http_client
    self.class.base_uri config.base_url
    self.class.headers 'Accept' => 'application/json',
                       'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  end

  def oauth_client
    @oauth_client ||= OAuth2::Client.new(
      config.client_id,
      config.client_secret,
      site: config.base_url,
      authorize_url: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
      token_url: 'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
    )
  end

  def access_token
    @access_token ||= OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      oauth_client,
      config.access_token,
      refresh_token: config.refresh_token,
      expires_at: config.token_expires_at.to_i
    )
  end

  def refresh_token_if_needed
    if access_token.expired?
      logger.info "Token expired, refreshing..."
      @access_token = access_token.refresh!
      update_env_tokens(@access_token)
      logger.info "Token refreshed successfully"
    end
    @access_token
  end

  def update_env_tokens(token)
    config.access_token = token.token
    config.refresh_token = token.refresh_token
    config.token_expires_at = Time.at(token.expires_at)
    
    # Update .env file for persistence
    env_file = '.env'
    if File.exist?(env_file)
      content = File.read(env_file)
      content.gsub!(/QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN=.*/, "QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN=#{token.token}")
      content.gsub!(/QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN=.*/, "QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN=#{token.refresh_token}")
      content.gsub!(/QUICKBOOKS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT=.*/, "QUICKBOOKS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT=#{Time.at(token.expires_at).iso8601}")
      File.write(env_file, content)
    end
  end

  def headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token.token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def get_invoice(invoice_id)
    refresh_token_if_needed
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/invoice/#{invoice_id}",
      headers: headers
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def create_invoice(invoice_data)
    refresh_token_if_needed
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/invoice",
      headers: headers,
      body: invoice_data.to_json
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def update_invoice(invoice_id, invoice_data)
    refresh_token_if_needed
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/invoice",
      headers: headers,
      body: invoice_data.merge('Id' => invoice_id, 'sparse' => true).to_json
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def mark_invoice_paid(invoice_id)
    refresh_token_if_needed
    
    # Get current invoice
    invoice = get_invoice(invoice_id)
    return nil unless invoice
    
    # Update invoice status to paid
    paid_invoice = invoice.merge(
      'Balance' => 0,
      'TxnDate' => Date.today.iso8601,
      'PrivateNote' => "Paid on #{Date.today}"
    )
    
    update_invoice(invoice_id, paid_invoice)
  end

  def create_payment(invoice_id, payment_data)
    refresh_token_if_needed
    
    payment = {
      'TotalAmt' => payment_data[:amount],
      'CustomerRef' => payment_data[:customer_ref],
      'TxnDate' => Date.today.iso8601,
      'PaymentMethodRef' => payment_data[:payment_method_ref] || { 'value' => '1' },
      'Line' => [
        {
          'Amount' => payment_data[:amount],
          'LinkedTxn' => [
            {
              'TxnId' => invoice_id,
              'TxnType' => 'Invoice'
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/payment",
      headers: headers,
      body: payment.to_json
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def list_invoices(query_params = {})
    refresh_token_if_needed
    query_string = build_query_string(query_params)
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/query?query=#{query_string}",
      headers: headers
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  def get_unpaid_invoices
    query = "SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE Balance > '0'"
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v3/company/#{config.realm_id}/query?query=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(query)}",
      headers: headers
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_query_string(params)
    return '' if params.empty?
    
    query_parts = params.map do |key, value|
      "#{key} = '#{value}'"
    end
    
    "SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE #{query_parts.join(' AND ')}"
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200, 201
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      logger.error "Authentication error: #{response.body}"
      nil
    when 404
      logger.error "Resource not found: #{response.body}"
      nil
    else
      logger.error "API error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    logger.error "JSON parsing error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'quickbooks_client'

class InvoiceExporter
  attr_reader :client, :logger

  def initialize(client = QuickBooksClient.new)
    @client = client
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def export_paid_invoices
    logger.info "Starting invoice export process..."
    
    # Get all unpaid invoices
    unpaid_invoices = client.get_unpaid_invoices
    return [] unless unpaid_invoices
    
    invoices = unpaid_invoices.dig('QueryResponse', 'Invoice') || []
    logger.info "Found #{invoices.length} unpaid invoices"
    
    exported_invoices = []
    
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      begin
        if invoice_paid?(invoice)
          logger.info "Invoice #{invoice['Id']} is paid, exporting..."
          
          # Create payment record
          payment_result = client.create_payment(
            invoice['Id'],
            amount: invoice['Balance'],
            customer_ref: invoice['CustomerRef']
          )
          
          if payment_result
            logger.info "Payment created for invoice #{invoice['Id']}"
            exported_invoices << {
              invoice_id: invoice['Id'],
              payment_id: payment_result.dig('Payment', 'Id'),
              amount: invoice['Balance'],
              status: 'exported'
            }
          end
        end
      rescue => e
        logger.error "Error processing invoice #{invoice['Id']}: #{e.message}"
        exported_invoices << {
          invoice_id: invoice['Id'],
          status: 'error',
          error: e.message
        }
      end
    end
    
    logger.info "Export completed. Processed #{exported_invoices.length} invoices"
    exported_invoices
  end

  def export_single_invoice(invoice_id)
    logger.info "Exporting invoice #{invoice_id}..."
    
    invoice = client.get_invoice(invoice_id)
    return nil unless invoice
    
    invoice_data = invoice['Invoice']
    
    if invoice_data['Balance'].to_f > 0
      logger.info "Invoice #{invoice_id} has balance #{invoice_data['Balance']}"
      
      # Mark as paid and create payment
      payment_result = client.create_payment(
        invoice_id,
        amount: invoice_data['Balance'],
        customer_ref: invoice_data['CustomerRef']
      )
      
      if payment_result
        logger.info "Successfully exported invoice #{invoice_id}"
        {
          invoice_id: invoice_id,
          payment_id: payment_result.dig('Payment', 'Id'),
          amount: invoice_data['Balance'],
          status: 'exported'
        }
      end
    else
      logger.info "Invoice #{invoice_id} is already paid"
      {
        invoice_id: invoice_id,
        status: 'already_paid'
      }
    end
  rescue => e
    logger.error "Error exporting invoice #{invoice_id}: #{e.message}"
    {
      invoice_id: invoice_id,
      status: 'error',
      error: e.message
    }
  end

  private

  def invoice_paid?(invoice)
    # Check if invoice balance is zero or negative
    balance = invoice['Balance'].to_f
    balance <= 0
  end
end
```
